Coarse hemp cord from your pouch bites into your palms as you lash the wet planks side by side, building a flat litter broad enough to spread your weight. The ivory spyglass glints half-buried in the sucking mud ten paces out, mocking your reach. You haul the makeshift sledge into position, kneeling upon its center to test the buoyancy of the timber before you push off.

nodes.title: Sledge Across Silt
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift sledge from driftwood planks, lashing the wood together to safely cross a patch of soft silt and recover an ivory spyglass.
nodes.page: Kneeling upon the trembling timber platform, you drive a pair of notched oars down into the grey paste, feeling the suction tug viciously at the wood. The makeshift sledge groans under your weight, tilting alarmingly as the silt beneath the left plank gives way with a wet sigh and sends a shudder up your arms. You shift your center of gravity, throwing your torso back while your muscles strain to keep the craft horizontal over the rising bubbles of marsh-gas.

check.label: Lash and maneuver the improvised sledge across the mud

nodes.title: Sinking into the Gray
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift sledge from driftwood planks, lashing the wood together to safely cross a patch of soft silt and recover an ivory spyglass.
nodes.page: The timber tips too far, sliding off the frozen crust and plunging your left arm deep into the cold, foul-smelling mire up to the elbow. You wrench yourself backward with a grunt, abandoning the slipping oars as the silt swallows half your makeshift sledge into the dark underbelly of the Low. Mud coats your sleeve and chills your bones, leaving you bruised and encumbered by heavy, reeking grey grime. Yet you manage to scramble back onto solid ground, clutching the damp wooden spar you managed to salvage.

nodes.title: Reclaiming the Glass
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift sledge from driftwood planks, lashing the wood together to safely cross a patch of soft silt and recover an ivory spyglass.
nodes.page: Balanced carefully over the shifting grey expanse, you slide the notched spar forward, letting the flat timber bridge the treacherous suction just long enough for you to hook the brass lanyard. The ivory spyglass slips free from the grip of the mud with a wet pop, landing safely upon the center of your raft before the whole contraption settles deeper into the mire. You haul the sledge back to the firm crust, wiping the salt-crust from the polished lens.

nodes.title: Shadow Among Pilgrims
nodes.brief: You stand perfectly still as a group of frantic Drift Pilgrims rushes past, avoiding their manic zealotry to quietly pocket a dropped ritual bell.
nodes.page: Heavy wool cloaks dyed the color of dried kelp sweep past your face as a ragged column of zealots tramps through the salt-hollow, chanting prayers to a tide that abandoned them. Their eyes remain fixed upon the horizon, burning with a frantic fervor that ignores everything else in the ruined seabed. You press your spine flat against the ribcage of an upturned skiff, waiting until the final straggler limps by. Resting on the dark sand where the crowd passed is a small, tarnished bell dropped from a wrist.

nodes.title: Silence in the Ranks
nodes.brief: You stand perfectly still as a group of frantic Drift Pilgrims rushes past, avoiding their manic zealotry to quietly pocket a dropped ritual bell.
nodes.page: A towering pilgrim with eyes wild and salt-caked pauses abruptly within arm's reach, turning his hollow gaze toward the very ribcage where you stand pressed into the gloom. His hand drifts toward a rusted iron censer swinging from his wrist, fingers twitching as though he senses the breath trapped in your throat. You swallow hard, keeping your muscles locked in absolute stillness while the dry wind hums through the hollow whale ribs between you.

nodes.title: Spotted by the Zealous
nodes.brief: You stand perfectly still as a group of frantic Drift Pilgrims rushes past, avoiding their manic zealotry to quietly pocket a dropped ritual bell.
nodes.page: A sudden twitch of your boot against a loose pebble echoes sharply in the salt-air, drawing the pilgrim's glazed stare straight to your hiding place. He lunges forward with a hoarse shout, striking your shoulder with the heavy iron censer before stumbling onward in his blind march toward the horizon. The blow leaves a deep, throbbing ache across your collarbone and scatters your rations into the dust. You recover your footing in the salt-drifts, nursing your bruised arm as the chant fades away.

exits.label: Brush the dust from your coat

nodes.title: Gathering the Fallen Bronze
nodes.brief: You stand perfectly still as a group of frantic Drift Pilgrims rushes past, avoiding their manic zealotry to quietly pocket a dropped ritual bell.
nodes.page: Motionless as a carved figurehead, you let the wave of fanatics surge past without a sound, their chanted prayers drowning out the whistling wind. As the last ragged hem disappears into the white dust-haze, you reach down and snatch the small bronze bell from the earth before it can be buried by the shifting sands. Its tongue is silent, muffled by a scrap of greasy leather tied around the clapper.

nodes.title: The Pawn-Widow's Ledger
nodes.brief: You encounter the eerie pawn-widow scavenging near a galleon, and she offers you a grim bargain for information about Orsolya's last known heading.
nodes.page: A dry rustle of parchment draws your gaze toward the rusted anchor-fluke where the pawn-widow sits huddled in black wool, sorting through heaps of salt-corroded trinkets. Her fingers, long and gray as driftwood, tap a notched tally stick as she watches you approach from the shadows of the wrecked galleon. She names Orsolya with a raspy rasp, recounting how the old keeper traded a brass chronometer for a compass needle that pointed inland rather than out to sea.

nodes.title: The Stranded Galleon
nodes.brief: The Stranded Galleon: A colossal warship leans precariously on a jagged reef, its hull groaning as scavengers try to pry loose its remaining secrets.
nodes.page: Timbers thick as cathedral pillars groan and settle into the jagged coral reef, holding the colossal warship at an impossible tilt above the grey seabed. Scavengers crowd the hull like barnacles, hacking at brass fittings and hauling rope pulleys through smashed gunports while the salt-wind howls through empty rigging. Every dark cabin and rusted hatch promises salvage for those willing to risk the shifting bulkheads and the scavengers who claim them.

nodes.title: The Sleeping Deck
nodes.brief: You slip past a sleeping crew of rival wreckers guarding the captain's cabin, holding your breath to steal a preserved jar of medicinal leeches.
nodes.page:
Salt-rimed pine creaks beneath your boots as you edge across the quarterdeck of the stranded schooner, keeping your profile low against the salt-bleached rail. Below the companionway, the rival crew from Saltspire lie sprawled in drunken exhaustion, snoring in unison amid empty rum flasks and discarded rope ends. The captain's cabin door hangs half-open on swollen brass hinges, leaking a stale reek of vinegar and old tobacco. Inside, shadows pool thick around the mahogany desk where the prize sits waiting behind glass.

You pause, letting a sudden gust of wind die down against the timbers before you take your next step into the gloom.

nodes.title: The Sleeping Cabin
nodes.brief: You slip past a sleeping crew of rival wreckers guarding the captain's cabin, holding your breath to steal a preserved jar of medicinal leeches.
nodes.page: Shadows cling to the mahogany paneling of the captain's saloon like wet soot. Heavy snoring rattles through the stagnant air from three rival wreckers sprawled across sea-chests, their knuckles bruised from turf fights on the dead seabed. Upon the baize-covered table sits a stoppered glass container clouded with dark brine, wherein dozen-eyed leeches writhe sluggishly in search of fresh blood. Your boots tread carefully over scattered navigation charts, avoiding the loose floorboards that could betray your quiet approach to the prize.

nodes.title: The Breath Held
nodes.brief: You slip past a sleeping crew of rival wreckers guarding the captain's cabin, holding your breath to steal a preserved jar of medicinal leeches.
nodes.page: Fingertips brush the cold glass of the jar just as the biggest of the sleeping guards grunts, rolling heavily onto his side with a leather-creaking sigh. His boot-heel hooks over your ankle, threatening to jerk you out into the open light filtering through the splintered stern-windows. Every muscle in your chest locks tight while you lean your weight against the tilt of the wreck, praying the floor timbers will hold their tongue under the sudden shift.

nodes.title: The Price of Clumsiness
nodes.brief: You slip past a sleeping crew of rival wreckers guarding the captain's cabin, holding your breath to steal a preserved jar of medicinal leeches.
nodes.page: Wood splinters beneath your heel with a loud crack that shatters the cabin's silence, waking the guard with a drunken curse and a sweep of a heavy iron wrench. The blow glances off your shoulder, leaving a hot, tearing ache in the muscle and a purple bruise that blooms instantly through your wet wool sleeve. You stumble backward out the shattered stern-gallery and into the salt-crusted alleys of the hull, lungs burning as you leave your quarry behind.

nodes.title: The Stolen Jar
nodes.brief: You slip past a sleeping crew of rival wreckers guarding the captain's cabin, holding your breath to steal a preserved jar of medicinal leeches.
nodes.page: Glass cold as winter sea-water meets your palm while the snoring guard kicks at empty air. Slipping backward through the shattered stern-window into the grey light, you tuck the heavy jar of medicinal leeches safely beneath your oilskin coat. It is a foul and squirming prize, but one that will buy patience or medicine in the alleys of Gullmouth when the fever sets in.

nodes.title: Below the Waterline
nodes.brief: You pry open a warped iron grate covering the ship's flooded lower hold, forcing the metal apart to retrieve a heavy harpoon gun.
nodes.page: Rust flakes drift like dark snow into the stagnant puddles pooled inside the ship's cavernous belly. Salt has welded the iron bars of the lower hold into a single stubborn mass, sealing off the dark waters where forgotten cargo drifts against the ribs. Your fingers trace the pitted metal, feeling the cold damp rise from the stagnant bilge below while the distant shouts of rival scavengers echo through the skeletal bulkheads.

nodes.title: The Iron Grate
nodes.brief: You pry open a warped iron grate covering the ship's flooded lower hold, forcing the metal apart to retrieve a heavy harpoon gun.
nodes.page: Thick layers of marine scale and oxidized copper coat the hinges of the rusted hatchway, smelling faintly of old vinegar and stagnant weed. Every movement inside the hull sends hollow, metallic groans shivering through the entire frame of the stranded warship, warning that the whole structure rests on a knife-edge of balance. You wipe the salt-grit from your eyes and plant your boots firmly against the wet timber ribs.

nodes.title: Heaving the Iron
nodes.brief: You pry open a warped iron grate covering the ship's flooded lower hold, forcing the metal apart to retrieve a heavy harpoon gun.
nodes.page: Muscles strain on the warped iron bars as you put your whole weight into the crowbar's shaft. The metal groans. Rusted hinges shriek like a gull; the grate could snap or slide and pin your hand against the jagged bulkhead frame. It moves a fraction of an inch. Sweat runs into your eyes in the damp subterranean gloom, and the deck above settles deeper into the coral reef.

nodes.title: The Slipped Iron
nodes.brief: You pry open a warped iron grate covering the ship's flooded lower hold, forcing the metal apart to retrieve a heavy harpoon gun.
nodes.page: The crowbar slips from the slimy iron with a sharp clang, sending you crashing hard against the jagged ribs of the hull and carving a deep, bleeding gash across your forearm. Rust flakes and rotten timber splinters rain down into the dark bilge water below, filling the hold with a choking cloud of red dust. You clutch your torn arm, teeth gritted against the sudden heat of the wound as you scramble clear of the unstable bulkhead.

nodes.title: The Heavy Iron Harpoon
nodes.brief: You pry open a warped iron grate covering the ship's flooded lower hold, forcing the metal apart to retrieve a heavy harpoon gun.
nodes.page: Iron yields with a screeching groan. The warped bars part, and the rotting deck stays up. You reach into the dark, oil-slicked water of the lower hold and close a hand around the cold, oiled walnut stock of a harpoon gun. It is an unwieldy piece, scarred by old salt-pits and awkward enough to slow a man crossing the flats, yet able to pierce the thickest hide on the seabed.

nodes.title: Shattering the Glass
nodes.brief: You smash a reinforced glass display case in the officers' mess, using blunt force to break through and claim a ceremonial silver compass.
nodes.page: Heavy mahogany panels frame the captains' mess, smelling of dried salt and long-spoiled brandy, where a thick pane of reinforced glass seals off a polished oak cabinet. Inside rests a silver compass gimballed in brass, its needle twitching erratically toward the dry, empty seabed outside rather than any true north. Raising the iron crowbar high above your shoulder, you bring the weighted end crashing down with all your strength against the centre of the pane. Shards burst inward like frozen rain, scattering across the threadbare rug as you reach through the jagged frame to claim your prize.

exits.label: Take the silver compass and leave

nodes.title: Striking the Case
nodes.brief: You smash a reinforced glass display case in the officers' mess, using blunt force to break through and claim a ceremonial silver compass.
nodes.page: Heavy salt-caked oak and stubborn brass frame the officers' mess, protecting the treasures within from the greedy hands of scavengers. You raise the iron bar high above your shoulder, muscles bunching across your back as you line up the blow against the reinforced glass. With a sharp grunt you bring the iron bar down hard on the center of the display, praying the thick pane shatters before the patrolling guild wardens hear the crash through the hollow ribs of the wrecked frigate.

nodes.title: The Shattered Wrist
nodes.brief: You smash a reinforced glass display case in the officers' mess, using blunt force to break through and claim a ceremonial silver compass.
nodes.page: The heavy glass resists the blow with a malicious elasticity, deflecting your iron bar and sending a vicious jolt straight up your forearms that rattles your teeth. Before you can pull back, the upper edge of the frame snaps free, dropping a jagged curtain of wire-bound glass directly across your knuckles and opening a hot, stinging gash. You snatch your hand back with a sharp hiss, clutching your bleeding wrist as the silver compass remains just out of reach behind its ruined barrier.

nodes.title: The Silver Needle
nodes.brief: You smash a reinforced glass display case in the officers' mess, using blunt force to break through and claim a ceremonial silver compass.
nodes.page: Thick glass fragments tumble away from the splintered mahogany frame, clattering against the deck plates as you plunge your hand into the dust-lined recess. Your fingers close around the cool metal of the gimballed casing and drag the prize free from its velvet bed before the snapping wire frame can catch your sleeve. An officer's compass of polished silver rests in your hand, glass face intact, its erratic needle spinning in wild, desperate circles toward the vacant horizon.

exits.label: Return to the stranded galleon deck

nodes.title: The Leviathan Bazaar
nodes.brief: You reach the rotting carcass of a stranded leviathan where opportunists have already set up a sprawling, foul-smelling market of scavenged seabed oddities.
nodes.page: Colossal white ribs arch overhead like the vault of an ungodly cathedral, forming a cavernous market inside the stranded carcass of a leviathan where the air tastes of old blubber and stale brine. Stalls are hacked directly into the yellowed bone, draped with rotting sails and illuminated by flickering lanterns fuelled from whale-fat grease. Shouting scavengers, nervous salt-miners, and hooded traders crowd the narrow alley of the beast's throat, hawking rusted winch-teeth, jars of phosphorescent weed, and scraps of copper pulled from the dead seabed. The market hums with a desperate, greedy energy, everyone watching their neighbours for any sign of weakness or sudden wealth.

exits.label: Step deeper into the bone market

nodes.title: The Salt-Scraped Hub
nodes.brief: The Leviathan Market: Stalls are carved directly into the sun-baked whale bones, offering a chaotic bazaar where bizarre relics and desperate secrets are traded.
nodes.page: Smoke from tiny dung-fires curls against the high ribs of the whale carcass, scenting the crowded market with an acrid haze that stings the eyes and throat. Every stall offers a new temptation or a hidden trap, from the glint of ambergris traded in the shadows to the quiet whispers of pilgrims mourning the missing sea. You stand at the crossroads of the beast's massive jaw, where multiple narrow paths diverge into the bustling chaos of the seabed bazaar. From here, you must choose where your search for Orsolya and the Meridian Gear leads next.

exits.label: Push deeper into the crowded market
Break up a violent merchant brawl
Decipher markings in a dead sailor journal
Repair a delicate clockwork bird for coin
Carve a weighing scale peg for kelp
Pass through the mournful pilgrim procession

nodes.title: The Bone-Carver's Bargain
nodes.brief: You haggle with a desperate bone-carver over a peculiar amulet, spotting the flaws in his bluff to acquire a warding charm at a fraction of the cost.
nodes.page: Yellowed scrimshaw teeth and jagged shark jaws litter the cramped stall where an old man with milky eyes polishes a dull green amulet carved from whale ear-bone. He swears by the dry tide that the trinket wards off the cold hum of the Hollow Choir, running a trembling thumb over its notched edges. You lean closer, smelling the rank tallow on his coat, and spot the fresh tool-marks near the suspension hole that prove he cut the protective runes this very morning. Pointing out the clumsy forgery with a dry smirk, you watch his defiant bluster deflate into a grudging surrender.

exits.label: Secure the warding amulet and move on

nodes.title: Weighing the Carver's Lies
nodes.brief: You haggle with a desperate bone-carver over a peculiar amulet, spotting the flaws in his bluff to acquire a warding charm at a fraction of the cost.
nodes.page: Narrowing your eyes at the crude notch in the whale-bone amulet, you turn the trinket over in your palm to test its weight against the old carver's breathless claims. The man watches your fingers like a starving gull, his tongue darting out to wet dry lips as he tries to guess whether you know real Tidewarden scrimshaw from modern shoreline scrap. You have to weigh his greasy desperation against the faint, unsettling vibration humming through the bone before you name your price.

nodes.title: The Flawed Trade
nodes.brief: You haggle with a desperate bone-carver over a peculiar amulet, spotting the flaws in his bluff to acquire a warding charm at a fraction of the cost.
nodes.page: Your challenge misses its mark as the old carver suddenly turns the tables, spinning a tearful tale of his starving grandchildren until shame and exhaustion cloud your judgment. You pay twice what the jagged bone is worth just to escape his weeping pleas, and end up clutching a useless trinket that feels suspiciously soft and damp in your palm. The coin pouch feels noticeably lighter at your hip as you slip away from his stall, poorer in silver and richer only in experience.

exits.label: Leave the stall with a lighter purse

nodes.title: The Carved Ear-Bone
nodes.brief: You haggle with a desperate bone-carver over a peculiar amulet, spotting the flaws in his bluff to acquire a warding charm at a fraction of the cost.
nodes.page: Your cold thumb finds the flaw in the old man's scrimshaw, a hairline fracture running straight through the whale-ear whorl where salt has eaten the grain. You press the defect home with a dry, flat stare, naming a fraction of his copper demand until his watery eyes dart to the rafters and his trembling fingers surrender the green trinket. It rests in your palm like a cold pebble, smelling faintly of bilge and old tallow, but the small charm will turn the edge of a salt-chill or a greedy blade when mist rolls off the dead seabed in a blank sheet.

exits.label: Step back into the grey press of the market

nodes.title: The Ambergris Scuffle
nodes.brief: You break up a violent brawl between two merchants fighting over a chunk of ambergris, imposing your physical presence to earn a grateful merchant's discount.
nodes.page: Shouts erupt near the rib-cage stalls where two traders tear at a greasy, foul-smelling lump of grey whale fat, their knuckles bloody and eyes wild with greed. You step between them, planting your heavy boots in the salt-crusted sand and pushing broad shoulders against their heaving chests until the struggling merchants stumble back, gasping and blinking in sudden shame. The grateful victor presses a warm, waxy chunk of the prize into your palm at a steep discount before vanishing into the crowd.

nodes.title: Breaking the Dispute
nodes.brief: You break up a violent brawl between two merchants fighting over a chunk of ambergris, imposing your physical presence to earn a grateful merchant's discount.
nodes.page: Shouts shatter the dry air near the rib-cage stalls where two greasy traders claw at each other's throats over a grey, waxy lump of valuable ambergris. You stride directly into the spinning storm of fists and iron nails, intending to drive your solid frame between their chests and force the pair apart before a blade clears leather. Muscles straining against the frantic thrashing of desperate men, you brace your weight against the shifting bone floor and shove with all your might.

check.label: Wedge your solid frame between them

nodes.title: A Heavy Toll
nodes.brief: You break up a violent brawl between two merchants fighting over a chunk of ambergris, imposing your physical presence to earn a grateful merchant's discount.
nodes.page: A stray elbow catches you squarely across the jaw, snapping your head back and sending a hot taste of copper flooding into your mouth as the brawling traders tumble over your boots. You stagger against the sun-baked ribs of a stranded leviathan, clutching a bruised cheek while the valuable ambergris splits into useless, sandy fragments upon the ground. The angry merchants curse your interference and bolt into the narrow alleys, leaving you with a throbbing ache in your jaw and precious hours wasted.

nodes.title: The Merchant's Grace
nodes.brief: You break up a violent brawl between two merchants fighting over a chunk of ambergris, imposing your physical presence to earn a grateful merchant's discount.
nodes.page: Your iron grip holds firm against the thrashing mob, forcing the combatants apart until they slump against the salt-caked ribs in exhausted submission. The surviving merchant, sweating and trembling with relief, presses a smooth, waxy fragment of grey amber into your palm as a silent token of gratitude before scurrying away into the shadows. You pocket the aromatic prize, knowing its rich scent will fetch a heavy price among the apothecaries of the upper cliffs.

nodes.title: The Water-Logged Journal
nodes.brief: You decipher the strange markings on a dead sailor's journal being sold for scrap, piecing together the cryptic language to learn a hidden tidal route.
nodes.page: Faded leather covers a water-logged journal tossed carelessly among a heap of rusted iron hooks and salt-rotted tackle on a blanket. You carefully flick open the stiff pages, squinting at cramped diagrams and cryptic margins scrawled in a dead sailor's hasty hand. By tracing the jagged ink lines against the known landmarks of the exposed seabed, you uncover a forgotten gully that bypasses the treacherous mud flats altogether.

exits.label: Pocket the secret and move on

nodes.title: Deciphering the Tides
nodes.brief: You decipher the strange markings on a dead sailor's journal being sold for scrap, piecing together the cryptic language to learn a hidden tidal route.
nodes.page: Faded leather covers a water-logged journal tossed carelessly among a heap of rusted iron hooks and salt-rotted tackle on a dusty blanket. You squint down at the cramped diagrams and strange marginal notes scrawled in a dead sailor's hasty, ink-stained hand, trying to match the looping symbols to the jagged contours of the exposed seabed. Your mind races through forgotten tidal charts and shifting sand patterns, searching for the hidden logic behind the erratic strokes.

check.label: Decipher the dead sailor's hasty notes

nodes.title: Ink-Stained Confusion
nodes.brief: You decipher the strange markings on a dead sailor's journal being sold for scrap, piecing together the cryptic language to learn a hidden tidal route.
nodes.page: The cryptic symbols blur into a senseless jumble of salt-crushed ink and weeping water-stains that refuse to yield any coherent meaning. Frustration burns behind your eyes as you stare too long at the mocking pages, losing track of the bustling market around you until your head throbs with a dull, persistent ache. The peddler snatches the worthless book back with a snort, leaving you empty-handed and bewildered by the drowned man's scribbles.

nodes.title: Secrets of the Low
nodes.brief: You decipher the strange markings on a dead sailor's journal being sold for scrap, piecing together the cryptic language to learn a hidden tidal route.
nodes.page: Your mind pieces together the jagged ink strokes and peculiar symbols, revealing a hidden pathway worn deep into the silent seabed. The dead sailor's hasty notes map out a safe passage through the treacherous sucking mud of the southern shallows, avoiding the dangerous sinkholes that swallow unwary wreckers whole. You memorize the winding route, locking the secret navigation marks firmly in your memory before closing the book.
nodes.grant: A secret map of the seabed

nodes.title: The Clockwork Aviator
nodes.brief: You repair a delicate clockwork bird for a wealthy trader from Saltspire, using tiny tools to fix the gears and earning a hefty purse of coin.
nodes.page: A wealthy trader from Saltspire holds out a delicate brass finch whose tiny mechanical wings have jammed mid-flap, its emerald eyes dull and motionless. Slender bone tweezers and a drop of refined whale oil come out of your kit as you peer into the packed clockwork chest of the miniature bird. With patient turns of the tiny screws, you coax the stubborn brass gears back into alignment until the bird gives a cheerful, whirring chirp and flutters its polished wings.

nodes.title: Repairing the Brass Finch
nodes.brief: You repair a delicate clockwork bird for a wealthy trader from Saltspire, using tiny tools to fix the gears and earning a hefty purse of coin.
nodes.page: A wealthy trader from Saltspire extends a delicate brass finch whose tiny mechanical wings have jammed mid-flap, its precious emerald eyes dull and lifeless. You retrieve your slender bone tweezers and a small vial of refined whale oil, peering into the microscopic clockwork chamber inside the bird's hollow breast. You must coax the rusted, salt-fouled gears back into precise alignment without snapping the fragile hair-springs inside.

nodes.title: A Costly Slip
nodes.brief: You repair a delicate clockwork bird for a wealthy trader from Saltspire, using tiny tools to fix the gears and earning a hefty purse of coin.
nodes.page: A microscopic spring suddenly snaps beneath your tweezers with a sharp ping, sending a tiny brass tooth flying into the dusty dirt where it is lost forever. The wealthy trader glowers at the crippled toy in your hands, his mouth tightening into a thin, disappointed line as he tosses a meager copper coin at your boots for the trouble. You are left with a ruined mechanism, a bruised reputation among the out-of-town merchants, and time wasted.

nodes.title: Precision Restored
nodes.brief: You repair a delicate clockwork bird for a wealthy trader from Saltspire, using tiny tools to fix the gears and earning a hefty purse of coin.
nodes.page: Your fingers guide the slender tweezers through the brass maze, nudging the stubborn gear until it clicks back into its proper groove. The tiny bird shivers in your palm, its emerald eyes flashing bright and clear before its wings unfold in a whir of perfect motion. The delighted Saltspire trader counts out a heavy purse of bright silver coin, pressing the clinking weight directly into your hand with an appreciative nod.
nodes.grant: A heavy purse of silver coin

nodes.title: The Scale Peg
nodes.brief: You carve a replacement peg for a broken weighing scale, fashioning the wood perfectly to secure a small vial of rare medicinal kelp extract.
nodes.page: Seasoned boxwood rests beneath your calloused thumbs as the small knife blade curls pale shavings onto the workbench. Every stroke requires absolute patience to match the tapered pin of the apothecary scale, ensuring the tiny brass sleeve holds tight against the weight of precious kelp extract. Outside, the dry wind scrapes salt-grit across the windowpanes like sand in a sieve.

nodes.title: Whittling the Toggle
nodes.brief: You carve a replacement peg for a broken weighing scale, fashioning the wood perfectly to secure a small vial of rare medicinal kelp extract.
nodes.page: Splitting a knot of drift-timber demands a delicate wrist while the small vial of medicinal kelp extract sits dangerously close to the edge of the workbench. One careless nudge of the blade could shatter the glass and spill the luminous green liquid into the sawdust. You steady your breath, holding the green wood against the grain as the edge bites deep into the heartwood to shape the replacement peg.

nodes.title: A Splintered Slip
nodes.brief: You carve a replacement peg for a broken weighing scale, fashioning the wood perfectly to secure a small vial of rare medicinal kelp extract.
nodes.page: The grain twists unpredictably under your blade, sending a sharp shard of boxwood deep into the ball of your thumb while the apothecary scale clatters onto the floor. Precious minutes slip away as you bind the weeping cut with a dirty rag and salvage the bruised wood from the dust. The valuable vial remains intact, but the clumsy slip leaves a dull, throbbing ache in your hand.

nodes.title: Perfect Fit
nodes.brief: You carve a replacement peg for a broken weighing scale, fashioning the wood perfectly to secure a small vial of rare medicinal kelp extract.
nodes.page: Smooth friction catches the toggle as you press the handmade peg home into the brass socket of the weighing scale, where it locks the precious vial of kelp extract securely in place. The repair holds fast against the heavy pull of the mechanism, proving your mastery over stubborn timber and erratic tools. You pack the remainder of your shavings away, pocketing a tangible token of your skill for the long road ahead.

nodes.title: Pilgrims of the Sulk
nodes.brief: A procession of mournful Drift Pilgrims blocks your path, demanding that you participate in a bleak ritual to appease the sulking ocean before proceeding.
nodes.page: Hooded figures in salt-stiffened wool crowd the cobblestones, chanting mournful dirges into the hollow air where waves once broke against the quay. Their leader thrusts an iron brazier forward, demanding tribute for the offended deep before any traveler may pass further onto the exposed seabed. Thick grey smoke smells of burnt bladderwrack and old brine, stinging your eyes and coating your tongue with the taste of copper.

nodes.title: Basins of the Faithful
nodes.brief: The Tide-pool Shrines: Shallow basins of trapped seawater serve as makeshift altars where fanatics offer sacrifices to the absent tide, creating tense and dangerous encounters.
nodes.page: Stagnant pools of grey seawater cling to the salt-flats like weeping eyes, reflecting the pale, cloudless dome of the sunless sky. Fanatics kneel by the rims, whispering desperate bargains to the vanished tide while black weed dries into brittle crusts along the margins. Every path away from this basin offers its own peculiar peril, whether through the guarded shrines, the biting shallows, or onward to the howling dunes.

nodes.title: The Zealous Warden
nodes.brief: You debate scripture with a zealous priest standing in a drying pool, remembering old coastal hymns to impress him and win a blessed iron nail.
nodes.page: Standing ankle-deep in warm, receding brine, a priest in oilskin vestments recites verses from the Book of the Ebb while waving a rusted censer. You recall an ancient coastal hymn about the third flooding of Gullmouth, humming the resonant cadence to catch his attention. He pauses his chanting, turning a cloudy eye toward you as he weighs your understanding of the old ways against the silence of the horizon.

nodes.title: Echoes in the Mud
nodes.brief: You debate scripture with a zealous priest standing in a drying pool, remembering old coastal hymns to impress him and win a blessed iron nail.
nodes.page: Ripples spread across the shallow basin as the priest nods slowly at your memory of the drowned liturgy, acknowledging your roots in the cliff-town. His wet cassock yields an iron nail blackened by sea-rot, its tip washed in a strange greenish sheen. This relic, he murmurs, has driven into many a timber bulkhead to ward off the cold malice of the deep.

nodes.title: Testing the Liturgy
nodes.brief: You debate scripture with a zealous priest standing in a drying pool, remembering old coastal hymns to impress him and win a blessed iron nail.
nodes.page: Quoting the forbidden verses of the Great Silt to the high priest requires absolute precision, for a single mispronounced syllable will mark you as an unbeliever in these salt-crusted lands. The crowd of pilgrims leans in closer, their breath smelling of dried kelp and stale well-water, waiting for your tongue to trip on the archaic syllables. You gather your thoughts, preparing to speak the next stanza over the dry slop of the mud.

nodes.title: A Scraped Tongue
nodes.brief: You debate scripture with a zealous priest standing in a drying pool, remembering old coastal hymns to impress him and win a blessed iron nail.
nodes.page: A faulty cadence causes your voice to crack, prompting the priest to spit into the brine and curse your lineage for a profane land-lubber. The surrounding pilgrims close ranks, pelting your shoulders with dried urchin shells and driving you back from the pool with sharp blows from their staves. You escape with your skin intact, though your pride smarts and your mouth tastes of bitter mud.

nodes.title: The Priest and the Iron Nail
nodes.brief: You debate scripture with a zealous priest standing in a drying pool, remembering old coastal hymns to impress him and win a blessed iron nail.
nodes.page:
Ankle-deep in the tepid brine of a receding basin, Father Vane watches the cracked mud of the exposed seabed, salt crusting his vestments into stiff plates. You match his pious cadence stanza by stanza, chanting the old verses of the drowned apostles until his scowl softens into grudging respect. From the folds of his wet cassock he draws a dark-headed iron nail blessed against rust and rot.

Pocketing the cold metal, you feel the weight of his cautious blessing settle between your shoulder blades as the congregation around you murmurs in uneasy awe.

exits.label: Leave the drying pool for the shrines

nodes.title: The Coral Trap
nodes.brief: You rescue a trapped scavenger from a collapsing coral altar, lifting the heavy stone away to gain the grateful survivor as a loyal companion.
nodes.page:
Heavy purple branches of fossilised reef groan and shudder as the salt-rotted masonry gives way, pinning a luckless net-mender beneath a jagged block of coral. You brace your shoulder against the porous stone, tasting copper and brine as your muscles strain against the grinding weight until the slab shifts and rolls aside with a hollow thud. The trembling scavenger crawls free from the dust, coughing up grey silt and pressing a cold, trembling palm to your forearm in fierce, silent loyalty.

With the rescue done, you look out across the drying flats toward the salt-crusted ridge where the old tracks lead.

exits.label: Climb the ridge toward the dry track

nodes.title: Beneath the Weight
nodes.brief: You rescue a trapped scavenger from a collapsing coral altar, lifting the heavy stone away to gain the grateful survivor as a loyal companion.
nodes.page:
You brace your boots deep into the dried brine and grip the jagged edge of the fallen pillar, shoulders hard against the porous stone. Ancient barnacles bite into your palms through leather and draw beads of dark blood. The pillar shifts a fraction of an inch. A pale face shows, smeared with mud and salt-tears. The trapped scavenger reaches out with a trembling hand and whispers a frantic prayer to the retreating ocean while you gather for the lift.

You heave hard. The dead mass has to leave their crushed limbs.

nodes.title: Shifting the Coral Arch
nodes.brief: You rescue a trapped scavenger from a collapsing coral altar, lifting the heavy stone away to gain the grateful survivor as a loyal companion.
nodes.page: Jagged shards of petrified coral grind against your ribs as you wedge your shoulder beneath the fallen archway, testing the dead weight of the masonry against your tired muscles. The entire heap shivers in the damp air, threatening to avalanche down the slope of the ruined bulkhead and bury you both in a suffocating shroud of shell-grit. You tighten your grip on the porous stone, leaning your full body weight into the lift while the damp earth gives way beneath your heels.

nodes.title: The Slip of the Stone
nodes.brief: You rescue a trapped scavenger from a collapsing coral altar, lifting the heavy stone away to gain the grateful survivor as a loyal companion.
nodes.page:
The damp earth gives way beneath your boots with a wet sucking sound, and a sharp jolt runs through your lower back as the coral slips back into place. A jagged fragment of shell rakes a deep red line across your forearm. Warm blood cools in the salty air. You stagger backward into the reedy sludge and cough as a cloud of ancient lime dust settles over your hair and clothes. The trapped scavenger groans from beneath the debris. They are still breathing.

You grit your teeth. The masonry waits for another haul.

nodes.title: A Grateful Survivor
nodes.brief: You rescue a trapped scavenger from a collapsing coral altar, lifting the heavy stone away to gain the grateful survivor as a loyal companion.
nodes.page: With a final wrenching heave, the massive coral block rolls clear of the trapped scavenger and plunges into the dark silt with a heavy thud. The rescued soul scrambles out from the wreckage, gasping for salt air and pressing a trembling hand to bruised ribs. They press a small, damp bundle of dried kelp leaves into your palm as a token of desperate thanks before pledging their loyalty to your crew for the long road ahead.

nodes.title: Carving the Pale Driftwood
nodes.brief: You carve an offering from a piece of pale driftwood, shaping the idol perfectly to satisfy the pilgrims and secure a pouch of blessed salt.
nodes.page:
Sitting on an overturned crab-pot outside the edge of the salt-flats, you turn a smooth piece of grey driftwood over in your calloused hands. Brine has soaked the grain dense and dark, polished to a dull sheen by years of rolling in the surf before the sea vanished. Using a narrow skinning knife, you shave away thin curls of pale wood to reveal a faceless idol meant to appease the wandering pilgrims of the deep. The sharp scent of resin fills the damp air as the crude likeness of a drowned saint begins to emerge from the timber.

You carefully pare the final details into the wooden surface before offering the small carving to the waiting crowd.

nodes.title: The Pilgrim's Bargain
nodes.brief: You carve an offering from a piece of pale driftwood, shaping the idol perfectly to satisfy the pilgrims and secure a pouch of blessed salt.
nodes.page:
In the salt-fog the hooded zealots gather close, woolen cloaks stiff with dried froth and smelling of old storms. They pass the pale wooden idol from hand to hand with reverent fingers, murmuring low incantations to the empty horizon where the tide used to lie. Pleased by the stark craftsmanship and the unmistakable tang of sacred driftwood, their leader tips a measure of glittering white crystals from a leather pouch into your waiting palm. This blessed salt commands a high price among the inland folk who still fear the thirst of the dry seabed.

You pocket the precious grains and turn your steps back toward the bustling clamor of the shore.

nodes.title: Shaping the Sacred Timber
nodes.brief: You carve an offering from a piece of pale driftwood, shaping the idol perfectly to satisfy the pilgrims and secure a pouch of blessed salt.
nodes.page: The woodgrain resists the edge of your blade, tough and stringy with centuries of salt-curing that makes every stroke a test of steady patience. A sudden knot in the timber threatens to split the delicate votive figure right down the center as the pilgrims watch with dark, suspicious eyes from the edge of the dunes. You ease your pressure, feathering the blade across the stubborn grain while the salty wind whips loose strands of hair across your brow.

nodes.title: A Slip of the Blade
nodes.brief: You carve an offering from a piece of pale driftwood, shaping the idol perfectly to satisfy the pilgrims and secure a pouch of blessed salt.
nodes.page:
The narrow blade catches on a hidden knot of dried salt, slipping sideways with a dull snap that shears away the carved face of the idol in a jagged ruin. A murmur of displeasure ripples through the watching pilgrims, their hooded heads turning away in sudden rejection of the botched offering. You curse under your breath as the ruined timber falls into the dust, costing you precious time and the clean materials you spent hours selecting from the wreck-fields.

You salvage the remaining scrap of wood and begin to carve a smaller token from what is left.

nodes.title: The Driftwood Idol
nodes.brief: You carve an offering from a piece of pale driftwood, shaping the idol perfectly to satisfy the pilgrims and secure a pouch of blessed salt.
nodes.page: Smooth grains of pale driftwood yield to your blade, shaving away under the cold light of the stranded moon until the small, eyeless effigy takes the required shape of a crouching gull. You present the carved offering to the watching pilgrims, who stroke its polished flanks with reverent thumbs and mutter praises to the sulking deep. They nod in quiet satisfaction, handing over a tightly sealed canvas pouch filled with coarse, blessed salt that stings your palm with an ancient, bitter cold.

nodes.title: The Murky Shallows
nodes.brief: You wade into a sacred pool filled with biting blind-eels, ignoring the painful nips to retrieve a sunken idol that the pilgrims revere.
nodes.page: Cold brine stings your ankles as you step into the sacred pool, disturbing a thick silt that clouds the dark water. Sleek, pale shapes dart between your shins with sudden, vicious hunger, their tiny jaws snapping against your leather boots and bare skin. Ignoring the sharp nips that draw thin lines of crimson into the pool, you plunge your hands deep into the heavy mud until your fingers brush the smooth edges of the venerated driftwood effigy.

nodes.title: Enduring the Bite
nodes.brief: You wade into a sacred pool filled with biting blind-eels, ignoring the painful nips to retrieve a sunken idol that the pilgrims revere.
nodes.page: Hundreds of blind-eels swirl in a frenzied knot around your submerged arms, tearing at your flesh with needle-teeth as the water churns red. Every instinct screams to snatch your hands back and abandon the relic to the deep, but the Drift Pilgrims are watching from the ridge. You must hold your stance in the freezing brine, muscles locked against the agony of the swarm, trusting your iron resolve to keep your grip true until the idol is clear.

check.label: Keep your hands steady in the swarm

nodes.title: Torn by the Swarm
nodes.brief: You wade into a sacred pool filled with biting blind-eels, ignoring the painful nips to retrieve a sunken idol that the pilgrims revere.
nodes.page: Pain flares white-hot as the blind-eels find a gap in your defense, latching onto your wrists in a writhing tangle of teeth. You wrench your arms upward with a desperate grunt, tearing yourself free from the water, but the voracious swarm leaves your forearms raked with ragged gashes and weeping crimson. The sacred idol comes with you, coated in blood and dark mud, but the cost leaves you breathless and smarting from the deep, throbbing bites.

nodes.title: The Pilgrim's Blessing
nodes.brief: You wade into a sacred pool filled with biting blind-eels, ignoring the painful nips to retrieve a sunken idol that the pilgrims revere.
nodes.page: Water drips from your bloodied sleeves as you lift the damp, carved figure clear of the frothing pool, clutching it close against your damp tunic. The sacred relic remains intact within your grasp, smelling strongly of old kelp and stagnant sea-salt. A murmur rises from the watchers on the stony shore, acknowledging your grim endurance with quiet respect and a begrudging debt.

nodes.title: Voices in the Dust
nodes.brief: You finally reach the treacherous Singing Dunes, where the howling wind carries the faint, grinding echoes of the Meridian Gear from the distant Sunken Stair.
nodes.page: The salt-flats give way to the rising slopes of the Singing Dunes, where the wind groans through ancient, hollowed ribs of stranded galleys. Beneath the whistling gale lies a deeper, resonant hum that vibrates through the soles of your boots, carrying the rhythmic, metallic grinding of the Meridian Gear from miles away. It sounds like a great clockwork heart beating beneath the seabed, reminding every scavenger in Gullmouth that the world's pulse is stuttering. You press forward through the swirling grey haze, keeping your eyes fixed on the distant, jagged silhouette of the Sunken Stair while the dunes whisper warnings in voices that sound hauntingly human.

nodes.title: Heart of the Whispers
nodes.brief: The Singing Dunes: Shifting sands hide the remnants of ancient wrecks, and the strange acoustic phenomena threaten to disorient anyone who lingers too long.
nodes.page: Towering drifts of pale sand shift continuously under a bruised sky, burying old masts and swallowing the echoes of the coast. The acoustic trickery of the dunes plays strange games with your ears, turning the whistle of the wind into distant laughter or the splash of unseen waves. Every direction offers a different hazard and a different prize across the vast, undulating desert of the low seabed.

exits.label: Push deeper into the white dust
Navigate the field of false echoes

nodes.title: Through the Gray Veil
nodes.brief: You walk blindly through a blinding sandstorm while resisting the urge to run, trusting your instincts to find a buried stash of emergency rations.
nodes.page: A sudden wall of fine white sand sweeps across the flats, swallowing the horizon and reducing the world to a blinding, choking blur. You pull your collar high across your face and lower your head, relying entirely on the memory of the ground beneath your boots to keep moving forward without losing your sense of direction. The howling gale tries to push you off course into the deeper sinkholes, but you march on with dogged persistence until your shoulder bumps against a hard, wooden timber marking the buried cache.

nodes.title: Blinded by the Gale
nodes.brief: You walk blindly through a blinding sandstorm while resisting the urge to run, trusting your instincts to find a buried stash of emergency rations.
nodes.page: The sandstorm thickens into a screaming vortex that scourges your skin and fills your eyes with stinging grit, entirely erasing the landmarks you relied upon. Panic threatens to take root as the ground shifts treacherously beneath your boots, hinting at hidden drop-offs into the empty sea-caves below. You force yourself to stand completely still amidst the howling white fury, listening to the subtle pitch of the wind against nearby wreckage to find your bearing.

check.label: Trust your instincts in the storm

nodes.title: Lost in the Whiteout
nodes.brief: You walk blindly through a blinding sandstorm while resisting the urge to run, trusting your instincts to find a buried stash of emergency rations.
nodes.page: A sudden eddy of wind sweeps your footing away, sending you tumbling down a steep bank of loose sand into a shallow, debris-choked hollow. You lie there coughing up grit as the storm howls overhead, bruised by half-buried iron spikes and losing precious hours digging yourself back out to the surface. When you finally regain the trail, your water skins are fouled with sand and your limbs ache with a deep, grinding exhaustion.

exits.label: Drag yourself back to the path

nodes.title: Buried Provisions
nodes.brief: You walk blindly through a blinding sandstorm while resisting the urge to run, trusting your instincts to find a buried stash of emergency rations.
nodes.page: Your fingers scrape against oiled canvas buried deep beneath the drifting dune, revealing a tightly sealed bundle left behind by earlier scouts. Through the storm's blinding fury you haul the dry canvas sack free from the grasping sands. Inside lies a small cache of unspoiled salt-meat and fresh water, providing a vital lifeline against the harsh emptiness of the Low.

nodes.title: Ribs of the Galley
nodes.brief: You construct a windbreak from the ribs of a half-buried galley, weaving canvas tightly to shelter yourself and discovering an ancient, rust-free cutlass inside.
nodes.page: Timbers of a stranded merchantman rear out of the scouring sand like the carcass of some salt-blind beast. Dragging the oiled canvas from your recent find, you lash it firmly across the bleached ribs to block the howling gale. Tucked deep within the lee of the hull lies an ancient, rust-free cutlass, its greased scabbard gleaming faintly despite the grit. You test its balance in your palm, feeling the cold weight of forgotten smithing. The rising howl of the wind insists you push forward before the drift swallows your makeshift shelter entirely.

exits.label: Follow the windbreak into the storm

nodes.title: Shelter in the Hull
nodes.brief: You construct a windbreak from the ribs of a half-buried galley, weaving canvas tightly to shelter yourself and discovering an ancient, rust-free cutlass inside.
nodes.page: Stiff fingers knot the canvas lines tighter against the groaning timber of the sunken wreck. Beneath the arched ribs, the howling gale drops to a dull, subterranean roar, leaving you a narrow pocket of stillness in the whiteout. Your eyes adjust to the gloom, falling upon an ancient, rust-free cutlass half-buried in the damp floorboards. You draw the blade an inch from its sheath; bright steel catches the dim light, untouched by the salt air. There is no time to linger while the dunes shift around you.

exits.label: Crawl past the rusted iron bulkhead

nodes.title: Rigging the Canvas Wall
nodes.brief: You construct a windbreak from the ribs of a half-buried galley, weaving canvas tightly to shelter yourself and discovering an ancient, rust-free cutlass inside.
nodes.page: Knotting the heavy canvas requires every ounce of patience as the gale tries to tear the stiff fabric from your numb hands. Inside the hollow of the half-buried galley, you pull the lashings taut against the iron-hard ribs while probing the debris for the rumored blade. Dust and dried kelp sting your eyes, but your fingers brush against a leather-wrapped hilt buried beneath silt. Steadying your breath against the biting cold, you begin to pry the ancient, rust-free cutlass free from the packed sand before the entire makeshift shelter collapses.

check.label: Anchor the canvas and pry the blade

nodes.title: Tangled in the Rigging
nodes.brief: You construct a windbreak from the ribs of a half-buried galley, weaving canvas tightly to shelter yourself and discovering an ancient, rust-free cutlass inside.
nodes.page: A sudden scream of wind tears the canvas from your frozen grip, collapsing the makeshift shelter and burying your hands in abrasive grit. The heavy timber bucks against your shoulder, leaving a dark, weeping bruise across your collarbone as you scramble clear of the falling wreckage. You salvage the ancient, rust-free cutlass from the drift, but the struggle costs you precious time and drains your remaining strength. Shivering bitterly, you hoist your pack and limp onward into the swirling whiteout.

exits.label: Press onward through the stinging grit

nodes.title: The Unblemished Blade
nodes.brief: You construct a windbreak from the ribs of a half-buried galley, weaving canvas tightly to shelter yourself and discovering an ancient, rust-free cutlass inside.
nodes.page: Securing the canvas with a swift, practiced hitch, you carve out a reliable haven from the screaming gale within the hollow ribs of the wreck. Your fingers trace the clean, oiled leather of the hilt, pulling the ancient, rust-free cutlass from the sand with barely a whisper of friction. It balances with lethal grace, untouched by the corrosive brine that ruins everything else along the coast. Wrapping the weapon securely at your hip, you step back out into the scouring wind, ready for whatever waits in the shifting dunes.

nodes.title: Spring-Trap in the Sand
nodes.brief: You dismantle a deadly spring-trap left by Brineholder scouts, disabling the mechanism carefully to salvage the poisonous darts for your own future use.
nodes.page: Half-concealed beneath a drift of white dust, a thin wire trips your boot before you catch yourself. A Brineholder spring-trap rests in the sand, its barbed metal jaws primed to release a trio of poisoned copper darts at the slightest nudge. Kneeling in the grit, you use the tip of your knife to gently lever the tension plate. Each tiny click echoes loudly over the wind as you ease the venomous needles from their housing one by one.

nodes.title: Unpinning the Brineholder Teeth
nodes.brief: You dismantle a deadly spring-trap left by Brineholder scouts, disabling the mechanism carefully to salvage the poisonous darts for your own future use.
nodes.page: Sweat cuts pale tracks through the dust on your forehead as you lean over the delicate trigger mechanism of the Brineholder spring-trap. The slightest twitch of your blade could release the poisoned copper darts directly into your wrist. The gale howls overhead, vibrating the metal frame and threatening to ruin your precise adjustments. Holding your breath, you slide the safety pin toward the release housing, your fingers hovering over the deadly needles.

nodes.title: Poison in the Grain
nodes.brief: You dismantle a deadly spring-trap left by Brineholder scouts, disabling the mechanism carefully to salvage the poisonous darts for your own future use.
nodes.page: A metallic snap shatters the silence, and a white-hot sting flares across your forearm as the trap's retaining bar slips. You jerk your hand back just in time, but one poisoned dart grazes your flesh, leaving a dark, swelling welt that burns like brine in an open cut. You manage to crush the spring with your boot heel and salvage the remaining darts, but the venom slows your pulse and leaves you dizzy. Gritting your teeth against the nausea, you press forward.

nodes.title: Harvest of the Watchers
nodes.brief: You dismantle a deadly spring-trap left by Brineholder scouts, disabling the mechanism carefully to salvage the poisonous darts for your own future use.
nodes.page: Your blade slides beneath the locking cam with a microscopic click, rendering the Brineholder spring-trap completely harmless. With careful fingers, you lift the three poisoned copper darts from their chamber and stow them away in a wax-sealed vial. The mechanism is a masterpiece of paranoid engineering, built to keep scavengers away from the deeper secrets of the coast. Fastening the container to your belt, you leave the disarmed shell behind and continue your march toward the dark descent.

nodes.title: Tracks in the Whiteout
nodes.brief: You track a strange scuttling creature across the shifting dunes, anticipating its sudden turns to locate its nest and claim a cluster of glowing pearls.
nodes.page: A low clicking sound draws your attention away from the dune crest. Something small and armored scuttles across the wind-packed salt crust, leaving a frantic trail of claw-marks before darting into the ribcage of a ruined skiff. You crouch low, letting the wind mask the crunch of your boots on the crystals. Anticipating its erratic path, you circle wide around the wreck to cut off its retreat toward the deeper dunes.

exits.label: Close in on the skeletal wreck

nodes.title: The Scuttling Shell
nodes.brief: You track a strange scuttling creature across the shifting dunes, anticipating its sudden turns to locate its nest and claim a cluster of glowing pearls.
nodes.page: The pale creature darts between your boots, its chitinous shell gleaming with a faint, bioluminescent pulse that cuts through the blowing sand. You follow its desperate zig-zags across the flat expanse, watching as it squeezes beneath the warped planking of a sunken longboat. Kneeling at the entry, you peer into the dark hollow where a nest of woven kelp trembles with pale, luminous shapes.

nodes.title: Prowling the Salt-Flats
nodes.brief: You track a strange scuttling creature across the shifting dunes, anticipating its sudden turns to locate its nest and claim a cluster of glowing pearls.
nodes.page: The bioluminescent scavenger freezes at the edge of its nest, its stalked eyes twitching in your direction as you reach out a slow hand. A single misstep will send it scuttling back into the labyrinth of buried wrecks, losing your only chance at the glowing pearls. The wind shifts abruptly, throwing a cloud of stinging grit directly into your face and blurring your vision at the worst possible moment. Relying entirely on instinct and memory of its shape, you lunge into the darkness of the nest.

check.label: Snatch the pearls from the nest

nodes.title: Slips in the Dark
nodes.brief: You track a strange scuttling creature across the shifting dunes, anticipating its sudden turns to locate its nest and claim a cluster of glowing pearls.
nodes.page: Your fingers graze the smooth sphere of a pearl just as the creature whips around, sinking sharp mandibles deep into the web of your thumb. You yank your hand back with a sharp hiss of pain, sending the nest scattering across the damp sand. The creature vanishes into a crack in the hull, leaving you nursing a bleeding hand and only a single glowing pearl retrieved from the chaos. Wiping the blood on your trousers, you curse the stubborn wildlife of the Low.

nodes.title: Nest of the Chitin
nodes.brief: You track a strange scuttling creature across the shifting dunes, anticipating its sudden turns to locate its nest and claim a cluster of glowing pearls.
nodes.page: Blood beads on the web of your thumb where the creature bit down, but your other hand fastens like a vice around the smooth, bioluminescent shell before it can dart beneath the hull ribs. You wrench it free from the damp sand, ignoring the frantic twitch of its stalked eyes, and prize the cluster of glowing pearls from the clustered barnacles of its nest. However narrowly, you secure the prize and rise to your feet as the salt-wind howls across the bare seabed.

exits.label: Trace the path back to the dunes

nodes.title: Voices of the Low
nodes.brief: You navigate a field of acoustic illusions that sound like drowning sailors, identifying the false echoes to safely recover a lost Brineholder signet ring.
nodes.page: Shifting dunes hide the skeletal remains of schooners long swallowed by the brine, and every gust across the exposed flats carries the terrible, weeping cadence of men drowning in a calm sea. You plug your ears with greasy wool and force your boots through the drifts, keeping your eyes fixed on the rusted iron spike that marks the Brineholder perimeter. Among the ribs of a shattered whaling brigantine, a gold signet stamped with the crest of the water-lords catches the dull grey light.

nodes.title: Echoes in the Drift
nodes.brief: You navigate a field of acoustic illusions that sound like drowning sailors, identifying the false echoes to safely recover a lost Brineholder signet ring.
nodes.page: Salt-crusted timbers groan underfoot as you pick your way through a hollow basin where the wind plays cruel tricks upon the ear, mimicking the frantic dying gasps of shipmates lost years ago. You pause by a half-buried cargo hatch, straining to separate the real scrape of metal from the phantom gurgling of the tide-ghosts, knowing that a single misstep into the shifting silt will pin you beneath the wrecks.

check.label: Discern the false echoes from reality

nodes.title: False Cries of the Drowned
nodes.brief: You navigate a field of acoustic illusions that sound like drowning sailors, identifying the false echoes to safely recover a lost Brineholder signet ring.
nodes.page: A sudden wail splits the air right beside your ear, so sharp and human that you lurch aside in blind panic, plunging your right leg deep into a hidden sinkhole of black, briny sludge. The cold mud sucks at your thigh like a mouth, dragging you down until your chest presses hard against the encrusted salt-crust while your pack tears on a hidden iron spar. You wrench yourself free with a breathless heave, dragging a bruised shin and a ruined coat back to firm ground.

exits.label: Crawl clear of the treacherous basin

nodes.title: Spoils of the Salt-Wastes
nodes.brief: You navigate a field of acoustic illusions that sound like drowning sailors, identifying the false echoes to safely recover a lost Brineholder signet ring.
nodes.page: Cold brine finds the raw scratch across your ribs where the iron spar bit deep, yet your fingers stay clamped tight around the gold signet ring in the grey silt. However narrowly, you master the deceptive whispers of the basin and pocket the water-lord's heirloom before the phantom tide can rise again in your skull.

nodes.title: Threshold of the Sunken Stair
nodes.brief: You stand before the yawning abyss of the Sunken Stair, ready to descend into the darkness and finally uncover the truth behind Orsolya's disappearance.
nodes.page: Iron gates of ancient, salt-pitted brass gape open in the cliff face where the foundations of Gullmouth plunge downward into the living rock of the coast. Below lies the spiral shaft of the Sunken Stair, dropping straight into the dark toward the jammed Meridian Gear and the silent domain of the Hollow Choir. No word remains on Orsolya Venn's oak desk save for this damp drop, and the salt-crust on the stone steps bears fresh boot-prints that do not belong to a wrecker. Canvas pack strap hitched, cold iron hand-axe in your grip, you step over the threshold into the damp gloom.

nodes.title: Offerings for the Pilgrims
nodes.brief: You carve an offering from a piece of pale driftwood, shaping the idol perfectly to satisfy the pilgrims and secure a pouch of blessed salt.
nodes.page: Driftwood pulled from the rib of a stranded schooner yields under your knife like cheese, curling into long pale shavings that smell of old kelp and stagnant bilge. You shape the rough block into a crude, eyeless idol with salt-crusted hands, knowing the wandering zealots on the flats will trade their blessed salt for any carved wood that looks enough like a drowned god. The pilgrims squat by their canvas tents in the lee of a copper freighter, watching your blade with hungry, sunken eyes.

exits.label: Trade the driftwood carving for salt

nodes.title: The Pawnbroker's Peg
nodes.brief: You carve a replacement peg for a broken weighing scale, fashioning the wood perfectly to secure a small vial of rare medicinal kelp extract.
nodes.page: Hard oak heartwood curls away from the chisel in thin, sweet-smelling ribbons as you turn the small lathe in the dim back room of the pawn-widow's house. The brass beam of her weighing scale rests unevenly on the counter, but this new peg-joint restores the balance true to a hair, earning a grudging nod from behind the iron grille. She shoves a small, stoppered vial of greenish medicinal kelp extract across the scarred wood without a word of thanks.

nodes.title: Hauling for the Guild
nodes.brief: You haul a crate of smuggled fresh water from the cellar, proving your worth through brute labour to receive a rare talisman of safe passage.
nodes.page: Oak crates bound with rusted wire bite into your palms as you heave the heavy cargo up from the damp cellar beneath the tavern floor, breathing in the stale stench of bilge and spilled ale. The secret stash of fresh water is worth its weight in silver teeth since the sea vanished, and the guild boss watches your shoulders strain with an appraising squint. He flips a small, notched copper token across the barrels, telling you to show it at the winch-house if you want back-alley passage past the Customs-Priest.

nodes.title: The Harbourmaster's Safe
nodes.brief: You pick the rusted lock on the harbourmaster's abandoned office, relying on careful hands to disarm a simple trap and claiming a stash of coin.
nodes.page: Rust flakes off the brass tumblers in tiny orange scales under the gentle prod of your bent wire, while the wind rattles the broken weather-vane high above the abandoned clapboard office. Inside the dark desk drawer sits a leather pouch fat with old coinage, left behind when the harbourmaster fled inland three days ago before the tide went out. You lift the iron latch with infinite care, listening for the snap of any crude trip-wire hidden in the dust.

nodes.title: The Water Smuggler's Debt
nodes.brief: You haul a crate of smuggled fresh water from the cellar, proving your worth through brute labour to receive a rare talisman of safe passage.
nodes.page:
Iron bands dig into your sweating palms as you haul the dripping water crate up the slick stone steps from the cellar. Brine leaks from the staves, soaking your boots with the bitter smell of stagnant well-water hoarded against the drought. The tavern keeper grunts approval, sliding a cold pewter disk across the sticky counter - a token stamped with the gull-wing mark of the smuggling ring.

Pocketing the metal talisman, you step back out into the sharp coastal glare to seek the next lead.

exits.label: Take the metal token and leave

nodes.title: Across the Sinking Ridge
nodes.brief: You cross a narrow ridge between two yawning chasms of black mud, keeping a steady balance to reach a stranded merchant's dropped satchel of supplies.
nodes.page:
Narrow and treacherous, the spine of dried silt offers only inches of purchase between two bottomless pits of grey, bubbling ooze. You steady your breathing, planting each boot heel with calculated precision while the wind tries to peel your oilskins from your shoulders. Down in the reeking trench, the abandoned merchant satchel rests beside a shattered crate, its leather straps glinting invitingly in the pale sunlight.

Crouching low to preserve your balance, you reach out with cautious fingers to claim the prize before the crust gives way beneath your weight.

exits.label: Secure the satchel and turn back

nodes.title: The Ambergris Brawl
nodes.brief: You break up a violent brawl between two merchants fighting over a chunk of ambergris, imposing your physical presence to earn a grateful merchant's discount.
nodes.page:
Off the salt-stained walls of the fish market, shouts and blunt thuds bounce as two burly haulers grapple in the dust over a grey, waxy lump of whale grease. You step directly between them, planting a solid hand against each heaving chest with enough force to break their momentum and remind them whose turf they are fouling. The taller man spits blood into the dirt, recognizes your guild colors, and backs off with a disgruntled mutter.

You take the chunk of ambergris for safe disposal and pocket the merchant's token of gratitude.

exits.label: Leave the brawlers in the dust

nodes.title: Shadows in the Salt
nodes.brief: You stand perfectly still as a group of frantic Drift Pilgrims rushes past, avoiding their manic zealotry to quietly pocket a dropped ritual bell.
nodes.page:
Chanting hymns to a dry ocean, a ragged swarm of pilgrims surges past the alley mouth, their bare feet slapping hard against the cobbles in a feverish frenzy. You press your spine flat against the flaking whitewash of the net-mender's shop, holding your breath until the cloud of dust and incense clears. In the dirt near your boot heel lies a small bronze bell on a frayed cord, dropped by a zealous straggler who never looked back.

Stooping swiftly, you slip the cold metal into your pocket and melt away from the procession.

exits.label: Slip away with the bronze bell

nodes.title: The Weighing Peg
nodes.brief: You carve a replacement peg for a broken weighing scale, fashioning the wood perfectly to secure a small vial of rare medicinal kelp extract.
nodes.page:
Smooth boxwood turns slowly against the fine blade of your drawknife, shaving off paper-thin curls that smell faintly of resin and old sawdust. You test the tapered end in your palm until it fits the brass balance scale without a wobble, restoring an honest measure to the pawn-widow's trade. She nods in quiet satisfaction, reaching beneath the counter to hand you a stoppered glass vial filled with dark, viscous kelp extract.

Stowing the remedy securely in your tunic, you gather your remaining tools and head for the door.

nodes.title: Grip of Iron
nodes.brief: You challenge the guildmaster's champion to an arm-wrestling contest, putting your back into the strain to win a coil of high-quality climbing rope.
nodes.page:
Sweat stings your eyes as your forearm locks against the guildmaster's champion across the scarred oak table, neither of you yielding an inch of leverage. Sinews strain and breath comes hard as the crowd falls silent, watching the white-knuckled struggle for dominance in the damp tavern air. With a final surge of effort, you slam your opponent's fist down onto the wood, winning a hearty roar from the onlookers.

Tossing the prize over your shoulder, the defeated brawler hands you a sturdy coil of climbing rope.

nodes.title: Claiming the Hull
nodes.brief: You confront a rival crew claiming a stranded fishing boat, holding your nerve to intimidate them into backing down and securing a sturdy grappling hook.
nodes.page:
Weathered timber groans as three rival wreckers cluster around a stranded fishing boat, waving rusted iron bars and shouting claims on the remaining gear. You step into their path without breaking your stride, keeping your expression flat and your hand resting casually near your belt. Meeting your cold stare, the leader hesitates, spits into the salt-crusted sand, and signals his men to retreat rather than force a bloody fight.

Pulling the iron-toothed grappling hook free from the gunwale, you secure your new prize.

nodes.title: The Brineholder's Stare
nodes.brief: You stare down a bragging Brineholder agent making offers to the locals, refusing to blink and extracting a valuable secret about the patrol routes.
nodes.page:
Sleek wool and silver buttons mark the agent out from the salt-bitten locals, his smooth smile dripping with false promises of water rights and secure contracts. You plant your boots firmly on the paving stones, fixing him with an unblinking gaze that slowly wipes the confidence from his face. Unsettled by your silence, he drops his voice and hastily blurts out the changing times of the southern patrols just to buy your quiet.

Pocketing the whispered intelligence, you turn your back on the rattled agent.

nodes.title: The Second Procession
nodes.brief: You stand perfectly still as a group of frantic Drift Pilgrims rushes past, avoiding their manic zealotry to quietly pocket a dropped ritual bell.
nodes.page:
Frenzied hymns rise into the salt-laden air as another knot of zealots surges through the narrow alley, their eyes wide with feverish visions of a returning tide. You freeze mid-stride, blending into the rough timber wall of the drying shed while the frantic procession sweeps past in a blur of gray rags and wild gestures. In the dust left in their wake, a small iron-tongued bell rests half-buried in the silt.

Bending down with slow care, you lift the relic before anyone else notices.

exits.label: Pocket the bell and move on

nodes.title: Descent Onto the Low
nodes.brief: You step onto the exposed seabed of the Low, boots sinking into salt-crusted mud as you begin your search for Orsolya.
nodes.page:
Grey silt stretches away to the jagged horizon where the ocean used to be, a vast and silent desert of sun-bleached mud, exposed ship ribs, and drowned streets no living eye was ever meant to witness. Your boots sink deep into the crust with a wet sucking sound as you leave the safety of the cliff shadow behind and step out onto the open seabed. Somewhere out in that maze of rotting hulls and salt-crusted alleys, Orsolya Venn has left a trail in the muck.

Pulling your cloak tight against the bitter wind, you set your sights toward the first skeletal wreck.

nodes.title: The Albatross Ribs
nodes.brief: The Wreck of the Albatross: The shattered hull of a merchant vessel offers shelter from the biting wind, though scavengers already lurk inside.
nodes.page:
Iron ribs arch over the silt like the skeleton of some drowned beast, shielding the lee of the merchant hull from the scouring brine-wind. Scavengers huddle near rusted windlasses, whispering of fresh water springs beneath the seabed and sharpening rusted blades against the salt-crust. Every shadow cast by the listing bulwarks hides a rival crew or a watcher from the Brineholders.

Between the cracked strakes and rusted anchor chains, narrow gaps invite you deeper into the wreck's dry belly, or outward toward the open salt-flats where the horizon shimmers under the leaden sky.

exits.label: Slip through the splintered timber gap

nodes.title: Waterlogged Ledger
nodes.brief: You decipher the captain's waterlogged ledger to find a hidden cache, risking a sudden deck collapse to claim a silver compass.
nodes.page: Thick parchment swollen with salt sticks together like salted hides, demanding careful fingers to pry each page apart without tearing the ink. Heavy beams groan overhead in the wind, threatening to drop tons of rotten oak onto your stooped shoulders while you peer into the gloom. By the faint grey light filtering through a fractured scuttle, strange symbols emerge from the damp pulp. You trace a faded diagram pointing toward the captain's private chart chest tucked beneath the flooring.

exits.label: Pry open the hidden floor panel

nodes.title: The Captains Ledger
nodes.brief: You decipher the captain's waterlogged ledger to find a hidden cache, risking a sudden deck collapse to claim a silver compass.
nodes.page: Rotting oak groans beneath your boots as you pry open the captain's seaman chest, its salt-crust flaking away to reveal a ledger swollen with dark ink. Every line of crabbed handwriting hides a secret coordinate, but the rusted deck-beams overhead sag dangerously with the weight of collapsed bulkheads. You trace the damp pages for the hidden cache while a sudden shift in the timbers warns that the entire ceiling is about to come down upon your head.

check.label: Pry the silver compass from the rotting deck

nodes.title: A Heavy Cost
nodes.brief: You decipher the captain's waterlogged ledger to find a hidden cache, risking a sudden deck collapse to claim a silver compass.
nodes.page: Timbers splinter violently beneath your boots as the floor drops away, plunging you knee-deep into jagged debris and tearing a deep, bleeding gash across your shin. You haul yourself free from the settling wreckage with aching muscles, gasping for breath in the salt-choked air while precious supplies spill into the dark mud below. The wound burns fiercely, a stark reminder of the seabed's hidden teeth, but you keep moving before the rest of the hull collapses.

nodes.title: The Silver Compass
nodes.brief: You decipher the captain's waterlogged ledger to find a hidden cache, risking a sudden deck collapse to claim a silver compass.
nodes.page: Dust settles around the shattered timbers as your fingers close on the cold metal casing set in the velvet lining. A delicate glass face reveals a needle spinning wildly over a rusted dial, refusing to point north in a world where the sea has vanished. You slip the heavy keepsake into your coat pocket, feeling its reassuring weight against your ribs as you step back out into the open air.

nodes.title: Cargo Hold Glyphs
nodes.brief: You translate the strange markings on the cargo crates, avoiding a trapped mechanism to secure a bundle of waterproof matches.
nodes.page: Heavy cedar crates stamped with the seal of the Brineholders fill the dark lower deck, their iron bands furred with green corrosion. Strange symbols are carved into the timber lids, warning of volatile compounds or cursed contraband meant for the wealthy enclaves. You kneel in the damp gloom, turning a tallow candle over in your fingers to inspect the wax seals before touching the latch.

nodes.title: The Iron Sealing
nodes.brief: You translate the strange markings on the cargo crates, avoiding a trapped mechanism to secure a bundle of waterproof matches.
nodes.page: Thick wax flakes away under your thumbnail to reveal heavy iron latches forged in the shape of coiling sea-serpents. A faint hiss escapes from the seam as fresh air hits the interior, releasing the sharp scent of damp wool and old spices. One by one you draw the bolts back, watching for any hidden triggers or poisoned needles left by cautious merchants.

nodes.title: The Serpent Latch
nodes.brief: You translate the strange markings on the cargo crates, avoiding a trapped mechanism to secure a bundle of waterproof matches.
nodes.page: Cold metal resists your fingers as you turn the ornate serpent clasp, feeling a slight spring tension beneath the rusted iron plate. One wrong twitch could snap a concealed copper wire and trigger whatever mechanical trap the old merchants rigged to guard their wares. You steady your breathing in the silent hull, testing the resistance of the bolt against the palm of your hand.

nodes.title: Snapped Wire
nodes.brief: You translate the strange markings on the cargo crates, avoiding a trapped mechanism to secure a bundle of waterproof matches.
nodes.page: A click sounds in the dark hold a fraction too late, and an iron spring lashes out across your knuckles and draws a line of blood.
