You jerk your hand back with a hiss of breath and clutch your wrist while your tallow candle tumbles into the dark silt and dies. The trap is sprung. You finish unsealing the crate by the dim grey light of the bulkhead gap.

nodes.title: Waterproof Matches
nodes.brief: You translate the strange markings on the cargo crates, avoiding a trapped mechanism to secure a bundle of waterproof matches.
nodes.page: Smooth wooden sticks tipped with dark sulfur emerge from the wax-sealed tin, completely untouched by the damp salt air that rots everything else on the Low. You slide the snug lid back into place, pocketing the dry treasures alongside your remaining gear with a quiet sigh of relief. Every scrap of dry tinder is worth its weight in silver out here on the barren seabed.

nodes.title: Watchers in the Hull
nodes.brief: You study the scavenging patterns of rival crews to slip past their lookouts, securing an intact spyglass for your journey.
nodes.page:
Salt-rimed timbers creak beneath your boots as you crouch behind the ribs of a three-masted merchantman stranded on its beam-ends. Across the dry silt, two rival scavengers from the Brineholder payroll pick their way through a drift of waterlogged barrels, their copper lanterns swinging with rhythmic caution. You wait until their backs turn toward a tangled shroud of rigging before darting across the open rib-valley.

Tucked inside a canvas creel lashed to a dead man's spar rests an intact brass spyglass, its lenses clouded with film but completely free of salt-pitting. You slip it into your coat pocket as the lookouts shift their patrol.

nodes.title: Ribs of the Merchantman
nodes.brief: You study the scavenging patterns of rival crews to slip past their lookouts, securing an intact spyglass for your journey.
nodes.page:
Grey light stretches across the exposed seabed as you track a competing Gullmouth crew on the lower terrace. Their lookout sits perched on an overturned anchor-stock. He chews dried kelp and watches the upper ridges rather than the debris directly below. You slide past their flank through the hollow shell of a half-buried barge with the care of a net-mender picking loose knots.

Inside the splintered cabin a polished brass spyglass rests on a coil of hemp rope, left behind in some hurried scramble. You snatch the glass. Cold metal settles into your palm before you slide it deep into your lining.

nodes.title: Through the Lookout's Arc
nodes.brief: You study the scavenging patterns of rival crews to slip past their lookouts, securing an intact spyglass for your journey.
nodes.page: Crouch low against the ribbed iron hull where the shadows thin out and the white crust of the salt-flats reflects a pale, unforgiving glare. Fifty paces ahead, a pair of rival lookouts from the Brineholders lean against a winch-drum, sweeping their gaze across the open trench every time a gull screeches overhead. You need to cross a patch of loose shell-grit without sending a clatter through the quiet dead zone, timing your movement precisely to the rhythm of their sweeping heads. Every muscle in your legs bunches as you prepare to cross the white line.

nodes.title: Caught in the Glare
nodes.brief: You study the scavenging patterns of rival crews to slip past their lookouts, securing an intact spyglass for your journey.
nodes.page: A dry twig snaps beneath your heel with the sound of a pistol crack, shattering the quiet of the trench. One of the lookouts whips around, shouting a warning across the silt as you scramble headlong behind a pile of waterlogged crates. An iron grappling hook comes flying through the air, clips your shoulder, and tears a long jagged rent in your wool coat; a bruise marks your collarbone. You tumble into the shadow of a sunken fishing smack, clutching your bruised arm as the angry shouts fade back into the murmur of the dry seabed.

nodes.title: Scavenged Sight
nodes.brief: You study the scavenging patterns of rival crews to slip past their lookouts, securing an intact spyglass for your journey.
nodes.page: Other boots walk these same dead waters. Movement has to stay ghost-silent among the wreck ribs and stranded keels. You pick your footing the way a man crosses thin ice over a winter marsh, testing each plank before the next. The far side of the wreck-field arrives underfoot with the prize intact. A long brass spyglass rests in your grip, lenses clear enough to pick out the distant ladders of Saltspire against the horizon haze.

nodes.title: Down the Water-Stair
nodes.brief: You recall old tide maps to navigate the treacherous cargo hold, dodging a falling mast to find a sealed jar of lantern oil.
nodes.page:
Memory is the only lamp that matters when the tide is gone and the old sea-roads rot in the open air. You mentally trace the lines of the cargo hold from the coastal charts Orsolya pinned to the lighthouse wall, stepping over rotting crates of dried salt-cod and displaced ballast stones. A sharp groan above makes you jerk backward just as a massive pine mast snaps from its rusted iron collar, crashing down across the exact spot where your boots stood a heartbeat prior.

Beneath a tangle of wet canvas in the forward locker, you find a small, heavy jar of refined lantern oil sealed with thick green wax.

nodes.title: Cargo Hold Navigation
nodes.brief: You recall old tide maps to navigate the treacherous cargo hold, dodging a falling mast to find a sealed jar of lantern oil.
nodes.page:
Darkness pools heavy between the jagged bulkheads of the sunken coal-carrier, smelling of ancient bilge and rotted oakum. Relying on your mental draft of the vessel's internal framework, you sidestep a gaping hole where the deck-planks have rotted away into empty blackness. A sudden sharp crack rings out overhead, and a towering oak mast shears free from its stays, slamming down into the hold with a thunderous blow that showers the deck in dry splinters right beside your shoulder.

You press onward into the corner alcove where a sealed earthenware jar of thick lantern oil sits wedged between two ribs.

nodes.title: Beneath the Groaning Spars
nodes.brief: You recall old tide maps to navigate the treacherous cargo hold, dodging a falling mast to find a sealed jar of lantern oil.
nodes.page: Step by step, you pick your way through the pitch-black belly of the stranded freighter, guided only by the memory of old harbour blueprints and the scrape of your boots on grit. The entire skeletal framework of the ship shifts with a dry, metallic groan as the weight of the seabed settles unevenly against its rusted plates. Directly above, a massive timber spar hangs suspended by a single frayed wire cable, swaying sluggishly in the draft and threatening to drop tons of dead wood upon anyone who misjudges the timing of their next stride. You pause in the dark, breath held, measuring the swing of the iron-bound timber.

nodes.title: Struck in the Dark
nodes.brief: You recall old tide maps to navigate the treacherous cargo hold, dodging a falling mast to find a sealed jar of lantern oil.
nodes.page: The cable snaps with a sharp metallic twang before your foot touches the clear floor, and the massive pine spar crashes down through the rotting deck-timbers. The blow catches you across the ribs. Wind leaves your lungs in a ragged gasp, and a splintered beam pins your leather kit-bag. You wrench yourself free with a desperate heave. A strip of your coat stays behind. Along your side a deep bruise makes every breath burn like salt water.

exits.label: Crawl out through the splintered gap

nodes.title: Oil in the Silt
nodes.brief: You recall old tide maps to navigate the treacherous cargo hold, dodging a falling mast to find a sealed jar of lantern oil.
nodes.page: Every salvage run extracts its toll from those who walk the naked seabed, whether paid in skin, time, or the cold sweat of a near miss. You clear falling timber and the dark hazards of the cargo hold, then emerge from the wreck with your prize secured against the coming night. Firmly clutched in your hand is a thick earthenware jar of clear lantern oil, sealed tight with green apothecary wax to keep the salt rot from spoiling the fuel.

exits.label: Press on toward the rumbling plains

nodes.title: The Earth Gives Way
nodes.brief: A distant rumble echoes across the plains as a massive sinkhole opens ahead, swallowing a cluster of drowned homes.
nodes.page: Tremors pulse through the damp floor of the Low, shaking loose the crust of salt and ancient silt. Far ahead, a deep subterranean groan splits the silence, followed by the terrifying sound of snapping timber and falling stone. A cluster of drowned timber houses, long preserved in the suffocating quiet of the seabed, tilts crazily into a sudden, yawning chasm. Grey dust billows into the heavy air, carrying the sharp stench of stagnant mud and rotting kelp as the earth swallows whole streets in a heartbeat.

exits.label: Pick a path around the dust

nodes.title: The Salt-Flats Sinkholes
nodes.brief: The Salt-Flats Sinkholes: A sprawling expanse of brittle white crust hides deep, treacherous pits that vent strange, intoxicating gases into the cold air.
nodes.page: Brittle crusts of white salt stretch out toward the hazy horizon, concealing bottomless pits where strange, intoxicating gases hiss into the cold air. The ground here feels dangerously thin beneath your boots, whispering with the pressure of trapped vapors from below. Every direction offers a perilous temptation, from half-buried treasures glinting in the pale light to the looming, cathedral ribs of the great leviathan far across the flats.

exits.label: Trace the edge of the pit

nodes.title: Reclaiming the Line
nodes.brief: You fashion a sturdy grappling hook from scattered debris, risking a fatal plunge to retrieve a preserved coil of rope.
nodes.page: Tangled heaps of rotting hemp and rusted iron litter the perimeter of the fractured basin. Sifting through the debris with numb fingers, you spot a length of thick, salt-preserved rope coiled beneath a heavy slab of timber. Working quickly to avoid a sudden shift in the rubble, you fashion a makeshift grappling hook from a discarded boat-hook and a curved iron cleat. The prize is stubborn and slow to move, but patience finally frees the coil into your waiting hands.

nodes.title: Reaching Across the Chasm
nodes.brief: You fashion a sturdy grappling hook from scattered debris, risking a fatal plunge to retrieve a preserved coil of rope.
nodes.page: Loose shale clatters into the black void as you lean over the edge of the jagged crevice, dangling the makeshift iron hook toward a coil of thick maritime rope snagged on a jutting timber below. The weight of the line pulls awkwardly against your grip, and the frozen mud beneath your boots begins to crumble and slide toward the abyss. You brace your muscles and test the balance of the crude tool, waiting to see if the makeshift metal claws will bite firmly into the wood or slip into the dark below.

nodes.title: Slipping into the Grey
nodes.brief: You fashion a sturdy grappling hook from scattered debris, risking a fatal plunge to retrieve a preserved coil of rope.
nodes.page: The frozen mud gives way without warning, plunging your boots into a sudden slide of loose shale and sharp debris. You throw your weight backward, scraping your palms raw against the jagged edge of the salt-crust as you scramble desperately for purchase. The coil of rope tumbles further down into the gloom, leaving you breathless and nursing a deep, stinging gash across your knuckles. Though you manage to haul yourself back onto solid ground, the mishap costs precious time and leaves your muscles aching with a bitter chill.

nodes.title: Snagging the Line
nodes.brief: You fashion a sturdy grappling hook from scattered debris, risking a fatal plunge to retrieve a preserved coil of rope.
nodes.page: Your fingers strain against the sudden weight as the crude iron prongs bite deep into the water-logged timber, holding firm despite the treacherous slide of the mud. One slow heave draws the prize upward until the hemp coil settles safely onto the dry grit beside your boots. It is a solid piece of gear, smelling faintly of old tar and briny depths, ready to serve when the road ahead grows steeper.

nodes.title: Stripping the Winch
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted winch mechanism near the edge, carefully avoiding jagged metal to extract a heavy iron gear.
nodes.page: At the edge of the dry basin, iron plates and frozen grease hold the old winch mechanism in a stubborn grip. Using the flat of your blade as a wedge, you hammer away the thick encrustation of salt until the rusted housing finally gives way with a metallic shriek. A tooth-cut gear still greased against the salt-rot and remarkably sound lies inside the battered casing. You pry it free from its housing, feeling the gratifying heft of solid iron in your palms.

nodes.title: Turning the Iron
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted winch mechanism near the edge, carefully avoiding jagged metal to extract a heavy iron gear.
nodes.page: The tooth-cut gear rides cold against your hip as you leave the winch housing behind and pick a path down the cracked basin rim. Salt crust breaks under each step, and the greased iron ticks against your canteen with every stride. You keep one hand on the strap that holds it, scanning the haze for a clear route across the flats toward the next low ground. Wind off the dry basin lifts white grit into your teeth as you carry the salvage on.

exits.label: Carry the gear across the low

nodes.title: Striking the Rusted Metal
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted winch mechanism near the edge, carefully avoiding jagged metal to extract a heavy iron gear.
nodes.page: The rusted housing of the winch groans under the bite of your blade and refuses to yield its inner workings to an impatient hand. Jagged flakes of iron scale fly through the air as you hammer the wedge deeper into the rusted seam, feeling the ancient metal resist every blow. The whole frame shudders on its mounting bolts, threatening to collapse and trap your fingers in the grinding mechanism if you misjudge the next strike.

nodes.title: Crushed in the Casing
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted winch mechanism near the edge, carefully avoiding jagged metal to extract a heavy iron gear.
nodes.page: A sudden jar sends the rusted frame shifting sideways, trapping your hand against the jagged iron housing with a bruising force. You grit your teeth against the sudden pain, wrenching your fingers free just as the entire winch assembly collapses into a heap of useless scrap. The injury leaves your knuckles swollen and stiff, a sharp reminder of the hazards hidden within the wreckage of the old port.

nodes.title: Freeing the Mechanism
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted winch mechanism near the edge, carefully avoiding jagged metal to extract a heavy iron gear.
nodes.page: Your blade finds the precise seam in the rusted iron, and with a sharp twist of your wrist, the stubborn casing splits open to release its hidden treasure. The heavy iron gear tumbles out into the silt, its teeth intact and gleaming with old grease despite the surrounding decay. You wipe the grime from the metal and tuck it safely into your pack, knowing such clean salvage is rare indeed upon the naked seabed.

nodes.title: Lifting the Salt Crust
nodes.brief: You pry open a half-buried sea chest embedded in the crust, straining against the hardened salt to claim a heavy cutlass.
nodes.page: Thick encrustations of white salt seal the iron-strapped lid of the sea chest against the dead seabed, hiding whatever plunder lies within its dark depths. Working your crowbar into the narrow gap, you throw your weight against the handle, feeling the ancient wood groan under the pressure of decades of dry exposure. The crust fractures with a dry, popping sound like snapping bones, releasing a puff of stagnant air that smells of old brine and rotting kelp.

nodes.title: Forcing the Seal
nodes.brief: You pry open a half-buried sea chest embedded in the crust, straining against the hardened salt to claim a heavy cutlass.
nodes.page: Muscles strain against the unyielding resistance of the hardened salt and rusted hinges, every fiber of your arms trembling under the sudden, brutal weight of the rusted lid. You plant your boots firmly into the damp seabed silt, throwing your full strength into one desperate, final heave to snap the iron lock before the entire casing gives way and buries the prize forever.

nodes.title: Bruised and Burdened
nodes.brief: You pry open a half-buried sea chest embedded in the crust, straining against the hardened salt to claim a heavy cutlass.
nodes.page: The rusted iron slams shut with a bone-jarring crash, catching your knuckles against the abrasive crust and sending a searing ache up your forearms. You stumble backward into the damp sand, nursing a jagged, bleeding scrape across your hand that will throb for days in the salt air. Valuable daylight slips away as you catch your breath, leaving you empty-handed and sore on the open seabed.

nodes.title: Claiming the Heavy Blade
nodes.brief: You pry open a half-buried sea chest embedded in the crust, straining against the hardened salt to claim a heavy cutlass.
nodes.page: Steel slides free from its rotting velvet bed with a scrape, balanced after years under the receding tides. You test the edge with a calloused thumb; old metal still takes an edge after worse than a dry seabed. You stow the weapon at your belt and leave the empty chest to sink back into the grey silt.

nodes.title: Reaching for the Ledge
nodes.brief: You haul a trapped scavenger from a crumbling ledge, risking your own footing to earn a pouch of rare coins.
nodes.page: Jagged chunks of limestone crumble beneath a stranded fellow's frantic grip, threatening to plunge them down into the shadowed fissure below the old cliffline. You drop your pack and scramble across the slick rock face, sliding your boots into a narrow crevice to brace yourself against the drop. Reaching down with one outstretched arm, you catch hold of a salt-crusted sleeve just as the climber's footing gives way entirely.

nodes.title: Bracing Against the Drop
nodes.brief: You haul a trapped scavenger from a crumbling ledge, risking your own footing to earn a pouch of rare coins.
nodes.page: Your shoulder muscles burn as the full, dead weight of the falling scavenger drags you perilously close to the jagged edge of the chasm. Digging your boot heels deep into the crumbling sediment, you arch your back and pull with everything you have left, fighting gravity and the treacherous pull of the unstable stone beneath you.

nodes.title: Slipping the Margin
nodes.brief: You haul a trapped scavenger from a crumbling ledge, risking your own footing to earn a pouch of rare coins.
nodes.page: Loose gravel cascades into the dark cleft below as your boot slips an inch, wrenching your shoulder socket with a sudden, agonizing jolt. You manage to drag the gasping stranger onto solid stone, but the violent strain leaves you doubled over and clutching a bruised side that aches with every breath. The cost of the rescue is stamped deep into your muscles as you stand shaking on the ledge.

nodes.title: Purse of the Rescued
nodes.brief: You haul a trapped scavenger from a crumbling ledge, risking your own footing to earn a pouch of rare coins.
nodes.page: Gratefully coughing up lungfuls of bitter dust, the rescued wrecker shoves a heavy leather pouch into your palm before vanishing back toward the cliff shadows without a backward glance. Silver coins clink inside the damp sack, a welcome purse for your split-second gamble on the crumbling stone. You secure the bounty tightly inside your coat and look back out across the wide expanse of the Low.

nodes.title: Breaking the Petrified Hull
nodes.brief: You smash through the petrified hull of a sunken dinghy, ignoring the toxic fumes to grab a sturdy wooden oar.
nodes.page: Rotting timbers hardened by decades of salt-soaking offer stubborn resistance to your heavy boots, refusing to yield easily to your assault. Again and again you swing the iron-shod pole into the warped ribs of the sunken dinghy, splintering the ancient wood until a dark cavity opens inside the ruined hull. Thick, greenish vapors escape from the breach, stinging your eyes, but you spot the smooth grain of an intact oar wedged inside the ribs.

nodes.title: Splitting the Hull
nodes.brief: You smash through the petrified hull of a sunken dinghy, ignoring the toxic fumes to grab a sturdy wooden oar.
nodes.page: Trapped air from the sunken dinghy's bowels smells of old bilge and rotten kelp, thick enough to coat your tongue in gray grease. You wedge the heel of your boot against the waterlogged gunwale and swing your heavy iron-shod maul with both arms, putting your back into the blow to shatter the petrified ribs of the craft. A cloud of black silt and stinging vapor bursts from the fracture, but you ignore the burning in your lungs and shove your shoulder into the gap, reaching deep into the dark interior for the clean, dry heft of an unbroken oar.

check.label: Drive your shoulder through the timbers

nodes.title: Choking on the Fumes
nodes.brief: You smash through the petrified hull of a sunken dinghy, ignoring the toxic fumes to grab a sturdy wooden oar.
nodes.page: A sudden burst of noxious, yellow gas erupts from the heart of the wreck, blinding you with stinging heat and sending you staggering backward into the mud. You cough until your ribs ache, gasping for clean air while the broken dinghy settles further into the shifting silt. The oar remains trapped inside the wreckage, lost to you along with the time spent hacking at the useless wood.

nodes.title: Seizing the Sturdy Oar
nodes.brief: You smash through the petrified hull of a sunken dinghy, ignoring the toxic fumes to grab a sturdy wooden oar.
nodes.page: Wood snaps cleanly under a final, well-placed blow, freeing the long oar from its cramped berth within the petrified ribs. You pull it free with a triumphant grunt, admiring the polished grain that somehow survived the drowning of the coast untouched by rot. It will serve well as a walking staff across the shifting flats or a lever when the ground turns traitorous beneath your boots.

nodes.title: The Ribs of Goliath
nodes.brief: The horizon darkens as you approach the immense, decaying bulk of a stranded leviathan, its pale ribs towering like a cathedral.
nodes.page:
Gray skies press down on the exposed seabed and smell sharply of old decay and salt-crusted mud. Ahead the colossal carcass of a stranded leviathan looms against the horizon, and its bleached ribs rise into the air like the vaulted nave of a drowned cathedral. Blackened blubber drips from the jaw-bones into slick puddles that take the dull sunless light. Scavengers hurry along the spine with iron hooks and coiled hemp through the massive ribcage. Ooze drags at your boots. The open sea is gone, and only this monument of flesh and bone marks where the deep once stood.

You edge closer to the towering skeletal barrier, and through the heart of the beast the noise of trade and haggling begins to swell over the silence of the Low.

nodes.title: The Leviathan Belly
nodes.brief: The Leviathan Market: Scavengers and opportunistic merchants have set up a bustling, foul-smelling bazaar within the rotting belly of the dead sea beast.
nodes.page: Inside the colossal ribcage, a chaotic bazaar thrives amidst the drying sinew and grease-slicked ribs. Merchants shout over the din of clinking copper and rasping saws, hawking salted scraps of meat, rusted anchors, and cloudy glass vials of distilled brine. The air is thick with smoke from fat-lamps and the heavy stench of rendered oil that clings to the back of your throat. Every shadow holds a bargain or a blade, and the crowd presses close, eager to strip whatever value remains from the dead giant before the tide decides to return. You stand at a crossroads of bone and mire, weighing where your next desperate step must fall.

exits.label: Hunt for fuel near the tallow-vats
Seek a map from the pawn-widow

nodes.title: Smoke and Sinew
nodes.brief: You wrestle a massive slab of blubber away from a territorial hound, taking heavy bruises to secure a valuable fuel source.
nodes.page: Shadows stretch long across the grease-soaked floor as you edge deeper into the cavernous ribcage, dodging carriers hauling heavy tubs of rendering fat. A sharp, feral snarl cuts through the hubbub from the darker recesses beneath a dropped shoulder-blade. There, a lean, salt-scabby hound with yellow eyes crouches over a thick, blood-matted slab of blubber, teeth bared in warning as you draw near. The beast blocks the narrow trail leading toward the outer rib-path, its muscles bunched and ready to spring if you show the slightest hesitation.

nodes.title: The Snarling Guardian
nodes.brief: You wrestle a massive slab of blubber away from a territorial hound, taking heavy bruises to secure a valuable fuel source.
nodes.page: You pace the slick mire with eyes locked on the hound, fingers curled around the haft of your iron-shod oar. The creature drops its head low, saliva dripping from yellow fangs into the dark mud as it circles you with unsettling patience. Every movement inside the cavernous belly seems to hush, leaving only the wet sucking sound of paws and boots in the grease. You raise the oar like a barrier, waiting for the split second the animal launches its scarred frame at your throat.

nodes.title: Bracing Against Jaws
nodes.brief: You wrestle a massive slab of blubber away from a territorial hound, taking heavy bruises to secure a valuable fuel source.
nodes.page: You heave your weight forward, thrusting the heavy wooden oar straight at the lunging hound while the beast snaps viciously at your forearms. Claws rake across your leather jerkin, tearing thick hide as hot breath fogs the damp air between you. Straining every muscle in your back and shoulders, you fight to pin the snarling weight against a ribbed pillar of bone before its teeth find flesh.

nodes.title: Torn Flesh and Mud
nodes.brief: You wrestle a massive slab of blubber away from a territorial hound, taking heavy bruises to secure a valuable fuel source.
nodes.page: Teeth sink deep into your forearm before you can bring the oar around, and a white-hot flare of agony shoots up your shoulder. You lash out with a booted heel, catch the creature squarely in the ribs, and send it howling away into the shadows of the rotting hull. Your sleeve soaks dark with blood. A jagged tear in your skin burns with salt-rot.

nodes.title: Heavy-Earned Spoils
nodes.brief: You wrestle a massive slab of blubber away from a territorial hound, taking heavy bruises to secure a valuable fuel source.
nodes.page: You wrench the thick slab of gray blubber free from the animal's grip and feel the lump of fat slide into your hempen sack. Though your knuckles are bruised and your breath comes in ragged gasps, the prize is secure, offering both valuable fuel for the long trek ahead and a hard-won proof of your resolve.

nodes.title: The Widow's Stall
nodes.brief: You negotiate fiercely with a suspicious pawn-widow, maintaining your composure to trade scrap metal for a map of the dunes.
nodes.page: Curtains of dried shark-skin rattle in the drafty gloom of a pelvic arch where a hunched pawn-widow presides over piles of tarnished brass and salt-flecked parchment. Her clouded eyes track your approach with practiced suspicion while bony fingers tap rhythmically against a counter made of a sawed-off jawbone. You need her hand-drawn map of the singing dunes if you want to cross the shifting salt-flats without getting swallowed by a dry-sinkhole, but she deals exclusively in rare leverage or hard coin.

nodes.title: Weighing Every Word
nodes.brief: You negotiate fiercely with a suspicious pawn-widow, maintaining your composure to trade scrap metal for a map of the dunes.
nodes.page: You meet the widow's cold, calculating stare without flinching, laying a polished brass sextant frame onto the bone counter as your opening bid. She tilts her head, her breath smelling of stale kelp and dried mint, while she weighs the metal in a palm scarred by fishhooks. Any sign of desperation in your voice will double her price or send her reaching for the copper-bladed knife tucked beneath her greasy shawl.

nodes.title: A Sour Trade
nodes.brief: You negotiate fiercely with a suspicious pawn-widow, maintaining your composure to trade scrap metal for a map of the dunes.
nodes.page:
Coins of thin lead and salt-pitted brass slide across the greasy timber counter while the pawn-widow weighs your iron shards with a suspicious squint. She finds a hairline crack in your best bolt-plate, her blackened thumb pressing hard into the fissure until the metal flakes away like dry skin. You are forced to surrender three weeks of dried lamp-meat and a heavy bronze linchpin just to balance the scale. She mutters a dry blessing over the parchment map of the dunes, slipping it into your palm with fingers cold as bilge-water.

Your knuckles ache from the pinch, and the empty pouch pulls light at your belt as you turn back toward the salt-flats.

exits.label: Step back into the bitter wind

nodes.title: The Price of Parchment
nodes.brief: You negotiate fiercely with a suspicious pawn-widow, maintaining your composure to trade scrap metal for a map of the dunes.
nodes.page:
Through shrewd glances and level breaths, you hold your ground against the pawn-widow's sharp-eyed inspection of your salvage. She taps her ledger with a notched bone needle, weighing the worth of your rusted gears against the yellowed skin of her chart. The bargain is struck without a copper changing hands, leaving your dignity intact and your pockets unburdened by debt. She hands you a grease-stained strip of hide marked with the shifting contours of the Singing Dunes.

You fold the sheepskin close to your ribs, knowing the shifting sands will test every step of the crossing ahead.

exits.label: Return to the noisy market stalls

nodes.title: The Bone Still
nodes.brief: You repair a merchant's broken water-still using discarded bones, carefully balancing the delicate components to earn a full canteen.
nodes.page:
Salt cakes the joints of the merchant's copper still until it resembles a crustacean shell left too long in the sun. You wedge a curved rib bone into the bent feed-pipe, tapping the porous ivory with the heel of your palm until the fit is airtight. A drop of brackish moisture gathers at the spout, hangs a moment, then falls clear. The trader hands over a sealed skin of water, heavy and cool against your hip.

The horizon hums with the distant grinding of the seabed machinery.

exits.label: Secure the water skin and press onward across the salt flats

nodes.title: Restoring the Filter
nodes.brief: You repair a merchant's broken water-still using discarded bones, carefully balancing the delicate components to earn a full canteen.
nodes.page: Working by the pale glare of a stranded jellyfish lantern, you scrape the calcified salt from the brass condenser coil using a sharp limpet shell. Every motion must be measured, for a careless slip will crack the brittle wiring salvaged from a sunken galley. The merchant watches your hands with hungry eyes, muttering nervous prayers to the missing sea. When you finally seat the bone valve into place, a clean trickle of clear water flows into the tin cup.

exits.label: Take the filled canteen and leave the merchant to his trade

nodes.title: The Fragile Seam
nodes.brief: You repair a merchant's broken water-still using discarded bones, carefully balancing the delicate components to earn a full canteen.
nodes.page: Brittle ribs of ancient leviathans and green-corroded copper tubing require a surgeon's touch if this leaking still is to hold pressure once more. You balance a wafer-thin bone wedge against the fractured condenser flange, your breath held shallow against the bitter smell of stagnant brine. One clumsy slip with the hammer will splinter the delicate bone strut beyond recall, spilling the merchant's last reserve into the mud. Your fingers twitch as you raise the tiny lead mallet over the fragile joint, measuring the exact force needed to seat the pin without shattering the casing.

nodes.title: A Bitter Patch
nodes.brief: You repair a merchant's broken water-still using discarded bones, carefully balancing the delicate components to earn a full canteen.
nodes.page:
Bone shatters under the clumsy blow, spraying sharp white splinters across the greasy timber and rupturing the primary distillation chamber with a sudden hiss of steam. The merchant curses through chapped lips as precious condensation escapes into the thirsty air, leaving you both empty-handed and short on time. You spend an hour scavenging scrap lead and fat from your kit to bodge a clumsy replacement sleeve that barely holds together under heat.

The repair is ugly and drips without pause, yet it works well enough to earn you a begrudging half-measure of tepid water and a sour look from the stall-owner.

nodes.title: The Clean Seal
nodes.brief: You repair a merchant's broken water-still using discarded bones, carefully balancing the delicate components to earn a full canteen.
nodes.page:
Bone shatters not, nor does the ancient copper yield under your precise taps, sliding smoothly into a tight, brine-tight union that hums softly as heat builds within the chamber. Clean droplets begin to bead along the interior capillary tube, falling rhythmically into the collection basin with a clear, metallic chime. The merchant lets out a ragged sigh of relief, shoving a brimming leather flask into your palm with genuine gratitude shining through the grime on his cheeks.

You pocket the reward and secure your gear against the coming chill of the salt flats.

nodes.title: Intercepting the Brutes
nodes.brief: You confront a band of aggressive thugs harassing a vendor, risking a violent brawl to gain the merchant's loyal patronage.
nodes.page:
Gray salt dust rises under iron-shod boots as three broad-shouldered wreckers from an opposing crew pin the terrified fish-monger against a ribbed whale-wall. You step straight into their path and block the narrow alley between two stranded hulls, one hand resting casually on the hilt of your salvage scraper. The lead thug stops short, smelling of stale ale and old sweat, his scarred lip curling into a cruel grin as he sizes up your lean frame.

Words pass back and forth like grinding stones, neither side willing to give ground in the shadow of the rotting ribs.

nodes.title: Staring Down the Pack
nodes.brief: You confront a band of aggressive thugs harassing a vendor, risking a violent brawl to gain the merchant's loyal patronage.
nodes.page: Three burly wreckers from a rival crew block the narrow passage, their iron-studded cudgels dragging lazily through the gray seabed salt as they close in on the cornered vendor. You stand your ground squarely in the middle of the alley, locking your gaze onto the scarred leader's yellowed eyes without a single flicker of doubt. The tension stretches taut as a damp bowstring while the bullies weigh the cost of a messy fight against whatever scraps the merchant has hidden in his coat. You steady your breathing, waiting to see if your cold stare will break their nerve or invite a crushing blow.

nodes.title: Bruised and Defiant
nodes.brief: You confront a band of aggressive thugs harassing a vendor, risking a violent brawl to gain the merchant's loyal patronage.
nodes.page:
An iron-capped cudgel catches you across the shoulder before you can duck. White-hot agony runs down your arm and drives you hard into the damp ribs of a stranded hull. The thugs press their advantage with mocking laughter, raining blows onto your ribs until you manage to sweep the lead brawler's legs out from under him into the foul mud. Scrambling back to your feet with a bruised shoulder and a split lip, you bare your teeth and refuse to yield another inch of the alley.

The bullies spit into the salt and back away, leaving you battered but the vendor untouched.

nodes.title: Breaking the Bullies
nodes.brief: You confront a band of aggressive thugs harassing a vendor, risking a violent brawl to gain the merchant's loyal patronage.
nodes.page:
Your unwavering stare and sudden, deliberate shift of weight makes the lead thug hesitate just long enough for doubt to take root in his muddy eyes. Recognizing the cold certainty in your posture, the ruffian spits into the salt and pulls his snarling mates back with a sharp jerk of his scarred chin. The grateful vendor presses a heavy bundle of dried kelp and salted roe into your hands, swearing eternal loyalty to your name across every corner of the Low.

You tuck the token away, knowing you have earned a dependable friend in a lawless place.

nodes.title: The Singing Wastes
nodes.brief: Leaving the market behind, you enter a vast stretch of sand that hums and vibrates with an eerie, mournful resonance.
nodes.page: The foul-smelling bustle of the leviathan carcass falls behind you. Ahead, pale yellow sand opens in a desolate expanse that runs out to the murky horizon. Sediment underfoot starts to shift and tremble. A slow knock climbs through boot soles into your teeth, uneven as a drowned organ under the crust. Faint silhouettes of wandering pilgrims and half-buried skeletal masts blur through the rising haze of salt dust. Deeper into the barren flats. The buried knock stays with every step.

nodes.title: The Singing Dunes
nodes.brief: The Singing Dunes: Shifting hills of golden sand emit a hypnotic sound, concealing ancient relics and the wandering figures of lost sailors.
nodes.page: Sweeping ridges of golden sand ripple under the grey sky, rolling toward the horizon in endless, whispering waves. Faint, melodic hums drift across the flats, rising and falling like the voices of drowned sailors calling from beneath the crust. Out among the shifting mounds, pale shapes wander aimlessly, half-swallowed by the dry tides of dust. Every gust stirs up buried relics that gleam briefly before sinking back into the yellow depths.

nodes.title: Buried Shrine Beneath
nodes.brief: You dig furiously through a sudden sandslide to uncover a buried shrine, exhausting your muscles to claim a jade idol.
nodes.page: Golden grains pour over your boots as you carve a trench into the side of the slope, unearthing the moss-slicked lintel of an old tide-shrine. Beneath the heavy silt lies a stone altar choked with dry salt and forgotten offerings. You pry loose a small, cool jade idol shaped like a coiled sea-serpent, its polished surface untouched by the abrasive air. Pocketing the relic, you press onward through the drifting dunes.

nodes.title: Unearthing the Relic
nodes.brief: You dig furiously through a sudden sandslide to uncover a buried shrine, exhausting your muscles to claim a jade idol.
nodes.page: Heavy tons of sun-baked sand suddenly give way above the partially buried shrine, threatening to bury you alive in a suffocating wave of yellow dust. You brace your shoulders against the shifting weight, planting your boots deep into the firm crust below to fend off the landslide. Every muscle in your back strains as the sliding slope presses down with brutal force.

nodes.title: Buried in Dust
nodes.brief: You dig furiously through a sudden sandslide to uncover a buried shrine, exhausting your muscles to claim a jade idol.
nodes.page: The sliding wall of sand overpowers your footing, burying you up to the chest before you can claw your way clear. You gasp in a mouthful of grit and alkaline dust, lungs burning, and wrench at your legs to free them from the sand trap. By the time you haul yourself onto stable ground, your supplies are fouled with sand and a dull ache throbs through your bruised ribs.

nodes.title: The Jade Serpent
nodes.brief: You dig furiously through a sudden sandslide to uncover a buried shrine, exhausting your muscles to claim a jade idol.
nodes.page: You stagger free of the shifting collapse with the cool jade idol locked in your fist, polished surface free of scratches. Whether through careful leverage or sheer stubborn luck, you managed to unseat the relic before the entire slope came down. The carved serpent hums faintly against your palm, a curious prize salvaged from the dry seabed.

nodes.title: Listening to the Sands
nodes.brief: You analyze the pitch of the singing sands to locate solid ground, avoiding dangerous quicksand to reach an abandoned campsite.
nodes.page: Low, melodic vibrations hum through the soles of your boots, warning of hollow cavities and treacherous quicksand hidden beneath the golden ripples. You trace the shifting pitch of the dunes, stepping carefully from one firm shelf of salt-crust to the next. Ahead, the ruins of an abandoned camp emerge from the dust like the ribcage of a beached whale, offering a temporary shelter from the wind.

nodes.title: Navigating the Quicksand
nodes.brief: You analyze the pitch of the singing sands to locate solid ground, avoiding dangerous quicksand to reach an abandoned campsite.
nodes.page: The ground beneath your feet suddenly softens into a treacherous slurry of fine yellow silt that pulls you down with terrifying speed. You sweep your gaze across the rippling dunes, searching for subtle shifts in color and texture to map a safe route across the basin. Every second counts as the sinkhole bubbles and threatens to swallow your boots.

nodes.title: Trapped in the Silt
nodes.brief: You analyze the pitch of the singing sands to locate solid ground, avoiding dangerous quicksand to reach an abandoned campsite.
nodes.page: A misjudged step sends you plunging knee-deep into a hidden pocket of wet quicksand that drains your strength with every frantic wrench. You manage to throw your weight forward onto a sturdy driftwood timber, but the struggle exhausts your muscles and costs you precious time and water. You pull yourself clear, shivering despite the dry heat.

nodes.title: Finding Solid Ground
nodes.brief: You analyze the pitch of the singing sands to locate solid ground, avoiding dangerous quicksand to reach an abandoned campsite.
nodes.page: Reading the subtle tonal shifts in the sand's hum, you pick a precise path around the churning sinkholes and reach the safety of solid ground. Whether through sharp observation or fortunate intuition, you avoid the worst of the hidden traps without losing your stride. The desolate expanse opens up before you, offering a clear route back to the shifting crossroads.

nodes.title: Tracking the Lost
nodes.brief: You decipher the chaotic footprints left by previous travellers, navigating the shifting maze to find a discarded, sturdy walking staff.
nodes.page: Scattered footprints cross the yellow expanse like the tracks of wandering ghosts, disappearing beneath fresh drifts of wind-blown sand. You study the chaotic trail, noting where boots hesitated or slipped against the steep ridges. Following their meandering path through the maze of dunes, you spot a sturdy wooden staff half-buried in the dust, left behind by some earlier traveller.

nodes.title: The Wandering Trail
nodes.brief: You decipher the chaotic footprints left by previous travellers, navigating the shifting maze to find a discarded, sturdy walking staff.
nodes.page: Picking your way through the labyrinth of golden hills, you keep your eyes fixed on the faint indentations left by previous wanderers. The wind howls across the crests, wiping away the tracks just as you find them, forcing you to rely on your wits to stay on course. Ahead, the dunes part to reveal a wide basin sheltered from the howling gusts.

nodes.title: Deciphering the Maze
nodes.brief: You decipher the chaotic footprints left by previous travellers, navigating the shifting maze to find a discarded, sturdy walking staff.
nodes.page: The tracks split into a dozen confusing directions as the wind whips the sand into blinding, swirling curtains. You pause to analyze the direction of the ripples and the weight of the footprints, trying to determine which path leads through the labyrinth. A sudden squall of dust descends, obscuring your landmarks entirely as you make your choice.

nodes.title: Lost in the Squall
nodes.brief: You decipher the chaotic footprints left by previous travellers, navigating the shifting maze to find a discarded, sturdy walking staff.
nodes.page: The blinding dust-storm swallows the trail entirely, sending you stumbling in circles until you collide hard against a jagged ridge of sandstone. You lose precious hours huddled against the rock while the gale strips your skin raw and scatters your supplies. When the wind finally dies down, you are left bruised, disoriented, and forced to retrace your steps.

nodes.title: The Way Forward
nodes.brief: You decipher the chaotic footprints left by previous travellers, navigating the shifting maze to find a discarded, sturdy walking staff.
nodes.page:
Footprints in the shifting grain resolve into a recognizable pattern through the blinding grit, guiding your boots away from the suffocating sandstone wall. Kneeling in the hollow between two dunes, your fingers brush against smooth polished timber half-buried by the wind. Pulling it free reveals a stout wooden staff scored with old navigation notches, perfectly weighted for steadying your balance on the unstable seabed.

With this reliable length of seasoned ash in hand, the swirling curtain of dust parts enough to show a familiar downward slope leading back toward the main trail.

exits.label: Descend the slope toward the singing dunes

nodes.title: Pearls in the Sand
nodes.brief: You ignore the maddening whispers echoing from the dunes, fighting off a creeping panic to pocket a gleaming white pearl.
nodes.page:
Low, rhythmic humming vibrates through the soles of your boots, carrying an undertone of voices calling your name from just beyond the blowing crests. You force your gaze downward, ignoring the shadows that shift at the edge of your vision like drowning sailors in the brine. Half-buried in a trough of golden drift sits a round, heavy pearl, glowing with a soft, milky luster entirely untouched by the salt-crust of the Low.

Bending quickly to scoop it from the loose silt, you slide the cold sphere into your pocket before the hollow murmurs can find a footing in your thoughts.

exits.label: Follow the trough toward the open basin

nodes.title: The Whispering Crest
nodes.brief: You ignore the maddening whispers echoing from the dunes, fighting off a creeping panic to pocket a gleaming white pearl.
nodes.page:
Voices swell from the shifting sand, mimicking the exact pitch of Orsolya's warnings when the tide-bell used to crack in the salt-gale. A pale, luminous pearl rests atop the ridge, but the ground beneath it shivers like water over a sinkhole, threatening to slide away into the dark hollows below.

Bracing your shoulders against the rising wind, you focus your breathing and reach out a steady hand to snatch the treasure before the dune collapses.

check.label: Keep your nerve against the whispers

nodes.title: Sinking into the Drift
nodes.brief: You ignore the maddening whispers echoing from the dunes, fighting off a creeping panic to pocket a gleaming white pearl.
nodes.page:
Panic snatches the breath from your throat as the sand gives way beneath your boots, plunging you knee-deep into a boiling slurry of fine quartz and shell-grit. The sudden drop wrenches your ankle sharply against a buried timber rib, sending a hot lance of pain shooting up your leg. You thrash backward with a ragged gasp, tearing your arm free from the suction just as the hollow swallows the spot where you stood.

Nursing the bruised joint and catching your breath in the bitter air, you drag yourself clear of the treacherous slope.

exits.label: Limp away from the treacherous hollow

nodes.title: Salvage from the Slope
nodes.brief: You ignore the maddening whispers echoing from the dunes, fighting off a creeping panic to pocket a gleaming white pearl.
nodes.page:
Scrambling clear of the treacherous slip, you check the damage to your stride while clutching the smooth, pale pearl retrieved from the edge of the slide. Though your pride takes a sting and your breathing remains shallow from the sudden terror, the prize rests safely in your palm.

Pocketing the cold, luminous stone, you limp back toward the main track where the dunes flatten out into the broader basin.

exits.label: Return to the main dune trail

nodes.title: Flower of the Shallows
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against a terrifying illusion conjured by the dunes, mastering your fear to pluck a rare desert flower.
nodes.page:
Shifting shapes loom through the wind-scoured haze, taking the brief form of old friends and lost debtors calling out from Gullmouth harbour. You stand completely still, letting the phantom voices wash over your skin until the desert air clears to reveal only dry stalks and bleached sand. Right in your path a hardy violet-petaled stem drinks the salt-mist, wholly out of place in the desolate basin.

Snapping the crisp stem at the base, you tuck the resilient blossom safely inside your collar away from the abrasive grit.

exits.label: Push past the weathered ridge ahead

nodes.title: Rooted in the Gale
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against a terrifying illusion conjured by the dunes, mastering your fear to pluck a rare desert flower.
nodes.page:
Phantom figures materialize along the crest of the ridge, stretching out skeletal hands to bar your way with silent accusations. The air grows icy cold, smelling of stale harbour mud and rotting kelp, pressing against your chest with enough weight to stop your heart.

Digging your heels hard into the shifting crust, you stare down the illusion and reach out to pluck the pale desert flower blooming between the phantom fingers.

check.label: Master your fear and pluck the flower

nodes.title: Blown Off Course
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against a terrifying illusion conjured by the dunes, mastering your fear to pluck a rare desert flower.
nodes.page:
Terror overwhelms your resolve as the spectral shapes lunge forward, sending you stumbling blindly backward down the steep face of the dune. Your shoulder strikes a jagged outcrop of buried ballast stone, tearing your coat and leaving a dull, throbbing ache across your ribs. You tumble into a hollow of loose silt, coughing up dust while the phantom voices fade away into the howling wind.

Nursing your bruised shoulder, you pick yourself out of the grey sand and check your remaining gear.

exits.label: Crawl out from the stony hollow

nodes.title: Plucked from the Brink
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against a terrifying illusion conjured by the dunes, mastering your fear to pluck a rare desert flower.
nodes.page:
Clinging tightly to the bruised rib with one hand, you stare down at the stubborn violet blossom clenched safely in your other fist, won through sheer stubborn defiance of the desert's tricks. The phantom shapes dissolve into harmless dust motes dancing in the salt-wind as your breathing slows back to a steady rhythm.

Securing the resilient stem within your coat pocket, you regain your footing on the firming ground below the ridge.

nodes.title: The Coral Boundary
nodes.brief: The dunes give way to a jagged reef of colourful coral, now bleached and crumbling beneath the unrelenting grey sky.
nodes.page:
The golden sea of dunes gives way at last to a sprawling expanse of jagged, coral-encrusted rock that runs as far as the grey sky allows. Once submerged beneath fathoms of green water, these massive branching formations now stand bleached and chalky under the sunless day, a labyrinth of sharp ridges and deep trenches. Salt crusts every pore. It sparks dull as crushed glass when the wind moves across the flats. From the crevices comes a faint grind of distant metal, and the path to the Sunken Stair lies somewhere beyond this maze.

Dry reef underfoot. Watch the razor branches or they will shred your boots.

nodes.title: The Bleached Labyrinth
nodes.brief: The Bleached Reef: Razor-sharp coral formations create a treacherous labyrinth, harbouring hidden tide-pools and aggressive, overgrown scavenging crabs.
nodes.page: Jagged calcified ribs and fossilised fan-corals rear from the dry seabed like the teeth of a buried jaw. Beneath these razor-sharp ledges, shadowed tide-pools stagnate in the salty air, smelling faintly of rot and ancient iron. Legions of pale, heavy-shelled scavenging crabs scuttle through the crevices, their segmented claws clicking against the stone with an incessant, unsettling rhythm. Every pathway splits among the white labyrinth, promising either a hidden cache of brine-cured spoils or a nasty pinch from the crustacean guardians waiting in the gloom.

exits.label: Pick a path through the razor coral
Climb the high limestone ridge for a view
Weave a net from discarded fishing lines
Follow the silent kelp-robed procession ahead

nodes.title: Reading the Fossil Stone
nodes.brief: You study the tidal patterns etched in the coral to predict a safe path, avoiding razor-sharp edges to find a healing poultice.
nodes.page: Salt-rimed grooves trace the ancient stone like a map left behind by a forgotten race of deep-sea dwellers. Careful inspection reveals tiny, dried veins of kelp trapped within the porous white walls, pointing away from the jagged drop-offs toward a sheltered basin. Moving slowly prevents boots from slipping against the abrasive coral teeth that ring the pathway. Somewhere past the next ridge of bone-white calcification lies the promise of a soothing poultice.

exits.label: Advance cautiously toward the sheltered basin

nodes.title: Beneath the Shelf
nodes.brief: You study the tidal patterns etched in the coral to predict a safe path, avoiding razor-sharp edges to find a healing poultice.
nodes.page: Overhanging shelves of dead coral cast long shadows across the dry floor, hiding whatever treasures or hazards linger in the gloom. Pale scavenging crabs retreat into dark fissures, their multi-jointed legs scraping against the rock as a heavy, stagnant draft rolls through the crevice. Reaching out to brush aside a tangle of brittle fronds exposes a narrow cleft where something green and medicinal rests against the cold limestone.

exits.label: Reach into the dark stone cleft

nodes.title: Testing the Coral Shallows
nodes.brief: You study the tidal patterns etched in the coral to predict a safe path, avoiding razor-sharp edges to find a healing poultice.
nodes.page: Sharp edges of petrified fan-coral scrape against thick leather boots as balance is tested on the uneven floor. A sudden shifting of loose debris beneath your heel threatens to pitch you straight into a jagged cluster of barnacle-encrusted teeth. Eyes narrow against the stinging salt crust while hands grope along the damp rock face for a secure handhold before the entire ledge gives way under your weight.

check.label: Read the coral ridges for footing

nodes.title: Torn by the Reef
nodes.brief: You study the tidal patterns etched in the coral to predict a safe path, avoiding razor-sharp edges to find a healing poultice.
nodes.page: A sudden collapse of calcified stone sends you tumbling hard against a wall of jagged fan-coral, tearing deep into your canvas coat and scraping your skin raw. Pain flares hot and sharp along your forearm as a large scavenging crab snaps aggressively at your dangling boot before scuttling away into the dark. Crawling clear of the debris leaves you bruised, bleeding, and poorer by several vital strips of cloth, but still breathing in the bitter air of the Low.

exits.label: Drag yourself toward the open flats

nodes.title: Balm of the Low
nodes.brief: You study the tidal patterns etched in the coral to predict a safe path, avoiding razor-sharp edges to find a healing poultice.
nodes.page: Picking your way past the razor-edged barriers, however narrowly, brings your hand down upon a cool, viscous cluster of healing moss tucked safely inside a dry crevice. Smoothing the damp fronds over your scraped skin immediately dulls the burning throb left behind by the sharp coral teeth. This strange green salvage will serve you well against the infections that fester in the salt-blasted air of the seabed.

exits.label: Join the silent procession on the flats

nodes.title: Harvesting the Dry Fronds
nodes.brief: You identify the medicinal properties of a rare dried kelp, harvesting the fragile fronds without triggering a rockfall to gain its benefits.
nodes.page: Brittle fronds of deep-sea fern cling desperately to the vertical limestone wall, bleached silver by an unaccustomed sun. Extending trembling fingers requires absolute stillness to prevent the loose scree above from cascading down upon your shoulders and triggering a dangerous rockfall. Snapping the fragile stems at the base releases a pungent, medicinal aroma that cuts cleanly through the heavy smell of old brine.

exits.label: Carry the harvest toward the open flats

nodes.title: Reaching for the Fronds
nodes.brief: You identify the medicinal properties of a rare dried kelp, harvesting the fragile fronds without triggering a rockfall to gain its benefits.
nodes.page: Fingers hover mere inches from the silvery medicinal fronds while small tremors in the limestone wall threaten to dislodge a ton of razor-sharp scree overhead. Shifting your weight requires absolute precision to avoid sending a noisy avalanche clattering down into the quiet stillness of the trench. Breath catches in your throat as you test the stability of the crumbling ledge beneath your boots.

nodes.title: Buried in the Scree
nodes.brief: You identify the medicinal properties of a rare dried kelp, harvesting the fragile fronds without triggering a rockfall to gain its benefits.
nodes.page: A sharp crack shatters the quiet as the unstable limestone shelf gives way beneath your boots, burying your legs in a sudden rush of sharp, sliding scree. Bruised muscles protest fiercely as you claw your way free from the gray debris, leaving behind a precious strip of your pack-strap and a good measure of your strength. The medicinal fronds are yours now, but they cost you dearly in sweat and torn cloth.

nodes.title: The Silver Harvest
nodes.brief: You identify the medicinal properties of a rare dried kelp, harvesting the fragile fronds without triggering a rockfall to gain its benefits.
nodes.page: Your hands secure the delicate silver fronds at last, clear of the treacherous cascade of falling stone that rattles into the shadows below. Tucking the fragile leaves safely inside your inner pocket preserves their potent juices against the drying heat of the open seabed. This bitter harvest will mend many a torn hide before your journey reaches its grim end.

exits.label: Follow the path toward the anchor-bearers

nodes.title: The Tangled Pool
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift net from discarded fishing lines, risking a severe pinch to capture a large, edible reef crab.
nodes.page: Coiled strands of frayed hemp and copper wire drift among the calcified ribs of a sunken ketch, offering the raw materials for a snare. Tangled in the kelp below, a mottled reef crab tests the water with twitching feelers, its heavy pincers snapping at the currents of air. Kneeling in the wet silt, fingers loop the discarded twine into a crude but serviceable noose, sliding it steadily toward the twitching shell while avoiding the razor edges of barnacles that encrust the hull timbers.

exits.label: Slip the noose around the claw

nodes.title: Snaring the Shell
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift net from discarded fishing lines, risking a severe pinch to capture a large, edible reef crab.
nodes.page: The noose of frayed hemp and copper wire settles around the reef crab's mottled claw as you draw the slack tight from your knees in the wet silt. The pincers snap once at empty air, then the shell jerks against the loop. You ease back from the barnacle-crusted ribs of the ketch, keeping the line taut so the catch cannot slip free into the kelp below.

exits.label: Haul the captive onto the silt

nodes.title: Reaching the Pincer
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift net from discarded fishing lines, risking a severe pinch to capture a large, edible reef crab.
nodes.page: Discarded fishing lines twitch among the rotting timbers of a stranded schooner where a massive reef crab scuttles through the brine-pools, its heavy claws clicking against the bleached ribs of the hull. Kneeling in the foul-smelling silt, fingers thread together a makeshift net of stray cordage, sliding the woven mesh closer to the snapping carapace. The beast senses the motion, rearing back with iron-hard nippers poised to strike at the slightest touch. The hands must move with absolute precision, matching the erratic pulse of the seabed before the creature lunges.

check.label: Weave and snatch the twitching crab

nodes.title: The Snapped Line
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift net from discarded fishing lines, risking a severe pinch to capture a large, edible reef crab.
nodes.page: Silence in the wreck-field breaks with a violent snap as the crustacean lunges and buries its crushing nippers deep in the flesh of your wrist. Pain flares white and hot up your forearm, tearing the makeshift net into useless shreds of twine before you can wrench your hand free from the grasping claws. The crab scurries back into the dark recess of the hull, leaving behind a bleeding, ragged gash that throbs with the bitter salt of the low seabed.

exits.label: Bind the wound and push onward

nodes.title: Meat from the Deep
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift net from discarded fishing lines, risking a severe pinch to capture a large, edible reef crab.
nodes.page: Steady fingers complete the final knot of the cordage just as the giant crab rears up to strike, however narrowly avoiding the crushing snap of its armored nippers. The makeshift net drops over the carapace with a swift twist, tangling the creature's legs in a web of discarded line and hauling it kicking and clicking onto the dry planks. It is a stubborn prize, full of sweet meat and stubborn fight, secured with only a few shallow scratches to show for the struggle.

nodes.title: The March of Kelp
nodes.brief: You encounter a solemn procession of figures wearing kelp robes, dragging an ornate anchor across the dry seabed in silent devotion.
nodes.page: Iron scrapes across the flat expanse of the seabed and shakes the salt crust under your boots. Out of the pale mist come the Drift Pilgrims, hunched under cloaks of dried bladderwrack and brine-soaked wool. They move in unison, chanting a low, rhythmic dirge that sounds like waves dragging shingle back into the deep. At the front of the procession, half a dozen robed backs strain against thick hemp ropes tied to an enormous, rusted anchor bearing the crest of an old Gullmouth cutter. They drag the iron dead-weight across the dry mud, seeking the lost tide with every step of their bare, calloused feet. You must slip past their slow, melancholic march or find yourself drawn into the orbit of their prayer.

nodes.title: The Pilgrim Encampment
nodes.brief: The Pilgrim Trail: The Drift Pilgrims have established a temporary camp, offering strange blessings and seeking offerings for their sulking ocean deity.
nodes.page: Ragged tents made of patched sailcloth and whale ribs cling to the flank of a rusted hull, forming a temporary sanctuary amidst the endless grey flats. Small cook-fires burn low, smelling of dried dung and charred kelp, while pilgrims murmur prayers to an absent ocean that left them behind. To one side, an elder weeps softly into a basin of dry sand, and paths fork outward toward the horizon, leading past the camp toward distant stilted structures or deeper into the misty wreck-fields. Every shadow here feels watched by people who believe the water will return only when the proper debts are paid.

exits.label: Defend the camp from wild dogs

nodes.title: Pulling the Iron
nodes.brief: You help the pilgrims drag their massive anchor up a steep incline, straining your back to earn their sacred blessing of protection.
nodes.page: Hemp bites hard into raw palms as you take your place among the robed figures and throw your weight against the thick tow-rope. The rusted anchor catches on a ridge of buried ballast stone, sending a jarring vibration up your spine while the pilgrims beside you hum an unceasing, low-pitched drone. Sweat stings your eyes in the damp air as you heave together, forcing the massive iron fluke to break free from the suction of the grey silt.

exits.label: Keep pace with the dragging crew

nodes.title: Heaving the Anchor
nodes.brief: You help the pilgrims drag their massive anchor up a steep incline, straining your back to earn their sacred blessing of protection.
nodes.page: The fluke finally clears the buried ballast, and the tow-rope jumps as the pilgrims haul the freed anchor across the grey silt. Raw palms burn where the hemp has bitten, and you match their stride as the rusted mass scrapes a dark trail behind you. Robed shoulders lean in together, and the anchor-bearers push on toward the next ridge of salt.

nodes.title: Straining Against the Anchor
nodes.brief: You help the pilgrims drag their massive anchor up a steep incline, straining your back to earn their sacred blessing of protection.
nodes.page: The enormous iron anchor catches firmly beneath the ribcage of an ancient sunken brigantine, refusing to budge another inch through the clinging grey silt. The pilgrims lean into their hemp harnesses with desperate, trembling breath, waiting to see if you possess the strength to match their devotion. Stepping up to the primary tow-line, you wrap the coarse rope twice around your bleeding palms, planting your boots deep into the wet mud to brace against the dead weight of the iron. Your muscles knot and strain as you throw your entire body backward, pushing against the unyielding resistance of the seabed.

check.label: Heave the anchor from the silt

nodes.title: Broken Muscles
nodes.brief: You help the pilgrims drag their massive anchor up a steep incline, straining your back to earn their sacred blessing of protection.
nodes.page: A dull pop echoes in your shoulder as the massive anchor refuses to yield, throwing you violently forward into the abrasive mud and tearing the skin from your knuckles. The pilgrims do not stop their chant, stepping smoothly around your fallen form while you struggle to catch your breath against a searing ache in your ribs. You pick yourself up from the grey mire, bruised and thoroughly humbled by the brute weight of their sacred iron.

exits.label: Pick yourself up and limp onward

nodes.title: The Blessed Muscle
nodes.brief: You help the pilgrims drag their massive anchor up a steep incline, straining your back to earn their sacred blessing of protection.
nodes.page: Muscles scream under the sudden strain, however narrowly finding the hidden leverage needed to wrench the massive fluke free from the mud. The anchor leaps forward with a dull thud, sliding smoothly across the scraped seabed as the pilgrims murmur a low word of approval for your labour. One of the robed elders presses a damp, knotted cord into your palm, tying it around your wrist as a mark of safe passage through the salt wastes.

exits.label: Leave the camp for the stilted outpost

nodes.title: Hounds of the Low
nodes.brief: You physically defend the pilgrimage from a desperate pack of wild dogs, risking deep bites to receive a consecrated vial of seawater.
nodes.page: Gaunt shapes detach themselves from the salt-crusted shadow of a turned hull, snarling with jaws dripping gray foam and sea-foulness. These beasts have lived on what the retreating brine spat ashore, growing bolder and leaner as the dry months stretch their hunger. They circle the small band of Drift Pilgrims, yellow eyes fixed upon the trembling children huddled beneath coarse wool cloaks. Your hand drops automatically to the heavy iron-shod timber staff at your side, planting your boots firmly into the damp, sucking silt. The lead hound lunges, a blur of matted fur and yellowed teeth, aiming straight for the nearest pilgrim's throat.

exits.label: Strike hard against the lead hound

nodes.title: Snarls in the Silt
nodes.brief: You physically defend the pilgrimage from a desperate pack of wild dogs, risking deep bites to receive a consecrated vial of seawater.
nodes.page: Salt cakes instantly into the fresh cuts along your forearms as the pack closes its ranks, driven by a frantic starvation that knows no fear of man or iron. The pilgrims chant a low, discordant supplication to the absent deep, throwing handfuls of dried kelp into the dusty wind while backing toward a ribbed cage of whale bones. You step forward to form a living wall between their ragged vestments and snapping jaws, lifting your timber stave to parry the lunging weight of a beast scarred by old brine burns. The air smells intensely of copper, wet hair, and the sharp, alkaline tang of exposed ocean floor.

exits.label: Stand your ground with raised staff

nodes.title: Teeth in the Muck
nodes.brief: You physically defend the pilgrimage from a desperate pack of wild dogs, risking deep bites to receive a consecrated vial of seawater.
nodes.page: Blood roars in your ears as three lean curs surge forward simultaneously, ignoring the heavy wood blows to claw directly up your chest with desperate, frantic energy. You twist your torso away from the tearing claws, planting your boots deeper into the unstable seabed while driving all your muscle and fury behind a two-handed thrust to keep their snapping jaws from your face. The brute weight threatens to drag you backward into the abrasive mud as your muscles strain against the onslaught, every fiber of your body burning with exertion.

check.label: Wrench free and shatter their charge

nodes.title: Torn Hide and Salt
nodes.brief: You physically defend the pilgrimage from a desperate pack of wild dogs, risking deep bites to receive a consecrated vial of seawater.
nodes.page: A vicious snap of jaws tears deep through the thick wool of your sleeve, leaving a jagged row of white punctures along your forearm as a hound's tooth scores the bone. You roar through the pain and lash out with a wild, desperate sweep of your staff, cracking ribs and sending the remaining curs yelping into the salt-mist. The pilgrims gather around you in the eerie quiet, binding your weeping wound with coarse linen strips soaked in bitter brine that burns like fire. You are left bruised, bleeding, and slower of foot, but the pack is scattered and the camp remains safe.

exits.label: Gather your breath and limp onward

nodes.title: The Consecrated Drop
nodes.brief: You physically defend the pilgrimage from a desperate pack of wild dogs, risking deep bites to receive a consecrated vial of seawater.
nodes.page: Steel and muscle find the necessary leverage, however narrowly, driving the fiercest of the brutes back into the muck with a sickening crunch of shattered bone. The surviving curs tuck their tails and vanish into the grey mists curling around the distant wrecks, leaving you chest-heaving and salt-encrusted upon the barren seabed. The oldest of the Drift Pilgrims steps forward, dipping a gnarled thumb into a small earthenware flask and pressing a cold, wet cross of sanctified foam onto your bleeding knuckle. He presses the stoppered glass firmly into your palm without a word, sealing a debt of salt and survival between you.

nodes.title: Grain of the Driftwood
nodes.brief: You carve a beautiful wooden offering bowl for their ritual, working the wood carefully to win a warm meal and vital supplies.
nodes.page: You find a solid piece of grey wreckage timber cast up from an old merchant ketch, its grain tight and seasoned by decades of salt-soaking. Sitting on an overturned crab-basket near the flickering drift-fires, you steady your pocket-knife and begin peeling away the weathered outer layers to reach the pale, workable heartwood beneath. The pilgrims watch in silence, their murmured prayers rising and falling like distant surf while your blade curls long, fragrant ribbons of cedar onto the damp earth. Every cut must be precise, smoothed against your palm until the vessel takes the clean, hollow curve of an offering basin.

exits.label: Shape the rim with careful blade-work

nodes.title: Offerings for the Sullen Deep
nodes.brief: You carve a beautiful wooden offering bowl for their ritual, working the wood carefully to win a warm meal and vital supplies.
nodes.page: The completed bowl rests in your hands, smooth and pale as polished bone, catching the wan light of the low-slung sun hanging over the dry horizon. You carry it through the ring of kneeling pilgrims, setting it gently upon their driftwood altar among dried starfish and iron nails left behind by superstitious sailors. In return, an old woman ladle-pours a steaming broth of salted kelp and dried cockles into your canteen, dropping a bundle of dry tallow tapers into your pack alongside hard biscuit. The warmth settles deep into your bones, steeling you against the damp chill of the endless seabed.

exits.label: Take your leave of the pilgrims

nodes.title: Carving the Offerings
nodes.brief: You carve a beautiful wooden offering bowl for their ritual, working the wood carefully to win a warm meal and vital supplies.
nodes.page: The wood grain twists against the edge of your blade. The delicate rim you spent an hour shaping from brine-cured timber could splinter. You ease your breathing and rest your thumb along the steel spine while erratic gusts sweep the open seabed from the north. Light fades behind the skeletal ribs of nearby wrecks. Long shadows cross the work as you press the edge forward for the last smoothing cut.

check.label: Pare the stubborn grain with precision

nodes.title: Split Timber and Salt Tears
nodes.brief: You carve a beautiful wooden offering bowl for their ritual, working the wood carefully to win a warm meal and vital supplies.
nodes.page: A vicious gust catches your sleeve, jerks the blade with a sharp crack, and slices clean through the thin rim of the offering bowl, spoiling hours of careful labor. You toss the ruined timber into the sand with a muttered curse, rubbing your cramped fingers as the watching pilgrims murmur softly among themselves at the spoiled craft. They still share a portion of their meager broth and hard biscuit with you out of pity, but the loss of your intended gift leaves you empty-handed and sharp with frustration as the cold sets in.

nodes.title: The Carver's Wages
nodes.brief: You carve a beautiful wooden offering bowl for their ritual, working the wood carefully to win a warm meal and vital supplies.
nodes.page: The blade slides smooth and true, however narrowly, shaving away the final curl of stubborn timber to leave the offering bowl perfectly balanced and satin-smooth to the touch. The pilgrims gasp in genuine admiration as you present the finished vessel, immediately filling it with dried sea-lavender and silver coins recovered from drowned pockets. They press a warm wooden bowl of thick broth into your hands alongside a sturdy canvas bundle of dried rations, murmuring blessings for the road ahead. You walk away richer in supplies and goodwill, your fingers aching pleasantly from the honest work.

nodes.title: Salt Upon The Skin
nodes.brief: You endure a painful initiation ritual with burning sea-salt, resisting the urge to cry out to gain an amulet of deep-sea glass.
nodes.page: Coarse crystals of sea-salt are pressed directly into the raw meat of your forearm, searing with a dry, white heat that bites straight to the marrow. A hooded pilgrim chants low and rhythmic words over the burning patch, watching your eyes for any twitch of terror or sign of surrender. Every instinct in your blood screams to wrench your arm away and plunge it into cooling mud. Instead, you lock your jaw until your teeth grind, keeping your breath steady against the agonizing burn of the ritual.

nodes.title: The Seared Flesh
nodes.brief: You endure a painful initiation ritual with burning sea-salt, resisting the urge to cry out to gain an amulet of deep-sea glass.
nodes.page: White smoke rises from your arm where the caustic grains eat into your skin, carrying the sharp scent of old brine and burnt copper. The elder pilgrim presses a flat thumb directly into the stinging wound to test your resolve one final time before nodding in grim satisfaction. A disk of deep-sea glass, cold and dark as a drowned eye, drops into your blistered palm as the price of your silence.

nodes.title: The Salt Trial
nodes.brief: You endure a painful initiation ritual with burning sea-salt, resisting the urge to cry out to gain an amulet of deep-sea glass.
nodes.page: Hot crystals of dried ocean salt are ground into the raw flesh of your arm by a withered pilgrim hand, the burning pain sinking deep into the bone. The hooded keeper of the rite watches your face with unblinking intensity, waiting for the first gasp or tremor that will ruin the ceremony. You must hold your muscles rigid against the white-hot agony, fighting the primitive urge to scream out as the salt poisons your blood.

check.label: Hold fast against the burning salt

nodes.title: Scars Of The Rite
nodes.brief: You endure a painful initiation ritual with burning sea-salt, resisting the urge to cry out to gain an amulet of deep-sea glass.
nodes.page: A sudden, irrepressible gasp tears from your throat, shattering the silence of the tent and drawing a disappointed hiss from the surrounding pilgrims. Rough hands shove you backward into the cold dust, denying you the pristine treasure promised to the steadfast. Your forearm is left raw, blistered, and weeping pale fluid, a painful reminder of your broken composure that will cost you precious time and tender flesh to mend.

nodes.title: The Salt-Sealed Oath
nodes.brief: You endure a painful initiation ritual with burning sea-salt, resisting the urge to cry out to gain an amulet of deep-sea glass.
nodes.page:
Coarse crystals of grey sea-salt are ground into your forearms until the skin breaks and the blood runs thin and clear as it mingles with the deep. You press your palms against the brazier's iron rim and bite your tongue until the copper taste fills your mouth. No cry for the robed pilgrims.

Through the haze of white smoke and burning brine, an elder steps forward with hands like dried kelp and presses a cold, thumb-thick drop of deep-sea glass into your clenched fist. The green lens catches no light of its own. Cold glass rests against your pulse.

exits.label: Leave the camp for the pilgrim trail

nodes.title: Beyond The Dust Shallows
nodes.brief: As the pilgrim camp fades in the distance, you spot the towering, stilt-supported structures of a wealthy outpost looming ahead.
nodes.page: The ragged tents of the drift folk shrink into grey smudges behind you as the low seabed flattens into a hard expanse of bleached shell-grit. Rising from this barren floor like the ribcage of an ancient leviathan, the immense iron stilts of Saltspire pierce the hazy sky. Heavy wooden walkways and suspended rope-bridges connect the towering platforms overhead, where the wealthy Brineholders oversee their guarded water-engines and pump-houses. Armed wardens pace the lower ladders, their brass-trimmed helmets catching the pale, sunless glare reflected off the salt-flats.
