You pull your cloak tighter around your shoulders, stepping carefully into the long, cold shadows cast by the sprawling metropolis of water-mongers.

nodes.title: Saltspire Outskirts
nodes.brief: Saltspire Outskirts: The towering stilt-city of the Brineholders casts long shadows over a cluster of desperate squatter camps and guarded water-pumps.
nodes.page: Desperate squatter camps cling to the massive rusted iron feet of the city like barnacles on a stranded hull, their inhabitants boiling brackish sludge over small fires of driftwood. Armed guards in polished bronze breastplates stand before the primary ladder-lifts, turning away anyone without heavy coin or a water-debt token. To your left, a leaking distribution pipe drips precious moisture into waiting copper basins, while narrow service hatches lead into the dark underbelly of the stilt-city. Further out, the seabed drops away into a deep, shadowy canyon where strange metal structures protrude from the silt.

exits.label: Pry open the rusted water valve

nodes.title: The Copper Canteen
nodes.brief: You bluff your way past a suspicious Brineholder guard, risking imprisonment to smuggle a canteen of pure, fresh water.
nodes.page: You hitch your belt and adopt the brisk, unconcerned stride of an errand-runner carrying orders for the upper tiers, keeping your eyes fixed straight ahead. A Brineholder sentinel turns toward you, his hand dropping casually to the iron truncheon at his hip as you approach the checkpoint ladder. Your heart beats a frantic rhythm against your ribs, but you force your posture to remain loose and indifferent while holding a forged delivery tally in your left hand.

nodes.title: Steps Upon Iron
nodes.brief: You bluff your way past a suspicious Brineholder guard, risking imprisonment to smuggle a canteen of pure, fresh water.
nodes.page: The sentinel squints at the ink-stamped paper in your hand, muttering a dry curse about the endless clerical nonsense of the upper levels before stepping aside with a sluggish wave. You climb the creaking iron rungs of the ladder as fast as dignity allows, leaving the watchful eyes of the checkpoint behind in the damp gloom. A narrow maintenance catwalk stretches before you, lined with condensation-slick pipes that hum with the distant vibration of heavy machinery.

nodes.title: The Guarded Ladder
nodes.brief: You bluff your way past a suspicious Brineholder guard, risking imprisonment to smuggle a canteen of pure, fresh water.
nodes.page: The Brineholder sentinel steps directly into your path, blocking the ladder-foot with his broad iron-plated shoulder and demanding your travel seal. You must maintain an absolute mask of unbothered authority, spinning a swift falsehood about urgent repairs for the upper reservoirs while your palms grow slick with nervous sweat. A single hesitation in your voice will invite a search and throw you straight into the deep-water holding cages below.

nodes.title: The Iron Cage
nodes.brief: You bluff your way past a suspicious Brineholder guard, risking imprisonment to smuggle a canteen of pure, fresh water.
nodes.page: The guard's eyes narrow at a slight tremor in your voice, and with a swift shove he pins you against the cold iron stilt, stripping your pack in seconds. You spend the next few hours huddled in a damp subterranean lock-up while they confiscate your spare rations and leave you with a bruised shoulder and a bitter grudge. They dump you back out into the squatter filth by nightfall, poorer and sorer, but free to try your luck elsewhere in the salt-shadows.

nodes.title: The Price of Purity
nodes.brief: You bluff your way past a suspicious Brineholder guard, risking imprisonment to smuggle a canteen of pure, fresh water.
nodes.page: Iron-shod boots pace slowly across the creaking timber floorboards just inches from your hiding place behind the stacked water barrels; the guard's suspicion sits in the air with the salt-dust. You steady your breathing, meeting his narrowed gaze with an easy, tooth-rotted grin and a casual lie about checking leaks for the Brineholder magistracy. He lingers, his hand resting heavily on the pommel of a brass-hilted cudgel, before a shouted order from the upper tier draws him away into the shadows. When the coast is clear, you slip your fingers into the canvas sack and draw out a tin-plated canteen that sloshes with sweet, untainted water drawn straight from the deep-city cisterns.

exits.label: Move out toward the stilt-city outskirts

nodes.title: The Seeping Conduit
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed, rusted water valve on the city's perimeter, battling the heavy pressure to fill your own flasks.
nodes.page:
Salt-crusted copper pipes snake along the underside of the stilt-city, weeping bitter moisture into the barren grey mud. You trace a thick feeder line where a rusted iron spigot juts from a joint like an old bone. Inside the casing, water gurgles with a heavy, pressurized promise that could save your parched throat if you can manage to crack the seal.

Slipping your fingers into the pitted grooves of the handle, you brace your boot against the iron pillar and heave with all your weight, but the valve refuses to turn an inch against decades of accumulated lime and neglect.

nodes.title: Pressure in the Pipe
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed, rusted water valve on the city's perimeter, battling the heavy pressure to fill your own flasks.
nodes.page:
Condensation drips steadily onto your neck as you lean your full shoulder into the stubborn conduit, muscles straining against the unyielding cold of the metal. The valve groans, a dry, sharding screech that echoes across the skeletal stilts above, threatening to draw unwanted eyes from the sentinels patrolling the walkways. You ignore the rising panic and plant your heels deeper into the brine-crusted silt.

Another desperate heave sends a sharp vibration up your spine, and the sealed joint finally gives a fraction of a rotation, spitting a thin, hissing jet of foul-tasting brackish water across your knuckles.

nodes.title: The Frozen Spigot
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed, rusted water valve on the city's perimeter, battling the heavy pressure to fill your own flasks.
nodes.page: Sweat stings your eyes as you wrap your blistered palms around the jagged iron lever, gathering your breath for one final, lung-bursting effort. The pressure inside the conduit hums a low, resonant note that vibrates right through the soles of your boots, warning of a sudden rupture if you push too hard or too fast. You set your jaw, lock your knees against the cold stilt, and throw your entire frame into the wrenching twist.

nodes.title: A Bitter Spray
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed, rusted water valve on the city's perimeter, battling the heavy pressure to fill your own flasks.
nodes.page: Iron screams as the frozen stem shears clean off in your grip, sending you tumbling backward into the thick, foul-smelling mud of the seabed. A ferocious geyser of high-pressure brine erupts from the ruptured pipe, drenching your pack and scouring a deep, stinging gash across your forearm before you can scramble out of the way. You lie coughing in the wet filth for a long moment, tasting copper and salt, poorer in strength and supplies than you were a minute ago.

nodes.title: Sweet Bitter Drops
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed, rusted water valve on the city's perimeter, battling the heavy pressure to fill your own flasks.
nodes.page: Iron groans and gives way at last under your desperate strain, allowing a thick, metallic stream of water to gush straight into your open flasks. You cap the containers just as the pressure threatens to burst the seams, wiping the stinging spray from your forehead with a trembling hand. You walk away with a skin of precious liquid tucked securely against your ribs.

nodes.title: The Sealed Chest
nodes.brief: You pick the complex lock on an abandoned storage crate, avoiding a poison needle trap to steal a cache of dried meat.
nodes.page:
Half-buried in a drift of grey kelp and dried barnacles sits a heavy naval crate bearing the faded crest of the old Gullmouth fleet. Its brass has turned the pale green of a bruised apple, and the keyhole is choked tight with salt-grit and hardened grease. You kneel in the damp gloom, drawing your thin wire picks from their lining to probe the intricate inner tumblers by touch alone.

A faint, sweetish odour drifts up from the lid's edge - the unmistakable tang of preserved lard and poison-damp that warns of a crude needle trap waiting behind the brass plate.

nodes.title: The Poison Needle
nodes.brief: You pick the complex lock on an abandoned storage crate, avoiding a poison needle trap to steal a cache of dried meat.
nodes.page: Your fingertips dance lightly over the jammed tumblers, feeling the tiny shivers of tension in the rusted springs beneath the heavy lid. A single false click will trip the poisoned brass barb hidden within the groove, leaving your arm numb before you can even claim the rations locked inside. You hold your breath, sliding the slender wire deeper into the dark gap while your heart hammers against your ribs.

nodes.title: A Slip in the Dark
nodes.brief: You pick the complex lock on an abandoned storage crate, avoiding a poison needle trap to steal a cache of dried meat.
nodes.page: Metal scrapes against metal with an ugly shriek, and a tiny, envenomed dart springs from the casing to graze the meat of your thumb before you can jerk your hand back. Numbness spreads like cold ink through your fingers, forcing you to drop your tools and sit in the grey mud while your pulse pounds wildly in your ears. You survive the sting by sheer stubborn will, but your pack remains firmly shut and your hand throbs with a dull, persistent ache.

nodes.title: The Stolen Cache
nodes.brief: You pick the complex lock on an abandoned storage crate, avoiding a poison needle trap to steal a cache of dried meat.
nodes.page: The rusty latch finally yields with a wet, satisfying snap, swinging upward to reveal rows of salted mutton wrapped in oilskin and grease-stained canvas. Your fingers have secured a prize that will keep your belly full through the long miles ahead. You slip the savory slabs into your pack alongside a small, unmarked brass token left behind by some forgotten sailor.

nodes.title: The Abyssal Trench
nodes.brief: Beyond the stilt-city, the ground plunges into a vast, dark canyon where the remains of a drowned cathedral lie exposed.
nodes.page: Beyond the outer ring of stilts, the flat grey seabed breaks apart, plunging precipitously into a massive, shadowed gash where the light of the low sun fails to reach. At the bottom of this drowned canyon lies a titanic gothic structure half-swallowed by grey silt, its shattered stained-glass windows gaping like blind eyes and its towering buttresses leaning at perilous angles. Faint, mournful harmonies drift up from the vaulted stone archways, echoing with voices that have not spoken to the living air in generations. You shoulder your pack and pick your way carefully down the steep, shale-strewn slope toward the dark entrance.

nodes.title: The Drowned Cathedral
nodes.brief: The Drowned Cathedral: A massive gothic structure leans precariously in the mud, its stained glass shattered and its damp halls echoing with strange voices.
nodes.page: Massive gothic ribs lean at a dizzying angle into the dried mud of the seabed, their shattered stained-glass windows gaping like blind sockets toward the dead horizon. Inside this leaning hull of stone and salt, damp prayer halls echo with the thin, reedy murmur of voices that belong to no living throat. A narrow archway beckons toward the echoing depths below, while a fractured spiral ramp twists upward into the salt-rimed vaulting. Further out, a heavy brass key gleams amidst the debris of a dismantled organ, and a thick, freezing mist begins to billow across the sunken nave.

nodes.title: Echoes in the Dark
nodes.brief: You brave the dark crypts to confront a restless spirit of the Hollow Choir, keeping your sanity intact to claim a silver chalice.
nodes.page: Shadows cling to the dripping limestone walls of the crypt as you navigate the narrow passage between fallen pillars. A pale, shifting luminescence detaches itself from the masonry, taking the wavering silhouette of a drowned soul belonging to the Hollow Choir. It opens a mouth choked with silt and weed, whispering secrets of the tide before lunging with fingers like frozen iron to test your resolve.

nodes.title: Reaching the Relic
nodes.brief: You brave the dark crypts to confront a restless spirit of the Hollow Choir, keeping your sanity intact to claim a silver chalice.
nodes.page: With the lingering chill of the spirit still prickling your skin, you step past the threshold of the inner vault where a tarnished silver chalice rests upon an altar of black stone. The vessel is cold and heavy, crusted with ancient marine growth yet gleaming faintly under the weak subterranean light. Pocketing the prize, you turn your back on the whispering shadows and retrace your steps toward the ruined nave.

nodes.title: Facing the Choir
nodes.brief: You brave the dark crypts to confront a restless spirit of the Hollow Choir, keeping your sanity intact to claim a silver chalice.
nodes.page: The spectral figure presses inward, filling your ears with the roar of a thousand phantom breakers crashing against unseen rocks. You force your breath to steady, planting your boots firmly in the wet silt as you reach out a hand toward the silver chalice resting on the altar. Every instinct screams to flee the crushing pressure of the tomb, but you grit your teeth against the rising panic.

nodes.title: The Cost of Terror
nodes.brief: You brave the dark crypts to confront a restless spirit of the Hollow Choir, keeping your sanity intact to claim a silver chalice.
nodes.page: Panic breaks your concentration, sending you stumbling backward against a jagged slab of fallen masonry that tears deep into your shoulder. The phantom shrieks as it dissolves back into the dripping stone walls, leaving you gasping for air in the damp dark. You clutch the bleeding wound, binding it tightly with a strip of oiled canvas while nursing a throbbing ache that will remind you of this damp vault for days.

nodes.title: A Prize Retrieved
nodes.brief: You brave the dark crypts to confront a restless spirit of the Hollow Choir, keeping your sanity intact to claim a silver chalice.
nodes.page: Your fingers close around the rim of the tarnished silver chalice, and the hostile spirit recoils into the masonry with a hiss of escaping steam. The vessel is yours now, cold with years and smelling faintly of brine and old coin. You stow it carefully among your gear before turning back toward the relative safety of the cathedral floor.

nodes.title: The High Ascent
nodes.brief: You walk the crumbling upper rafters to reach the bell tower, ignoring the dizzying drop to retrieve a forgotten Tidewarden journal.
nodes.page: Stone steps spiral upward into the skeletal roof of the cathedral, slick with centuries of condensation and sea salt. Below you, the muddy floor drops away into absolute shadow, while above, the ruined bell tower sways slightly in the heavy subterranean draft. You grip the rusted iron handrail, testing each fractured slab of masonry before committing your weight to the climb.

nodes.title: Among the Rafters
nodes.brief: You walk the crumbling upper rafters to reach the bell tower, ignoring the dizzying drop to retrieve a forgotten Tidewarden journal.
nodes.page: High above the drowned floor, wooden beams groan under accumulated salt and years. Half-buried in the tangled wreckage of the belfry, a leather-bound Tidewarden journal sits under bird droppings and dried kelp. You brush away the crust of salt. Pages of frantic ink annotations detail the secret workings of the Meridian Gear while grit still clings to the margins.

nodes.title: Walking the Beam
nodes.brief: You walk the crumbling upper rafters to reach the bell tower, ignoring the dizzying drop to retrieve a forgotten Tidewarden journal.
nodes.page: A single rotten timber spans the dizzying gap between the nave wall and the isolated belfry platform. The drop below is enough to break a body twice over, and the damp air makes your boots slick on the ancient wood. You steady your breathing, locking your gaze on the opposite ledge as you take the first tentative step across the void.

nodes.title: A Slip on High
nodes.brief: You walk the crumbling upper rafters to reach the bell tower, ignoring the dizzying drop to retrieve a forgotten Tidewarden journal.
nodes.page: The timber cracks beneath your boot with a sickening pop, pitching you sideways into a jagged tangle of iron reinforcement rods. You manage to hook an arm over a sturdy crossbeam just as the lower plank plunges into the darkness below. Bruised and scraped, you haul yourself onto the platform with a sharp gasp, your heart hammering against your ribs like a trapped gull.

nodes.title: The Tidewarden's Record
nodes.brief: You walk the crumbling upper rafters to reach the bell tower, ignoring the dizzying drop to retrieve a forgotten Tidewarden journal.
nodes.page: Your fingers close over the leather spine of the journal, pulling it free from the masonry just as a gust of salt wind rattles the skeletal framework overhead. The fragile book is safe within your satchel now, its dried pages packed with secrets of the great mechanism below.

nodes.title: The Organ Lofts
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a rusted pipe organ to access a hidden compartment, avoiding the collapsing masonry to find an ornate brass key.
nodes.page: Dust hangs thick in the vaulted silence, smelling of dried salt and ancient horsehair felt. You wedge your pry-bar into the side panel of the grand bellows, feeling the heavy oak groan under the strain. Above your head, a loose gargoyle wobbles upon its cracked plinth, threatening to let fly a shower of masonry at the slightest tremor. You work the iron bar steadily upward, easing the rusted hinges until the warped wood gives a sudden, dry snap.

nodes.title: Within the Rusted Pipes
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a rusted pipe organ to access a hidden compartment, avoiding the collapsing masonry to find an ornate brass key.
nodes.page: Shadows gather deep inside the hollow throat of the instrument, cool and smelling faintly of stagnant bilge-water. Reaching your bare hand past rows of tin pipes, your fingers brush against a small velvet-lined recess hidden behind the lower register. Something metallic gleams in the gloom. Thumb and forefinger slip into the tight gap and curl around the cold shape of a shaped handle while masonry dust sifts down through the upper bars.

nodes.title: The Collapsing Keystone
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a rusted pipe organ to access a hidden compartment, avoiding the collapsing masonry to find an ornate brass key.
nodes.page: A sudden sharp crack echoes from the high chapel ceiling as a massive block of dressed stone shifts in its mortar. Inside the narrow recess your hand holds still while the tip of your blade levers the jammed brass latch, careful not to wake the falling arch above you. A single false twitch of your wrist will bring tons of carved granite crashing down directly onto your fingers.

nodes.title: Buried Beneath the Rubble
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a rusted pipe organ to access a hidden compartment, avoiding the collapsing masonry to find an ornate brass key.
nodes.page: The stone gives way too fast, slamming down across your knuckles and pinning your sleeve beneath a jagged wedge of slate. You wrench your arm free with a sickening wrench that leaves a long, bleeding graze across your forearm and costs precious minutes clawing your way out from the debris. By the time you stumble back into the damp air, your fingers throb dully and your pack is coated in white grit.

nodes.title: The Sealer's Brass
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a rusted pipe organ to access a hidden compartment, avoiding the collapsing masonry to find an ornate brass key.
nodes.page: Whatever the cost of the falling dust and the narrow margin of your escape, your fingers close firmly around the cool metal shank before the masonry settles into ruin. You pull back your arm just as a shower of old mortar crashes into the recess where your hand had rested a heartbeat before. In your palm lies a heavy, sea-green key cut with teeth like a row of small shark jaws.

nodes.title: The Choking Tide-Fog
nodes.brief: A chilling mist rolls in from the deeper trenches, obscuring your path and bringing with it the scent of ancient rot.
nodes.page: A dense grey vapor rolls in from the deeper abyssal trenches. Jagged silhouettes of the wreck-fields vanish, and the stench of rotting kelp and ancient grease fills your mouth. Mist soaks into your wool coat. Distant sounds go hollow and arrive from every side at once. Shapes flicker at the edge of vision: hulks of timber shifting in the gloom, or something on two legs that were never meant for dry land. You stay low and tread the crusty salt-pans, where the crust gives way to sucking mud.

nodes.title: The Trench Edge
nodes.brief: The Trench Edge: The seabed drops off into an impenetrable abyss where strange, phosphorescent fungi grow and unseen predators stalk the gloom.
nodes.page: The seabed drops away abruptly into a sheer, black chasm where pale phosphorescent fungi cling to the vertical cliffs of silt and stone. Down in the darkness, strange blue lights pulse with a slow, hypnotic rhythm, while from the deeper gloom comes the rhythmic scraping of unseen things moving through the muck. To your left, a narrow goat-track winds down past weeping salt-springs; straight ahead, the fog swallows the abyss entirely; behind you, the wreck-fields wait in their frozen silence.

exits.label: Pry open the giant clam shell
Navigate the patches of glowing fungi
Follow the map to the spiral shaft

nodes.title: Teeth in the Murk
nodes.brief: You fight off a grotesque, mutated angler-beast that emerges from the fog, risking terrible lacerations to harvest its glowing lure.
nodes.page: A long, pale shape lunges from the fog with terrifying speed, its jaws agape and lined with needle-sharp teeth that glisten with phosphorescent slime. You leap backward onto a slippery ridge of whale-ribs just as the creature snaps shut on empty air. It coils its segmented body in the mud, thrashing its tail to whip up a blinding cloud of black silt while its glowing forehead-lure bobs back and forth like a false star in the dark.

exits.label: Stand firm against the lunging beast

nodes.title: The Lure's Harvest
nodes.brief: You fight off a grotesque, mutated angler-beast that emerges from the fog, risking terrible lacerations to harvest its glowing lure.
nodes.page: You drive your salvage hook deep into the soft cartilage behind the creature's eye, pinning its thrashing head against the rib-bone until the frantic movements slow to a sluggish twitch. Reaching out with your sheath-knife, you slice cleanly through the fleshy stalk of the glowing lure, catching the pulsing pouch before it can fade into dull gray jelly. The beast slides back into the sucking mud with a wet sigh, leaving you alone in the quiet mist with your prize.

exits.label: Move on into the deeper trench

nodes.title: Wrestling the Abyssal Horror
nodes.brief: You fight off a grotesque, mutated angler-beast that emerges from the fog, risking terrible lacerations to harvest its glowing lure.
nodes.page: The beast strikes with the weight of a falling spar, slamming its bulk against your chest and driving the breath from your lungs in a ragged gasp. You throw your arms around its slick, cold throat, fighting to keep its snapping jaws away from your face while your boots sink deeper into the treacherous grey mire. Every muscle in your back screams against the strain as you try to force its head back against the jagged hull plates.

nodes.title: Torn by the Deep
nodes.brief: You fight off a grotesque, mutated angler-beast that emerges from the fog, risking terrible lacerations to harvest its glowing lure.
nodes.page: The creature's jagged teeth rake across your leather jerkin, tearing deep into the meat of your shoulder before you manage to bash its skull with your heavy iron canteen. You stumble backward into a pool of brine, coughing salt water and clutching your torn arm while the beast retreats into the blinding fog with a harsh, clicking hiss. The wound burns fiercely, pulsing in time with your racing heart as you struggle back to your feet.

exits.label: Gather your breath and move on

nodes.title: The Pulse in the Palm
nodes.brief: You fight off a grotesque, mutated angler-beast that emerges from the fog, risking terrible lacerations to harvest its glowing lure.
nodes.page: Your fingers close around the pulsing lump of bioluminescent tissue as the beast writhes back into the black water. The soft organ warms your palm, casting a pale green glow over the wet sand and illuminating the strange tracks left by other things that share the trench. You slide the prize into a sealed oilskin pouch, wiping the cold slime from your blade as the silence settles back over the flats.

exits.label: Return to the trench edge hub

nodes.title: The Giant Bivalve
nodes.brief: You pry a massive clam shell open with your bare hands, struggling against its tremendous grip to extract a flawless black pearl.
nodes.page: Salt-encrusted ribs of a rib-ribboned galleon jut from the grey muck like old teeth, and beside them lies an iron-grey shell the size of a tavern table. Its jagged lips are clamped shut against the dry air, weeping a thin trickle of brackish foam that smells of ancient mud and iodine. You wedge the crook of your heavy crowbar into the living seam, leaning your entire weight upon the shaft until your shoulder muscles shriek in protest. Slowly, grudgingly, the massive valves part an inch, revealing a wet cavern of grey-blue nacre where a sphere as dark as a wet slate stone rests in the fleshy folds.

exits.label: Wrench the iron against the shell

nodes.title: Deep Shell Secrets
nodes.brief: You pry a massive clam shell open with your bare hands, struggling against its tremendous grip to extract a flawless black pearl.
nodes.page: Heedless of the suction that threatens to snap your wrists, you dig your fingers deeper into the cold, pulsing meat of the bivalve to snare the prize before the stubborn shell snaps shut again. The brute thing shudders in the muck, exhaling a foul gust of stagnant water that coats your oilskins in a film of grey silt. Your boots slide an inch in the ooze, but you wrench your arm backward with a savage grunt, tearing the heavy pearl free from its ligament just as the great jaws slam together with the hollow crack of a falling spar.

exits.label: Secure the pearl in your pouch

nodes.title: Forcing the Great Shell
nodes.brief: You pry a massive clam shell open with your bare hands, struggling against its tremendous grip to extract a flawless black pearl.
nodes.page: Mud bubbles sluggishly around the perimeter of the titanic shell where it is half-buried in the floor of the Low. Bending low, you plant both heels against the ribbed underside and jam your bare fingers straight into the slimy, twitching gap of the hinge. The beastly thing fights back with the hydraulic heft of an incoming tide, its massive muscle contracting to crush your digits into bone meal while the suction tries to drag your knuckles into the dark. You strain every tendon in your forearms, summoning the raw muscle needed to wrench the shell apart before the trap closes for good.

nodes.title: Crushed in the Grasp
nodes.brief: You pry a massive clam shell open with your bare hands, struggling against its tremendous grip to extract a flawless black pearl.
nodes.page: The bivalve wins with a brutal, sickening snap, calcareous lips slamming shut on your hand before you can yank it clear. A jagged edge of shell slices straight through your thick leather glove and scores deep across your knuckles, drawing a bright line of crimson that mixes instantly with the grey brine. You stagger backward into the stinking silt with a curse, nursing a bruised and bleeding hand that throbs with every beat of your heart, leaving the prize locked tight in the belly of the monster.

nodes.title: The Midnight Sphere
nodes.brief: You pry a massive clam shell open with your bare hands, struggling against its tremendous grip to extract a flawless black pearl.
nodes.page: At last the anomaly comes free of the shell. Your hand closes on cold mineral, dense and slick. It is no true pearl, but a dense globule of hardened brine and deep-sea phosphorescence. Held up to the pale sky of the Low, it pulses with an oily midnight sheen. Into the waxed canvas pouch it goes. Faint warmth finds your ribs through the cloth, the beat of something drowned and long forgotten.

nodes.title: The Phosphor Grotto
nodes.brief: You navigate the confusing patches of glowing fungi to find a safe descent, avoiding hallucinogenic spores to discover a hidden cave shelter.
nodes.page: A cavernous cleft opens in the side of a sunken lighthouse tower, its stone walls furred with thick patches of bioluminescent fungi that pulse in sickly rings of amber and sea-green. Sweet-scented vapour curls from the moss in thin wisps, smelling of fermented kelp and old dreams, enough to make your eyelids droop if you breathe too deep. You pull the wet wool of your scarf across your mouth and nose, stepping carefully over the bleached ribcage of a pilot whale that serves as the threshold to the descent.

nodes.title: Down the Stained Steps
nodes.brief: You navigate the confusing patches of glowing fungi to find a safe descent, avoiding hallucinogenic spores to discover a hidden cave shelter.
nodes.page: Slick stone steps wind downward into the hull of the wrecked tower, coated in a greasy film of luminescent slime that glows faintly beneath the soles of your wading boots. Every surface is damp and weeping, and far below in the dark, a slow rhythmic dripping echoes like a clock ticking down the hours of the stranded sea. You keep one hand pressed firmly against the weeping masonry, feeling the cold salt sweat of the stones as you navigate the treacherous switchbacks of the shaft.

nodes.title: Navigating the Spores
nodes.brief: You navigate the confusing patches of glowing fungi to find a safe descent, avoiding hallucinogenic spores to discover a hidden cave shelter.
nodes.page: Thick carpets of pale blue lichen choke the narrow gallery ahead, releasing microscopic clouds of luminous dust whenever your boots brush against the floorboards. Inhaling even a lungful of the shimmering smoke will fill your head with waking dreams of drowning cities and voices calling your name from beneath the ice. You narrow your eyes against the glare, picking your footing with extreme care, testing every inch of the stone floor with the tip of your boarding axe to find the firmest patches of ground before committing your weight.

nodes.title: Breath of the Fungi
nodes.brief: You navigate the confusing patches of glowing fungi to find a safe descent, avoiding hallucinogenic spores to discover a hidden cave shelter.
nodes.page: A sudden gust of warm air from a lower vent stirs the blue carpet, billowing a thick cloud of luminous spores directly into your face before you can turn away. You cough violently, your chest burning as the hallucinogenic dust coats your throat, filling your ears with the phantom roar of breakers crashing over your head. By the time you stagger out of the cloud and wipe your streaming eyes, your head is spinning with a dull ache, and you have lost precious minutes stumbling blind against the damp stone walls.

nodes.title: The Hidden Alcove
nodes.brief: You navigate the confusing patches of glowing fungi to find a safe descent, avoiding hallucinogenic spores to discover a hidden cave shelter.
nodes.page: Past shimmering haze and fog you reach the far side of the grotto and find a dry, sheltered alcove tucked behind an iron bulkhead. The air here is still and free of the sweet, rotting reek of the spores, offering a safe place to catch your breath away from the scouring wind of the seabed. Tucked into a crevice in the stonework, forgotten by whoever fled the tower before the tide vanished, lies a dry bundle wrapped in oilskin.

nodes.title: The Sunken Threshold
nodes.brief: Following the map from the journal, you finally locate the entrance to the spiral shaft leading down into the darkness.
nodes.page: Iron rings bolted into the weeping limestone match every mark in the missing lighthouse keeper's journal. You uncurl the water-stained parchment against the damp rock and check the coordinates. Here the spiral shaft plunges beneath the dead seabed. An iron grate has been levered aside. Below, a vertical drop choked with dry kelp carries the faint copper tang of ancient machinery. Under that jagged opening the stairs spiral down into absolute blackness. Metallic drips of subterranean brine mark the dark in slow ticks.

nodes.title: The Sunken Stair
nodes.brief: The Sunken Stair Descent: A treacherous, spiralling staircase carved into the bedrock descends toward the Meridian Gear, guarded by ancient traps and brittle stone.
nodes.page:
Spiralling deep into the damp bedrock, the Sunken Stair drops away into absolute gloom, its basalt treads slick with salt-crust and age-old grease. Every footfall echoes against walls carved with the faded crests of forgotten Tidewardens, who left their iron marks to rot long before Gullmouth took its first breath of brine. Somewhere far below, the great brass teeth of the Meridian Gear grind against the dark, calling to anyone desperate enough to command the returning tide.

Shadows twist along the winding drop, offering half a dozen paths through the fractured stonework where crumbling masonry and rusted machinery block the descent. You test the air for the smell of old oil and damp iron, weighing each hazard before you commit your weight to the stairs.

exits.label: Squeeze through the narrow rock crevice
Heave the fallen stone pillar aside
Leap across the gaping stair chasm
Lower heavy gear with the pulley
Approach the great brass Meridian Gear

nodes.title: The Alchemist's Step
nodes.brief: You disarm an ancient pressure plate on the steps, working with steady hands to secure passage and a vial of alchemical fire.
nodes.page: Smooth flagstones conceal a pressure-sensitive plate that clicks softly beneath the heel of your boot. Working by the dim, greenish illumination of your lantern, you use a small bone-handled knife to scrape away centuries of salt crust from the triggering mechanism. A delicate glass vial, sealed with red wax and filled with volatile alchemical fire, rests untouched within a recessed niche right beside the trap.

nodes.title: Tampering With Steel
nodes.brief: You disarm an ancient pressure plate on the steps, working with steady hands to secure passage and a vial of alchemical fire.
nodes.page: The delicate linkage of the pressure plate hums under the gentle pressure of your fingertips, resisting every attempt to lift the rusted locking bolt. Sweat drips from your brow and threatens to blind you while you slow your breathing and align the delicate brass teeth of the trap with the edge of your blade. One false twitch will shatter the mechanism and trigger whatever forgotten doom rests within the stone.

nodes.title: A Slip in the Dark
nodes.brief: You disarm an ancient pressure plate on the steps, working with steady hands to secure passage and a vial of alchemical fire.
nodes.page: Metal snaps with a sharp, brittle crack that echoes up the damp stairwell, releasing a sudden spray of stinging rust and alkaline dust. You scramble backward just as the stone slab drops into a dark cavity, scraping your forearm hard against the jagged masonry. The sudden strain costs you precious time and leaves a raw, bleeding scratch across your skin, but you keep your footing on the narrow ledge.

nodes.title: Safe Passage Secured
nodes.brief: You disarm an ancient pressure plate on the steps, working with steady hands to secure passage and a vial of alchemical fire.
nodes.page: Your fingers catch the hidden seam of the pressure plate. Metal scrapes stone as you push the bronze toggle, and a distant click answers from inside the works. The trap drops into its groove; dart-holes and rusted tripwires stay shut. In the recess behind the mechanism sits a small flask sealed with red wax, smelling of distilled turpentine and cold fat. You pocket it, wipe the greasy black film from your palms, and the stairs drop farther into the dark.

exits.label: Approach the great brass Meridian Gear

nodes.title: The Ribs of Stone
nodes.brief: You squeeze through a terrifyingly narrow crevice to bypass a collapsed section, fighting off severe claustrophobia to find a rusted signet ring.
nodes.page: Jagged walls of granite press inward until the passage narrows to the width of a man's shoulders, smelling intensely of old salt and damp earth. Squeezing through this claustrophobic cleft requires you to strip away your heavy pack and inch forward sideways, feeling the rough rock scrape against your ribs. Wedged in a crevice near the floor is a small, tarnished metal hoop bearing the emblem of an old Tidewarden family.

nodes.title: Breath Against the Rock
nodes.brief: You squeeze through a terrifyingly narrow crevice to bypass a collapsed section, fighting off severe claustrophobia to find a rusted signet ring.
nodes.page: The stone walls seem to pulse and tighten around your chest, threatening to pin you in the darkness as panic claws at the back of your throat. Closing your eyes, you force your lungs to take slow, deliberate breaths while your fingers search blindly along the cold crevice for a handhold. The pressure mounts, demanding every ounce of your self-control to prevent a blind retreat.

nodes.title: Narrow Escape
nodes.brief: You squeeze through a terrifyingly narrow crevice to bypass a collapsed section, fighting off severe claustrophobia to find a rusted signet ring.
nodes.page: Terror overcomes reason for a frantic second, and you thrash forward blindly, tearing your woolen coat and scraping the skin raw from your shoulders. You tumble out of the narrow cleft and land hard on the lower flagstones, gasping for cold air with a bruised ribcage. The delay costs you dearly in lost energy, but the obstacle is finally behind you.

nodes.title: The Found Relic
nodes.brief: You squeeze through a terrifyingly narrow crevice to bypass a collapsed section, fighting off severe claustrophobia to find a rusted signet ring.
nodes.page: Controlling your breathing with iron discipline, you slide smoothly through the crushing stone gap without catching a single strap of your gear. In the dirt at the far end lies a rusted signet ring that still bears the stamp of a forgotten maritime magistrate. You slip the cold metal onto your finger and press deeper into the shaft.

nodes.title: The Fallen Pillar
nodes.brief: You push a massive fallen pillar out of the stairwell, straining your muscles to the limit to uncover a hidden weapon cache.
nodes.page: Granite dust settles in your lashes as your shoulder blades scream against the cold tonnage of the masonry. You wedge your boot against a cracked riser and throw your full weight into the heave, boots grinding until the pillar finally groans and rolls aside with a dry rattle. Beneath its shadowed belly, tucked into a dry alcove untouched by the sea's ancient salt, rests an old iron-bound box and a broad-bladed harpoon pike wrapped in greasy oiled hide. The metal is cold and grey, untouched by red rust.

exits.label: Take the iron weapon from the dust

nodes.title: Clearing the Debris
nodes.brief: You push a massive fallen pillar out of the stairwell, straining your muscles to the limit to uncover a hidden weapon cache.
nodes.page:
Dust hangs thick in the stale air, smelling of ancient brine and iron ore. Kneeling beside the shifted masonry, you clear away the remaining grit until the full length of the cache shows inside the rock. A rusted latch gives way beneath your calloused fingers, revealing oiled leather wrapping that protects the gear from the damp rot of the seabed. You pause to catch your breath, listening intently for any echo rising from the depths before reaching out to claim the hidden store.

The metal inside is cold and heavy, forged in an era before the sea retreated from the cliffs of Gullmouth. Gathering the items close, you ready yourself for the next downward leg of your descent toward the great mechanism.

nodes.title: Shifting the Great Stone
nodes.brief: You push a massive fallen pillar out of the stairwell, straining your muscles to the limit to uncover a hidden weapon cache.
nodes.page: Muscle and bone strain as you plant your boots against the cracked flagstones of the stairwell. The fallen pillar blocks the only way forward, granite wedged between the arched walls of the old sea-temple. You grit your teeth and drive into the stone. Your muscles shake. Sweat runs into your eyes while the granite scrapes the bedrock. A deep crack sounds in the masonry above your head. The whole archway could come down on your shoulders if your footing slips even a fraction of an inch.

nodes.title: Crushed Underfoot
nodes.brief: You push a massive fallen pillar out of the stairwell, straining your muscles to the limit to uncover a hidden weapon cache.
nodes.page: The stone suddenly shifts with a vicious snap, rolling backward and pinning your shoulder against the jagged wall with a sickening crunch. Pain flares hot and sharp down your arm, knocking the wind from your lungs as grey dust fills your eyes and mouth. You scramble wildly in the dark, tearing your skin against the rough granite until you finally wrench yourself free, leaving behind a tattered shred of your woolen coat and a deep, throbbing bruise. Coughing violently in the choking air, you drag your battered body away from the unstable rubble and press on down the winding stair.

nodes.title: The Hidden Cache
nodes.brief: You push a massive fallen pillar out of the stairwell, straining your muscles to the limit to uncover a hidden weapon cache.
nodes.page: Granite resists your strength with stubborn fury, but you find the exact balance point and heave with a final, desperate burst of energy. The massive pillar groans, tips over the edge of the stair, and crashes heavily into the abyss below, leaving the secret alcove wide open to your reach. Inside the dry cavity rests a well-preserved blade of dark tempered steel, its edge still keen despite long years of salt and time. You slip the weapon's leather harness over your shoulder, feeling the solid, reassuring weight of the relic against your ribs.

nodes.title: Crossing the Chasm
nodes.brief: You leap across a yawning chasm where the stairs have crumbled, risking a deadly fall to reach a secure landing and resting spot.
nodes.page:
Jagged gaps fracture the spiralling stone path where time and salt-rot have eaten away the outer edge of the stair. Far below, the dark core of the shaft drops away into absolute blackness, save for the faint glimmer of phosphorescent moss clinging to the distant walls. You grip the cold handrail of ironwork, testing each remaining foothold with intense care before committing your weight to the open air. A gust of damp wind sweeps up from the deep abyss, carrying the dry, metallic scent of the mechanism waiting at the bottom.

Reaching the opposite landing safely, you shake the tremors from your fingers and look up at the next stretch of the crumbling descent.

nodes.title: Leap Across the Void
nodes.brief: You leap across a yawning chasm where the stairs have crumbled, risking a deadly fall to reach a secure landing and resting spot.
nodes.page: The stone stairs vanish abruptly before you, leaving a yawning ten-foot gap of empty air above the dark and silent shaft. You back up against the damp wall, measuring the terrifying distance in the gloom while loose gravel trickles from your boots into the abyss. Taking a sharp breath, you charge forward through the chill fog and launch yourself outward over the empty space, praying that your legs have enough power to clear the deadly drop. Your palms sweat as the opposite ledge rushes toward you out of the shadows.

nodes.title: Falling Short
nodes.brief: You leap across a yawning chasm where the stairs have crumbled, risking a deadly fall to reach a secure landing and resting spot.
nodes.page: Your boots strike the slick edge of the far landing, but your momentum fails you and your knees slam hard into the jagged stone. Pain shoots up your shins as you slip backward, your fingernails frantically scraping against the rough rock wall until you manage to hook your elbows over the rim. You dangle for a breathless second over the endless drop before heaving yourself onto solid ground, bruised and breathless. A sharp scrape across your ribs leaves a warm streak of blood beneath your shirt, reminding you of the cost of carelessness in this buried place.

nodes.title: Landing Firm
nodes.brief: You leap across a yawning chasm where the stairs have crumbled, risking a deadly fall to reach a secure landing and resting spot.
nodes.page: Your boots hit the opposite flagstone with a solid, resonant thud, and your momentum carries you safely into a low crouch against the far wall. Dust settles around your ankles as you catch your breath, realizing how close you came to joining the drowned bones at the bottom of the shaft. Tucked into a niche beside the landing lies a small, leather-bound logbook left behind by a forgotten pilgrim, its pages filled with neat diagrams of the great mechanism below. You tuck the book securely into your coat pocket, gaining a valuable insight into the workings of the deep sea.

nodes.title: The Iron Pulley
nodes.brief: You repair a shattered pulley mechanism to lower your heavy gear safely, dodging snapping cables to ensure your supplies remain intact.
nodes.page:
Rusted chains and rotting hemp hang in loops down the center of the deep vertical shaft, and they can tangle around your limbs with every step. Overhead a jammed iron pulley waits, its brass wheels stuck fast in a thick crust of green verdigris and dried salt. Quick fingers pry the rusted teeth apart with your knife and clear the corrosion until the cylinder spins true once more. The metal screeches. The mechanism holds for a passage into the lower depths.

You secure your supply pack to the newly freed hook, watch it drop smoothly into the gloom, and follow down the ladder.

nodes.title: Mending the Tackle
nodes.brief: You repair a shattered pulley mechanism to lower your heavy gear safely, dodging snapping cables to ensure your supplies remain intact.
nodes.page: Iron cables groan and snap under sudden tension, spraying showers of rusted sparks across the dark stone floor around your boots. You desperately work your knife into the jammed cogs of the overhead winch, trying to free the fouled line before the heavy cargo breaks loose and plunges into the dark. The metal teeth bite into your palm through your gloves, and the entire iron housing shudders violently as the weight slips another terrifying inch toward the abyss. Your fingers move with desperate speed, trying to force the locking lever home before the whole assembly gives way.

nodes.title: Snapped Cables
nodes.brief: You repair a shattered pulley mechanism to lower your heavy gear safely, dodging snapping cables to ensure your supplies remain intact.
nodes.page: The winch shrieks as the iron pawns shear off. Your supply pack plunges into the darkness and hits far below. A whip-like steel cable lashes across your forearm, tears through your woolen sleeve, and opens a burning crimson welt across your skin. You press your hand against the smarting cut and curse in the damp dark. Half your rations now lie scattered across the unseen floor far below. You gather the remaining gear and resume your careful descent down the shaft.

nodes.title: Smooth Lowering
nodes.brief: You repair a shattered pulley mechanism to lower your heavy gear safely, dodging snapping cables to ensure your supplies remain intact.
nodes.page: Your swift fingers find the jammed safety pin just in time, wedging it firmly between the grinding cogs to lock the heavy winch in place. The iron cables ease and lower your pack onto the stone landing without a single tear or loss of supplies. As you untie the rig, your fingers brush against a small brass token wedged into the pulley housing, stamped with the crest of the old Gullmouth harbor masters. Into your pocket goes the token; the right person might trade safe passage or answers for it.

nodes.title: The Meridian Gear
nodes.brief: At the bottom of the stair, the massive brass teeth of the Meridian Gear loom in the shadows, waiting to be turned.
nodes.page:
Brass teeth the size of doors stand from the drowned flagstones, green with copper rot, cold water beading off their edges into the dark. This is the heart of the Sunken Stair: a maze of silent levers and dead iron that has steered the deep currents since the old days. Each notch on the great rim smells of old tallow and oxidized salt. Somewhere above, the tide clock ticks in a hurry. Across the machinery the light slips further back.

You set a hand on the cold metal. Under the earth something knocks once, hollow, then again. Ozone and old oil cut the nose. The sleeping ocean waits on a turn of this rim.

exits.label: Reach for the rusted brass lever

nodes.title: Salvaging the Winch
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted winch mechanism near the edge, carefully avoiding jagged metal to extract a heavy iron gear.
nodes.page: Jagged plates of iron frame the rusted winch mechanism, dripping with stagnant brine and greasy grease. You wedge your fingers into the narrow gap between the rusted casing and the primary cog, ignoring the sharp edges that threaten to bite into your skin. Careful leverage and one hard heave break the iron gear free from its corrosion; it drops into your waiting palm.

exits.label: Carry the heavy iron gear onward

nodes.title: Salt-Searing Oath
nodes.brief: You endure a painful initiation ritual with burning sea-salt, resisting the urge to cry out to gain an amulet of deep-sea glass.
nodes.page: Crystals of burning sea-salt bite deep into your bare skin as the ritual circle flares with a sickly violet flame. The agony runs through your bones like molten lead, but you clench your teeth and keep your breathing steady against the torment. When the fire cools at last to pale ash, a cold amulet of deep-sea glass rests upon the altar for your blood-stained fingers.

nodes.title: The Pressure Plate
nodes.brief: You disarm an ancient pressure plate on the steps, working with steady hands to secure passage and a vial of alchemical fire.
nodes.page: Cold stone blocks press down beneath your boots along the winding stairway, where a single hair-trigger seam threatens to unmake the entire passage. You drop to one knee, breath held tight, and use a notched blade to scrape away centuries of encrusted lime from the hidden spring. The metal clicks softly into place, harmless at last, leaving a small vial of volatile alchemical fire exposed in the dust.

exits.label: Pocket the vial of alchemical fire

nodes.title: Rafters of the Bell Tower
nodes.brief: You walk the crumbling upper rafters to reach the bell tower, ignoring the dizzying drop to retrieve a forgotten Tidewarden journal.
nodes.page: Timbers groan under your weight as you creep along the high, skeletal rafters high above the stone floor. The drop below is a bottomless black well, smelling of pigeon droppings and rusted iron bells. Reaching the shadowed alcove, your fingers close around the leather-bound cover of a forgotten Tidewarden journal before the ancient wood beneath you can snap.

nodes.title: Cargo Hold Glyphs
nodes.brief: You translate the strange markings on the cargo crates, avoiding a trapped mechanism to secure a bundle of waterproof matches.
nodes.page: Faint crimson symbols glow across the water-logged timber of the stacked cargo crates and warn of volatile contents sealed within. You scrape the barnacles off. The old maritime shorthand resolves just in time, and you bypass the tripwire before it can spring. Inside the dry straw lining sits a tightly wrapped bundle of waterproof matches.

nodes.title: The Offering Bowl
nodes.brief: You carve a beautiful wooden offering bowl for their ritual, working the wood carefully to win a warm meal and vital supplies.
nodes.page: Smooth driftwood yields beneath your carving knife, curling into fine ribbons of pale grain under the dim torchlight. You shape the rim with practiced care, smoothing the sacred maritime patterns until the vessel feels balanced and whole in your palms. The hooded folk nod in silent approval, sliding a wooden bowl of hot kelp broth and dried salt-meat across the trestle.

exits.label: Accept the warm meal and supplies

nodes.title: Echoes in the Crypt
nodes.brief: You brave the dark crypts to confront a restless spirit of the Hollow Choir, keeping your sanity intact to claim a silver chalice.
nodes.page: Shifting shadows take shape within the damp crypt, murmuring names of sailors who never saw the dawn. A cold wind passes through your coat, but you keep your gaze fixed on the gleaming silver chalice resting upon the stone bier. The phantom faces fade into the mist as your hand closes firmly around the cold metal.

nodes.title: Whispering Tombs
nodes.brief: You brave the dark crypts to confront a restless spirit of the Hollow Choir, keeping your sanity intact to claim a silver chalice.
nodes.page: Damp stone walls press in from every side as you navigate the narrow passages of the lower vault. A sudden chill grips your chest, carrying the bitter scent of deep-water drowning and forgotten grief. You force your lungs to draw breath, shutting out the weeping voices until you reach the altar where a tarnished silver chalice waits.

nodes.title: Whispers in the Sand
nodes.brief: You ignore the maddening whispers echoing from the dunes, fighting off a creeping panic to pocket a gleaming white pearl.
nodes.page: Soft ripples of sand shift under your boots while thin, reedy voices rise from the low dunes, calling you by names you abandoned years ago. A cold sweat breaks across your neck, but you grit your teeth against the rising panic and push forward through the gale. Half-buried in the pale quartz, a gleaming white pearl catches the grey light of the sky.

nodes.title: Salt-Cured Fronds
nodes.brief: You identify the medicinal properties of a rare dried kelp, harvesting the fragile fronds without triggering a rockfall to gain its benefits.
nodes.page: Whitebeard kelp clings to the vertical face of a brine-whitened shelf, its curled fronds rich with bitter iodine that seals a torn palm better than tallow. You reach with your thumb and forefinger, peeling each brittle ribbon away from the stone while watching the unstable shale above shift with a dry, warning hiss. By shifting your weight to your heels and moving with agonizing slowness, you fill your canvas pouch without bringing the grey overhang down upon your neck.

exits.label: Pack the dried fronds safely away

nodes.title: The Anchor Haul
nodes.brief: You help the pilgrims drag their massive anchor up a steep incline, straining your back to earn their sacred blessing of protection.
nodes.page: Drift Pilgrims lean their raw shoulders against the cold iron shank of an anchor as heavy as a cathedral bell, their cracked lips chanting praises to a sea that turned its back. You step into the muddy rut behind them, setting your palms against the rusted fluke and throwing your spine into the heave while the damp incline threatens to slide back down into the brine-pit. Sweat stings your salt-crusted eyebrows, but the collective grunt of the faithful finally tops the rise, earning you a solemn nod and a thumb-pressed smear of holy silt across your forehead.

exits.label: Receive the blessing of the pilgrims

nodes.title: Rafters of the Bell
nodes.brief: You walk the crumbling upper rafters to reach the bell tower, ignoring the dizzying drop to retrieve a forgotten Tidewarden journal.
nodes.page: Rotting oak beams groan beneath your boots as you scale the skeletal ribs of the collapsed municipal hall, looking down into a dizzying drop where jagged timbers jut like broken teeth. Above you hangs the green-patinated bronze bell, half-choked with dried kelp and holding the leather-bound ledger of the old Tidewarden wedged tight between its iron yoke and the wall. You stretch across the void, trusting the ancient wood to hold your weight one last time while your fingers catch the water-swollen leather.

nodes.title: Shelf of Medicinal Kelp
nodes.brief: You identify the medicinal properties of a rare dried kelp, harvesting the fragile fronds without triggering a rockfall to gain its benefits.
nodes.page: Crisp ribbons of bladder-wrack cling to a sun-baked ledge above the drop, glistening with a pale medicinal resin that every Gullmouth wrecker keeps tucked in their cheek during a fever. You wedge your toes into a fissure in the limestone, testing the brittle rock before reaching up with both hands to harvest the fragile fronds without sliding the loose shale below. The harvest comes away clean in your grip, smelling of bitter iodine and ancient mud.

exits.label: Secure the fragile fronds in your pouch

nodes.title: Fogs of the Abyss
nodes.brief: You fight off a grotesque, mutated angler-beast that emerges from the fog, risking terrible lacerations to harvest its glowing lure.
nodes.page: A greasy vapor rolls across the salt-flats, parting just long enough to reveal a pulsing, yellow lantern dangling from the snout of a bloated, crawling thing with too many jaws. It lunges from the fog with a wet, blunt thud and sprays foul brine as its needle-teeth snap inches from your throat. You draw your heavy sheath-knife and drive it upward into the soft flesh behind its glowing lure, twisting the blade hard as the carcass thrashes in the mud.

nodes.title: The Iron Bivalve
nodes.brief: You pry a massive clam shell open with your bare hands, struggling against its tremendous grip to extract a flawless black pearl.
nodes.page: Half-buried in the black silt of a drowned harbor lane rests a giant river-clam, its ridged shell sealed shut with the stubborn strength of an iron vault door. You wedge the flat of your heavy pry-bar into the pulsing seam, leaning your entire body weight against the iron while the shell groans and fights back with the hydraulic pull of the deep. With one final wrench, the muscle gives way with a wet snap, revealing a lustrous black pearl resting in the grey folds.

nodes.title: Hold of the Wreck
nodes.brief: You recall old tide maps to navigate the treacherous cargo hold, dodging a falling mast to find a sealed jar of lantern oil.
nodes.page: Pitch-black darkness clings to the rusted iron ribs of the stranded merchant hulk, and the air tastes of stagnant bilge and old wool. Fingertips trace the flaking bulkheads as you recall the precise layout of the cargo decks from old harbor charts, and above you a towering pine mast groans and starts to list. You duck aside. The timber crashes into the deck planks. Ahead sits a wooden crate filled with sealed glass jars of lamp oil.

nodes.title: The Reef Crab Trap
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift net from discarded fishing lines, risking a severe pinch to capture a large, edible reef crab.
nodes.page: Twisted monofilament lines from a dozen snapped nets lie tangled across a salt-crusted trench, offering strong, flexible cordage if you have the patience to untangle them without snagging your skin. Working quickly with cold fingers, you weave a crude drop-basket and bait it with a scrap of salted skate, lowering it into a churning tide-pool where dark shapes scuttle beneath the foam. A heavy, armored reef-crab snaps its claws against the mesh, fighting fiercely as you haul the impromptu trap onto the dry shale.

nodes.title: The Water-Still
nodes.brief: You repair a merchant's broken water-still using discarded bones, carefully balancing the delicate components to earn a full canteen.
nodes.page: A Brineholder merchant sits beside a collapsed copper condenser, cursing the split pipe that leaves him with nothing to drink beneath the glare of the open sky. You drop to your knees in the grit, using two small rib-bones from a stranded porpoise to splint the fractured joint and binding the seam tightly with strips of salted leather. The apparatus hisses and begins to drip clear condensation into the waiting tin, earning you a grudging nod and a full canteen of lukewarm water.

nodes.title: The Winch Mechanism
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted winch mechanism near the edge, carefully avoiding jagged metal to extract a heavy iron gear.
nodes.page: Thick iron cables spool out from a rusted winch bed bolted to the deck of an upturned galleon, its internal cogs jammed tight with encrusted barnacles and dried kelp. You wedge an iron spike between the interlocking teeth and lean your weight against the rusted metal while the sharp flanges threaten to shear your knuckles. Tormented steel shrieks as the iron gear breaks free from its salt-bed and tumbles straight into your waiting leather sack.

nodes.title: The Singing Dunes
nodes.brief: You analyze the pitch of the singing sands to locate solid ground, avoiding dangerous quicksand to reach an abandoned campsite.
nodes.page: Fine quartz crystals hum against your boots like a nest of trapped hornets as you cross the undulating ridge. By listening closely to the fluctuating whine of the dunes, you map out the denser compaction where the silt settles safely over buried bedrock. Every step requires a light touch, keeping your weight distributed to avoid sliding down the deceptive slopes that conceal bottomless pockets of shifting dust. Beyond the loudest crest lies a sheltered hollow where previous travelers abandoned a smoldering brazier and a scatter of dry rations.

nodes.title: The Watchful Horizon
nodes.brief: You study the scavenging patterns of rival crews to slip past their lookouts, securing an intact spyglass for your journey.
nodes.page: Crouched behind the bleached ribs of a stranded pinnace, you track the rhythmic sweeps of the rival crew patrolling the salt flats. They move in predictable pairs, their heavy iron pikes catching the harsh midday glare while their eyes scan the open flats rather than the broken hulls. Waiting for their backs to turn toward the distant tide pools, you dart from shadow to shadow across the white-crusted mud. Tucked beneath an overturned dingoy lies a brass-bound spyglass left behind in their haste, its lenses clear and undamaged.

nodes.title: The Iron Stilts
nodes.brief: You approach the soaring stilt-legs of Saltspire, discovering the rusted winch-lifts are heavily guarded by Brineholder mercenaries who demand a steep toll for entry.
nodes.page: Colossal iron stilts rise from the barren seabed like the legs of drowned goliaths, holding the towering metropolis of Saltspire high above the dry floor. At their base, a sprawling camp of timber shanties crowds the rusted structural joints, patrolled by Brineholder mercenaries in polished plate mail. Their blockade is absolute: long pikes bar the central lift platforms, and they demand an exorbitant toll in coin or rare rations from every desperate soul trying to ascend. Guards eye your salt-stained gear with suspicion, their hands resting near their heavy cudgels as you step into the shadow of the great legs.

nodes.title: The Piling Slums
nodes.brief: The Piling Slums: A sprawling shanty of shipwreck timber clings to the lower stilts, teeming with desperate scavengers looking for a way up.
nodes.page: Shacks of driftwood and discarded canvas cling to the rust-streaked iron pillars of Saltspire, a shanty town sprawled under the wealthy city. Haggling vendors call between the damp walls. Scavengers watch every ladder and pulley with hungry calculation. Routes climb the structural maze toward the heights, some past the guards, some straight up the stilts. A narrow rope ladder sways in the draft. Nearby a rusted maintenance hatch rattles as someone tests the locks from the far side.

nodes.title: The Cargo Lift
nodes.brief: You try forcing a jammed cargo lift to bypass the guards, risking a fatal plunge to earn a rusted access key.
nodes.page: Heavy grease cakes the sliding tracks of the freight hoist where it jams halfway up the lower support column. Below the suspended platform, a drop of twenty spans opens directly onto jagged iron scrap protruding from the seabed. A rusted access key hangs from a wire tether just out of normal reach, dangling temptingly above the mechanical teeth of the winch housing. You wedge your fingers into the frozen gears, straining against the rusted iron as the entire framework groans under the sudden tension.

nodes.title: The Hoist Mechanism
nodes.brief: You try forcing a jammed cargo lift to bypass the guards, risking a fatal plunge to earn a rusted access key.
nodes.page: Rust flakes off the iron housing into your eyes as you heave your shoulder against the stuck pulley wheel. The cable groans, slipping an inch before catching with a sharp metallic shriek that echoes off the surrounding shanties. Salt-caked grease fouls your grip, threatening to send you tumbling backward into the open drop below. With a final heave, you throw your weight onto the rusted lever to force the mechanism past its rusted bind.

nodes.title: Forcing the Mechanism
nodes.brief: You try forcing a jammed cargo lift to bypass the guards, risking a fatal plunge to earn a rusted access key.
nodes.page: Muscles screaming under the sudden strain, you throw your entire weight against the frozen iron lever of the cargo lift, praying the rusted housing holds. The internal cogs grind together with a deafening screech of stressed metal, threatening to snap the main axle and send you plunging into the scrap-strewn depths below. You lock your heels against the slick decking and heave with every ounce of strength left in your frame.

nodes.title: The Broken Gear
nodes.brief: You try forcing a jammed cargo lift to bypass the guards, risking a fatal plunge to earn a rusted access key.
nodes.page: The rusted axle snaps with a sound like a pistol shot, sending you sprawling backward onto the metal decking as a shower of iron teeth rains down into the abyss. Your shoulder impacts a jagged bolt, leaving a deep, throbbing bruise that flares with every breath you take. The lift remains firmly wedged, and the noise draws immediate shouts from the guard post above, forcing you to scramble away into the shadows of the shanty town before they can investigate.

nodes.title: The Rusted Key
nodes.brief: You try forcing a jammed cargo lift to bypass the guards, risking a fatal plunge to earn a rusted access key.
nodes.page: The stubborn iron mechanism finally yields with a wet metallic pop, and the lift plate drops an inch into place. Reaching quickly into the greasy recess, your fingers close around a cold, oil-slicked key that fits the lower maintenance gates. However narrowly, you have secured the means to bypass the primary checkpoint without paying the exorbitant merchant toll.

nodes.title: The Uniform Coat
nodes.brief: You attempt to trick a naive mercenary into lowering a private basket, risking discovery to gain a uniform coat.
nodes.page: A young Brineholder guard stands alone near the outer basket winch, whistling idly as he watches the distant horizon of the Low. His discarded uniform coat, bearing the brass buttons of an assistant hoist-tender, drapes over a nearby packing crate while he adjusts his boots. Approaching with a practiced swagger and a borrowed clipboard from a dead scavenger, you call out an urgent false order regarding an inspection of the lower cables. He hesitates, glancing nervously between his post and the gleaming brass buttons on the coat.

nodes.title: The False Inspection
nodes.brief: You attempt to trick a naive mercenary into lowering a private basket, risking discovery to gain a uniform coat.
nodes.page: You fix the young guard with a stern, authoritative glare, reeling off fabricated regulations about low-tide pressure checks to rattle his composure. He shifts his weight from foot to foot, his eyes darting toward the hanging basket and the spare uniform coat as he tries to weigh the risk of offending an apparent superior. You step into his personal space and hold out a hand for the garment, your voice level as a clerk's.

nodes.title: The Guard's Suspicion
nodes.brief: You attempt to trick a naive mercenary into lowering a private basket, risking discovery to gain a uniform coat.
nodes.page: The young guard narrows his eyes at the salt stains on your hem, suddenly spotting the telltale insignia of a Gullmouth wrecker beneath your improvised swagger. He lets out a sharp whistle for backup, and though you slip away into the labyrinth of shanties before the patrol arrives, the clumsy ruse costs you precious time and leaves you with a sharp scrape across your forearm where a bulkhead corner caught you.

nodes.title: The Guard's Coat
nodes.brief: You attempt to trick a naive mercenary into lowering a private basket, risking discovery to gain a uniform coat.
nodes.page:
You stroke your chin with slow, false confidence, murmuring a forged password about brine-audit inspections until the young mercenary at the upper hoist lowers the iron-ribbed basket without another question. Slipping past the braided ropework, you trade your salt-crusted jacket for the heavy wool coat of an off-duty Brineholder guard, its brass buttons stamped with the salt-rose sigil of the upper platforms. The garment smells faintly of dry lime and stale tallow, but it gives you the unmistakable silhouette of authority among the struts.

Pockets yield a brass token and a half-eaten hard biscuit.

exits.label: Descend to the sprawling shanty slums below

nodes.title: The Smuggler's Hide
nodes.brief: You work to repair a broken rope-pulley left by smugglers, risking exhaustion to secure a hidden climbing harness.
nodes.page: Damp hemp and salt-grease cling to your fingers as you pry open the smuggler's forgotten cache tucked beneath a rotting cross-brace. A severed tackle-block swings in the stale draft, its wooden sheave jammed tight with dried kelp and verdigris. Working by the dim grey luminescence filtering through the stilt-forest above, you clean the brass spindle with a notched pocket-knife. Scraping away the hard-encrusted shell takes slow care, and every minute spent clinging to the timber framework drains your remaining reserves as the distant traffic of the upper districts shakes through your boot-soles.

exits.label: Reach for the rusted winch handle

nodes.title: Rigging the Line
nodes.brief: You work to repair a broken rope-pulley left by smugglers, risking exhaustion to secure a hidden climbing harness.
nodes.page:
Canvas straps and frayed twine pull taut across your knees as you splice the broken strands of the smugglers' harness. The work demands careful fingers that do not shake despite the numbing dampness soaking through your woollen cuffs from the open seabed below. Every knot must hold its bite against the iron weight of the climb, or a single slip will send you crashing down into the skeletal shadows of the lower stilt-work

Testing the tension with a sharp tug, you find the improvised purchase holds fast against your weight, promising a safer passage upward through the vertical maze.

nodes.title: The Frayed Pivot
nodes.brief: You work to repair a broken rope-pulley left by smugglers, risking exhaustion to secure a hidden climbing harness.
nodes.page: Sweat runs into your eyes as you drive your iron wedge into the jammed housing of the smuggler's pulley and twist until the frozen axle begins to give. The metal groans under the strain, flakes of rust raining down onto the barnacled timber far below like dark snow. If the housing shatters under your leverage, the whole mechanism will rip loose and send you tumbling into the void. You brace your boots against the slimy wood and throw your weight onto the tool, holding your breath as the bolt reaches its breaking point.

nodes.title: The Splintered Snag
nodes.brief: You work to repair a broken rope-pulley left by smugglers, risking exhaustion to secure a hidden climbing harness.
nodes.page: Metal screeches against metal as the rusted pivot gives way too fast, biting deep into your forearm and leaving a ragged, bleeding graze across the skin. The broken winch handle whips around in a vicious arc, striking your ribs and knocking the wind from your chest with a sharp gasp. You cling desperately to the slippery timber beam, wheezing salt air as the pain flares through your torso. The harness is secured at last, but the struggle has cost you dearly in both time and blood.

nodes.title: The Smuggler's Cache
nodes.brief: You work to repair a broken rope-pulley left by smugglers, risking exhaustion to secure a hidden climbing harness.
nodes.page: Metal yields under careful pressure with a dry snap. The repaired rope-pulley swings true and silent in the draft. You pull the leather climbing harness over your shoulders and check each buckle and knot before you trust it with a climb into the upper heights. The gear holds. As you finish, a small token of old illicit trade rolls free from the mechanism into your palm.

exits.label: Climb up toward the stilt slums

nodes.title: The Iron Pillar
nodes.brief: You brave a treacherous climb up the barnacle-encrusted central pillar, risking a nasty fall to discover a dropped purse of Coin.
nodes.page:
Barnacles crust the massive iron-sheathed central pillar like grey tumours, offering treacherous footing above the dizzying drop to the dried seabed. Every handhold must be tested before you commit your weight, the cold metal sweating a thin brine that makes your leather gloves slick and untrustworthy. Far above, the lower balconies of Saltspire loom against the pale sky like the ribs of a stranded leviathan

Shifting your grip to a rusted rivet, you spot a glint of dull metal wedged deep inside a seam of iron plating just within reach.

exits.label: Reach into the crusted iron seam

nodes.title: The Lodged Purse
nodes.brief: You brave a treacherous climb up the barnacle-encrusted central pillar, risking a nasty fall to discover a dropped purse of Coin.
nodes.page:
Your fingers scrape against rough salt-encrustation as you inch higher up the vertical expanse of the central pillar, leaving smeared tracks in the grey grime. The wind whistles through the network of timber braces below, carrying the distant, hollow echoes of the stilt-city's markets and guarded gates. Every inch gained is a silent battle against vertigo and the creeping ache in your forearms

Pressing your chest flat against the cold metal plate, you angle your hand further into the crevice where the glint of coin caught your eye.

exits.label: Pry the heavy coin purse loose

nodes.title: The Slippery Footing
nodes.brief: You brave a treacherous climb up the barnacle-encrusted central pillar, risking a nasty fall to discover a dropped purse of Coin.
nodes.page: Your left boot heel skids sideways on a slick cluster of dried barnacles, leaving you dangling by one desperate hand over the abyss. Below you, the jagged wrecks of the Low look like broken teeth waiting in the grey haze. If your grip fails now, there is nothing between you and the seabed to break the fall. You lock your fingers tighter around the rusted iron flange, pulling with all your remaining strength to find a toehold against the sheer vertical plate.

check.label: Claw for purchase on the metal

nodes.title: The Bruised Ascent
nodes.brief: You brave a treacherous climb up the barnacle-encrusted central pillar, risking a nasty fall to discover a dropped purse of Coin.
nodes.page: A sudden shift in the rusted plates drops you hard against the jagged ironwork, scraping your shoulder raw and sending a jarring shock down your spine. You cling to the pillar with teeth gritted against torn skin gone hot and raw, your own heart thudding loud in your ears. Though you manage to keep from falling, the clumsy scramble costs you precious breath and leaves a dark, purple bruise across your ribs.

exits.label: Pull yourself onto the rusted ledge

nodes.title: The Plundered Seam
nodes.brief: You brave a treacherous climb up the barnacle-encrusted central pillar, risking a nasty fall to discover a dropped purse of Coin.
nodes.page: Your fingers hook securely around the leather cord of the hidden purse just as the foothold crumbles beneath your boot, leaving you swinging for a heartbeat before hauling yourself flush against the metal. Your hand comes away clutching a salt-stiffened pouch filled with old coinage left behind by some careless traveller. The small hoard will buy passage or silence when you finally reach the gates above.

nodes.title: The Iron Gatekeeper
nodes.brief: You stare down a territorial thug guarding a secret ladder, risking a beating to win his begrudging respect and free passage.
nodes.page: A rusted ladder is bound by thick hemp ropes to a salt-crusted stilt, and a broad-shouldered Brineholder enforcer plants his boots across the lowest rung. He smells of stale sweat and stagnant cistern water. Salt-greased wrecking clothes earn his flat contempt. You plant your feet on the groaning timber and meet his stare without a blink as he raises a meaty fist to push you back into the abyss. Instead of retreating, you lean forward and take his blow squarely against your collarbone with a dull thud that leaves your teeth aching. Your stillness gives him pause. His brows knit as he weighs your stubbornness against the hassle of a broken jaw.

nodes.title: Standing Your Ground
nodes.brief: You stare down a territorial thug guarding a secret ladder, risking a beating to win his begrudging respect and free passage.
nodes.page: Iron-knuckled fingers coil around your collar and shove you hard against the shivering stilt ironwork until your breath bursts from your lungs in a hot cloud. You refuse to drop your gaze from his flat, pitiless eyes, letting the salt-rimed wind whip between you while your ribs throb beneath your tunic. Every muscle in your torso coils like a wet winch-cable, bracing for the inevitable haymaker that threatens to pitch you over the rail into the empty seabed far below.

nodes.title: The Price of Passage
nodes.brief: You stare down a territorial thug guarding a secret ladder, risking a beating to win his begrudging respect and free passage.
nodes.page: The enforcer's knuckle catches you across the cheekbone, splits the skin, and a hot trickle of blood runs down into your salt-caked collar. You stagger sideways, clinging to a rusted crossbeam as dizziness swims behind your eyes, your left shoulder burning from where you slammed against the iron. He spits a glob of phlegm onto the planks, grunting a coarse word of grudging respect before stepping aside to clear the ladder. You wipe the blood from your face with a calloused thumb, nursing a fresh bruise that will throb for days as you pull yourself onto the rungs.

nodes.title: A Grudging Nod
nodes.brief: You stare down a territorial thug guarding a secret ladder, risking a beating to win his begrudging respect and free passage.
