nodes.page: His fist stops an inch from your jaw; the enforcer's thick fingers uncurl as a slow, greasy grin cracks his sun-baked lips. Your willingness to take his punishment earns a raspy chuckle and a solid slap between your shoulder blades. He steps aside, hooking a thumb toward the vertical rungs above and muttering a warning about the masters higher up. You press past him, pocketing a greasy brass token that marks you as someone who has earned the lower guards' twisted tolerance.

nodes.title: The Thirst of Saltspire
nodes.brief: Ascending into the lower districts, you realise Saltspire is parched, and the Brineholders strictly ration all freshwater to control the populace.
nodes.page: Iron ladders and rusted catwalks climb into the copper haze. Saltspire sits dying of thirst beside an empty ocean. Every pipe, trough, and gutter funnels straight down to the private cisterns of the Brineholders, locked and watched day and night. Lower stilt-dwellers lick moisture from cold metal plates. Armed enforcers patrol every major junction with drawn harpoons. No common scavenger dares siphon a drop of the condensation. Battered wooden shanties cling like barnacles to the structural beams. Hollow-cheeked citizens trade their last scraps of rusted copper for muddy water. You pull your canvas hood lower. Humid shadow takes you in. Far off, valves drip where you cannot reach them, and each dry swallow tastes of nothing.

nodes.title: The Drip Markets
nodes.brief: The Drip Markets: A chaotic bazaar suspended on netting, where desperate citizens trade salvage for tiny measures of precious, muddy water.
nodes.page: Frayed fishing nets stretch between rusted iron pylons to form a swaying, crowded plaza where desperate souls barter salvage for tiny, measured vials of murky water. A sharp reek of unwashed bodies, rotting kelp, and boiling brine fills the damp air, dense enough to chew. Shouts echo from every corner as merchants weigh dull iron nails against drops of condensation, while desperate scavengers eye your pockets with hungry, sunken eyes.

exits.label: Trace the chalk marks of Orsolya

nodes.title: The Leaking Condenser
nodes.brief: You attempt to jury-rig a broken condensation trap, risking angry merchants to claim a full flask of clean water.
nodes.page: Copper tubing snakes across a vibrating frame of ship ribs, weeping precious droplets of condensation into a dented tin basin while angry market vendors glare from nearby stalls. You wedge yourself between a stack of salt-crusted barrels and the humming pipework, pulling a spool of waxed hemp twine from your belt. The local merchants watch your every move with suspicion, ready to set their guard dogs on you if your clumsy fingers puncture their makeshift water line. You wrap the leaking joint tightly, binding the split copper just as a sharp hiss of escaping steam threatens to blow your patch wide open.

nodes.title: The Quick Repair
nodes.brief: You attempt to jury-rig a broken condensation trap, risking angry merchants to claim a full flask of clean water.
nodes.page: Your calloused fingers work with frantic speed against the vibrating, superheated copper while boiling drops spit against your forearms. The rusted union sleeve threatens to shear completely under the pressure of the escaping steam, requiring absolute precision with your hemp cord and sealing wax. You bite your lower lip, ignore the searing heat of the metal, and thread the final knot around the spitting seam, then hold your breath as the whole apparatus holds or bursts.

nodes.title: Scalded and Shouted Down
nodes.brief: You attempt to jury-rig a broken condensation trap, risking angry merchants to claim a full flask of clean water.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of pressure blows your hemp binding wide open, blasting a cloud of scalding steam across your knuckles and leaving angry red blisters blooming on your skin. The surrounding merchants erupt into fierce shouts, brandishing iron wrenches and driving you back from the rig with sharp blows to your shins. You stumble backward into the swaying netting, clutching your burning hand to your chest while losing precious time and a coil of your best twine. Although you escaped without a knife in your ribs, you are left empty-handed and nursing a painful burn that makes every movement a chore.

nodes.title: The Spliced Line
nodes.brief: You attempt to jury-rig a broken condensation trap, risking angry merchants to claim a full flask of clean water.
nodes.page: The hemp binding holds against the shuddering metal. Steam cuts off. A clear trickle of water runs into the tin basin. You finish the joint as the vendor steps forward to inspect the work and gives a grudging nod. He scoops a modest measure of clean water into your leather flask as payment for saving his rig from total ruin. You tuck the cool flask against your hip. Net-traders nearby already mutter that you know how to fix a broken line.

nodes.title: Splintered Stilettos and Brine
nodes.brief: You push through a desperate crowd fighting over a spilled barrel, risking broken ribs to grab an ornate silver cup.
nodes.page: Iron ladders frost over with salt-rime as you climb into the lower tiers of Saltspire. Beneath your boots, the suspended timber walkways groan under the shifting weight of thousands of refugees and greedy Brineholders jostling for purchase. Shouts echo off the damp iron pylons where a cask of preserved eels has burst across the planking, drawing a ravenous mob of scavengers. You duck low beneath a swinging cargo hoist, tasting the metallic tang of fog and bilge on your tongue.

nodes.title: Slippery Timber and Shouts
nodes.brief: You push through a desperate crowd fighting over a spilled barrel, risking broken ribs to grab an ornate silver cup.
nodes.page: Heavy hemp ropes slap against the rotting stilt-posts with the rhythm of a failing heart. The crowd surges forward like a black wave, boots sliding on the greasy residue of crushed brine-fish and spilled oil. Somewhere in the crush, a woman shrieks as her basket of rusted ironmongery tips into the abyss below. You keep your shoulders square and your elbows tucked tight, navigating the churning human tide while the air grows thick with the smell of unwashed wool and panic.

nodes.title: Plucked from the Scramble
nodes.brief: You push through a desperate crowd fighting over a spilled barrel, risking broken ribs to grab an ornate silver cup.
nodes.page: Directly ahead, a splintered oak barrel lies cracked open upon the boards, spilling a heap of tarnished household plate and a heavy, chased silver cup that catches the weak grey light. A burly Brineholder guard reaches for the prize with a hand like a meat-hook, his thick leather coat brushing against your chest. Without pausing to weigh the peril, you hurl your weight against his ribs, planting your boot-heel firmly on a slick patch of fish-guts to wrench the gleaming vessel from the timber before he closes his grip.

nodes.title: Bruised Shins and Splinters
nodes.brief: You push through a desperate crowd fighting over a spilled barrel, risking broken ribs to grab an ornate silver cup.
nodes.page: The guard's dense frame barely budges, and his elbow catches you squarely in the ribs with the force of a falling spar. You stumble backward over a coil of wet mooring line, gasping for breath as a sharp iron hoop tears a long, jagged gash across your forearm. The silver cup rolls away into the grasping hands of another scavenger, leaving you clutching your bleeding arm while the crowd tramples past your boots without a backward glance.

nodes.title: A Gleaming Trophy
nodes.brief: You push through a desperate crowd fighting over a spilled barrel, risking broken ribs to grab an ornate silver cup.
nodes.page: Your sudden impact catches the guard off balance, and he crashes sideways into the wooden railing with a muffled oath. Your fingers close around the cold, chased metal of the silver cup just as his heavy gauntlet grazes your sleeve. Slipping backward into the shadows of a drying-rack, you tuck the prize inside your woollen coat, the stolen cup cool against your ribs.

exits.label: Carry your prize to the market

nodes.title: Ink and Rusted Files
nodes.brief: You forge a quick counterfeit rationing token to fool a vendor, risking arrest to secure extra Supplies for your journey.
nodes.page: Dim candlelight flickers across a workbench cluttered with scraps of trimmed parchment and dried cuttlefish bone inside a dry cooperage. Outside, the endless grey expanse of the Low stretches toward a horizon devoid of water, while a suspicious vendor demands strict token-payment for every dram of flour. You pull a notched copper scraping tool from your pocket, smoothing down the jagged edge of a counterfeit seal until it mimics the official stamp of the salt-miners' syndicate.

nodes.title: The Counterfeiter's Bench
nodes.brief: You forge a quick counterfeit rationing token to fool a vendor, risking arrest to secure extra Supplies for your journey.
nodes.page: Fine brass shavings fall like golden snow onto the stained timber table as you carve the finishing notch into the soft lead-tin alloy. Every creak of the stilt-city's frame sounds like the heavy tread of a Brineholder inspector coming to check permits. Nervous sweat slicks your palms as you rub a pinch of greasy soot into the fresh cuts, aging the metal and hiding the bright, betraying gleam of new work.

nodes.title: The Forger's Final Stroke
nodes.brief: You forge a quick counterfeit rationing token to fool a vendor, risking arrest to secure extra Supplies for your journey.
nodes.page: The critical moment hangs by a thread as you press the heated iron die against the soft metal disc, praying the alloy does not crack under the pressure. A fraction of a millimetre too deep and the fake will snap; too shallow and the emblem will look like a child's scratch. You hold your breath, applying firm, even weight with the palm of your hand while the metal glows dull red in the dim lantern-light.

nodes.title: Cracked Lead and Suspicion
nodes.brief: You forge a quick counterfeit rationing token to fool a vendor, risking arrest to secure extra Supplies for your journey.
nodes.page: The metal gives a sharp, dry snap beneath the die, splitting straight across the forged emblem into two useless pieces of scrap. The vendor narrows his eyes at the sudden noise, his hand drifting toward the heavy iron whistle hanging from his belt. You snatch up the ruined fragments before he can raise the alarm, leaving a small copper coin behind to cover your hasty retreat into the shadows of the salt-sheds.

nodes.title: A Weight of Forged Coin
nodes.brief: You forge a quick counterfeit rationing token to fool a vendor, risking arrest to secure extra Supplies for your journey.
nodes.page: The heated die bites cleanly into the soft alloy, leaving a crisp, flawless impression of the syndicate's rampant whale emblem stamped into the metal. You lift the token to the lantern-light, turning it over to admire the dull, authentic sheen that would fool any clerk from here to the cliffs.

nodes.title: The Stilt-City Scuffle
nodes.brief: You intercept a thief trying to steal a merchant's aqueduct map, risking a knife wound to claim the map yourself.
nodes.page:
A hooded figure slips between the salt-encrusted beams of the mezzanine, fingers clawing greedily at the brass cylinder strapped to a merchant's leather pack. You leap across the narrow gap of rotting timber, catching the thief's sleeve just as a rusted blade slices deep into your forearm with a hot, stinging hiss of salt-seared blood. You wrench the heavy brass tube free from their grip, tumbling hard onto the wooden slats while the mugger vanishes into the shadowed maze of ladders.

Clutching your bleeding arm, you uncap the battered metal casing on a wet barrel top, spreading out the stiff vellum sheets to reveal the inked layout of the Brineholder aqueducts and the hidden service flumes below.

exits.label: Slip into the lower maintenance tunnels

nodes.title: Intercepting the Courier
nodes.brief: You intercept a thief trying to steal a merchant's aqueduct map, risking a knife wound to claim the map yourself.
nodes.page: Steel flashes in the cramped corridor as you hurl your weight forward, aiming to pin the courier's knife-arm against the damp timber rail before he can find your ribs. He twists sideways with eel-like speed, driving his shoulder into your chest while his free hand slashes an erratic, blinding arc through the stagnant air. You catch his wrist mid-air, muscles straining against bone and leather as the dagger's point hovers inches from your throat, every ounce of your physical strength required to keep the blade from sinking home.

check.label: Wrestle the blade from his grip

nodes.title: A Costly Struggle
nodes.brief: You intercept a thief trying to steal a merchant's aqueduct map, risking a knife wound to claim the map yourself.
nodes.page: The courier proves too slick, wrenching his arm free and driving the pommel of his dagger hard into your collarbone with a sickening crack of bone and leather strain. You stumble backward against a sagging rain-barrel, gasping for breath as a hot line of blood spills down your shoulder, soaking your jacket in salt-stiffened fabric. The thief scrambles over the low wooden balustrade and drops toward the lower netting, leaving you clutching a torn scrap of the map and nursing a deep, throbbing ache in your chest.

exits.label: Follow the path toward the canopy

nodes.title: Blood-Earned Cartography
nodes.brief: You intercept a thief trying to steal a merchant's aqueduct map, risking a knife wound to claim the map yourself.
nodes.page:
Salt finds the raw gash across your forearm where the thief's blade bit deep, but the brass cylinder in your palm is reward enough for the pain. Inside the watertight casing lies an unrolled vellum sheet detailing every concealed drainage pipe and rusted pressure valve winding beneath the stilt-city's foundations. The merchant, too terrified of the Brineholder guards to raise an alarm, presses a small token of iron currency into your palm and scurries away into the fog.

You pocket the inked chart and the blood-stained token, knowing this hidden route bypasses the main gates entirely.

nodes.title: The Canvas Catch
nodes.brief: You mend a torn canvas rain-catcher dangling over the abyss, risking a deadly slip to earn a grateful water-baron's favour.
nodes.page:
High above the yawning emptiness of the seabed a massive expanse of tattered canvas flaps wildly against its iron moorings. It threatens to tear free and deprive a wealthy water-baron's terrace of precious condensation. You climb out onto the swaying wooden crossbeams. Wind hits hard. It roars up from the dry abyss like the breath of a buried leviathan, and securing the fluttering fabric needs sure hands and a cool head because the ropes groan and fray beneath your boots with every violent gust of salt air.

Below you a cluster of privileged water-merchants watch from a dry balcony, their faces masked against the alkaline dust. Mend this tear before the canvas gives way entirely and you earn the direct attention of the household master plus a vital opening into their guarded district.

nodes.title: Weaving the Rain-Catcher
nodes.brief: You mend a torn canvas rain-catcher dangling over the abyss, risking a deadly slip to earn a grateful water-baron's favour.
nodes.page: Hanging suspended over empty space, you thread a thick needle of bone through the wet duck-cloth and pull the hemp cord tight against the howling gale. Every stitch demands precise calculation as the frayed edges strain under the immense weight of trapped moisture, threatening to rip the entire quadrant free at once. Your fingers grow numb against the frozen metal of the eyelets, and a single clumsy knot will unravel the whole repair while the watching barons murmur impatiently from their dry ledge.

nodes.title: A Shredded Mend
nodes.brief: You mend a torn canvas rain-catcher dangling over the abyss, risking a deadly slip to earn a grateful water-baron's favour.
nodes.page: A sudden, vicious gale rips through the scaffolding just as you pull the final knot taut, snapping the heavy hemp line and sending a shower of coarse canvas shards fluttering down into the dark. The water-baron's overseer shouts an angry oath from the balcony, docking your expected standing and leaving your hands raw, bleeding, and stiff from the abrasive salt-twine. You scramble back to the safety of the wooden platform with bruised knuckles and a torn sleeve, having lost precious time to the unforgiving winds.

nodes.title: The Baron's Ledger
nodes.brief: You mend a torn canvas rain-catcher dangling over the abyss, risking a deadly slip to earn a grateful water-baron's favour.
nodes.page: Your quick fingers tie off the last reinforced seam just as the squall crests, leaving the massive rain-catcher taut, secure, and funneling precious trickles of clean water into the central cistern. The overseer nods in grudging approval, tossing a brass tally token onto the planks as a mark of the household's gratitude. This token grants you temporary passage through the guarded brass gates that bar the route toward the upper tiers and the missing lighthouse keeper.

nodes.title: The Chalk Trail
nodes.brief: You learn Orsolya Venn was seen being escorted by the Brineholder elite towards the upper canopy, leaving a trail of coded chalk marks.
nodes.page:
Moving cautiously past the guarded gates of the middle tier, you spot a faint, powdery smear of pale blue chalk upon a timber pillar, shaped into the distinct, jagged glyph of an old Gullmouth tide-mark. It is Orsolya's hand, unmistakable in its hurried angles, pointing straight up toward the gilded balconies where the Brineholder elite hold court. Inquiry among the net-menders confirms that a stern escort of armed enforcers marched an old woman with a brass-rimmed spyglass through these very arches only hours ago.

The trail leads deeper into the labyrinth of suspended walkways, away from the open air and into the echoing stone corridors of the high administration towers. Every sentinel you pass wears the silver whale emblem of the water-lords, their eyes sharp for interlopers from the cliff-town. If Orsolya was brought this way, she is being held within the inner sanctum where the mechanisms of Saltspire are controlled.

nodes.title: The Swaying Bridges
nodes.brief: The Swaying Bridges: A network of precarious rope bridges connects the middle tiers, battered by sudden, fierce salt winds.
nodes.page: A dizzying web of thick hemp ropes and salt-bleached cedar planks links the middle tiers across a sheer drop where the seabed lies thousands of feet below. Sudden, freezing salt gales howl through the gap, setting the entire causeway shuddering like a hooked shark on a line. Distant lantern light flickers through the gray haze, illuminating narrow crossings that offer several desperate routes deeper into the stilt-city's core. Every path is fraught with hazard, and every span requires absolute nerve to cross before the rising squall tears the moorings free.

exits.label: Weave fallen planks into a path

nodes.title: The Lash of Spray
nodes.brief: You sprint across a snapping bridge during a sudden squall, risking a plummet to reach an abandoned courier's satchel.
nodes.page: Gales tear through the stilt-work of Saltspire and whip salt spray off the empty seabed far below into a blinding white mist. Thick hemp ropes groan under your boots, twisting as the suspension bridge dances violently in the gale. A leather courier's satchel, dropped by a fleeing Brineholder runner, catches on a frayed spar halfway across the plunging span. Every gust threatens to tear your grip from the guide-wires, leaving you swaying above the abyss.

nodes.title: Slipping Cedar Planks
nodes.brief: You sprint across a snapping bridge during a sudden squall, risking a plummet to reach an abandoned courier's satchel.
nodes.page: Frost and dried brine coat the cedar planks, making each footfall a treacherous gamble over the gaping void. Below, the dark, bone-strewn floor of the Low stretches toward a distant, mocking horizon where the water ought to be. The satchel swings like a pendulum from a broken knuckle of timber, its brass buckle glinting dully in the gray gloom. The wind shrieks through the timber pylons, demanding you commit before the whole web tears loose.

exits.label: Scramble onward through the howling gale

nodes.title: Grasping the Wind-Torn Span
nodes.brief: You sprint across a snapping bridge during a sudden squall, risking a plummet to reach an abandoned courier's satchel.
nodes.page: Water lashes your face as you lunge across the tilting boards, fingers stretching out toward the swinging satchel while the bridge drops sickeningly beneath your weight. The cedar snaps with a wet crack behind you, leaving only a single frayed tether holding your footing to the tier. You must throw your full weight forward and trust your balance to span the remaining gap before the wind pitches you into the open air.

check.label: Catch the bag before the drop

nodes.title: Bruised Against the Timbers
nodes.brief: You sprint across a snapping bridge during a sudden squall, risking a plummet to reach an abandoned courier's satchel.
nodes.page: The bridge buckled violently, whipping upward and throwing you hard against a jagged timber cross-beam. A sharp, burning ache flares across your ribs, and your left hand drips with dark blood where a splinter bit deep. The satchel slipped from your desperate fingers, tumbling down into the gray shadows of the Low. You pull yourself gasping onto the swaying platform, clutching bruised bones as the storm continues to batter the metal and wood around you.

exits.label: Retreat back toward the middle tier

nodes.title: Seizing the Courier's Prize
nodes.brief: You sprint across a snapping bridge during a sudden squall, risking a plummet to reach an abandoned courier's satchel.
nodes.page: Your fingers closed around the wet leather strap just as the tether snapped, hauling the treasure hard against your chest as the bridge leveled out from its violent swing. Breathing hard against the salt-choked air, you worked the brass buckle free to reveal its contents hidden away from the prying eyes of the Brineholder guards. It is a prize hard-won from the gale, tucked safely into your coat as you steady your footing.

nodes.title: Weaving the Wreckage
nodes.brief: You try weaving fallen planks into a stable path across a gap, risking structural collapse to salvage a sturdy grappling hook.
nodes.page: Loose lengths of water-logged pine and split staves litter the scaffolding where a storage shed collapsed weeks ago. Down in the narrow cleft between two stilt-supported platforms, a heavy brass grappling hook with salt-caked barbs hangs snagged on a rusted iron bracket. Reaching it requires bridging the gap with whatever scraps you can scavenge from the debris pile before the whole makeshift structure gives way under your weight.

exits.label: Lash the timbers across the void

nodes.title: Testing the Jury-Rigged Span
nodes.brief: You try weaving fallen planks into a stable path across a gap, risking structural collapse to salvage a sturdy grappling hook.
nodes.page: You wedge a notched beam into a rusted joint, binding the slippery timbers with a length of salted twine salvaged from a discarded net. The improvised bridge sags alarmingly, groaning under the pressure of the salt wind sweeping in from the open seabed. The brass hook waits just beyond your fingertips, dangling over a sheer drop that plunges down to the bleached ribcage of an ancient whale hull far below.

exits.label: Creep out onto the makeshift beam

nodes.title: Balancing on Splintered Wood
nodes.brief: You try weaving fallen planks into a stable path across a gap, risking structural collapse to salvage a sturdy grappling hook.
nodes.page: Your hands steady the shifting timber path as a sudden gust catches your jacket, threatening to tip the whole precarious bridge into the empty air. The wood groans beneath your knees, fibers parting with a dry snap as you reach down toward the dangling iron prongs. A sure grip and absolute precision are what you need to lift the hook free without the anchor-beams shearing through completely.

check.label: Salvage the hook with steady hands

nodes.title: Collapsing Scaffold
nodes.brief: You try weaving fallen planks into a stable path across a gap, risking structural collapse to salvage a sturdy grappling hook.
nodes.page: The central beam splintered without warning, pitching you sideways into the rough timber lattice and scraping skin raw from your forearms. Dust and dry rot fill your eyes as the improvised bridge collapses entirely into the darkness below, leaving you hanging by one elbow from a sturdy cross-brace. You haul yourself upward with a grunt, spitting salt, while the prized hook tumbles down to vanish among the wreckage on the seabed.

nodes.title: Securing the Iron Flukes
nodes.brief: You try weaving fallen planks into a stable path across a gap, risking structural collapse to salvage a sturdy grappling hook.
nodes.page: Knotted twine held just long enough for your fingers to wedge under the iron shank and haul the tool free from its rusted prison. It is a solid piece of salvaged gear, its prongs scored with old salt-carvings from the Gullmouth shipwrights who forged it years ago. You sling the rope and iron over your shoulder, and the familiar wrecking tools settle hard against your ribs.

nodes.title: The Fraying Hawser
nodes.brief: You physically hold a tearing rope steady for a panicked citizen, risking torn muscles to receive a vital Brineholder password.
nodes.page:
Hemp fibres shriek against iron stanchions as a cargo net swings wild over the abyss between Saltspire's leaning piers. A merchant clerk, pinned by his own panic, clings to a snapping guideline while the wind tears at his fine wool coat. Below lies the empty grey floor of the Low, far enough down that a falling body would be nothing more than a wet splash against salt. You lurch forward across the shivering planks, boots skidding on encrusted rime, and slam your shoulder against the post just as the hemp begins to unravel into thin white hairs.

You dig into the greasy strands and twist the damp rope around your forearm for a friction brake. The dangling hoist pulls hard. Your palms go numb. Let go now and the cargo and the clerk go over together.

nodes.title: Weight of the Stranded
nodes.brief: You physically hold a tearing rope steady for a panicked citizen, risking torn muscles to receive a vital Brineholder password.
nodes.page:
Sweat stings your eyes, mixing with the crust of old salt caked on your eyebrows while the straining rope burns a black line through the leather of your sleeve. The clerk scrambles backward onto the safety of the slatted walkway, gasping like a landed cod and clutching a ledger to his chest with white knuckles. He looks up at you with wild, grateful terror in his rheumy eyes, knowing as well as you do that Gullmouth wreckers do not haul strangers out of the air for charity.

Trembling, he fumbles in his waistcoat pocket and presses a damp scrap of parchment into your palm, whispering a sequence of coded numbers that grant entry through the lower customs gates. The wind howls through the stilt-timbers, drowning his voice, but the sequence remains clear in your head. He ducks away into the shadow of a brine-vat house, leaving you alone on the vibrating timber.

nodes.title: Strain of the Fiber
nodes.brief: You physically hold a tearing rope steady for a panicked citizen, risking torn muscles to receive a vital Brineholder password.
nodes.page: The hemp groans, parting strand by strand under an intolerable load while the wind hammers your ribs against the scaffolding. Your boots slide half an inch toward the open drop, and the iron ring securing the line screeches in its wooden socket, threatening to rip free entirely. You throw your entire weight backward, locking your elbows and setting your boots hard into the grain of the wet timber, forcing every ounce of muscle to fight the howling void below.

nodes.title: Torn Tendons and Salt
nodes.brief: You physically hold a tearing rope steady for a panicked citizen, risking torn muscles to receive a vital Brineholder password.
nodes.page: The rope snaps with the crack of a dry branch and whips back across your forearm. A hot welt opens. You stumble hard against the railing, and the breath leaves your lungs as the load crashes into the empty air below with a hollow distant thud. Your muscles burn; a sullen ache settles into your joints like winter damp. The clerk vanishes into the grey mist before you can demand your due. Bruised, you nurse a smarting arm on the swaying boards.

nodes.title: A Merchant Secret
nodes.brief: You physically hold a tearing rope steady for a panicked citizen, risking torn muscles to receive a vital Brineholder password.
nodes.page: The hemp holds, however narrowly, its frayed threads screaming under the strain until the trapped load settles safely onto the timber platform with a heavy, vibrating thud. The merchant clerk presses a wet scrap of parchment into your hand, whispering a sequence of coded numbers that grant entry through the lower customs gates before he scuttles away into the shadows. Your muscles throb with a dull ache from the effort, but your grip remains firm around the ink-stained paper.

nodes.title: Chalk on the Timbers
nodes.brief: You decipher Orsolya's faded chalk marks through the swirling dust, risking lost time to find a hidden cache of Vigor-restoring herbs.
nodes.page:
Gray dust coats the underside of the leaning walkways and settles into the grain of old pilings where the sun never reaches. Orsolya's unmistakable hand lingers here, scratched into the salt-crusted timber with a piece of dry tallow-chalk that resists the damp breeze. Arrows and cryptic cross-hatching form a ragged trail. They point away from the busy trade-platforms and toward the dark, forgotten storage alcoves beneath the water-tanks.

Along the faint white lines you pass dripping pipes and rusted chains and keep low to dodge Brineholder patrols. Bilge and old lime coat the tongue. Grey residue of the vanished sea covers every board underfoot.

nodes.title: Reading the Gray Dust
nodes.brief: You decipher Orsolya's faded chalk marks through the swirling dust, risking lost time to find a hidden cache of Vigor-restoring herbs.
nodes.page: The marks grow fainter where the wind eddies around a corner, turning into mere smudges against the damp, salt-rotted grain of the stilt-posts. You squint through the gloom, trying to separate Orsolya's deliberate strokes from random splashes of dried foam and bird droppings. Time slips away as you trace the ambiguous angles with a gloved finger, needing to guess which way the old lighthouse keeper turned before her trail vanished into the shadows altogether.

nodes.title: Lost in the Stilt-Mazes
nodes.brief: You decipher Orsolya's faded chalk marks through the swirling dust, risking lost time to find a hidden cache of Vigor-restoring herbs.
nodes.page: Dust shifts under your boot. A dead-end alcove holds discarded nets and rusted crab-pots. Pale light fades from the gaps in the planking. Precious minutes gone on a false trail some net-mender chalked for no reason. Your legs ache from the climb and the cold of the upper air. No hidden cache waits here. Distant waves knock once against the stilts and fall quiet. You turn back toward the main thoroughfare, poorer in time and breath.

nodes.title: The Chalk Cache
nodes.brief: You decipher Orsolya's faded chalk marks through the swirling dust, risking lost time to find a hidden cache of Vigor-restoring herbs.
nodes.page:
Dust hangs between the salt-encrusted beams and gets in your eyes as you trace Orsolya's hurried strokes with a grease-stained thumb. Each faded chalk mark cuts through the labyrinth of rotting timber toward a dry pocket sheltered from the wind's salt. Beneath a loose plank bound in hempen twine you find a small oilcloth pouch. Inside lie dried stalks of bitter-root and blue-veined lungwort that smell of damp earth and old cellars, for chewing when the lungs burn and the limbs give out.

With the bitter bundles in your coat pocket, the narrow gangway ahead opens toward the swaying rope bridges of the middle tiers.

nodes.title: The Iron Barricade
nodes.brief: A patrol of heavily armed Brineholder enforcers blocks the main thoroughfare, conducting brutal searches for suspected Drift Pilgrim sympathisers.
nodes.page: Heavy iron pikes gleam in the pale light as a squad of Brineholder enforcers seals the intersection with a spiked barrier, their polished breastplates reflecting no warmth at all. They drag a trembling Drift Pilgrim from the line, demanding papers, tithes, and names of those who whisper against the water-monopoly. The crowd parts in a wide, silent circle, too terrified to meet the enforcers' gaze or offer a hand of help. To reach the lower levels and the path toward the Stair, you must pass directly through their checkpoint.

nodes.title: The Vent Shafts
nodes.brief: The Vent Shafts: Dark, narrow steam vents offer a perilous alternative route upward, echoing with the moans of trapped gulls.
nodes.page: Narrow iron tubes snake upward into the gloom like the entrails of a colossal beast, hissing with pressurized heat and carrying the thin, frantic cries of gulls trapped in the metal labyrinth. Every seam weeps rusty condensation that scalds your skin, and the air tastes thick of copper and old grease. You stand at a critical junction where choices divide into steam-choked darkness.

exits.label: Squeeze through the dangerously narrow boiling pipe
Follow the changing air currents through intersecting vents
Dismantle the rusted grating for a makeshift shield
Ascend toward the glittering glass-domed water reservoirs

nodes.title: Boiling Flue
nodes.brief: You squeeze through a dangerously narrow, boiling pipe, risking severe burns to emerge near a forgotten armoury stash.
nodes.page: Heat radiates from the metal walls, baking the air in your lungs until every breath tastes of copper and rust. You hitch your weight onto a narrow bracket, inching forward as the steam thickens around your collar and sweat runs in stinging channels down your forehead. Far below, the muffled clank of Brineholder patrols echoes against the bulkheads, a reminder of the price of a slip.

nodes.title: The Seam of Steam
nodes.brief: You squeeze through a dangerously narrow, boiling pipe, risking severe burns to emerge near a forgotten armoury stash.
nodes.page: Condensation drips in greasy beads from the overhead rivets, soaking through your woollen collar as you squeeze sideways through a junction box choked with old soot. The metal groans under your boots, vibrating with the pulse of distant pumps that feed the stilt-city's endless thirst. You catch the faint smell of old grease and cold iron ahead, breaking the monotony of the scalding dark.

nodes.title: Scalding Passage
nodes.brief: You squeeze through a dangerously narrow, boiling pipe, risking severe burns to emerge near a forgotten armoury stash.
nodes.page: The pipe narrows until your shoulders scrape the blistering iron, and a sudden roar of superheated steam fills the flue with a blinding white fog. Your skin prickles with immediate blisters as the heat forces you to choose between backing down into certain capture or driving forward through the scorching white-out. You brace your palms against the white-hot metal, gathering every ounce of resolve to push through the choking haze before your lungs give out.

nodes.title: Seared Flesh
nodes.brief: You squeeze through a dangerously narrow, boiling pipe, risking severe burns to emerge near a forgotten armoury stash.
nodes.page: Steam bites deep into your forearms, leaving angry, weeping welts that throb with every pulse of your racing heart as you tumble headlong out of the pipe and onto a cold iron grating. You lie coughing in the gloom, clutching your burned skin while the metallic taste of panic slowly fades from your mouth. The pain is a sharp, nagging companion, but you have left the worst of the heat behind in the dark flues.

nodes.title: The Armoured Niche
nodes.brief: You squeeze through a dangerously narrow, boiling pipe, risking severe burns to emerge near a forgotten armoury stash.
nodes.page: You spill out of the restrictive pipework and tumble onto a bed of discarded sacking, coughing as the cooler air hits your lungs. In the shadows of an abandoned maintenance bay a forgotten cache of gear waits, left by some long-dead stilt-guard and untouched by salt or damp. You snatch up the prize before the metal settles around you.

nodes.title: The Whispering Drafts
nodes.brief: You navigate the intersecting vents by listening to the changing air currents, risking getting hopelessly lost to find a smuggler's map.
nodes.page: Murmurs of escaping air thread through the junction boxes, shifting in pitch as distant valves turn and seal within the stilt-city's vast plumbing. You press your ear against a cold rivet, trying to map the complex maze of flues by the subtle whistle of the drafts. Every passage looks identical in the dim, yellow gloom, promising either an exit or a slow death in the iron bowels of the settlement.

nodes.title: Labyrinth of Vents
nodes.brief: You navigate the intersecting vents by listening to the changing air currents, risking getting hopelessly lost to find a smuggler's map.
nodes.page: Intersecting pipes branch off into darkness like the veins of a drowned leviathan, and the sound of your own breathing threatens to drown out the faint, whistling currents you rely on. You pause at a four-way junction where the air smells faintly of old parchment and salt, trying to recall the jagged lines of the stolen route Orsolya left behind. A wrong turn here means getting swallowed by the endless maze of the stilt-city.

nodes.title: Tangled Corridors
nodes.brief: You navigate the intersecting vents by listening to the changing air currents, risking getting hopelessly lost to find a smuggler's map.
nodes.page: The drafts lie. A twisting loop of iron flues dumps you back at the start, cold and turned around. Time burns off in the metallic quiet; your muscles lock up and your rations taste of stale dust. You rub your temples and listen for the city above, then pick a flue and try again.

nodes.title: The Smuggler's Mark
nodes.brief: You navigate the intersecting vents by listening to the changing air currents, risking getting hopelessly lost to find a smuggler's map.
nodes.page: You decode the rhythmic hiss of the flues with sudden clarity, picking out the distinct whistle that marks an unsealed service hatch in the plating above. Slipping through the narrow gap, your fingers brush against a folded scrap of oiled sheepskin wedged behind a water pipe, marked with precise ink strokes that map the Brineholder patrol routes. It is a dangerous prize, but it turns the dark maze into a weapon in your hands.

nodes.title: Iron Shield
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted vent grating to create a makeshift shield, risking a noise that attracts guards to gain vital protection.
nodes.page:
Iron flakes shower onto the salt-crusted floor as you wrench the corroded grating from its mounting frame. Metal screeches against the stilt-beams. A patrolling guard unit around the corner answers at once. You seize the jagged-edged plate and hoist the grid before your chest just as the first boot-steps turn the blind corner.

Long shadows cross the vertical thoroughfare. Damp air tastes of ozone and old sweat. Ahead the guard hunts for the shriek while you press into the gloom.

nodes.title: Forced Entry
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted vent grating to create a makeshift shield, risking a noise that attracts guards to gain vital protection.
nodes.page: Rusted bolts scream in protest as you apply calculated pressure with your knuckles and palms, coaxing the stubborn iron framework apart without triggering a collapse. Heavy footfalls echo from the upper catwalks, drawing dangerously close as the patrol swings their lanterns across the damp stilt-beams. You wedge your fingers into the widening gap, muscles trembling under the sudden strain of the rusted barrier.

nodes.title: Strained Defenses
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted vent grating to create a makeshift shield, risking a noise that attracts guards to gain vital protection.
nodes.page: Brittle iron gives way with a vicious snap, biting deep into your palm and sending a hot flare of pain shooting up your forearm. The sudden slip throws you off balance against a sharp rivet, tearing a ragged gash across your shoulder that stains your salt-cased jacket dark. Heavy boots stamp on the grating above, shouting orders into the damp shadows, but you manage to scramble sideways into a narrow drainage chute before the lanterns sweep your way.

nodes.title: Shielding Metal
nodes.brief: You dismantle a rusted vent grating to create a makeshift shield, risking a noise that attracts guards to gain vital protection.
nodes.page: Fingers locked tight around the jagged crossbar, you manage to tear the heavy grating free from its mounting just as a patrol lantern sweeps the corridor. The thick iron plate absorbs a glancing blow from a Brineholder halberd with a dull, echoing thud that leaves your teeth aching. Breathing hard in the stagnant air, you shoulder the improvised barrier and slip into the shadows.

nodes.title: Dome of Glass
nodes.brief: Emerging near the upper canopy, you behold the magnificent, glass-domed water reservoirs of the Brineholders, glittering under the harsh sun.
nodes.page: Emerging near the upper canopy through a service hatch, you behold the magnificent, glass-domed water reservoirs of the Brineholders glittering under the harsh sun. Vast oceans of crystal-clear water are held aloft in ribs of wrought iron and sealed glass, casting shifting blue refractions across the towering walkways. Armed sentries in polished brass breastplates pace the perimeters, guarding the pristine liquid against the desperate thirst of the seabed below. Every surface gleams with wealth and strict order, contrasting sharply with the salt-crusted ruin of Gullmouth. You linger in the shadows of a massive support pillar, mapping the patrols and plotting your path toward the Sunken Stair.

nodes.title: Cistern Walk
nodes.brief: The Cistern Walk: A grand, patrolled promenade wrapping around the immense glass water tanks, offering incredible views and terrible danger.
nodes.page: The Cistern Walk stretches as a grand, patrolled promenade wrapping around the immense glass water tanks, offering incredible views and terrible danger. Sunlight reflects blindingly off the vast liquid domes, where Brineholder wardens march in rhythmic unison and merchants haggle over sealed water skins. Every archway offers a tempting route deeper into the stilt-city's administrative heart, though a single misstep could plunge you into the dry abyss below.

nodes.title: Ornamental Gleam
nodes.brief: You try to pry a loose ornamental gem from the cistern framework, risking a crushing fall to acquire a valuable trade stone.
nodes.page: Sunlight catches a dull gold glint embedded in the ornate filigree surrounding the massive water cistern's base. The gemstone ornament looks loose enough to pry free if you press and twist, a rich prize for any wrecker bold enough to reach for it. Below your boots, the drop is sheer and unforgiving, plunging straight down through the iron stilt-work toward the distant seabed.

nodes.title: High Risk Reach
nodes.brief: You try to pry a loose ornamental gem from the cistern framework, risking a crushing fall to acquire a valuable trade stone.
nodes.page: Wind howls through the structural struts, carrying the smell of salt and cold iron from the open Low far below. You stretch one boot outward onto a narrow maintenance bracket, fingers brushing against the cold, encrusted stone of the decorative bezel. The whole framework groans under the sudden shift in weight, warning you of the perilous drop waiting beneath your heels.

nodes.title: Weight on the Bezel
nodes.brief: You try to pry a loose ornamental gem from the cistern framework, risking a crushing fall to acquire a valuable trade stone.
nodes.page: Muscles coil like rusted springs as you plant your boots firmly against the slick iron strut and lean your entire weight into the decorative bezel. The ornamental stone holds fast for a breathless heartbeat, resisting your pull with stubborn ancient mortar. You brace your shoulders and heave upward with all your strength, straining against the dizzying drop beneath you.

nodes.title: Dangerous Slip
nodes.brief: You try to pry a loose ornamental gem from the cistern framework, risking a crushing fall to acquire a valuable trade stone.
nodes.page: The stubborn stone gives way with terrifying suddenness, throwing you backward against the sharp edge of the iron bracket and bruising your ribs. You manage to snag your fingers into a drainage loop, but the precious gemstone tumbles out of reach into the empty air below. Pain flares through your side as you haul yourself back onto the narrow walkway, breathless and empty-handed.

nodes.title: Prize Secured
nodes.brief: You try to pry a loose ornamental gem from the cistern framework, risking a crushing fall to acquire a valuable trade stone.
nodes.page: Old mortar shrieks as the ornamental gem pops free into your grip, and your footing starts to slide at the same moment. You catch your balance against the cistern wall, clutching the cold, multi-faceted trade stone tightly in your palm. Flawless salt-crystal stained amber with age, it is worth a small fortune among the merchants of the stilt-city.

nodes.title: Whispers Beneath Saltspire
nodes.brief: You eavesdrop on two elite guards discussing the Sunken Stair, risking discovery to learn the precise schedule of the patrols.
nodes.page: Salt-crusted timber groans overhead as the ocean-wind rattles through the stilt-city's suspended walkways, carrying the sharp scent of ozone and dried kelp. Two Brineholder guards in lacquered blue breastplates lean against a corroded bronze railing, their low murmurs cutting through the hollow roar of the distant seabed. They speak of rotation shifts at the Sunken Stair, mapping out when the heavy iron gates are left unbolted for supply hoists. Every word they drop is a sharp-edged stone you tuck into your memory, each detail of their patrol timing offering a safer passage down into the dark.

nodes.title: Shadows on the Walkway
nodes.brief: You eavesdrop on two elite guards discussing the Sunken Stair, risking discovery to learn the precise schedule of the patrols.
nodes.page: Below the raised wooden planking, the grey expanse of the Low stretches toward the horizon like an unscribed slate, framed by the skeletal ribs of stranded schooners. The elite watchmen continue their measured pacing, their heavy greaves clanking rhythmically against the salt-bleached joists. You cling to the shadowed underside of the crossing, letting their conversation about the lower iron stairwell wash over your ears. The exact minutes they pause to check their copper pocket-watches are yours to keep, unlocking the rhythm of the garrison's guard rotation.

nodes.title: Listening Through the Brine
nodes.brief: You eavesdrop on two elite guards discussing the Sunken Stair, risking discovery to learn the precise schedule of the patrols.
nodes.page: Condensation drips from the iron conduits above, splashing cold against your neck as you press your shoulder harder into the damp timber wall. The guards shift their weight, their conversation turning toward the precise timing of the change of guard at the lower security threshold. A sudden gust of salt-laden wind howls through the structural struts and nearly drowns out their words about the password and the patrol routes. You strain every sense, calculating the gaps in their speech and trying to catch the hidden schedule before their boots turn back toward your hiding spot.

nodes.title: Caught in the Draft
nodes.brief: You eavesdrop on two elite guards discussing the Sunken Stair, risking discovery to learn the precise schedule of the patrols.
nodes.page: A sudden shift in the sea-breeze eddies around the stilt supports and blows a flurry of loose salt straight into your eyes, blinding you for a second. Your boot slips on the greasy green slime coating the timber joist, sending a sharp thud echoing through the hollow framework. The guards whirl around with drawn cutlasses, forcing you to scramble backward into a narrow storage alcove among stacked brine barrels. You escape their sweeping lanterns by squeezing into the darkest cranny, but the frantic scramble leaves a deep, stinging scrape across your forearm and costs you precious minutes in the damp gloom.

nodes.title: Secrets of the Guard
nodes.brief: You eavesdrop on two elite guards discussing the Sunken Stair, risking discovery to learn the precise schedule of the patrols.
nodes.page: Silence holds as the guards' footsteps fade down the branching walkway; brine drips against the iron pilings, one drop after another. You let out a slow, measured breath, clutching the valuable fragments of conversation you managed to extract from their talk. The precise layout of the lower checkpoint and the shifting hours of the watchmen are now clear in your mind, providing an invaluable edge for the descent. The knowledge you carry is a sharp weapon against the Brineholder patrols.

nodes.title: The Watchman's Turning
nodes.brief: You distract a pacing watchman with a thrown piece of debris, risking an alarm to slip inside a secure archivist office.
nodes.page: Iron lanterns swing in the salty updraft and throw fractured light across the high walkways of Saltspire. A solitary watchman paces his beat with mechanical regularity, his boots clicking against the riveted plating just ten paces from the restricted archivist doors. You pry a loose rusted rivet from the timber decking. Cold iron sits in your palm. A sharp flick of the wrist sends the scrap into a distant empty bucket. Metal clatters on metal. The guard leaves his post at once and goes after the noise.

nodes.title: Distracting the Sentinel
nodes.brief: You distract a pacing watchman with a thrown piece of debris, risking an alarm to slip inside a secure archivist office.
nodes.page: The sentinel barks an oath into the damp air, his lantern sweeping rapidly toward the far corner where the metal scrap clattered against the iron pail. He stomps away along the elevated gangway to investigate the sudden noise, his back turned entirely to the recessed doorway of the archivist quarters. The narrow gap between the heavy oak panels beckons like an open mouth in the salt-whitened wall. You step out from the shadows of the rigging, moving with silent haste to bridge the distance before the watchman realizes he has chased a phantom.

nodes.title: Timing the Distraction
nodes.brief: You distract a pacing watchman with a thrown piece of debris, risking an alarm to slip inside a secure archivist office.
nodes.page: The hollow clatter of the thrown rivet echoes off the corrugated tin walls, drawing an angry shout from the pacing sentinel as he pivots toward the sound. You crouch low behind a stack of curing nets, waiting for his heavy, copper-shod boots to carry him far enough down the wooden run. Every second counts as you measure the distance to the reinforced archivist threshold against the speed of his furious inspection. Your fingers trace the cold iron latch of the restricted door, calculating the exact moment to slip inside before he wheels around to check his rear.

nodes.title: Echoes in the Iron
nodes.brief: You distract a pacing watchman with a thrown piece of debris, risking an alarm to slip inside a secure archivist office.
nodes.page: The metal rivet hits the tin pail with a hollow clang, but the watchman's reflexes are sharper than anticipated, and he wheels around before you can make your move. A stray length of anchor chain catches your shoulder as you lunge for the doorway, tearing your jacket and leaving a deep, throbbing bruise across your collarbone. You manage to slip into the shadowed recess just as his lantern beam sweeps the threshold, but the clumsy rush costs you precious time and leaves your nerves frayed.

nodes.title: Through the Narrow Gap
nodes.brief: You distract a pacing watchman with a thrown piece of debris, risking an alarm to slip inside a secure archivist office.
nodes.page: The heavy oak door gives way with a muted creak as you throw your weight against it, slipping past the threshold just as the sentinel's boots return to the corridor outside. You press your back against the cool stone wall of the interior archive and listen as the thud of his patrol fades into the distance. With the diversion still running, the inner sanctum is yours to explore. A leather folio bearing the seal of the high magistrates rests on a mahogany side table within arm's reach.

nodes.title: Across the Glass Ledge
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a thin glass ledge above the reservoir, risking a terrifying plunge to recover a drowned worker's toolbelt.
nodes.page: Frost-slicked windowpanes offer a narrow footing suspended high above the echoing darkness of the primary water reservoir. Below, the dark liquid laps silently against iron pillars while far overhead salt-crusted girders groan in the cold draught. A discarded leather toolbelt hangs precariously from a protruding rivet on the opposite pier, swaying gently with every gust that whistles through the stilt-city struts. Balance requires absolute focus as boots find only inches of smooth, condensation-filmed plate glass.

exits.label: Step across to the dangling leather

nodes.title: Glass Above The Sump
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a thin glass ledge above the reservoir, risking a terrifying plunge to recover a drowned worker's toolbelt.
nodes.page: Salt-crusted brine laps against the vertical walls of the reservoir far below, a grey eye staring upward through forty feet of dead air. The suspended walkway consists of thick panes bolted directly into iron ribs, their upper surfaces pitted white from decades of chemical condensation. A drowned worker's heavy leather toolbelt hangs snagged upon an external bracing strut, just beyond a rusted railing missing three vertical bars. You ease your boots onto the translucent glass, feeling the cold surface bow slightly under your weight while the distant drip of moisture echoes endlessly in the hollow shaft.

nodes.title: Slip on the Pane
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a thin glass ledge above the reservoir, risking a terrifying plunge to recover a drowned worker's toolbelt.
nodes.page: A sudden tremor in the stilt-work sends the boots skidding across the condensation-slicked glass before purchase can be found. Arms windmill wildly against the void, catching hard against a rusted iron bracket that leaves a deep, stinging purple bruise across the forearm. The belt slides off the far rivet and drops silently into the deep water below. Only bruised ribs and a bitter taste of rust remain in the mouth. Shivering and breathless, the foothold is finally secured on the far platform.

nodes.title: The Glass Ledge
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a thin glass ledge above the reservoir, risking a terrifying plunge to recover a drowned worker's toolbelt.
nodes.page: Your boots slide with a sickening screech against the curved pane, suspended high above the echoing vault of the reservoir. Down in the dark, black water laps against lead walls, waiting for anyone foolish enough to lose their footing. Every breath is a struggle against the damp chill rising from the depths, yet your trembling fingers finally close around the heavy leather straps of the drowned worker's toolbelt. Hauling it up onto solid stone, you secure a grease-stained brass wedge - a simple keepsake that might just jam a lock when the time is right.

exits.label: Slip back into the dusty annex

nodes.title: The Governors Ink
nodes.brief: Inside the archives, you discover documents proving the Brineholders know the Meridian Gear is jammed and intend to destroy it.
nodes.page: Heavy iron-bound ledgers lie scattered across the mahogany table of the inner chamber, bearing the neat, ruthless script of the Brineholder magistracy. Parchment maps pinned to the cedar walls reveal that the great pumping engine at the foot of the Sunken Stair has not merely jammed by accident, but has been deliberately welded shut by royal decree. The water barons intend to shatter the mechanism entirely, locking the seabed dry forever while they control the last stagnant cisterns above. Every page confirms that Gullmouth is meant to die of thirst while these high platforms hoard the remnant tide. A single iron-keyed corridor leads deeper into the stilt-city core past the patrols.

nodes.title: The Dusty Annex
nodes.brief: The Dusty Annex: A neglected library of damp, rotting charts and tidal records, guarded by intricate mechanical locks.
nodes.page: Rotting charts and damp tidal logs carpet the floor of this forgotten alcove, where the air tastes of old paper and stagnant bilge. Intricate brass-faced locks hum faintly from every cabinet, guarding secrets that the water barons would rather leave to mould in the dark. Narrow grates in the floor vent the chill draught of the empty seabed far below, carrying the distant, hollow moans of the stilt-city struts. Every shadow seems to hold a watcher, and every surface invites a desperate pry or a stolen glance.

nodes.title: The Crumbling Ledger
nodes.brief: You speed-read through a decaying ledger before it crumbles, risking toxic mold exposure to glean the secret combination to the vault.
nodes.page: Brittle pages flake away into grey dust at the lightest touch, bearing centuries of high-tide calculations and water-tax tallies. Eyes strain across fading iron-gall ink to trace the sequence of emergency overrides once used by the original Tidewardens. Acrid mould spores rise from the binding like yellow smoke, catching in the throat and setting off a silent, burning cough that threatens to draw the sentinels from the corridor. Only a few lines remain legible before the binding entirely disintegrates into the floor grates.

nodes.title: The Cipher in Ash
nodes.brief: You speed-read through a decaying ledger before it crumbles, risking toxic mold exposure to glean the secret combination to the vault.
nodes.page:
Black spores cling to your eyelashes as you hunch over the rotting spine of the ledger, fingers burning from the salt-acid that eats the paper. Each breath pulls more rot into your lungs. A cough would bring the Brineholder guards outside the alcove. Yet the faded ink of the final water-tax tally still shows the repeating numerical sequence of the vault tumbler, half-erased by damp. You brace your shaking hands on the wooden desk and squint through streaming tears. You catch the last digit. The remaining text dissolves into grey sludge.

Your lungs lock. The parchment crumbles to ash under your fingertips as you throw yourself against the hidden latch to test the sequence.

nodes.title: Choked on the Dust
nodes.brief: You speed-read through a decaying ledger before it crumbles, risking toxic mold exposure to glean the secret combination to the vault.
nodes.page: A thick cloud of black spores bursts from the spine of the ancient ledger, catching the throat in a sudden, violent spasm. Coughing tears at the chest wall, leaving a metallic taste of blood and rotten linen on the tongue while the eyes stream with blinding tears. Footsteps halt in the outer passage at the sudden noise, forcing a frantic scramble into the shadows behind a stack of empty water casks. The secret numbers are lost to the dust, and the lungs will ache with every breath for hours to come.

nodes.title: The Vault Combination
nodes.brief: You speed-read through a decaying ledger before it crumbles, risking toxic mold exposure to glean the secret combination to the vault.
nodes.page:
Your fingertips trace the fading ash-grey digits pressed into the final intact margin before the parchment dissolves in your damp palm. You cough against the black spores on your tongue and fix the sequence of turns the iron tumblers demand. Amid the rot and the bitter taste of salt-acid, you hold the cipher that opens the Brineholder vaults.

It is a copper tally-token stamped with the seal of the high water-tax office, solid enough to crack a tooth and recognized by every gate-warden on the stilts.

exits.label: Slip away before the guards return

nodes.title: The Locked Cabinet
nodes.brief: You carefully pick the brass lock of a restricted tidal cabinet, risking a triggered poison needle to claim an ancient brass compass.
nodes.page:
The iron latch of the wall-mounted container is caked in salt, sealing its secrets against the damp air of Saltspire. Inside rests an instrument crafted when the oceans still obeyed human clocks, its polished rim catching the faint greenish luminescence leaking through the floorboards. Your wire pick scrapes against stubborn tumblers while the timber beneath your boots groans under a sudden gust from the empty seabed below.

Another fraction of a millimeter, and you ease the tiny tension tool, listening for the soft click that will release the brass door before any hidden trap can spring.

nodes.title: The Restricted Alveolar
nodes.brief: You carefully pick the brass lock of a restricted tidal cabinet, risking a triggered poison needle to claim an ancient brass compass.
nodes.page:
Under the overhang of a stilt-supported walkway, an alcove keeps treasures the fleeing Brineholders abandoned. The cabinet door hangs ajar on green-corroded hinges. Velvet-lined slots inside once cradled delicate navigational tools. Near the hinge a tiny concealed tube lets out a thin hiss of gas. Saltspire cuts hard at anyone who opens the wrong latch.

You reach into the velvet recess and take the brass body of the old compass before the air turns foul.

nodes.title: Testing the Brass Tumblers
nodes.brief: You carefully pick the brass lock of a restricted tidal cabinet, risking a triggered poison needle to claim an ancient brass compass.
nodes.page:
Your fingers trace the intricate channel of the brass faceplate, searching for the hidden pressure release that guards the central mechanism. One false shift of the wire could trip the poison spring deep in the damp timber casing and spray venom across your knuckles before you can jerk your hand away. Sweat runs into your eyes in the salt-fouled air as you apply the final, delicate pressure to the stubborn bronze tumbler.

You hold your breath, waiting for the internal click to confirm whether your touch has bypassed the trap or awakened it.

nodes.title: The Price of a Slip
nodes.brief: You carefully pick the brass lock of a restricted tidal cabinet, risking a triggered poison needle to claim an ancient brass compass.
nodes.page:
A sharp snap echoes in the cramped alcove as the hidden needle strikes home, piercing your thumb with a sudden, burning agony that races up your arm. You jerk your hand back with a curse, knocking a stack of damp logbooks onto the dusty floorboards while poison pulses through your veins. The wound leaves a dark, mottled scar across your flesh and drains your breath, yet you refuse to let the pain stop your retreat.

Sucking the dark blood from your throbbing thumb, you snatch the brass compass from its velvet bed and stumble away into the shadows of the stilt-city.

nodes.title: The Navigator's Prize
nodes.brief: You carefully pick the brass lock of a restricted tidal cabinet, risking a triggered poison needle to claim an ancient brass compass.
nodes.page:
Your fingers find the exact balance of the internal mechanism, coaxing the stubborn brass tumblers aside without disturbing the venomous barb tucked behind the faceplate. The heavy door swings open with a soft, oiled sigh, offering up its prize to the dim light filtering through the floor planks. The ancient instrument rests in your palm at last, its needle spinning wildly toward the dry abyss.

You pocket the relic and turn your back on the ruined cabinet, carrying your new prize toward the dusty annex.

nodes.title: Shards of Clear Glass
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift magnifying lens from broken spectacles, risking eye strain to decipher a microscopic map of the Sunken Stair.
nodes.page:
Splintered frames from an old pair of spectacles lie scattered across a mahogany desk, their curved lenses caked in decades of white salt-crust. You gather the least scratched fragment, polishing its cloudy surface against your sleeve until it catches the dim yellowish glow of a hanging tallow lamp. Through this makeshift magnifier, a discarded parchment scroll transforms from a blur of grey ink into a terrifyingly detailed labyrinth of lines and numbers.

You press the glass closer to your eye, squinting to trace the microscopic stairwells and landing markers that denote the path down to the Sunken Stair.

nodes.title: The Microscopic Cartography
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift magnifying lens from broken spectacles, risking eye strain to decipher a microscopic map of the Sunken Stair.
nodes.page:
Tiny, hair-thin pen strokes map out every rusted bolt and spiral stone of the great descent beneath the ocean floor. Each marking reveals a hazard left behind by the old Tidewardens, from rusted counterweights to vertical drops where the sea used to roar. Your eyes water from the strain of bracing the glass in the drafty, salt-fouled chamber.

You shift your footing on the creaking floorboards, leaning closer over the parchment to decipher the final notation near the foot of the abyss.

nodes.title: Straining Over the Parchment
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift magnifying lens from broken spectacles, risking eye strain to decipher a microscopic map of the Sunken Stair.
nodes.page:
The tiny ink marks blur together into an unreadable smear as your tired eyes rebel against the flickering lamplight and the magnifying glass's distorted edges. One more minute of intense scrutiny might reveal the secret bypass around the locked maintenance gates, or it might leave your vision swimming in darkness for hours. You press the curved glass harder against your brow, fighting the burning fatigue behind your eyelids as you scan the perilous drop.

You steady your trembling hand, waiting to see if your strained vision holds long enough to reveal the secret path.

nodes.title: Blurred Lines and Headaches
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift magnifying lens from broken spectacles, risking eye strain to decipher a microscopic map of the Sunken Stair.
nodes.page:
A blinding ache stabs behind your temples, forcing you to drop the makeshift lens onto the desk as darkness swims across your vision. The extreme eye strain leaves you rubbing your temples with trembling fingers while precious minutes tick away in the drafty alcove. Though your head throbs with every beat of your pulse, the general layout of the descent remains burned into your memory, imperfect yet sufficient.

You gather your breath in the damp air, blinking against the lingering blur before turning away from the desk.

exits.label: Leave the desk with aching eyes

nodes.title: Secrets of the Descent
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift magnifying lens from broken spectacles, risking eye strain to decipher a microscopic map of the Sunken Stair.
nodes.page:
The cracked lens holds firm against your thumb, focusing the dim lamplight into a sharp beam that lays bare the hidden architectural secrets of the abyss. The map yields its deepest mystery, showing you a forgotten maintenance hatch that bypasses the guarded upper gates of the Stair. You fold the fragile parchment with practiced care and tuck the knowledge inside your coat.

You pocket the secret route and retrace your steps toward the dusty annex.
nodes.grant: secret map of the Sunken Stair

nodes.title: Iron Against Bone
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted iron bookcase that has sealed shut, risking a deafening crash to uncover a hidden cache of Coin.
nodes.page:
Under layers of grease and salt-crust, the iron bookcase defies ordinary leverage, its hinges seized by decades of damp air off the seabed. Bracing your boot against the rotting floorboards, you haul upward with both hands, muscles straining against the unyielding metal until the rusted bolts give a sudden, protesting shriek.

The iron door swings wide at last, showering the floor with reddish flakes and revealing a small, dark velvet pouch tucked behind a stack of water-damaged ledgers. Inside, heavy silver coins clink against one another, bearing the stamped profile of an ancient Brineholder magistrate long dead.

exits.label: Pry open the stubborn iron shelves

nodes.title: The Seized Casement
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted iron bookcase that has sealed shut, risking a deafening crash to uncover a hidden cache of Coin.
nodes.page: Tendons pull tight across your forearms as you wedge a crowbar into the hairline gap of the rusted iron bookcase, seeking purchase against the swollen metal frame. The whole structure groans under your weight, threatening to collapse forward and send a deafening clatter echoing across the stilt-city corridors where guards patrol. Every muscle in your body burns with the effort, trembling as you lean harder into the iron bar to force the stubborn latch.

check.label: Wrench the rusted iron case open

nodes.title: Heavy Metal Toll
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted iron bookcase that has sealed shut, risking a deafening crash to uncover a hidden cache of Coin.
nodes.page: The rusted iron bookcase slips with a vicious bite. It catches the skin of your knuckles and a jagged shard of metal tears through your sleeve. Sharp heat blooms along your forearm as an iron shelf drops two inches and pins your fingers against the wooden wall. You wrench your hand free with a harsh gasp. Dark blood smears the wall. An ugly gash runs open with every beat of your pulse.

nodes.title: Spoils of the Stilt-City
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted iron bookcase that has sealed shut, risking a deafening crash to uncover a hidden cache of Coin.
nodes.page: Metal screams against metal as the stubborn bookcase finally yields to your persistence, tipping outward with a heavy, muffled thud that scatters a cloud of ancient dust. Deep within the shadowed recess, your fingers brush against a cold, velvet-wrapped bundle hidden away from the prying eyes of the Brineholders. Prize goes into your pocket before the echoes die away.

nodes.title: The Bell Rings Out
nodes.brief: An alarm bell shatters the quiet, signalling that your intrusion has been noticed, forcing a frantic escape toward the governor's spire.
nodes.page: A shrill, brassy clang cuts through the salt air, bouncing off the damp slate roofs and down the narrow stilt-city alleys with merciless clarity. Somewhere below, a guard's whistle shrills in frantic answer; the quiet corridors wake into a maze of shouting voices and boots on timber. You throw your weight against the oak door and burst onto the open walkways just as a cluster of Brineholder patrolmen rounds the corner with drawn pikes. The grey slate expanse of the upper rooftops offers the only remaining avenue of escape from the converging net.

exits.label: Scramble up the steep slate roof

nodes.title: The Slate Ridge
nodes.brief: The Rooftop Run: A slanted, terrifying expanse of slate roofs and guttering connecting the archives to the central palace.
nodes.page: Slanted grey tiles drop away toward the churning abyss below, offering a terrifying expanse of rooftops and rusted gutters where the wind howls unchecked. To your left, a narrow chimney trail winds upward toward the governor's palace, while a dangling hemp rope swings wildly across a yawning chasm ahead. Thick, acrid smoke billows from a lower vent, obscuring potential hiding places in a choking grey fog, and a shattered glass skylight reveals a lavish, chandelier-lit chamber directly below.

exits.label: Sprint along the sloping rooftop ridge
Leap across the chasm for the rope
Plunge into the blinding chimney smoke
Drop through the shattered glass skylight

nodes.title: The Shattered Tile
nodes.brief: You attempt to jam a pursuit door with a shattered roof tile, risking crushed fingers to buy precious time and a discarded weapon.
nodes.page: Snatching a salt-crusted roof tile from the gutter, you wedge it firmly between the iron frame and the latch of the pursuit door just as boots thunder up the wooden stairs. The timber door slams against the improvised obstacle with a dull, splintering crunch, trapping the shouts of your pursuers in the narrow stairwell. Scrambling backward over the slick slate, your hand brushes against a discarded brass scraper left behind by some careless slater.

exits.label: Flee across the wet slate tiles

nodes.title: The Jammed Latch
nodes.brief: You attempt to jam a pursuit door with a shattered roof tile, risking crushed fingers to buy precious time and a discarded weapon.
nodes.page: You work a jagged shard of roof tile into the narrow gap of the latch in the iron door frame. Furious pounding hits the other side. The wood shudders under a sudden violent shoulder-strike. If the wedge slips even a fraction, the door will crush your hands against the stone wall. Damp wind puts salt in your eyes. You hammer the tile home with the heel of your palm and hold your breath for the next crash.

nodes.title: Crushed Bone and Iron
nodes.brief: You attempt to jam a pursuit door with a shattered roof tile, risking crushed fingers to buy precious time and a discarded weapon.
nodes.page: The oak door slams inward with crushing force just as your fingers slip. It drives the jagged roof tile deep into your palm and pins your hand against the rough stone facing. White-hot agony flares through your wrist. Your knuckles bruise and weep dark blood onto the wet slate. You yank your hand free with a stifled curse and stumble backward across the slippery roof while the pursuit spills out behind you.

nodes.title: The Holdfast Wedge
nodes.brief: You attempt to jam a pursuit door with a shattered roof tile, risking crushed fingers to buy precious time and a discarded weapon.
nodes.page: The jagged tile bites deep into the timber frame and holds the door fast against the fury of the guards; tortured wood groans, solid and unyielding. The sudden blockade buys you a few heartbeats to put distance between yourself and the shouts behind you. Your fingers throb, but clutched tightly in your left hand is a brass scraper dropped by the fleeing patrols.

exits.label: Drop through the glass skylight below

nodes.title: The Gaping Void
nodes.brief: You calculate the exact trajectory for a desperate leap across a gap, risking a fatal miss to grab a dangling escape rope.
nodes.page:
Iron pipes leak overhead. Rusty condensate hits the grated walkway with a sharp hollow ring. Between two stilt-propped platforms of Saltspire a drop opens under your boots: thirty feet of salt-encrusted emptiness where the sea used to run. A frayed hempen rope hangs from a rusted winch on the opposite scaffolding and swings out of reach with every gust. Smoke rolls from a nearby cook-house. Soot coats the damp air and your eyes water. You measure the distance once. Soaked coat, slick iron edge under the heels.

You set your heels on the wet plating and fix on the frayed end of the line.

exits.label: Leap across the void for the rope

nodes.title: Measure the Span
nodes.brief: You calculate the exact trajectory for a desperate leap across a gap, risking a fatal miss to grab a dangling escape rope.
nodes.page:
Staring across the abyss, you mentally map the arc of your weight against the howling wind tunnel between the stilted tenements. Every second counts as heavy footsteps clatter on the metal grating behind you, drawing closer through the acrid fog of the chimney fire. Your calf muscles coil tight, heels hovering over the sheer drop where barnacles crust the iron pillars far below. A misjudged trajectory means plummeting into the bone-dry seabed, while a clean catch leaves you dangling over the open void with guards at your heels.

You crouch low, steadying your breathing as you time the rhythmic sway of the frayed rope dancing in the updraft.

check.label: Leap across the gap to the dangling line

nodes.title: Bruised and Breathing
nodes.brief: You calculate the exact trajectory for a desperate leap across a gap, risking a fatal miss to grab a dangling escape rope.
nodes.page: Your boots strike the slippery edge of the far platform rather than solid timber, sending you skidding hard into a rusted iron bracket that leaves a deep, throbbing bruise across your ribs. Pain flares white-hot through your side as your fingers claw desperately at the rough timber until a secure grip takes hold. You haul yourself upward onto the grating, coughing violently from the inhaled soot and spitting gray phlegm onto the metal. The clumsy impact cost you precious gear and a painful wrench to your shoulder, but the pursuers are left shouting on the far side of the chasm.

exits.label: Crawl away along the stilt walkway

nodes.title: Caught in the Fibers
nodes.brief: You calculate the exact trajectory for a desperate leap across a gap, risking a fatal miss to grab a dangling escape rope.
nodes.page: Iron screeching against stone fades behind you as your fingers wrap around the coarse hempen strands, taking the full shock of the drop with a searing friction burn across your palms. You swing across the dizzying gulf in a single fluid arc, slamming heavily into the opposite scaffolding but hooking a boot securely over the lower rail. You settle onto the platform just as shouts echo from the mist above. Your fingers burn raw, but clenched in your bruised fist is a brass shackle pin torn straight from the swaying winch rigging.

exits.label: Flee down the ladder toward the rooftops

nodes.title: Choked in Soot
nodes.brief: You rapidly plan a route through the blinding smoke of a chimney fire, risking asphyxiation to find a safe hideout.
nodes.page: Yellowish smoke billows from a ruptured flue and turns the narrow stilt-alley into a blinding labyrinth of acrid haze and blistering heat. Ash settles in your hair. Each ragged breath cakes your throat as you draw air through your sleeve. Wooden walkways groan under the thermal stress and warp outward while flames lick the underside of the hanging balconies. Every blind turn offers a new hazard, from white-hot iron plates to plunging drops into the hazy seabed below. You press your shoulder against the damp timber wall and inch forward through the gloom where the air tastes less like burning pitch.

exits.label: Grope through the choking smoke ahead

nodes.title: Navigating the Blind Maze
nodes.brief: You rapidly plan a route through the blinding smoke of a chimney fire, risking asphyxiation to find a safe hideout.
nodes.page:
Smoke claws at your lungs and cuts visibility to a handspan of soot-blackened timber and glowing iron rivets. You press your palm flat against the exterior wall of a stilted granary and feel for the familiar grain of salt-weathered oak that marks the concealed maintenance ladder. Boots stamp nearby.
