The sound carries through the hollow superstructure and tracks your retreat. Your chest burns with every shallow breath of superheated air, so you map the next step by memory and touch alone.

You pause at a junction where two venting shafts converge. A shift of wind marks an unblocked passage.

check.label: Navigate the blinding smoke by touch

nodes.title: Smoke-Scoured Lung
nodes.brief: You rapidly plan a route through the blinding smoke of a chimney fire, risking asphyxiation to find a safe hideout.
nodes.page: A sudden gust of superheated draft drives a wall of thick, oily soot straight into your face, blinding you and causing you to stumble hard against a protruding iron pipe. The metal strikes your collarbone with a sickening crack, dropping you to your knees on the blistering deck plates. You gasp in pure ash, your throat tearing as you crawl blindly along the bulkhead until your fingers find a drainage scupper. The delay costs you dear in breath and blood, leaving your chest raw and your supplies scorched, but the suffocating pocket clears enough to let you drag yourself onward.

exits.label: Stagger into the damp night air

nodes.title: Finding the Vent
nodes.brief: You rapidly plan a route through the blinding smoke of a chimney fire, risking asphyxiation to find a safe hideout.
nodes.page: Your fingers trace the familiar cold iron rivets of a maintenance hatch just as the air turns marginally cooler against your sweat-slicked forehead. You slip through a narrow gap behind a water tank where the draft runs clean from the seabed below. The heat recedes into a dull roar behind the timber bulkheads, leaving you coughing in the shadows of a silent storage loft. Clutched in your belt is a damp wool rag soaked in vinegar, discarded by some fleeing dock-worker but offering vital relief against the lingering smoke.

exits.label: Drop through the floor hatch downward

nodes.title: Shattering the Glass
nodes.brief: You crash through a skylight into the opulent chambers of the Brineholder Governor, finding him locked in a tense negotiation.
nodes.page: Glass starbursts inward in a cascading roar of crystal shards as your boots smash through the domed skylight of the Brineholder Governor's private chamber. You drop onto a Persian carpet threaded with silver wire. Porcelain tea sets scatter. An ivory globe rolls across the polished floor. Across the room, startled courtiers freeze mid-sentence, while an immaculate elderly man in a velvet doublet lowers a pearl-handled ledger with unblinking composure. Cloth hangings along the curved walls muffle distant alarms from the stilt-city outside. The Governor regards you with the cold, assessing curiosity of a merchant inspecting a damaged crate washed up on the Low.

exits.label: Face the Governor across the shattered glass

nodes.title: The Governor's Solarium
nodes.brief: The Governor's Solarium: A sun-drenched room filled with dying exotic plants and nervous aristocrats making desperate bargains.
nodes.page: Pale sunlight filters through salt-crusted domes onto dying ferns and imported palms drooping in terracotta pots across the circular chamber. Nervous aristocrats in stiff collars huddle near velvet settees, whispering behind gloved hands while armed guards hover by the bronze-plated doors. The Governor sits at an inlaid mahogany desk, ignoring the scattered glass from your entrance to study a brass-bound tide ledger. Every exit from this sunlit cage offers a desperate gamble, whether through negotiation, stealth, intimidation, or force, while the true prize - and the missing keeper - lurks deeper in the shadows of the stilt-city.

exits.label: Jam the heavy brass locking mechanism
Stare down the swaggering armed guards
Smash the porcelain urn for cover
Demand the truth about Orsolya Venn

nodes.title: The False Envoy
nodes.brief: You bluff your way into joining the negotiation as an emissary, risking immediate execution to secure a signed transit pass.
nodes.page: Mahogany doors part on a ring of tense Brineholder factors arguing over ledgers of stagnant water rights. You smooth your salt-stiffened collar, step into the sunlit perimeter of the chamber with an assumed swagger, and announce yourself as a courier dispatched from the lower docks. A scribe wearing spectacles lashed to his nose with twine looks up, his quill hovering over parchment while murmurs ripple through the silk-robed assembly. Every eye turns toward you, measuring the dust on your boots against the pristine white marble of the floor. You must convince them your forged credentials carry the weight of an official trade mandate before suspicion hardens into steel.

exits.label: Step forward and present the scroll

nodes.title: Weighing the Bluff
nodes.brief: You bluff your way into joining the negotiation as an emissary, risking immediate execution to secure a signed transit pass.
nodes.page: Sweat trickles into the stubble of your jaw as the chief factor examines the greasy seal with trembling fingers, muttering under his breath about harbour tariffs and contraband. Your pulse hammers against your ribs like a trapped gull, each tick of the distant tide clock sounding louder than a church bell. You lean casually against a carved mahogany pillar, maintaining a flat gaze while calculating the exact distance to the arched balcony window in case the fraud dissolves into iron. Your mind races through maritime statutes and forged signatures, searching for the precise cadence of bureaucratic arrogance that keeps executioners at bay.

check.label: Talk your way past the factors

nodes.title: Cost of a Slip
nodes.brief: You bluff your way into joining the negotiation as an emissary, risking immediate execution to secure a signed transit pass.
nodes.page: The chief factor narrows his eyes, spots the smeared ink of a false seal, and slams his fist down upon the mahogany desk with a sharp oath. Guards converge from the shadows with drawn cutlasses, their leather boots slamming hard against the floorboards as iron rings out in the confined space. You take a vicious backhand across the cheek that leaves a stinging red welt and tears your collar, driving the breath from your lungs in a ragged gasp. Scrambling backward through the shattered glass of the balcony, you leave behind your reserve supplies and a deep, angry scratch along your forearm while desperate shouts echo behind you.

nodes.title: The Forged Seal
nodes.brief: You bluff your way into joining the negotiation as an emissary, risking immediate execution to secure a signed transit pass.
nodes.page: The chief factor grunts, rubs his salt-roughened chin, and drives his signet into warm red wax to validate your passage with reluctant authority. You tuck the parchment inside your jacket alongside your pounding heartbeat, offering a stiff, mocking bow before the nervous aristocrats have time to reconsider their cowardice. The ink dries quickly in the salt breeze drifting through the open casement, leaving you with a weapon far sharper than any rusted blade in Gullmouth.

nodes.title: Whispers in the Iron
nodes.brief: You subtly disable the intricate locking mechanism of the solarium door, risking detection to ensure a clear escape route for later.
nodes.page: Pale light glints off the brass tumblers of the solarium door as your fingers work the pins of the lock. Dust motes drift through the humid air and settle upon the abandoned tea trays and velvet armchairs of the panicked aristocracy. Every breath must be measured. Guards with halberds patrol the outer corridor, and any sound could betray you. A faint metallic click slips through the silence as the internal tongue frees from its housing. The portal sits primed to swing open at a single touch whenever haste demands it.

exits.label: Move back toward the arched balcony

nodes.title: The Tumbler's Secret
nodes.brief: You subtly disable the intricate locking mechanism of the solarium door, risking detection to ensure a clear escape route for later.
nodes.page: A drop of cold sweat gathers on the bridge of your nose as your improvised wire probe nudges a stubborn spring within the brass mechanism. The inner bolt resists with a dull metallic grinding sound that seems to echo like thunder through the quiet antechamber. Your fingers grow cramped and clumsy against the cold metal, but you force your breathing to slow, feeling for the subtle give of the brass lever that separates a clean escape from a locked tomb. The tension in the internal springs reaches a razor edge, waiting for the final twist of your wrist.

nodes.title: Caught in the Cogs
nodes.brief: You subtly disable the intricate locking mechanism of the solarium door, risking detection to ensure a clear escape route for later.
nodes.page: A sudden snap shatters the silence as the delicate pick jams fast inside the brass housing, shearing off the tip and leaving the lock permanently fouled. Alarms chime softly in the corridor outside, and rough hands seize your collar before you can twist away from the door. You wrench yourself free at the cost of a torn sleeve and a nasty graze across your knuckles, tumbling into a storage alcove amid crates of imported linens. The guards sweep past the wrong archway, leaving you breathless, bruised, and nursing a throbbing hand in the gloom.

exits.label: Slip out through the service hatch

nodes.title: The Oiled Bolt
nodes.brief: You subtly disable the intricate locking mechanism of the solarium door, risking detection to ensure a clear escape route for later.
nodes.page: The brass tumblers give with a whisper of well-oiled grease, and the iron tongue slides back flush into its mortise plate. You withdraw your wire tools with clean precision, wiping the soot from your fingers onto your trousers without leaving a single mark upon the polished timber. The escape route remains entirely yours, quiet and unguarded, offering a clear path out of the stilt-city when the inevitable reckoning arrives.

nodes.title: The Iron Stare
nodes.brief: You stand your ground when an aristocrat's bodyguard draws a blade, risking a severe wound to establish dominance and gain respect.
nodes.page: A tall bodyguard in silver-plated scale armour steps squarely into your path, his hand resting casually upon the pommel of a broadsword notched from years of wharf brawls. His eyes are cold and pale as dried bone, sweeping over your mud-spattered boots and patched coat with quiet contempt. You do not flinch, meeting his dead gaze with a flat, level stare that acknowledges neither fear nor respect. The murmur of the surrounding aristocrats fades away into an uneasy stillness as the two of you measure each other in the salt-heavy air.

exits.label: Hold your ground against the guard

nodes.title: Standoff on the Stilt
nodes.brief: You stand your ground when an aristocrat's bodyguard draws a blade, risking a severe wound to establish dominance and gain respect.
nodes.page: Sunlight beats down through the salt-crusted glass dome above, laying long bars of amber light across the polished marble floor where you stand shoulder to shoulder with the armed sentinel. The bodyguard shifts his stance. Leather creaks. He tests whether your nerve will shatter or bend under that institutional stare. You keep your hands loose at your sides, near your hidden rigging knife, ready for the flash of cold steel. Neither side blinks first. A fern frond brushes the guard's boot.

exits.label: Force a path past the blade

nodes.title: Testing the Metal
nodes.brief: You stand your ground when an aristocrat's bodyguard draws a blade, risking a severe wound to establish dominance and gain respect.
nodes.page: The mercenary's fingers tighten around his leather-wrapped grip, his knuckles whitening as he draws the heavy broadsword an inch clear of its scabbard with a low rasp of iron. A single drop of sweat traces the line of your jaw, but you refuse to step back, holding your ground as the razor edge catches the pale light from the ruined dome. Your pulse roars in your ears like surf against the Gullmouth cliffs, waiting for the twitch of a muscle that will turn this stilted parlour into a slaughterhouse.

nodes.title: The Price of Pride
nodes.brief: You stand your ground when an aristocrat's bodyguard draws a blade, risking a severe wound to establish dominance and gain respect.
nodes.page: The mercenary's blade flashes too fast for the eye, flat-siding across your ribs with a sickening thud that knocks the wind from your chest and sends you staggering into a terracotta planter. Shards of red clay and dying ferns erupt around your boots as you hit the marble floor, tasting copper on your tongue. You scramble back to your feet with a bruised shoulder and a shallow gash along your ribs, chest heaving while the guard returns his sword to its sheath with bored indifference.

exits.label: Pick yourself up from the floor

nodes.title: Unflinching Bone
nodes.brief: You stand your ground when an aristocrat's bodyguard draws a blade, risking a severe wound to establish dominance and gain respect.
nodes.page: The mercenary holds your unwavering gaze for a long, breathless heartbeat before slowly sliding his broadsword back into its scabbard with a dull click of locking brass. A flicker of reluctant respect crosses his scarred features, and he steps aside to clear the threshold without a single spoken word. You adjust your jacket, smoothing the crumpled fabric with steady hands, knowing you have earned passage through the heart of the stilt-city by sheer stubbornness alone.

nodes.title: Panic On The Branch
nodes.brief: You physically restrain a panicked nobleman who tries to flee, risking a brutal scuffle to extort a heavy purse of Coin.
nodes.page:
Silk rustles like dry kelp as the nobleman scrambles backward over the carved railing of the stilt-way, his eyes wide and milky with saltwater terror. Below him, the exposed seabed yawns like an open grave, tempting him to jump or bolt into the shadowed lattice of Saltspire's lower struts. You catch the hem of his velvet doublet before his heels can find purchase on the slick iron rungs, hauling him back onto the wooden planks with a sharp twist of his embroidered collar. He thrashes like a hooked cod, his expensive rings flashing in the dim gloom of the high walkway.

While he gasps for air you wedge your forearm across his chest, pin him against the damp cedar wall, and demand the purse swinging from his belt as toll for your silence.

nodes.title: The Weight Of Silk
nodes.brief: You physically restrain a panicked nobleman who tries to flee, risking a brutal scuffle to extort a heavy purse of Coin.
nodes.page:
Breath rattles in the aristocrat's throat as he writhes against your grip, his manicured fingers clawing desperately at your wrists to break your hold. He babbles of Brineholder guards and maritime law, spit of salt-foam flecking your sleeve, while the coin-purse at his hip jingles like a trapped bell. The humid air of the stilt-city reeks of old brine and stagnant bilge-water, thick enough to choke on as you tighten your purchase on his silk collar.

Every second spent wrestling this coward risks drawing the attention of patrolling wardens or rival wreckers lurking in the shadows of the water-towers. You must force the issue now before his frantic shrieks bring the entire upper tiers down upon your head.

nodes.title: A Desperate Struggle
nodes.brief: You physically restrain a panicked nobleman who tries to flee, risking a brutal scuffle to extort a heavy purse of Coin.
nodes.page:
The nobleman lunges sideways with unexpected fury, slamming his full weight against your ribs and trying to hurl you both over the narrow railing into the abyssal drop below. You drop your stance instantly, planting your boots hard against the damp grain of the duckboards and driving your shoulder straight into his chest with all the leverage you can muster. Bone grinds against bone in the tight, wet heat of the stilt-way as you fight for dominance over the precipice.

For one breathless heartbeat, you hover on the very edge of the drop, your muscles screaming under the strain of his frantic, terrified thrashing.

check.label: Wrench the purse from his grip

nodes.title: Bruised Pride
nodes.brief: You physically restrain a panicked nobleman who tries to flee, risking a brutal scuffle to extort a heavy purse of Coin.
nodes.page: Your footing slips on a patch of green slime coating the cedar planks, sending you stumbling hard against a rusted iron water-pipe. The nobleman breaks free with a ragged shriek, leaving a fistful of your jacket behind as he scrambles away down the ladder-well like a frightened crab. You pick yourself up from the deck, rubbing a deep, purple bruise blossoming across your ribs where the pipe bit into your flesh. Still dangling from his retreating belt, the purse is a bitter loss that costs you valuable time and your pride.

exits.label: Pursue him down the iron rungs

nodes.title: The Spoils Of Salt
nodes.brief: You physically restrain a panicked nobleman who tries to flee, risking a brutal scuffle to extort a heavy purse of Coin.
nodes.page: Despite the slippery slime underfoot your grip holds, and you wrench the leather purse from his failing grasp as the cord snaps sharp. The nobleman collapses against the cedar bulkhead, gasping for breath and clutching his bruised side while you pocket the rattling prize. The purse brims with cold silver coins stamped with the seal of the Brineholders. You leave him huddled there among the damp ropes, nursing his terror as you slip away into the labyrinth of walkways.

nodes.title: Shards And Shadows
nodes.brief: You smash a heavy urn to create a sudden diversion, risking flying shrapnel to snatch a ceremonial key from a table.
nodes.page:
Terracotta pots of dying ferns line the veranda and throw deep, salt-crusted shadows across the sun-bleached planks of the terrace. You grab a massive ornamental urn by its rim and hurl it down hard against the stone flagging, where it shatters into a thousand jagged pieces with a deafening crack. High-born guests shriek and scatter like gulls from a carcass, diving behind wicker screens and gilded pillars to escape the flying red shards.

Through the sudden cloud of dry dust and confusion, you lunge across the inlaid mahogany table, your fingers closing around the cold brass of the ceremonial key just as a guard shouts from the arched doorway.

nodes.title: The Brass Snatch
nodes.brief: You smash a heavy urn to create a sudden diversion, risking flying shrapnel to snatch a ceremonial key from a table.
nodes.page:
Shards of baked clay skitter across the floorboards as you drive your weight forward, plunging your hand into the swirling dust toward the glittering brass key resting upon the velvet cloth. Heavy boots thunder behind you along the wooden gallery, and a mailed hand reaches out from the drifting haze to close around your shoulder before your fingers can fully secure the prize. You brace your legs against the polished floor, putting every ounce of your strength into a violent, twisting heave to break free and pull the key along with you.

The metal bites into your palm as you struggle against the sudden, iron grip closing on your back.

check.label: Rip the key from the table

nodes.title: A Costly Escape
nodes.brief: You smash a heavy urn to create a sudden diversion, risking flying shrapnel to snatch a ceremonial key from a table.
nodes.page: The guard's grip will not shake off cleanly, and as you wrench yourself away, a jagged terracotta shard slices a deep line across your forearm. Blood wells up instantly, hot and bright against your salt-stained skin, dripping onto the splintered floorboards as you bolt through the arched exit. You clutch the stolen key tightly in your bleeding hand, leaving behind a trail of red droplets that will make tracking you through Saltspire's alleys all too easy for your pursuers.

nodes.title: The Brazen Key
nodes.brief: You smash a heavy urn to create a sudden diversion, risking flying shrapnel to snatch a ceremonial key from a table.
nodes.page: Terracotta shards fly like gravel against your boots as the storage urn shatters across the mosaic tiles, and every armed eye in the chamber snaps toward the noise. While every eye snaps toward the crash, your hand darts across the carved mahogany table and closes around a ceremonial key of dull bronze, its teeth filed into the shape of a breaking wave. A Brineholder captain shouts an oath, but you are already backing toward the arched doorway, your fingers curled tightly around the cold metal keepsake that now binds the house's fortunes to your own.

nodes.title: The Governor's Confession
nodes.brief: Orsolya is not here, but the Governor reveals she was taken down the Sunken Stair by the Hollow Choir as a hostage.
nodes.page:
High above the dry seabed, the sun-drenched solarium smells of scorched citrus leaves and the cold sweat of terrified aristocrats. The governor sits slumped in a wicker chair, his powdered wig askew, staring blankly out at the empty horizon where the grey ocean used to be. Orsolya Venn is not here among the fluttering palms and trembling sycophants, but when you press the blade of your intent against his ribs, the old man speaks her name with a shudder. He confesses that the lighthouse keeper was cornered on the cliffs three nights ago and dragged down the Sunken Stair by the Hollow Choir as an offering to the jammed Meridian Gear. The drowned dead wanted someone who knew how the machinery sang before they turned it to drown the world once more.

The only way down to chase them is through the great iron winch dangling over the abyss.

nodes.title: The Descent Winch
nodes.brief: The Descent Winch: A massive, groaning mechanical elevator meant to lower brave souls directly towards the exposed seabed.
nodes.page: Iron cables thick as a hangman's noose groan against grease-blackened pulleys above the great drop. This towering contraption serves as Saltspire's mechanical lung, hauling cargo and caged nobility between the stilt-city and the rotting seabed. Rust flakes drift downward like red snow into the abyss, where the shadowed mouth of the Sunken Stair waits like an open grave. Steam hisses from rusted pressure valves nearby, smelling of boiled salt and scorching tallow. You stand at the precipice of the loading stage, weighing every heavy choice before the platform lunges into the damp void.

exits.label: Crank the rusted manual override wheel
Fight off a desperate shadow hijacker
Pry a glowing crystal from the shaft
Ride the winch to the base

nodes.title: Iron on the Wind
nodes.brief: You step onto the swaying, unrailed platform as it violently descends, risking debilitating vertigo to secure a sturdy iron prybar.
nodes.page: Oak timbers shake under your boots as the hoist platform shears free of the stilt-city's wooden skirts. Breath leaves your throat. Far below, the dry seabed resembles a cracked white skull under the bruised sky while salt-crusted winds whip your jacket against your ribs. Your fingers search the shivering iron guardrail for purchase and slide past greasy grease-stains left by a thousand previous descents. A loose bracket rattles beside your knee. It could tear free and plunge into the gray nothingness.

exits.label: Reach for the hanging iron prybar

nodes.title: The Shuddering Cage
nodes.brief: You step onto the swaying, unrailed platform as it violently descends, risking debilitating vertigo to secure a sturdy iron prybar.
nodes.page: Cold dampness clings to your skin as the descent accelerates into a dizzying blur of rusted ironwork and rotting timber pilings. The prybar hangs just beyond arm's reach from a protruding bracket, swaying violently with every shudder of the winch. You brace your boots against the ridged metal plating, leaning your weight out over the abyss where the wind screams a jagged tune. The horizon tilts wildly, blending the bleached floor of the Low with the swirling gray clouds overhead in a nauseating whirl.

exits.label: Test your nerve against the drop

nodes.title: Swung Over the Abyss
nodes.brief: You step onto the swaying, unrailed platform as it violently descends, risking debilitating vertigo to secure a sturdy iron prybar.
nodes.page: Vertigo coils tight in your stomach, threatening to loosen your grip as the platform lurches sideways on a frayed cable. You stretch your arm out into the roaring gale, fingers clawing toward the cold iron handle of the prybar while your boots slip on the greasy deck. The ground below seems to rush upward while the stilt-city vanishes into the mist above. Your muscles lock against the terror, fighting the sickening urge to curl into a ball and let the abyss take you.

nodes.title: A Slip in the Void
nodes.brief: You step onto the swaying, unrailed platform as it violently descends, risking debilitating vertigo to secure a sturdy iron prybar.
nodes.page: A sudden lurch of the cables betrays your balance, sending you crashing hard against the jagged iron framework of the cage. Pain shoots up your shoulder as your arm takes the brunt of the impact, leaving a deep, throbbing bruise that burns beneath your wool sleeve. The prybar clatters against the metal grating and nearly slips over the edge before you manage to pin it beneath your boot heel. Panting heavily against the gale, you clutch your aching arm and watch the gray depths crawl slowly past.

nodes.title: Iron in the Fist
nodes.brief: You step onto the swaying, unrailed platform as it violently descends, risking debilitating vertigo to secure a sturdy iron prybar.
nodes.page: Your fingers wrap securely around the cold, salt-pitted handle of the prybar, wrenching it free from its rusted housing just as the platform settles into a slower, steadier crawl. The metal tool sits cold and solid against your palm, a reliable bite of steel amid the treacherous heights. Whether earned through calm mastery or sheer desperate luck, the prize is yours to keep now. You tuck the tool firmly into your belt, ready for whatever rusted locks or stubborn teeth wait below.

nodes.title: The Brake House
nodes.brief: You study the complex braking levers to control the descent speed, risking a free-fall to salvage some precious mechanical parts.
nodes.page: Thick iron cables hum with unbearable tension inside the wooden control shed perched above the gaping shaft. Heavy brass levers, green with centuries of oxidation, control the descent rate of every cage hanging beneath Saltspire. Piles of discarded oil rags and broken gear teeth litter the floorboards, smelling strongly of stale fish-oil and heated metal. You follow each linkage rod with a careful eye, hunting for a mechanical shortcut under the grease and grime.

nodes.title: Lever and Cog
nodes.brief: You study the complex braking levers to control the descent speed, risking a free-fall to salvage some precious mechanical parts.
nodes.page: Gears grind together with a deafening shriek of protesting bronze as you nudge the primary brake lever a fraction of an inch. The platform beneath your feet shudders, slowing its terrifying plunge into a controlled, rattling creep that stirs up clouds of old dust. Through the grime-coated viewing slit in the shed wall, the vast expanse of the Low opens up like a ruined map carved in salt and bone. A secondary linkage catches your eye, twitching erratically behind a housing of riveted copper plates.

nodes.title: The Jammed Gearbox
nodes.brief: You study the complex braking levers to control the descent speed, risking a free-fall to salvage some precious mechanical parts.
nodes.page: Your fingers trace the intricate pattern of the release pins, seeking the single rusted cotter that holds the entire emergency brake assembly together. The iron casing is blistering cold to the touch, and the deafening roar of the main winch vibrates straight through the floorboards into your teeth. One wrong twitch of your wrist could snap the primary spindle and send the entire cage hurtling down into the dark. You narrow your eyes against the flying rust flakes, calculating the exact pressure needed to trip the lock.

nodes.title: A Costly Misalignment
nodes.brief: You study the complex braking levers to control the descent speed, risking a free-fall to salvage some precious mechanical parts.
nodes.page: A sudden screech of sheared iron shatters your concentration as the gear slips backward with bone-jarring violence. A jagged metal burr slices deep across your palm, painting the brass levers with a bright streak of hot blood. The entire control box rattles furiously, threatening to seize up completely and leave you stranded halfway down the face of the stilt-city. You snatch your hand back with a sharp hiss, wrapping your torn flesh in a scrap of damp cloth while the machinery slowly grinds to a halt.

nodes.title: The Precision Slip
nodes.brief: You study the complex braking levers to control the descent speed, risking a free-fall to salvage some precious mechanical parts.
nodes.page: The heavy brass lever slides home with a satisfying, muffled click, easing the screech of the main cables down to a low, rhythmic thrum. Inside the open maintenance tray sits a marvel of old engineering, untouched by the salt-rot that ruins everything else in this drowned world. Whether through brilliant calculation or a blessed stroke of fortune, the mechanism yields its secrets without breaking your fingers. You pocket your prize, feeling the subtle weight of mechanical insight settling into your bones.

nodes.title: The Iron Wheel
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted manual override wheel to force the winch down, risking severe muscle tearing to reach a hidden maintenance alcove.
nodes.page:
Heavy grease coats your knuckles as you grasp the spokes of the manual override. Salt crust flakes off the iron with a dry, papery hiss every time you strain against the jammed spindle. Below your boots, the stilt-city groans in the cold wind blowing off the exposed seabed, vibrating through the metal floor plates like a trapped pulse.

Breathing deep, you plant your heels against the riveted plating and force your weight onto the wheel, praying the rusted chain inside the partition holds firm.

nodes.title: A Searing Strain
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted manual override wheel to force the winch down, risking severe muscle tearing to reach a hidden maintenance alcove.
nodes.page:
Iron splinters and rust flakes rain down onto your shoulders as the stubborn mechanism grudgingly gives another quarter-turn. Muscles across your back tighten like overtightened bowstrings, threatening to tear with every inch you claw from the dead weight of the winch. The alcove remains shrouded in absolute shadow just past the rusted bulkhead.

You grit your teeth against the sudden tremor in your forearms, determined to force the pathway open before the chain snaps.

nodes.title: The Manual Override
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted manual override wheel to force the winch down, risking severe muscle tearing to reach a hidden maintenance alcove.
nodes.page:
Cold brine cakes the iron spokes of the manual winch as you plant your boots against the slick rusted grating of the platform. Below your heels a three-hundred-foot drop opens into the grey gloom of the seabed. It is empty. The jammed cable above groans and refuses to yield an inch of slack unless you put every ounce of muscle and leverage behind the turning wheel. You grit your teeth against the sudden strain in your back and heave with all your might against the dead mass of the iron.

Sinews pull taut beneath your skin. Salt-crusted metal bites hard into your calloused palms while the drum shudders under the sudden, brutal pressure.

nodes.title: Torn Tendons and Rust
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted manual override wheel to force the winch down, risking severe muscle tearing to reach a hidden maintenance alcove.
nodes.page:
A sharp pop echoes inside your shoulder joint, followed by a wave of white-hot agony that robs the breath straight from your lungs. Your grip fails, and you stumble backward against the wet iron railing, clutching your wrenched arm as the override wheel spins violently back into place.

Pain flares with every heartbeat, leaving you weakened and gasping on the cold deck, yet alive enough to press onward through the gloom.

nodes.title: The Hidden Alcove
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted manual override wheel to force the winch down, risking severe muscle tearing to reach a hidden maintenance alcove.
nodes.page:
Pain flares through your shoulder with a dull, persistent throb, reminding you how close you came to snapping entirely. The iron bulkhead finally gives way with a protesting groan and slides aside to reveal the cramped space within. Resting upon a dusty shelf of oiled canvas sits a small, cold object left behind by some long-forgotten mechanic.

Reach inside and claim the prize.

nodes.title: The Desperate Leap
nodes.brief: You fight off a desperate scavenger trying to hijack the platform, risking a lethal shove to keep your hard-won Supplies intact.
nodes.page:
A heavy shadow lunges from behind a support beam, gloved hands slamming hard against your chest to knock you backward toward the open drop. Salty air rushes past your ears as you twist violently at the last fraction of a second, catching the attacker by the collar of their sodden oilskin coat.

The stilt-city walkway sways under the sudden, brutal impact, threatening to send your hard-earned packs tumbling into the empty abyss below.

nodes.title: Teeth and Scraps
nodes.brief: You fight off a desperate scavenger trying to hijack the platform, risking a lethal shove to keep your hard-won Supplies intact.
nodes.page:
Fingernails rake across your forearm as the desperate scavenger fights like a cornered dog, snarling curses about water rations and empty pockets. You slam your shoulder into their ribs, driving them back against the freezing iron railing while your canvas packs remain safely strapped to your chest.

The salt-encrusted deck is slick underfoot, turning every movement into a perilous dance above the dead seabed.

nodes.title: Edge of the Platform
nodes.brief: You fight off a desperate scavenger trying to hijack the platform, risking a lethal shove to keep your hard-won Supplies intact.
nodes.page: Rough canvas rubs raw against your ribs as the scavenger lunges from the shadow of a salt-crusted oil drum, fingers clawing fiercely for the straps of your bulging pack. You slam your bootheel down onto the damp, slick timber of the stilt-walk, throwing your shoulder forward to meet the sudden impact with every ounce of muscle you possess. The brine-soaked boards groan beneath your combined weight while the dizzy drop to the dry seabed yawns just inches away, threatening to swallow you both whole in the dark.

nodes.title: Bruised and Battered
nodes.brief: You fight off a desperate scavenger trying to hijack the platform, risking a lethal shove to keep your hard-won Supplies intact.
nodes.page:
A vicious blow catches you across the ribs, winding you instantly and forcing you to release your grip as your attacker scrambles away into the shadows. You slump against the cold iron stanchion, gasping for air while checking your gear bags. Several precious items are crushed or lost over the edge, leaving your provisions lighter and your body aching from the violent exchange.

Gather your breath and stand up.

nodes.title: The Spoils of Scrimmage
nodes.brief: You fight off a desperate scavenger trying to hijack the platform, risking a lethal shove to keep your hard-won Supplies intact.
nodes.page:
The scuffle ends with a sudden, breathless thud as your adversary tumbles away into the gloom and leaves a canvas pouch dropped in the rush. Supplies intact, you keep a firm grip on the prize left in the wake of the fight.

Pocket the recovered token of survival.

nodes.title: Glimmer in the Shaft
nodes.brief: You spot a hidden structural weakness in the elevator shaft, risking a delay to carefully extract a rare, glowing lumen-crystal.
nodes.page:
Rust flakes drift like gray snow from the heavy iron braces of the Saltspire hoist as you catch a strange, milky luminescence pulsing deep within a cracked timber strut. Someone wedged a raw lumen-crystal into the framework years ago, perhaps to illuminate a clandestine repair or to hide a stolen cache from Brineholder tax-men. The temptation to stop is sharp, though the massive chains above groan with the restless weight of the hanging carriage.

Carefully sliding the tip of your skinning knife into the narrow seam of the rotting wood, you begin to pry the damp fibers apart to reach the pale, throbbing mineral before the winch master notices your delay.

nodes.title: The Trembling Beam
nodes.brief: You spot a hidden structural weakness in the elevator shaft, risking a delay to carefully extract a rare, glowing lumen-crystal.
nodes.page:
Droplets of brackish condensation patter steadily against your oilskin shoulders while your fingers work the stubborn grain of the petrified support beam. Every tremor in the stilt-city above sends a dull vibration down the iron cables, shaking loose flakes of dried salt that sting your eyes. Yet the crystal remains stubbornly wedged in its dark nest, held fast by centuries of mineral buildup and swollen timber.

Working by touch alone in the damp gloom, you shift your weight onto a narrow iron rivet and reach deeper into the shadowed crevice.

nodes.title: Shifting the Timber
nodes.brief: You spot a hidden structural weakness in the elevator shaft, risking a delay to carefully extract a rare, glowing lumen-crystal.
nodes.page:
Pale light washes over your knuckles as the crystal yields a fraction of an inch, revealing a web of hairline fractures spreading through the surrounding structural brace with an ominous, cracking hiss. Stopping now means leaving a valuable prize behind, but pulling harder threatens to collapse the rusted iron housing right onto your fingers. You study the grain of the petrified wood and the angle of the iron bolts, searching for the exact fulcrum that will release the prize without bringing the whole shaft down around your ears.

With your blade wedged tight and your breath held against the rising dust, you apply steady pressure and prepare to wrench the mineral free.

nodes.title: Snap of the Brace
nodes.brief: You spot a hidden structural weakness in the elevator shaft, risking a delay to carefully extract a rare, glowing lumen-crystal.
nodes.page:
A sudden, sharp crack splits the air as the rotted timber gives way entirely, sending a shower of jagged splinters tearing across the back of your hand and nearly pitching you off the narrow metal rung. The lumen-crystal slips from your grasp, plunging down into the lightless void beneath the stilt-city with a distant, hollow clatter. You cling to the vibrating iron cable with your uninjured arm, gasping for breath as a dull, throbbing ache blooms across your knuckles.

Wiping the smear of dark blood onto your trousers, you haul yourself back onto the maintenance platform and press onward.

nodes.title: Cold Blue Light
nodes.brief: You spot a hidden structural weakness in the elevator shaft, risking a delay to carefully extract a rare, glowing lumen-crystal.
nodes.page:
The mineral yields with a soft, wet pop, sliding neatly into your palm and casting a cold, steady blue glow over the damp iron walls of the elevator shaft. The prize is yours, unbroken and burning with a deep-sea luminescence that will illuminate the darkest passages ahead. You tuck the glowing treasure safely into your canvas pouch alongside your salt-hardened rations, feeling the comforting warmth of its strange energy against your hip.

Squeezing past the ruined brace, you signal the winch operator to resume the descent.

nodes.title: Roots of the Spire
nodes.brief: The winch deposits you at the very base of Saltspire, where the shadows are long and the entrance to the Stair looms.
nodes.page:
Iron cables screech in protest as the heavy lift drops you out of the salt-crusted salt-winds and into the permanent twilight beneath Saltspire, where colossal roots of petrified wood and tangled red coral form an artificial forest as dense as any cliff-side thicket. The air down here tastes of ancient mud, stale bilge, and the metallic tang of standing water. Above, the city hangs suspended on its thousands of stilts like a inverted mountain of timber and lanterns; below, the dry seabed stretches out toward the black maw of the Sunken Stair.

Guards in lacquered brass helms pace the upper walkways, their long polearms glinting in the lantern-glow, while the shadowy passages between the roots lie open and unguarded to anyone bold enough to walk them.

nodes.title: The Stilt-Root Labyrinth
nodes.brief: The Stilt-Roots: A gloomy labyrinth of petrified wood and coral forming the foundation of the city in the dry dark.
nodes.page: Endless pillars of drowned timber and calcified weed rear up around you like the ribs of forgotten leviathans, casting long, twisting shadows across the cracked mud of the Low. Faint murmurs drift from distant trading posts run by Brineholder agents, while narrower, unlit gaps plunge deeper into the gloom toward the foot of the Sunken Stair. Every direction hums with the suppressed panic of a city that knows its water supply hangs on a knife-edge.

exits.label: Follow the marked coral trail deeper
Fashion a torch from kelp and fat
Crawl through a narrow root tunnel
Pry a barnacle from a buried chest

nodes.title: Carving the Way
nodes.brief: You carve a series of guiding marks into the coral pillars, risking a ruined blade to ensure you can find your way back.
nodes.page:
Deep shadows cling to the base of the massive coral pillars as you draw your skinning knife and begin to score sharp, deliberate crosses into the calcified surface of the wood. The blade bites into centuries of salt-crust with a gritty rasp, leaving bright white scars that stand out sharply against the dark, weed-choked background. Every mark must be clear enough to guide your retreat through this maze of dead roots when the tide or the Brineholder patrols turn against you.

Wiping a stray shaving of coral from your brow, you check the edge of your blade for nicks before moving deeper into the gloom.

exits.label: Deepen the marks on the pillars

nodes.title: Deeper into the Stale Dark
nodes.brief: You carve a series of guiding marks into the coral pillars, risking a ruined blade to ensure you can find your way back.
nodes.page:
The air cools as you press further past the outer ring of stilts. The distant sound of the city lifts falls away. Absolute silence takes its place. Strange shapes loom in the gray murk - discarded cargo nets stiffened into stone, skeletal whale-ribs draped in strands of dried kelp, and the occasional rusted winch housing left by forgotten scavengers. Every few paces you carve another guiding rune into the damp timber so the route back stays clear.

A sudden scuttling comes from a dark recess nearby. Your hand finds the knife handle and holds it.

exits.label: Test the strength of your blade

nodes.title: The Hard Grain
nodes.brief: You carve a series of guiding marks into the coral pillars, risking a ruined blade to ensure you can find your way back.
nodes.page:
Your knife bites deep into a stubborn knot of petrified oak, but the hardened wood resists the blade with a sudden, vicious shudder that threatens to snap the steel clean across at the hilt. Rushing the cut now will ruin your only dependable tool miles away from any blacksmith, yet leaving the pillar unmarked means losing your way in the twisting dark. You ease your grip, adjusting your wrist to match the stubborn grain of the ancient timber while the metal groans under the strain.

With your muscles tensed against the resistance of the wood, you apply a final, measured pressure to complete the guiding rune.

nodes.title: A Snapped Blade
nodes.brief: You carve a series of guiding marks into the coral pillars, risking a ruined blade to ensure you can find your way back.
nodes.page:
The tip of your knife snaps off with a dry metallic ping, clattering away across the salt-crusted floor and leaving you with a jagged, useless stump of steel. Frustration flares in your chest as you realize the cost of your haste, forced to abandon your favorite tool in the dark heart of the stilt-city's foundations. Fortunately, the rough gouge you managed to carve into the timber pillar is still deep enough to serve as a beacon, even if your equipment is poorer for the effort.

You pocket the ruined hilt and continue your cautious exploration through the shadows.

nodes.title: A Sharp Notch
nodes.brief: You carve a series of guiding marks into the coral pillars, risking a ruined blade to ensure you can find your way back.
nodes.page:
Steel rings a clear note as the final stroke bites deep into the petrified wood. A clean rune sits in the cut and catches the faint glow from above: deep, crisp, and unmistakable in the gloom. The blade held. You wipe it clean on your sleeve and slide it back into its leather sheath. Those marks will guide you through the labyrinthine roots when you need them.

You turn from the cut and retrace your steps toward the central junction.

nodes.title: Kelp and Grease
nodes.brief: You fashion a makeshift torch from dried kelp and whale fat, risking a nasty burn to acquire reliable illumination for the depths.
nodes.page:
Strands of salt-cured kelp coil thick around your forearm, slick with rancid whale fat scooped from a discarded cooper's tub. The mixture smells of old rot and cold oil, clinging to your skin like a second coat of grime. You twist the fibrous ribbons tighter into a makeshift brand, packing the grease deep into the weed's hollow stems to feed a steady, smoky flame. This subterranean gloom under Saltspire demands more than a Gullmouth wrecker's ordinary spark if you mean to see what watches from the stilt-shadows.

Striking flint against iron until a bright yellow ember catches, you watch the fat begin to bubble and spit dark smoke.

nodes.title: Binding the Flame
nodes.brief: You fashion a makeshift torch from dried kelp and whale fat, risking a nasty burn to acquire reliable illumination for the depths.
nodes.page: Smoke billows thick and acrid from the twisted kelp torch, stinging your eyes and coating the back of your throat in greasy soot as the volatile whale fat begins to render too fast. You must steady your trembling hands, shaping the makeshift wick against a sudden flare that threatens to ignite the entire bundle in your grip and sear your flesh to the bone. Every muscle in your arm aches with the strain of keeping the sputtering flame under tight control.

nodes.title: Searing Backlash
nodes.brief: You fashion a makeshift torch from dried kelp and whale fat, risking a nasty burn to acquire reliable illumination for the depths.
nodes.page: A sudden sputter of boiling grease spatters your knuckles, blistering the skin with white-hot agony and forcing a sharp hiss through your clenched teeth. You drop the burning kelp bundle onto the damp salt-floor with a curse, stamping out the stray sparks before they can catch on your canvas trousers. Your palm throbs with a angry red burn that will leave a stiff, puckered scar for the rest of your days. Wiping the greasy soot from your eyes, you retrieve the smoking remnant and press onward into the cold dark.

nodes.title: Steady Torchlight
nodes.brief: You fashion a makeshift torch from dried kelp and whale fat, risking a nasty burn to acquire reliable illumination for the depths.
nodes.page: Hot oil spatters dangerously close to your knuckles, but your calloused fingers hold firm against the heat until the kelp settles into a slow, rhythmic burn. The thick green flame casts long, wavering shadows across the petrified timber foundations of the city above, illuminating the salt-crusted alleys of the stilt-roots. You now hold a dependable beacon to pierce the blackness.

exits.label: Pick a path through the stilt-roots

nodes.title: Into the Silt
nodes.brief: You brave the suffocating darkness to crawl through a narrow root-tunnel, risking a panic attack to discover an ancient Tidewarden signet ring.
nodes.page:
Thick petrified roots arch overhead like the ribs of a beached leviathan, shutting out whatever faint light filters down from the stilt-city above. You drop to your hands and knees, crawling into a passage barely wider than your shoulders where the air tastes of ancient dust and stagnant brine. The claustrophobic weight of the damp earth presses against your spine, threatening to bring a cold sweat to your neck as you inch forward through the pitch-black silence.

Something metallic grates against your knee amid the damp silt.

nodes.title: Narrow Tunnel Dread
nodes.brief: You brave the suffocating darkness to crawl through a narrow root-tunnel, risking a panic attack to discover an ancient Tidewarden signet ring.
nodes.page: The low wooden ceiling seems to drop lower with every inch, pressing into your shoulders and choking your lungs with the dry, suffocating scent of centuries-old rot. Panic rises in your throat like bitter gall, whispering of cave-ins and unbreathing dark, but you force your limbs to move through the suffocating squeeze. You reach blindly into the black silt where something small and hard lies half-buried in the muck.

nodes.title: Choking Panic
nodes.brief: You brave the suffocating darkness to crawl through a narrow root-tunnel, risking a panic attack to discover an ancient Tidewarden signet ring.
nodes.page: A sudden wave of blind terror seizes your chest, making your breath come in ragged, shallow gasps that echo off the tight wooden walls. You thrash backward in panic, scraping your spine hard against a jagged knot of petrified oak and leaving a raw, bleeding scratch across your shoulder blades. By the time you claw your way back out into slightly wider air, your chest heaves and your palms are slick with nervous sweat.

nodes.title: Deep Archive Relic
nodes.brief: You brave the suffocating darkness to crawl through a narrow root-tunnel, risking a panic attack to discover an ancient Tidewarden signet ring.
nodes.page: The dark tunnel presses like a tomb against your ribs, yet your breathing remains steady enough to guide your groping fingers through the freezing mud. Your hand closes around a metal band buried deep in the silt. Pulling it free into the faint gloom, you turn the cold circle over in your palm and trace the worn grooves of an old office.

nodes.title: Iron and Barnacle
nodes.brief: You pry a massive, crushing barnacle off a buried strongbox, risking crushed hands to loot a hefty sum of emergency Coin.
nodes.page:
Jagged white teeth of massive barnacles encrust the oak chest, sealing the lid shut against anyone seeking to plunder the Brineholders' hidden stores. You wedge the flat of your wrecking bar beneath the iron clasp and lean your full weight into the rusted iron. The ancient wood groans under the strain, resisting your push with stubborn, stubborn malice before the encrustation finally cracks with a dry, splintering pop.

The iron lid falls back to reveal a gleaming hoard of heavy silver coinage.

nodes.title: Breaking the Seal
nodes.brief: You pry a massive, crushing barnacle off a buried strongbox, risking crushed hands to loot a hefty sum of emergency Coin.
nodes.page: The encrusted barnacles lock the heavy iron clasp tight against the rotting lid of the strongbox, refusing to yield to ordinary leverage. You plant your boots firmly against the salt-crusted floor, heave with every ounce of muscle in your back, and throw your weight against the jammed iron bar. The locked chest shudders under your assault, but the rusted hinges scream a sharp protest that threatens to give way entirely.

nodes.title: Crushed Claws
nodes.brief: You pry a massive, crushing barnacle off a buried strongbox, risking crushed hands to loot a hefty sum of emergency Coin.
nodes.page: A lump of encrusted shell gives way without warning, and your hands smash hard against the jagged iron corner of the strongbox. Pain shoots up your forearms, and you pull your bleeding knuckles back with a sharp hiss as dark blood wells from a deep, ragged gouge. The box stays sealed for now, its secret contents locked behind salt and stubborn age.

nodes.title: Spoils of the Stilt
nodes.brief: You pry a massive, crushing barnacle off a buried strongbox, risking crushed hands to loot a hefty sum of emergency Coin.
nodes.page: The stubborn iron lid wrenches free with a final, screeching groan of rusted metal, scattering flakes of old red paint across the salt-floor. Fingers clear of the snapping clasp, you find your prize waiting in the dark interior. You scoop up a heavy handful of stamped silver coin, feeling the cool weight settle deep into your canvas pouch.

nodes.title: The Sunken Stair
nodes.brief: Standing before the spiralling abyss of the Sunken Stair, you take a deep breath and begin the dark descent towards the Gear.
nodes.page: Iron rings bite into grease and moisture as you lower yourself past the final guard-house of Saltspire. The stilt-city's lantern-lit underside vanishes into the deep salt-haze. Below you the Sunken Stair uncoils into the bedrock like the ribs of some immense, buried Leviathan. Cold air reeks of stagnant bilge and oxidized copper. Taste sits hard. Far down in the grey gloom a faint knock travels through the masonry and shakes the stone under your boots. Orsolya Venn is somewhere down there in the dark, and the great mechanism waits for the hand that dares to turn it.

exits.label: Begin the long drop into the dark

nodes.title: Braking the Spindle
nodes.brief: You study the complex braking levers to control the descent speed, risking a free-fall to salvage some precious mechanical parts.
nodes.page: Heavy iron levers hum under your palms, cold grease coating your knuckles as the counterweights groan overhead. You lean your weight against the rusted teeth, courting a sudden, bone-shattering drop just to save a few precious heartbeats on the clock. Sparks spit from the iron brake-shoe, smelling of hot sulphur in the damp air. Below the cage, precious brass linkages dangle within reach of the drop, waiting for a daring hand to snatch them before the descent settles.

nodes.title: Rotting Ledger
nodes.brief: You speed-read through a decaying ledger before it crumbles, risking toxic mold exposure to glean the secret combination to the vault.
nodes.page: Brittle pages flake away into black dust beneath your fingertips, releasing a sharp, lung-clogging reek of green mold. You squint through watery eyes at the fading ink, racing against the absolute decay of the paper to find the numbers that govern the vault door. A grey spore-cloud billows from the spine, stinging your throat with every shallow breath you draw in the dim alcove.

exits.label: Trust the cracked and fading numbers

nodes.title: The Glass Ledge
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a thin glass ledge above the reservoir, risking a terrifying plunge to recover a drowned worker's toolbelt.
nodes.page: Smooth green glass spans the open gap above the black, unmoving reservoir, slick with condensation from the damp air. Your boots slide an inch before finding purchase against the brittle surface, suspended over a terrifying drop where drowned iron shapes loom in the dark water. A heavy leather toolbelt dangles from a rusted stanchion on the far side, half-submerged in the greenish film.

exits.label: Reach across the gap for leather

nodes.title: Barnacle Strongbox
nodes.brief: You pry a massive, crushing barnacle off a buried strongbox, risking crushed hands to loot a hefty sum of emergency Coin.
nodes.page: Jagged shells crusting the iron lid tear through the thick leather of your gloves, drawing sudden warmth across your palms. You wedge a cold chisel into the seam, throwing your shoulders against the rusted iron while the sharp edges threaten to splinter bone. A thick layer of grey scale falls away at last, exposing the heavy lock and the promise of hidden wealth within.

exits.label: Force the heavy encrusted latch open

nodes.title: The Tidal Cabinet
nodes.brief: You carefully pick the brass lock of a restricted tidal cabinet, risking a triggered poison needle to claim an ancient brass compass.
nodes.page: Thin brass tumblers click under your improvised wire, too loud for the narrow corridor of the stilt-city. Above the keyhole a hidden poison needle holds a dark bead of liquid, ready for one slip. You hold your breath. The final pin lifts with a faint snap.

exits.label: Lift the brass compass from velvet

nodes.title: Shadows on the Walk
nodes.brief: You eavesdrop on two elite guards discussing the Sunken Stair, risking discovery to learn the precise schedule of the patrols.
nodes.page: Boots strike the iron grating just around the rusted corner, and muffled voices discuss the rotation schedules of the deep guards. You press your shoulder flat against the damp stone of the bulkhead, praying the shadows swallow the outline of your coat. Every detail of the patrol timing falls clear and distinct into the damp air between their slow, measured footsteps.

exits.label: Slip away before the lanterns turn

nodes.title: The Rusted Bookcase
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted iron bookcase that has sealed shut, risking a deafening crash to uncover a hidden cache of Coin.
nodes.page: Iron edges bite into the wooden floorboards as you haul your weight against the jammed frame, praying the noise stays swallowed by the distant rumble of the tide. A cascade of heavy ledgers tumbles into the dark salt-dust, followed by the dull, metallic clatter of a hidden tin box rolling free. You freeze, listening hard for the sound of boots on the stairs while your heart hammers against your ribs.

exits.label: Grab the heavy tin box quickly

nodes.title: Picking the Solarium
nodes.brief: You subtly disable the intricate locking mechanism of the solarium door, risking detection to ensure a clear escape route for later.
nodes.page: Fine wire twists inside the brass latch. You work by the faint click of springs and by touch alone, glancing at the moonlit corridor for Brineholder patrols. The bolt slides back with a whisper of oiled metal. The door hangs free on its hinges for when you come back this way.

nodes.title: Securing the Passage
nodes.brief: You subtly disable the intricate locking mechanism of the solarium door, risking detection to ensure a clear escape route for later.
nodes.page: Cold oil coats your fingertips as you adjust the hidden latch, ensuring the heavy door will yield to a swift shoulder-push later tonight. Faint strains of music drift down from the upper terraces of Saltspire, masking the faint mechanical sigh of the retreating bolt. You test the gap with a fingernail, satisfied that your path back from the inner sanctum is clear of locks.

exits.label: Step away into the dim corridor

nodes.title: The Yawning Descent
nodes.brief: The descent into the yawning mouth of the Sunken Stair begins with the crushing scent of stagnant brine and ancient rust clinging to your throat.
nodes.page:
Damp air rises from the dark interior of the Sunken Stair, carrying the old stench of rotting kelp and copper scale. Your boots meet the slick basalt threshold. Above you the world narrows into a spiral shaft carved deep into the seabed's floor. Faint sounds drift up from the lower tiers, less like human voices than timber groaning under load. Every breath burns the throat with ancient salt. Whatever mechanism waits below has slept a long time.

A cold draft pushes against your chest. Beyond the threshold the damp gloom swallows Gullmouth's light.

exits.label: Descend into the yawning stone spiral

nodes.title: The Upper Landings
nodes.brief: The Upper Landings: A vast spiral of slick basalt steps descends into darkness, cluttered with the discarded detritus of desperate scavengers who turned back.
nodes.page: A vast well of slick basalt steps drops away into absolute shadow, choked with the discarded junk of desperate scavengers who lost their nerve and turned back. Rusted iron spikes and waterlogged packs litter the stone landings, telling silent stories of those who misjudged the climb. The air here hangs heavy and still, smelling of wet slate and old bone. Shadows twist unnaturally against the curved walls as your lantern flickers against the damp draft. Several passages branch away into the dark architecture, each promising a different route toward the heart of the machinery.

exits.label: Clear the jammed metal beam ahead
Reach for the glowing fungal lantern
Force open the heavy iron bulkhead
Study the old Tidewarden mosaic path

nodes.title: Beneath the Fallen Beam
nodes.brief: You heave a fallen brass beam off a crushed smuggler, testing your strength against rusted metal, claiming a sealed pouch of untainted water as reward.
nodes.page: Iron girders choke the narrow archway and pin the crushed remains of a long-dead smuggler against the masonry. You wedge your shoulder beneath a rusted brass beam, feeling the cold metal bite through your jacket as you strain every muscle. Dust and dried salt shower down from the vaulted ceiling with every fraction of an inch you gain. A sealed leather pouch hangs untouched at the dead man's belt, bulging with the unmistakable shape of precious supplies. You plant your boots firmly against the stone and push with everything you have.

exits.label: Wrench the beam clear of the remains

nodes.title: The Smuggler's Hoard
nodes.brief: You heave a fallen brass beam off a crushed smuggler, testing your strength against rusted metal, claiming a sealed pouch of untainted water as reward.
nodes.page: The heavy brass beam groans and shifts, sliding sideways with a harsh scrape of metal against stone to clear the blocked path. Beneath the wreckage, the leather pouch lies waiting, its wax seal intact against the creeping damp. You slip the cord from the dead smuggler's belt and tuck the prize safely into your own pack. The air feels slightly fresher here, drawn through a narrow vent that opens somewhere toward the lower foundations. Stepping past the ruin, you prepare for the next turn in the winding descent.

nodes.title: The Smuggler's Beam
nodes.brief: You heave a fallen brass beam off a crushed smuggler, testing your strength against rusted metal, claiming a sealed pouch of untainted water as reward.
nodes.page: Crushed timber and green-rotted canvas pin the dead smuggler to the basalt floor of the stairwell, trapping a leather water-skin beneath his ribs. Heavy condensation drips from the damp vault above, pooling in the grease that smears your palms as you grip the cold, square-headed brass beam. Every muscle in your back knots and trembles, straining against centuries of accumulated silt and jammed masonry. You brace your boots hard against a rib of ancient iron, heave upward with all your strength to break the dead weight free, and wait for the metal to either groan and yield or snap your spine.

nodes.title: Crushed Underfoot
nodes.brief: You heave a fallen brass beam off a crushed smuggler, testing your strength against rusted metal, claiming a sealed pouch of untainted water as reward.
nodes.page: The rusted metal suddenly slips from your grip with a sharp screech, dropping back onto the stone with a force that rattles your teeth. A jagged edge catches your forearm, tearing through cloth and skin to draw a hot line of blood. You stumble backward into the damp wall, gasping for air as pain flares through your arm. The lost time and sudden injury leave you shaken, but you manage to yank the sealed pouch free from the debris before pressing onward.

exits.label: Retreat slightly to bind the wound

nodes.title: The Sealed Pouch
nodes.brief: You heave a fallen brass beam off a crushed smuggler, testing your strength against rusted metal, claiming a sealed pouch of untainted water as reward.
nodes.page: Metal screams against stone as you lift, and the crushed ribs give up their prize into your waiting fingers. A thick-skinned pouch of treated ox-hide slides from beneath the wreckage, smelling faintly of old brine and mountain mint rather than the flat stagnation of the Low. Inside lies a full day's ration of sweet, cool water untouched by the bitter salt-crust of the abandoned seabed. Tucking the prize against your ribs, you turn your back on the crushed smuggler and begin the long, careful climb back toward the echoing basalt landings.

nodes.title: The Fungal Shelf
nodes.brief: You brave a crumbling ledge to retrieve a glowing fungal lantern, steadying your trembling hands to gain a light source that never requires oil.
nodes.page: A narrow stone ledge juts out over a pitch-black chasm, its surface slick with slimy phosphorescent moss that casts a sickly green glow. Suspended from a rusted iron bracket at the far end hangs a wild cluster of bioluminescent fungi, throbbing with a steady, pulsing light. No oil feeds the uncanny bloom, making it a priceless prize for anyone brave enough to cross the drop. The stone beneath your boots crumbles silently into the abyss below at the slightest touch.

exits.label: Step carefully along the narrow ledge

nodes.title: The Fungal Glow
nodes.brief: You brave a crumbling ledge to retrieve a glowing fungal lantern, steadying your trembling hands to gain a light source that never requires oil.
nodes.page: Thin air rattles in your lungs as you inch along a six-inch lip of crumbling mortar, hundreds of feet above the dark abyss of the Sunken Stair. Below your boots, loose scree rattles into the vertical blackness with no answering clatter of bottom. Suspended directly over the void on a broken iron bracket hangs a pale, swollen bulb of fungus, casting a steady, cold turquoise luminescence across the sheer damp wall. You force your racing heart to slow, press your shoulder flat against the weeping stone, and reach out an unsteady hand toward the dangling stalk.

nodes.title: Slipping the Ledge
nodes.brief: You brave a crumbling ledge to retrieve a glowing fungal lantern, steadying your trembling hands to gain a light source that never requires oil.
nodes.page: A patch of wet moss betrays your footing, sending loose gravel clattering down into the unseen depths with a hollow sound. You throw your weight against the rock face, scraping your shoulder raw as you scramble for a secure handhold. The fungal lantern swings wildly on its bracket, spilling a shower of cold spores across your face before you finally manage to steady yourself. You claim the glowing prize, but the near-fall leaves your nerves frayed and your breath coming in ragged gasps.

nodes.title: The Pale Lantern
nodes.brief: You brave a crumbling ledge to retrieve a glowing fungal lantern, steadying your trembling hands to gain a light source that never requires oil.
nodes.page: Cold phosphor rubs off on your fingertips and leaves a faint luminous smear across your skin. The bulb hangs snug in its iron cage, thrumming with a silent, internal pulse that feeds on the damp salt-mist without a drop of whale-oil or tallow. Its steady turquoise glare pushes back the clinging shadows of the stairwell, turning the wet stone into a map of jagged crevices and hidden nails. With the pulsing light secured in your grip, you retrace your steps along the ledge and head back toward the upper landings.

nodes.title: Rust and Seal
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed iron bulkhead door leading to a forgotten guard post, straining your muscles to discover a heavy harpoon tipped in black glass.
nodes.page: Heavy iron studs crust the bulkhead door like barnacles on a sunken spar. You throw your shoulder against the corroded hinge, planting your boots on the damp stone until your calves tremble with the strain. Metal groans against metal, spraying orange flakes into the drafty gloom of the stairwell. Inside, a narrow guard post smells of stale tallow and ancient salt. You press forward to inspect the gloom.

exits.label: Slide through the narrow iron gap

nodes.title: The Guard Post
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed iron bulkhead door leading to a forgotten guard post, straining your muscles to discover a heavy harpoon tipped in black glass.
nodes.page: Dim phosphor light catches the edge of a racked weapons bench inside the abandoned shelter. Dust coats every surface like fine grey ash, undisturbed since the day the sea withdrew. You step past a rotting leather stool, your fingers trailing along the damp stone wall for any sign of movement or hidden hazards. The air tastes of stagnant bilge and cold iron. Deeper in the shadows, something long and dark rests against the back timber.

exits.label: Reach for the weapon in the dark

nodes.title: Wrenched Iron
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed iron bulkhead door leading to a forgotten guard post, straining your muscles to discover a heavy harpoon tipped in black glass.
nodes.page: Tendons strain in your forearms as you grip the rusted latch of the inner locker, putting your full weight into the heave to break the seal. The old iron resists with a shrieking grind that echoes up the vertical shaft, threatening to jam permanently or snap the retaining pin. Sweat beads on your forehead despite the subterranean chill as you brace your feet and push harder against the unyielding metal.

check.label: Heave the jammed iron bulkhead open

nodes.title: Heavy Cost
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed iron bulkhead door leading to a forgotten guard post, straining your muscles to discover a heavy harpoon tipped in black glass.
nodes.page: The rusted latch gives way with a sudden, vicious snap that sends you stumbling backward against the rough stone wall. A jagged edge of iron catches your forearm, tearing through your sleeve and leaving a hot, stinging gash that oozes dark blood. You clutch your arm, wincing as the salt-laden air bites into the raw skin. Though your breath comes ragged and the wound throbs with a dull ache, you push yourself upright.

exits.label: Collect the heavy harpoon despite the pain

nodes.title: Deep Iron Barbed
nodes.brief: You force open a jammed iron bulkhead door leading to a forgotten guard post, straining your muscles to discover a heavy harpoon tipped in black glass.
nodes.page: Your fingers wrap around the cold, salt-pitted shaft of the heavy harpoon resting against the locker wall. The point is forged from dull black glass, sharp enough to pierce the thickest hide of any creature prowling the dry seabed. You slide it free from its mount, feeling its balanced weight settle into your palm as a grim safeguard for the dark miles ahead.

exits.label: Descend toward the silent tide bell

nodes.title: Ribs of the Leviathan
nodes.brief: You cross a bridge of decaying whalebone suspended over a terrifying drop, maintaining absolute calm to secure a perfectly preserved coil of silk rope.
nodes.page: Giant yellowed ribs arch overhead like the vault of a drowned cathedral, framing the dizzying drop into the bowels of the stairwell. Each footstep on the old whalebone bridge sends a hollow vibration up through the soles of your boots. Below you, the abyss stretches endlessly downward, filled with the faint sound of dripping water and distant, mournful echoes. You keep your eyes fixed on the far side of the span.

nodes.title: The Swinging Span
nodes.brief: You cross a bridge of decaying whalebone suspended over a terrifying drop, maintaining absolute calm to secure a perfectly preserved coil of silk rope.
nodes.page: A sudden gust of updraft catches your coat, making the suspension ropes groan and sway above the unseen chasm. You lower your center of gravity, spreading your weight evenly across the porous surface of the ancient vertebrae. Every instinct warns against rushing, urging absolute stillness between each measured step. The air grows colder and damper the further you move from the stone threshold.

exits.label: Step carefully onto solid stone again

nodes.title: Breath on the Edge
nodes.brief: You cross a bridge of decaying whalebone suspended over a terrifying drop, maintaining absolute calm to secure a perfectly preserved coil of silk rope.
nodes.page: A sharp tremor rattles the suspension anchors, sending a shower of bone dust down into the black void below. You freeze mid-stride, centering your weight over the narrowest part of the span as the entire walkway sways rhythmically in the rising draught. Your heart hammers against your ribs like a trapped bird, but you force your breathing to slow, refusing to let panic dictate your balance.

check.label: Maintain absolute calm across the chasm

nodes.title: Shaken Balance
nodes.brief: You cross a bridge of decaying whalebone suspended over a terrifying drop, maintaining absolute calm to secure a perfectly preserved coil of silk rope.
nodes.page: A sudden lurch of the bridge throws you sideways, forcing you to drop to your hands and knees on the slick bone surface. Your shoulder slams hard against a protruding rib, knocking the wind from your chest and leaving a deep, aching bruise. You cling tightly to the porous marrow until the swaying subsides, swallowing the metallic taste of fear in your mouth before crawling the final yards to safety.

nodes.title: Silken Strand
nodes.brief: You cross a bridge of decaying whalebone suspended over a terrifying drop, maintaining absolute calm to secure a perfectly preserved coil of silk rope.
nodes.page: Your hand closes around a tightly wound coil of salt-resistant silk rope resting atop a stone bollard. The fibers are remarkably supple, showing no rot despite decades in the damp salt air. You sling the coil over your shoulder, feeling the reassuring heft of reliable cordage that might well mean the difference between climbing back out of the deep or remaining down here forever.

exits.label: Approach the colossal silent bell platform

nodes.title: Mosaic of the Tidewardens
nodes.brief: You study a mosaic of the old Tidewardens to deduce the correct pressure plate path, using your sharp mind to uncover a hidden cache of medicinal kelp.
nodes.page:
Faded enamel tiles map the old dynasty's sea-lanes across the floor, each square depicting a legendary tide-command. You trace the sequence with a soot-stained thumb, reading the subtle wear patterns where ancient pilgrims knelt. The correct path shimmers under a film of dried brine, leading directly toward a recessed alcove choked with pale, leathery fronds.

Reaching into the shadows past the mosaic, your fingers brush against a damp cluster of preserved kelp, still slick with medicinal sap. You stow the dark green leaves inside your canvas satchel, knowing their bitter juices can staunch a deep salt-rot wound before the chill settles into your bones.

nodes.title: Decoding the Floor Plates
nodes.brief: You study a mosaic of the old Tidewardens to deduce the correct pressure plate path, using your sharp mind to uncover a hidden cache of medicinal kelp.
nodes.page: Glaring fractures crack the porcelain tiles beneath your boots, threatening to trigger the counterweights hidden just below the masonry. You scan the chipped mosaic symbols, calculating the exact weight distribution required to bypass the sunken tripwires. Every second you linger, more lime dust filters down from the vaulted ceiling and finds your eyes as you prepare to step.

nodes.title: Sinking into the Trap
nodes.brief: You study a mosaic of the old Tidewardens to deduce the correct pressure plate path, using your sharp mind to uncover a hidden cache of medicinal kelp.
nodes.page: A metallic snap under your heel as a false stone gives way. Your boot drops into a narrow grease-lined pit. Sharp iron teeth clamp shut against your shin, tear a ragged line through your trousers, and draw a dark line of blood. You wrench your leg free with a desperate heave. A strip of wool and a spray of crimson stay behind in the darkness. The trap resets with a hollow thud.

nodes.title: Secrets of the Paved Floor
nodes.brief: You study a mosaic of the old Tidewardens to deduce the correct pressure plate path, using your sharp mind to uncover a hidden cache of medicinal kelp.
nodes.page: Weight shifts evenly across the cool porcelain tiles, your cautious steps finding the exact hollow joints where the ancient mortar has crumbled away. Beneath a loose slab, your fingers close around a bundle of damp, salt-cured kelp wrapped in oiled sailcloth. The leaves are pliable and cool to the touch, retaining their healing moisture despite decades of suffocating dark. You tuck the bundle securely into your pack, your pulse steadying as the narrow corridor opens ahead.

nodes.title: The Silent Bronze Bell
nodes.brief: The temperature plummets as you reach a platform dominated by a colossal, silent bell that once tolled the changing of the tides.
nodes.page: Frost glazes the massive iron handrails as the shaft opens onto a cavernous amphitheatre carved straight into the living stone of the sea-bed. Suspended from the towering arches above hangs a monstrous bronze bell, its surface pitted with greenish verdigris and scarred by centuries of salt-spray. It has not rung since the water vanished, yet the dead air around it hums with a low, bone-deep vibration that sets your teeth on edge. Piles of bleached shells and discarded carapaces crunch beneath your boots as you step onto the vast terrace, dwarfed by the silent instrument of the deep.

nodes.title: The Bell Toll Terrace
nodes.brief: The Bell Toll: An expansive stone terrace surrounds the silent bronze bell, its surface etched with deep grooves and guarded by aggressive, oversized scavenger crabs.
nodes.page: Scavenger crabs the size of wagon wheels scuttle across the flagstones, and their clustered eyes catch the faint bioluminescence clinging to the damp walls. A sea chest sits jammed to the left beneath a fallen gargoyle. The bronze bell broods ahead. It fills the centre of the stone circle, and its rusted clapper begs a closer look while narrow stairwells and shadowed alcoves branch off into the gloom of the salt-crusted ruins where the air grows colder still.

nodes.title: The Carapace Shield
nodes.brief: You wrestle a massive pale crab away from a hollowed-out sea chest, using pure force to secure a pair of heavy brass diving gauntlets.
nodes.page: Razor-sharp claws slash through the dim air, missing your throat by a hair as you drive your shoulder hard into the underside of the massive pale crab. The creature clicks in fury, its heavy shell scraping against the flagstones as you force it back from the wooden chest. You wedge your heel into its hinge-joint, twisting the beast off balance until it skitters away into the dark, leaving the prize unguarded.

nodes.title: Wrestling the Brine-Crab
nodes.brief: You wrestle a massive pale crab away from a hollowed-out sea chest, using pure force to secure a pair of heavy brass diving gauntlets.
nodes.page: A mountain of pale chitin blocks your path to the iron-bound chest, its heavy claws snapping like iron shears in the damp air. You hurl your full weight against its armored side, your muscles straining to flip the beast before it clamps onto your arm. The shell is slick with cold slime, offering precious little grip as the creature rears up to strike.

nodes.title: Pinioned by the Claws
nodes.brief: You wrestle a massive pale crab away from a hollowed-out sea chest, using pure force to secure a pair of heavy brass diving gauntlets.
nodes.page: A blinding pinch catches your forearm as the crustacean's pincer closes through your sleeve, biting deep into the flesh.
