You grunt through clenched teeth, swinging the butt of your heavy iron pry-bar against its eyestalk until the beast releases its grip with a wet shriek. Blood wells from the ragged notch in your arm, warm and sticky against the freezing air, leaving you bruised and gasping for breath on the wet stone.

nodes.title: Prize of the Carapace
nodes.brief: You wrestle a massive pale crab away from a hollowed-out sea chest, using pure force to secure a pair of heavy brass diving gauntlets.
nodes.page: Bracing your boots against the slimy flagstones, you heave the massive beast over onto its back, its claw thrashing harmlessly against the empty air. You wrench the water-swollen lid of the sea chest open, your fingers sinking past damp wool to close around a pair of heavy brass diving gauntlets. The metal is cold and scored with salt-burns, fitted with reinforced knuckle-plates that gleam dimly in the gloom. You slip them onto your hands, feeling their reassuring weight settle over your fingers as you step back onto the terrace.

nodes.title: The Rusted Clapper
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle the rusted clapper mechanism of the great bell, using your tools to extract a flawless resonating crystal useful for bartering.
nodes.page: Iron corrosion flakes away like dried scales under the edge of your blade as you start on the bronze clapper suspended inside the bell housing. Salt has welded the joints into a stubborn mass, demanding patient, careful leverage rather than brute force. Every tap of your hammer echoes hollowly down the spiralling stone corridor, bouncing off damp masonry and stale air. You wedge a narrow cold chisel into the primary hinge, applying steady pressure until the ancient metal finally gives a sharp, protesting groan.

nodes.title: Extracting the Resonant Core
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle the rusted clapper mechanism of the great bell, using your tools to extract a flawless resonating crystal useful for bartering.
nodes.page: Deep within the heart of the iron assembly lies a milky quartz crystal, snug against the bronze and shimmering with a faint, trapped luminescence. Your fingers work methodically around its mounting brackets, brushing away centuries of grey silt and encrusted salt crystals that threaten to scratch the delicate mineral surface. The chamber feels intensely still, save for the distant, phantom dripping of water somewhere far below in the sunless shaft. With a final twist of your pliers, the mineral block slips free from its housing into your waiting palm, cool and humming with a faint internal vibration.

nodes.title: Silence the Iron Tongue
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle the rusted clapper mechanism of the great bell, using your tools to extract a flawless resonating crystal useful for bartering.
nodes.page: Slipping your slenderest scraping tool into the hairline seam of the bell's internal locking nut, you hold your breath as you apply torsional force. The rusted threading binds instantly, threatening to snap the delicate steel tip inside the ancient machinery. A sudden shudder runs through the hanging bronze above you, as if the massive dead bell itself objects to your intrusion. You lean your weight into the tool, fingers slick with cold sweat, trying to coax the rusted bolt past its final thread without shattering the precious crystal hidden inside.

check.label: Unseat the crystal without snapping steel

nodes.title: A Shattered Prize
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle the rusted clapper mechanism of the great bell, using your tools to extract a flawless resonating crystal useful for bartering.
nodes.page: Metal screams against metal as the stubborn pin shears off mid-turn, sending a sharp shard of hot iron slicing across the back of your hand. Blood wells instantly into the salt-crusted skin, stinging sharply in the damp air as you pull your arm back with a sharp hiss. The valuable crystal fractures down its middle with a dry pop, its inner glow winking out into a dull, grey opacity. You are left sucking at the bleeding scratch in the gloom, richer by only a jagged stone and a fresh, throbbing ache in your knuckles.

nodes.title: The Flawless Core
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle the rusted clapper mechanism of the great bell, using your tools to extract a flawless resonating crystal useful for bartering.
nodes.page: Steel scrapes brass as the retaining bracket yields at last and turns smoothly in your grip despite centuries of decay. You slide the milk-white mineral free from its iron cradle and catch it before it can drop onto the flags. It sits whole in your hand, a captive bead of cold light that shows the deep scoring on your calloused palms. Any wary scavenger along the coast will trade a purse of coin or safe passage for an artifact like this.

exits.label: Step back out to the terrace

nodes.title: Marks in the Bronze
nodes.brief: You decipher the weathered tally marks carved into the bell housing, realizing a hidden compartment contains a detailed chart of the deeper shaft.
nodes.page: Faint, purposeful scratches catch your eye where the salt has worn thin near the base of the massive bell housing. Weathered tally marks show through. Someone long dead carved them. Your fingers trace the jagged lines and note how they group and repeat in patterns that mirror the winding descent of the Sunken Stair below. A small, square panel right beneath the lowest notch sits slightly recessed from the surrounding masonry. The catch sits out of casual sight.

nodes.title: Decoding the Tally
nodes.brief: You decipher the weathered tally marks carved into the bell housing, realizing a hidden compartment contains a detailed chart of the deeper shaft.
nodes.page: Squinting against the gloom, you examine the sequence of deep notches and directional arrows etched into the verdigris-stained metal. Each stroke seems to mark a pressure point or counter-weight release within the vertical shaft, set down by some careful predecessor. You press your thumb against the final, heavily worn groove, trying to determine if it acts as a spring-loaded latch or a dead-bolt that requires a precise, measured push to slide open without triggering a trap.

nodes.title: The Trapped Spring
nodes.brief: You decipher the weathered tally marks carved into the bell housing, realizing a hidden compartment contains a detailed chart of the deeper shaft.
nodes.page: A sharp metallic snap echoes off the damp stone walls as your thumb depresses the wrong notch, releasing a rusted internal spring with brutal force. The hidden panel slams shut violently, catching the edge of your thumbnail and pinning your hand against the rough iron housing in a vice-like grip. You curse under your breath, wrenching your fingers free with a sickening tug that leaves your nail bruised dark and bleeding into the grit. The compartment remains firmly locked, mocking your miscalculation.

nodes.title: Secrets of the Shaft
nodes.brief: You decipher the weathered tally marks carved into the bell housing, realizing a hidden compartment contains a detailed chart of the deeper shaft.
nodes.page: The concealed panel gives way with a soft, pneumatic hiss, swinging open on hidden hinges to reveal a dry, oil-preserved leather cylinder tucked safely inside. You pull it free and unroll the stiff hide on the flat stone rim, revealing a remarkably detailed chart of the lower chambers, noting every known drop-off, sealed door, and air pocket marked in faded ink. It is a prize that turns the blind descent into a calculated route, saving hours of hazardous guesswork in the dark.
nodes.grant: Detailed chart of the deep shaft

nodes.title: Breaking the Barnacle Wall
nodes.brief: You smash through a calcified wall of barnacles blocking a side alcove, driving your shoulders forward to uncover a stash of salted provisions.
nodes.page: Generations of calcified marine growth have sealed a shallow side alcove completely shut, forming a thick, grey mound of stone-hard shells against the corridor wall. You set your jaw, plant your boots on the damp flagstones, and draw in a deep breath of the stale brine air. Bracing your shoulder against the center of the crust, you slam your full weight forward into the barrier, listening to the sharp crunch of shattered shells giving way beneath the sudden impact.

exits.label: Smash through the calcified shell barrier

nodes.title: Clearing the Sealed Alcove
nodes.brief: You smash through a calcified wall of barnacles blocking a side alcove, driving your shoulders forward to uncover a stash of salted provisions.
nodes.page: Driving your shoulder repeatedly into the stubborn crust of barnacles, you feel the solid mass begin to fracture along invisible stress lines within the old mortar. Sharp edges of ancient shell bite through your heavy canvas jacket, scoring the skin beneath as you put every ounce of muscle into forcing the blockade inward. The wall groans and shifts, threatening to collapse entirely upon your boots or give way to whatever stagnant air has pooled behind the barrier for years.

nodes.title: Crushed by the Shells
nodes.brief: You smash through a calcified wall of barnacles blocking a side alcove, driving your shoulders forward to uncover a stash of salted provisions.
nodes.page: The calcified mass collapses inward all at once, but your momentum carries you too far into the jagged opening as a heavy shelf of stone-hard barnacles shears off and pins your leg to the floor. A sharp pain flares through your shin as the jagged edges tear through your trousers, drawing a warm line of blood down to your ankle. Long minutes pass while you lever the debris off your limb, then you crawl from the alcove dusty, bruised, and nursing a raw scrape.

exits.label: Crawl back out to the terrace

nodes.title: Hidden Rations
nodes.brief: You smash through a calcified wall of barnacles blocking a side alcove, driving your shoulders forward to uncover a stash of salted provisions.
nodes.page: The barrier caves inward with a satisfying crash, scattering dry white shell dust across the flagstones and revealing a small, dry alcove untouched by the encroaching damp. Tucked safely inside sits a tightly sealed canvas bundle bearing the old wax stamp of the Gullmouth Wreckers' Guild. Untying the cord reveals a cache of hard biscuit and salted mutton, remarkably preserved and smelling strongly of old tallow and dried pepper. It is a welcome windfall for anyone facing a long journey down into the sunless depths.

exits.label: Head back to the stone terrace

nodes.title: Song from the Pit
nodes.brief: A haunting melody drifts upward from the abyss, echoing off the damp walls as the first pale members of the Hollow Choir emerge from the gloom.
nodes.page: Cold water drips from the moss-choked vault above, carrying the faint metallic tang of deep rust and old salt. From the spiralling abyss beneath your boots a thin reedy vibration climbs and sets your teeth on edge. It is a chord of many voices, and they harmonise in a language spoken only by things that have forgotten the sky. Pale shapes detach from the weeping stonework. Their waterlogged garments hang with silt and clinging weed. These are the ones who never left, and they guard the descent with mouths open in perpetual silent song.

exits.label: Descend into the echoing lower tiers

nodes.title: The Whispering Tiers
nodes.brief: The Whispering Tiers: Waterlogged priests of the Hollow Choir block the downward path, their voices intertwining in a maddening song that threatens to drown your thoughts.
nodes.page: Gloom wraps tightly around the stone steps as the vanguard of the Hollow Choir forms a shifting wall of damp wool and bloated flesh. Their endless chant reverberates within your skull, threatening to dissolve every coherent thought into a wash of brine and sorrow. Below them, the spiral staircase plunges deeper into the roaring dark toward the great mechanism. You can force a brutal path through their ranks by sheer muscle, or attempt to outwit their hypnotic cadence with a clever distraction. The chorus waits, swaying in unison with the nonexistent tides.

exits.label: Force a passage through the choristers
Distract the singing assembly with noise
Endure the piercing gaze without flinching
Slip past into the outer workings

nodes.title: Torn Silver
nodes.brief: You violently push your way through the grasping hands of a bloated chorister, using brute strength to rip a silver amulet from its neck.
nodes.page: Salt-rimed fingers graze your collar, cold as winter weed, but you twist away with a sharp heave of breath and snag a fold of damp fabric to wrench the figure forward into the dim light. A tarnished silver pendant hangs from its swollen neck. It catches the faint phosphorescence of the damp walls. You tug hard against the chain. The metal links snap with a dry crack off the vaulted masonry, and the chorister murmurs, "The links are broken," in a low wet breath that smells of stagnant harbour mud.

exits.label: Climb higher among the weeping stones

nodes.title: Breaking the Grip
nodes.brief: You violently push your way through the grasping hands of a bloated chorister, using brute strength to rip a silver amulet from its neck.
nodes.page: Heavy, waterlogged arms close around your chest like bands of wet iron, dragging you backward into the crushing press of the assembly. You plant your boots firmly against the slick flagstones, gathering every ounce of strain in your muscles to shatter their collective hold. Bracing your shoulder against the nearest bloated chest, you prepare to hurl your entire weight forward against the tide of bodies.

check.label: Wrench free from the grasping choir

nodes.title: Dragged to the Silt
nodes.brief: You violently push your way through the grasping hands of a bloated chorister, using brute strength to rip a silver amulet from its neck.
nodes.page: The collective weight proves too great, dragging your boots out from under you as you crash hard against the mossy stones. Choking spray fills your lungs, and a jagged edge of masonry tears a deep, burning gash across your forearm. You kick out wildly, catching a pale jaw with your heel, and scramble back to your feet while the choir regains its rhythm. The struggle costs you precious breath and leaves a stinging red reminder of the depths.

nodes.title: A Token of Resistance
nodes.brief: You violently push your way through the grasping hands of a bloated chorister, using brute strength to rip a silver amulet from its neck.
nodes.page: Breaking free from the clutching hands with a final, desperate heave, you stagger forward onto drier stone, breathing raggedly. A pewter crucifix torn from the vestments of the lead chorister sits clutched in your fist, cold and slick with river slime. The haunting melody fades slightly into the background damp, leaving your ears ringing with a dry, pulsing silence. You drop the trinket into your pocket as proof of your passage through the lower gloom.

exits.label: Return to the upper tier landing

nodes.title: Scrap Metal Harmony
nodes.brief: You assemble a crude noisemaker from scrap metal to disrupt their unified chanting, earning safe passage and a vial of sacred anointing oil.
nodes.page: Shivering in the damp draft, you pull loose pieces of rusted iron and discarded bell-metal from your pack, wiring them together with stiff copper wire. Striking the makeshift contraption against the stone wall produces a jagged, discordant screech that cuts right through the mournful harmony of the choir. The waterlogged priests hesitate, their voices faltering as the harsh metallic clatter scrambles their overlapping tones. In the sudden confusion, a small clay flask of clear anointing oil rolls across the flags toward your boots.

nodes.title: Tuning the Discord
nodes.brief: You assemble a crude noisemaker from scrap metal to disrupt their unified chanting, earning safe passage and a vial of sacred anointing oil.
nodes.page: Quick fingers bend the jagged scrap metal into alignment, testing the tension of the wire with frantic precision as the choir's chant swells back toward a crescendo. You raise the crude instrument into the draft, waiting for the exact moment when the acoustic resonance of the stairwell will amplify the false note. A single false turn of the wire will blend your noise into their song instead of shattering it.

nodes.title: False Notes
nodes.brief: You assemble a crude noisemaker from scrap metal to disrupt their unified chanting, earning safe passage and a vial of sacred anointing oil.
nodes.page: The wire slips from your numb fingers with a sharp ping, tangling hopelessly just as the choir unleashes a wave of resonant sound. The sudden feedback strikes your eardrums like a physical blow, sending you stumbling against the damp wall with a bruised shoulder and a ringing head. Splinters of rusted iron scatter across the flagstones, lost in the murky water pooling at the edge of the stair. You bite back a curse and push onward through the lingering echoes.

exits.label: Recover your wits on the landing

nodes.title: The Oil Flask
nodes.brief: You assemble a crude noisemaker from scrap metal to disrupt their unified chanting, earning safe passage and a vial of sacred anointing oil.
nodes.page: The makeshift contraption holds together just long enough to emit a piercing, rhythmic screech that breaks the hypnotic spell of the singing dead. They recoil into the shadows, hissing like trapped eels as you step cleanly past their ragged circle into the clearer air below. Resting in the recess where they stood is a small, sealed vial of clear anointing oil left by some forgotten pilgrim. You pocket the glass container before the choir can resume its dismal tune.

nodes.title: The Unblinking Master
nodes.brief: You endure the piercing gaze of the choir master without flinching, hardening your mind against the song to earn a cryptic blessing of protection.
nodes.page: Salt-crusted eyelids refuse to twitch as the choir master leans forward, his hollow sockets fixed on your face. The howling dirge washes over your temples like cold bilge water and tries to scour reason from your skull. You lock your jaw against it and stare straight into the darkness of his hood. A slow, rasping sigh rises from the assembled dead. The master raises a gray, webbed finger and traces a damp cross upon your brow. The noise behind your eyes goes still.

nodes.title: Staring Down the Wail
nodes.brief: You endure the piercing gaze of the choir master without flinching, hardening your mind against the song to earn a cryptic blessing of protection.
nodes.page: That pale, unblinking stare pins you to the slick stone while the choir shifts from a dull murmur to a shrieking wall of sound that rattles your teeth. Every instinct screams to tear your gaze away and plunge your hands over your ears before your sanity cracks down the middle. You fight the overwhelming urge to bolt, forcing your breath to steady as you meet the lead singer's empty glare head-on, testing whether your spirit can outlast a legion of the drowned.

nodes.title: Scoured by the Dirge
nodes.brief: You endure the piercing gaze of the choir master without flinching, hardening your mind against the song to earn a cryptic blessing of protection.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of sonic fury shatters your concentration, driving a spike of white-hot agony through your temples that leaves your ears ringing with the taste of old copper. You stagger backward against the damp masonry, clutching your head as a thin trickle of dark blood winds down your neck. The pain is sharp and lingering, a dull throb that settles deep behind your eyes as a harsh reminder of what the dead demand from the living.

nodes.title: The Drowned Blessing
nodes.brief: You endure the piercing gaze of the choir master without flinching, hardening your mind against the song to earn a cryptic blessing of protection.
nodes.page: Your persistence forces the lead singer to lower his chin in grudging recognition. He reaches into the folds of his rotting vestments and withdraws a small, salt-cured talisman shaped like a coiled whelk, pressing it into your palm with fingers as cold as winter iron. The object hums faintly against your skin, carrying a residual ward that dampens the worst of the subterranean echoes as you leave the chamber behind.

nodes.title: Iron and Oil
nodes.brief: Leaving the choir behind, the stairs transition from stone to massive cogs and gears, indicating you have entered the outer workings of the great machine.
nodes.page: The spiral of worn stone gives way to colossal walls of riveted bronze and rusted iron: the true boundary of the Sunken Stair's inner mechanism. Massive counterweights hang in the dim gloom like slaughtered leviathans, held by chains as wide as a wrecker's waist and coated in black grease that smells of ancient whale oil. Metal underfoot shakes with a bone-deep knock that says immense power sits just beyond your reach. Steam vents hiss from narrow gaps in the bulkheads and throw hot, blinding plumes across the rusted catwalks that stretch out over the void.

nodes.title: The Grinding Descent
nodes.brief: The Grinding Descent: Massive stationary gears form precarious walkways over a bottomless drop, slick with ancient grease and populated by territorial blind eels.
nodes.page: Giant stationary gears form precarious, jagged bridges over a bottomless drop, slick with ancient grease and populated by territorial blind eels that snap from the shadows. To your left, a rotating shaft hums with lethal speed while a pale pearl gleams temptingly within a nest of wire. Straight ahead, a skeletal mechanic hangs upside down from a snapped harness, clutching a peculiar tuning fork. Below a sputtering steam pipe, a puddle of condensed freshwater begs to be salvaged into empty canteens. Deeper still, a sprawling archive of drowned ledgers blocks the main route, guarded by an automaton with glowing glass eyes.

nodes.title: The Jammed Cog
nodes.brief: You physically wedge a jammed cogwheel back into alignment to cross a gap, relying on raw power to discover a heavy iron maintenance key.
nodes.page: A massive iron wheel sits stubbornly wedged between two bulkheads, bringing a secondary sector of the machinery to a complete, ominous halt. Grasping the jagged spokes with both hands, you brace your boots against the slick plating and throw your full weight into the metal. Muscles strain against the unyielding rust until a sharp report echoes through the shaft; the gear groans back into motion and shows a maintenance key buried in the grease beneath its axle.

nodes.title: Turning the Iron
nodes.brief: You physically wedge a jammed cogwheel back into alignment to cross a gap, relying on raw power to discover a heavy iron maintenance key.
nodes.page: Gripping the newly found key, you clamber across a network of vibrating pipes to reach the maintenance panel set into the central pillar. The rusted lock offers initial resistance, protesting with a screech of dry iron before the internal tumblers finally yield to your persistence. Inside the recess lies a series of heavy brass levers, caked in salt and waiting to dictate the flow of pressure through the looming apparatus above.

nodes.title: Bracing the Slip
nodes.brief: You physically wedge a jammed cogwheel back into alignment to cross a gap, relying on raw power to discover a heavy iron maintenance key.
nodes.page: The entire catwalk shudders violently as the machinery below shifts its weight, threatening to shear your footing away and drop you into the dark machinery wells. You slam your shoulder against the vibrating iron frame, digging your heels into the greasy plating with all your strength to keep the structural beam from buckling under the sudden strain. Every muscle in your torso burns as you pit your raw power against the shifting iron.

nodes.title: Strain of Iron
nodes.brief: You physically wedge a jammed cogwheel back into alignment to cross a gap, relying on raw power to discover a heavy iron maintenance key.
nodes.page: Raw muscle meets ancient metal with a bone-jarring shriek that echoes down the damp stone shaft. A rusted tooth of the cog catches your shoulder plate, biting hard through leather and wool to score a fresh red line across your flesh. You grunt against the pain, heaving your weight until the iron gear groans and snaps grudgingly into alignment. Your breathing comes ragged in the chill air, and your grip feels slippery with your own warm blood, but the heavy iron maintenance key drops heavily into your palm from the jammed housing.

exits.label: Pry the rusted maintenance hatch open

nodes.title: The Iron Wedge
nodes.brief: You physically wedge a jammed cogwheel back into alignment to cross a gap, relying on raw power to discover a heavy iron maintenance key.
nodes.page: You wedge the component back into alignment, and the surrounding machinery settles with a solid thud that restores the walkway. Wedged firmly in the mechanism's housing is a thick, square-headed iron peg stamped with the old Tidewarden seal, forged from rust-resistant alloy that will never corrode in the brine. You pry it free from the housing and tuck it securely into your belt, knowing such solid metal will prove invaluable before your journey ends.

nodes.title: The Greasy Axis
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a rotating shaft while ignoring the snapping jaws of blind eels, keeping steady to pluck a valuable pearl from a nest.
nodes.page: Heavy iron collars rotate in the gloom with a rhythmic, bone-deep thrum that vibrates through the soles of your boots. Slick black grease coats the cylindrical housing, smelling of ancient tallow and stagnant bottom-water. Beneath the rolling metal spine, pale blind eels coil in nests of rusted copper wire, their lidless eyes milky and their jaws snapping reflexively at the dark grease. You crouch low, testing the slick curve of the axle with your palms while waiting for the gap between rotating braces to widen just enough for a desperate scramble.

nodes.title: Snapping Jaws Below
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a rotating shaft while ignoring the snapping jaws of blind eels, keeping steady to pluck a valuable pearl from a nest.
nodes.page: Cold spray spits from a high fissure somewhere above, turning the grease on the spinning shaft into a treacherous paste. Each rotation threatens to sweep your boots off the curved iron, pitching you straight into the writhing tangle of blind eels waiting in the dark void beneath. You tuck your elbows tight against your ribs and slide forward on your belly, using your forearms to gauge the speed of the grinding metal while your fingers brush against a damp nest wedged into a service bracket.

nodes.title: Plucking the Pearl
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a rotating shaft while ignoring the snapping jaws of blind eels, keeping steady to pluck a valuable pearl from a nest.
nodes.page: A milky glob as large as a gull egg rests in the center of the eel-infested nest, pulsing with a faint, bioluminescent violet light. As you slide your hand past the rim of the bracket, a dozen pale snouts whip upward from the slime, teeth clicking together like iron washers. You hold your breath, anchoring your boots against the vibrating axle while your fingers stretch toward the glowing shell, balancing on a hair-trigger between a clean grab and a nasty bite.

check.label: snatch the pearl from the eels

nodes.title: A Blind Strike
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a rotating shaft while ignoring the snapping jaws of blind eels, keeping steady to pluck a valuable pearl from a nest.
nodes.page: Steel slips against grease, and a pale shape darts from the gloom with shocking speed, sinking needle-teeth deep into the meat of your forearm. Pain flares white-hot as you jerk your arm back, slamming your elbow hard against the iron housing and bruising bone through wool. You scramble backward on your heels, sucking air through your teeth while the eel thrashes back into the dark sump. The wound leaks a slow, hot line of blood down your wrist, stinging fiercely with salt.

exits.label: Climb away from the grease pit

nodes.title: The Blind Eel's Pearl
nodes.brief: You carefully traverse a rotating shaft while ignoring the snapping jaws of blind eels, keeping steady to pluck a valuable pearl from a nest.
nodes.page: Shafts of cold green light filter through the salt-crrusted ironwork as you step carefully across the turning brass axle, ignoring the wet snapping of blind eels striking blindly at your boots. By keeping your breathing shallow and your stance low, you reach into the slime-lined cavity of a dormant valve and pluck out a large, heavy pearl veined with streaks of oil. The smooth, cold sphere pulses faintly against your palm, carrying the trapped chill of a forgotten ocean depth.

exits.label: Climb back to the central junction

nodes.title: The Hanging Harness
nodes.brief: You dangle over the abyss to reach a skeletal mechanic hanging from a harness, holding your breath to retrieve his specialized tuning fork.
nodes.page: A tattered leather strap dangles over the bottomless drop, supporting a small iron frame where a skeletal mechanic still sits slumped inside a rusted safety harness. The figure is long dead, dried to leather by the salt draft, but a peculiar metal implement remains gripped tightly in its rigid fingers. The abyss breathes upward with a cold, hollow roar, making the harness sway gently on its cable like a pendulum over an open grave.

nodes.title: Swinging Over the Abyss
nodes.brief: You dangle over the abyss to reach a skeletal mechanic hanging from a harness, holding your breath to retrieve his specialized tuning fork.
nodes.page: You grip a rusted stay-wire with one hand and lean out over the empty dark, letting your boots drift above the invisible floor of the shaft. Below, the distant grinding of the Meridian Gear echoes like the heartbeat of a buried leviathan. The skeleton rocks in its harness as your fingers brush against its sleeve, sending a shower of flaky salt and dry cloth fragments spiraling down into the black abyss.

exits.label: Pry the metal from stiff fingers

nodes.title: The Tuning Fork
nodes.brief: You dangle over the abyss to reach a skeletal mechanic hanging from a harness, holding your breath to retrieve his specialized tuning fork.
nodes.page: A heavy bronze tuning fork rests in the dead mechanic's hand, its twin tines notched with fine calibrations designed to match the pitch of the great gear's locking pins. As you pry the cold metal from the rigid fingers, the entire supporting wire groans and slips an inch lower into the shaft, throwing your weight off balance over the sheer drop. You freeze instantly, holding every muscle tight as you wait to see if the frayed strands will hold.

nodes.title: A Sudden Drop
nodes.brief: You dangle over the abyss to reach a skeletal mechanic hanging from a harness, holding your breath to retrieve his specialized tuning fork.
nodes.page: The wire snaps with a sharp, metallic ping, and the harness plunges six inches before the safety dog catches with a bone-jarring slam. The sudden jolt wrenches your shoulder joint and rattles your teeth, knocking the breath from your lungs in a harsh gasp. You cling to the cold stay-wire with both arms, trembling as the rusted gearworks above settle back into a groaning equilibrium. Your shoulder aches dully, but you hold the prize.

nodes.title: The Skeleton's Tuning Fork
nodes.brief: You dangle over the abyss to reach a skeletal mechanic hanging from a harness, holding your breath to retrieve his specialized tuning fork.
nodes.page: Metal shudders beneath your fingers as you drop over the open edge of the walkway, dangling by one elbow above the black abyss of the shaft. You swing slightly to catch the harness of a long-dead mechanic slumped against a brass beam, holding your breath against the foul stench of stagnant copper. With careful, trembling fingers, you slip a heavy iron tuning fork from his stiff leather belt just before the entire bracket groans and slips further into the dark.

nodes.title: Steam and Solder
nodes.brief: You repair a fractured steam pipe using scraps of leather and wire, sealing the leak to safely harvest condensed freshwater for your empty canteen.
nodes.page:
Hissing plumes of superheated mist obscure the rusted ladder rungs and smell of boiled iron and old grease. You wrap a length of greasy leather tightly around the fractured joint of the vertical steam pipe and bind it fast with thin copper wire. Water beads against the makeshift bandage. It spits into the gloom.

From your belt you pull the metal canteen and hold its mouth beneath the slow drip of condensed freshwater. Each drop strikes the hollow stairwell like a struck bell. Lukewarm mineral water fills the dry vessel.

nodes.title: Droplets in the Dark
nodes.brief: You repair a fractured steam pipe using scraps of leather and wire, sealing the leak to safely harvest condensed freshwater for your empty canteen.
nodes.page:
Scalding droplets spatter against your knuckles as you press the leather seal harder into the split metal seam, and the shriek of escaping pressure softens to a manageable gurgle once the wire bites into the damp hide. You catch your breath. In the humid damp you wipe sweat and soot from your forehead with a soot-stained sleeve.

Below the leaking joint your canteen fills slowly, ounce by precious ounce, and the sweet moisture leaves the dying machinery for your flask. The metal plates of the walkway take the grind of the Meridian Gear somewhere far beneath. Water beads on the canteen rim.

nodes.title: Binding the Iron Vein
nodes.brief: You repair a fractured steam pipe using scraps of leather and wire, sealing the leak to safely harvest condensed freshwater for your empty canteen.
nodes.page: Boiling vapour scorches your fingers as you yank the copper wire taut with your bare hands, trying to cinch the leather patch over the widening split before the whole joint bursts. The metal screeches in protest, the fracture gaping wider under the mounting pressure of the trapped steam. You must force the stubborn wire to bite into the slick, vibrating pipe without slipping and burning your flesh to the bone.

nodes.title: Scalded and Spent
nodes.brief: You repair a fractured steam pipe using scraps of leather and wire, sealing the leak to safely harvest condensed freshwater for your empty canteen.
nodes.page: The wire slips from your slick fingers with a sharp snap, and a jet of scalding steam lashes across your forearm, leaving a mottled, throbbing burn. You stumble backward against the wet bulkhead, gasping for air as your canteen clatters against the iron grating, spilling half its contents into the dark abyss below. The repair only half holds; a frustrating hiss leaks out, drains what energy you have left, and leaves your skin raw.

nodes.title: A Dry Victory
nodes.brief: You repair a fractured steam pipe using scraps of leather and wire, sealing the leak to safely harvest condensed freshwater for your empty canteen.
nodes.page: Heat still burns your palms where the leather and wire pressed into place, yet the wrap holds against the shuddering iron of the pipe. Escaping steam drops from a shriek to a sullen murmur. Clear lukewarm water pools in your canteen, drip by drip, until the salvaged moisture sits full at your belt.

nodes.title: The Hall of Ledgers
nodes.brief: A sprawling archive of drowned ledgers blocks the way, watched over by a massive automaton archivist with glowing glass eyes and multiple brass limbs.
nodes.page: Endless rows of water-swollen ledgers stretch out into the gloom, bound in moldering sharkskin and stacked upon rusted iron shelves that groan under the weight of centuries. A colossal automaton archivist stands sentinel among the paper tombs, its multi-jointed brass limbs shifting with a sound like grinding teeth. Twin glass lenses glow a dull, baleful amber in the damp air, tracking your every movement as you step onto the damp floor. It lowers a ledger-stamped palm to block your path and waits in absolute silence for an accounting of your presence in the deep.

nodes.title: The Drowned Archive
nodes.brief: The Drowned Archive: The Last Tidewarden categorizes ruined books in a vast circular library, demanding proper authorization or a terrible toll to let you pass.
nodes.page: Towering shelves of waterlogged records loom like grey cliffs beneath the vault, lit by the amber glow of the archivist's unblinking lenses. The vast chamber hums with the stagnant breath of a thousand forgotten tides, offering multiple ways deeper into the cold heart of the stair. You can challenge the towering machine with unblinking defiance, present a contradictory paradox from the drowned books, brace your back against a collapsing shelf to save a rare history, realign its damaged ocular lens with delicate skill, or request formal permission to enter the pressure-locked chambers.

exits.label: Stand your ground before the archivist
Confuse the machine with a ledger paradox
Save the falling shelf from collapse
Request descent into the pressure locks

nodes.title: The Unblinking Gaze
nodes.brief: You firmly assert your right to pass without breaking eye contact with the towering machine, demonstrating unwavering resolve to receive a stamped brass token.
nodes.page:
You square your shoulders and fix your eyes squarely on the glowing amber lenses of the towering archivist, refusing to shrink back from its mechanical bulk. The massive brass frame whirs and clicks as it processes your defiant posture, its multi-jointed fingers twitching above a collection of heavy stamps. Only the rhythmic drip of distant bilge water from the ceiling above marks the quiet of the damp vault.

The machine lowers one arm and presses a jagged token of stamped brass into your palm; a deep pneumatic sigh stirs the dust around your boots.

nodes.title: Weight of the Token
nodes.brief: You firmly assert your right to pass without breaking eye contact with the towering machine, demonstrating unwavering resolve to receive a stamped brass token.
nodes.page:
The cold brass token feels heavy and sharp-edged against your calloused palm, stamped with the faded seal of the old Tidewardens. You slip it securely into your pocket, feeling the watchful eyes of the brass archivist follow your silhouette as you thread your way past the towering stacks of drowned ledgers. The air grows noticeably cooler here, smelling sharply of ozone and old salt.

Ahead, the rusted iron floor grating gives way to a solid stone pathway that slopes downward into the absolute dark, leading toward the lower chambers where the great mechanism waits.

nodes.title: Meeting the Amber Eye
nodes.brief: You firmly assert your right to pass without breaking eye contact with the towering machine, demonstrating unwavering resolve to receive a stamped brass token.
nodes.page: The archivist leans forward on its heavy brass tracks, bringing its glowing amber lenses inches from your face in a silent, suffocating test of wills. Every instinct screams at you to look away, to break the gaze and yield the floor to the terrifying machine before it strikes. You must hold your ground without flinching, matching the unfeeling stare of the drowned world's librarian until it grants you passage.

nodes.title: Broken Focus
nodes.brief: You firmly assert your right to pass without breaking eye contact with the towering machine, demonstrating unwavering resolve to receive a stamped brass token.
nodes.page: Your nerve cracks under the oppressive heat of those amber lenses, and you avert your eyes with a sharp gasp, stumbling backward against a stack of ledgers. Ledgers tumble down in a cloud of choking mold and dust, burying your boots and bruising your shin against the iron frame. The archivist emits a low, mocking hiss of steam from its vents, marking your failure with a harsh, grating chime before blocking the aisle entirely.

nodes.title: A Grudging Pass
nodes.brief: You firmly assert your right to pass without breaking eye contact with the towering machine, demonstrating unwavering resolve to receive a stamped brass token.
nodes.page: You hold your stance through the agonizing stillness until the machine's internal cogs shift with a heavy, resonant clank of approval. The archivist steps aside and presses a stamped token into your palm. The cold metal bears the mark of the deep archives, granting you unhindered access to the lower vaults.

nodes.title: The Logician's Ledger
nodes.brief: You present a contradictory paradox from one of the ruined ledgers to confuse the automaton, utilizing sharp logic to steal a rare oceanic map.
nodes.page: Iron hinges groan in the chill subterranean draft as you slide the water-warped ledger across the frost-filmed brass of the desk. A grease-stained thumb finds the impossible ink marks of the third equinox. The tide-tables of seventy years ago demand a flood where these columns record a permanent ebb: a closed loop of clerical error the mechanical archivist cannot compute. The automaton's brass cogs stutter and click. Copper eyelids flutter while its logic-engine chews the contradiction, and its internal mirrors sit free. You snatch the rolled vellum chart of the deep trenches from beneath its inactive claws and slide the prize inside your woollen waistcoat. The machine starts to grind again.

exits.label: Slip back into the stairwell shadows

nodes.title: Distracting the Archivist
nodes.brief: You present a contradictory paradox from one of the ruined ledgers to confuse the automaton, utilizing sharp logic to steal a rare oceanic map.
nodes.page:
Smoke from your oil lamp drifts across the glowing amber lenses and blurs the machine's piercing vision for a heartbeat. You repeat the paradoxical decree about the sea returning before it departs, weaponizing the rigid logic of its own forgotten laws against its brass brain. The brass torso swivels a fraction, distracted by the recursive error written across your torn ledger page.

The precious parchment map rests untouched on the pitted steel workbench, ready for whoever claims it next.

nodes.title: Weaving the Trap
nodes.brief: You present a contradictory paradox from one of the ruined ledgers to confuse the automaton, utilizing sharp logic to steal a rare oceanic map.
nodes.page: Your mind races through the twisted axioms of the deep-sea ledgers, seeking the exact phrase that will freeze the archivist's internal clockwork. Sweat stings your eyes as the amber lenses refocus with a terrifying snap, pinning your thoughts in a blinding glare of logical scrutiny. Every second spent balancing on the edge of this intellectual precipice threatens to betray your deception. You marshal your wits, framing the ultimate paradox of a dry ocean to paralyze the machine's judgment.

nodes.title: A Flawed Deduction
nodes.brief: You present a contradictory paradox from one of the ruined ledgers to confuse the automaton, utilizing sharp logic to steal a rare oceanic map.
nodes.page:
A sharp metallic click cuts through your concentration. The automaton finds the flaw in your reasoning the way salt finds iron. Brass jaws snap shut inches from your knuckles and you jerk your hand back with a hiss of pain. A strip of skin hangs on a jagged cog. The machine vents a short corrected-error note, dry and smug.

You clutch your bleeding thumb to your chest and fall back into the shadows. The prize sits secured against you, bought in skin.

exits.label: Slip away into the damp shadows

nodes.title: The Ledger Thief
nodes.brief: You present a contradictory paradox from one of the ruined ledgers to confuse the automaton, utilizing sharp logic to steal a rare oceanic map.
nodes.page: Dust hangs in the damp air as you slide away from the towering racks with the vellum map tucked beneath your coat. The automaton stands frozen in its circular track, and its internal cylinders keep clicking through the impossible riddle you laid before its brass ears. You have slipped past its iron scrutiny. Boot marks alone mark the sunken tiles behind you. The map is yours.

exits.label: Return to the vaulted archive hall

nodes.title: Shoring the Racks
nodes.brief: You brace your back against a collapsing bookshelf to prevent it from crushing you, using pure physical endurance to save a leather-bound history text.
nodes.page:
Centuries of salt-rot have weakened the oak uprights that hold thousands of leather-clad volumes of tide history. Floorboards complain. The towering shelf behind you starts to list forward, ready to bury you under a crush of ancient pulp. You drop your shoulder against the buckling timber and plant your boots on the damp flagstones. The rack presses down like a collapsed bulkhead.

Wood digs into your spine. You shove back and hold the shelf where it stands.

nodes.title: The Crushing Weight
nodes.brief: You brace your back against a collapsing bookshelf to prevent it from crushing you, using pure physical endurance to save a leather-bound history text.
nodes.page: The mass of fallen ledgers threatens to pancake your ribs against the stone wall as the wooden brace splinters into jagged shards. Your muscles lock, burning with sudden fire as you try to arrest the terrifying momentum of the collapsing shelving unit. Every sinew in your back screams under the crushing load of drowned history. You brace your legs, pouring all your remaining might into a desperate, groaning heave against the timber frame.

check.label: Push back against the falling timbers

nodes.title: Bruised and Burdened
nodes.brief: You brace your back against a collapsing bookshelf to prevent it from crushing you, using pure physical endurance to save a leather-bound history text.
nodes.page:
The shelf wins the contest of strength by an inch, slamming into your shoulder and sending you sprawling hard onto the gritty flagstones. A heavy calf-skin volume clips your temple on its way down, leaving a purple bruise and a slow trickle of warm blood across your cheekbone. You cough up dust tasting of ancient salt, your body aching from the sudden impact.

You drag yourself free from the wreckage, clutching a single surviving history text to your chest.

exits.label: Crawl clear of the fallen timber

nodes.title: Weight of the Past
nodes.brief: You brace your back against a collapsing bookshelf to prevent it from crushing you, using pure physical endurance to save a leather-bound history text.
nodes.page: Timbers groan and groan again as the towering stack lists sideways, threatening to bury you beneath centuries of damp paper and crumbling calfskin. You throw your shoulder against the leaning mahogany shelf, muscles straining against the descending avalanche until your breath rasps raw in your throat. Through sheer stubborn grit you brace the frame long enough to snatch a leather-bound chronicle from the shelf, securing the fragile history as the timber finally splinters into the dark.

nodes.title: Steadying the Glass
nodes.brief: You delicately realign the damaged ocular lens on the automaton's secondary face, employing technical skill to earn a spool of unbreakable copper wire.
nodes.page:
Tiny brass screws catch the dim amber light as you use the tip of your skinning knife to align the delicate focal lens on the machine's secondary face. The automaton hums softly, its internal prisms shifting with a pleasing, oiled click that echoes through the vaulted stone chamber. Fine copper filaments unspool neatly across your palm as the machine rewards your delicate craftsmanship with a quiet nod of approval.

You coil the bright metal wire carefully and tuck it away into your belt pouch.

nodes.title: The Lens-Maker's Art
nodes.brief: You delicately realign the damaged ocular lens on the automaton's secondary face, employing technical skill to earn a spool of unbreakable copper wire.
nodes.page:
Your fingers move with the practiced precision of a net-mender working fine linen, coaxing the warped brass housing back into true alignment. The automaton's second face flickers to life, casting a clean blue beam across the dusty flagstones where absolute darkness reigned a moment before. A spool of bright, unbreakable copper wire rolls across the workbench into your waiting palm.

The machine relaxes its posture, recognizing your rare skill with intricate mechanical joints.

nodes.title: The Hairline Adjustment
nodes.brief: You delicately realign the damaged ocular lens on the automaton's secondary face, employing technical skill to earn a spool of unbreakable copper wire.
nodes.page: A single slip of your blade will strip the gossamer threads inside the automaton's secondary optic assembly and trigger its defensive clamps. You hold your breath, steadying your trembling fingers as you nudge the microscopic brass lever into its final slot. The surrounding air feels thick as brine, pressing heavily against your skin while you wait to see if the delicate mechanism holds. You apply gentle, measured pressure to the eccentric screw, holding your breath against the impending snap.

nodes.title: A Slips-Way Error
nodes.brief: You delicately realign the damaged ocular lens on the automaton's secondary face, employing technical skill to earn a spool of unbreakable copper wire.
nodes.page:
The tiny screwdriver slips on a patch of green corrosion, gouging a deep, useless scratch across the face of the expensive lens. A sharp electrical shock dances up your arm, leaving your fingers numb and smelling of ozone as the automaton buzzes an angry warning note. You retreat a half-step, sucking on a scorched thumb while the machine resets its optical housing with a dismal clatter.

You salvage what you can from the botched repair and move on before the mood shifts further.

nodes.title: The Lens-Maker's Art
nodes.brief: You delicately realign the damaged ocular lens on the automaton's secondary face, employing technical skill to earn a spool of unbreakable copper wire.
nodes.page: With care borrowed from years of mending nets, you ease the warped brass housing back until the threads seat clean. The tiny screw clicks home. Dust motes drift in the amber glow of the automaton's remaining optic against the basalt walls of the vault. It reaches into its copper-ribbed breast and offers a spool of unbreakable copper wire whose surface shines with an oily, stubborn sheen. "Your craft holds," it grinds.

exits.label: Step through the heavy archive doors

nodes.title: The Pressure-Locked Chambers
nodes.brief: The archivist permits your descent into the pressure-locked chambers, where the air grows agonizingly thick and your mentor's presence feels tangibly close.
nodes.page: Iron bolts grind back with the groan of centuries, and the archivist lets you descend into the pressure-locked chambers below. Old ozone and compressed brine coat the back of your throat on every breath. Ceiling lanterns throw a dim pulse along the walls. Pipe tobacco and damp wool drift up from the lower shaft, and your mentor's presence rides that scent from somewhere close below. The bulkheads hiss. They seal behind you. The spiral stair goes down into the deep.

nodes.title: The Pressure Locks
nodes.brief: The Pressure Locks: A series of reinforced bulkheads and flooded antechambers creates a maze of dead ends, hiding secrets of the ancient tide engineers.
nodes.page: Water drips in a slow, monotonous rhythm from the vaulted ceiling of the pressure locks, pooling around a maze of reinforced bulkheads and flooded antechambers. The damp stone corridors twist in baffling directions, hiding secrets of the ancient tide engineers behind rusted iron doors and weed-choked grates. Faint mechanical sighs echo through the conduits, tempting you to pry open forgotten lockers or brave the flooded lateral tunnels. Every passage promises a different path deeper into the guts of the stair, though none of them look safe.

exits.label: Force open the jammed metal locker
Analyze the flow of leaking water
Heave the submerged fallen pillar aside
Crawl through the low drainage pipe
Follow the torn coat into the gloom

nodes.title: The Rusted Valve
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted emergency valve against immense counter-pressure, straining your shoulders to drain a flooded room and claim a pristine diver's helmet.
nodes.page: Condensation drips from the overhead pipes as you crank a rusted emergency valve against immense counter-pressure. Your shoulders strain fiercely against the stubborn iron wheel, each rotation buying only a fraction of an inch against the groan of the seals. Water drains away in a noisy, frothing torrent through the floor grates, leaving a slick layer of black silt behind. Half-buried in the mud lies a pristine diver's helmet of polished brass and thick glass, untouched by the creeping corrosion of the depths. You heave it free from the muck, wiping the salt film from its viewing port.

exits.label: Return to the central pressure locks

nodes.title: Straining Against the Wheel
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted emergency valve against immense counter-pressure, straining your shoulders to drain a flooded room and claim a pristine diver's helmet.
nodes.page: Muscle and sinew burn as you throw your full weight against the spokes of the massive bronze valve, fighting the immense water pressure backing up from the lower levels. The metal groans in protest, threatening to snap its rusted pins as the trapped tide pushes back with unrelenting fury. Your boots slip in the greasy brine pooling around the floor grating, and ragged burning gasps scrape your throat in the close air. With the valve half-turned, the resistance reaches a breaking point where a single wrong move will either clear the channel or shatter the housing entirely.

nodes.title: The Sudden Backlash
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted emergency valve against immense counter-pressure, straining your shoulders to drain a flooded room and claim a pristine diver's helmet.
nodes.page: The frozen wheel slips from your sweat-slicked palms with a sharp clang, spinning backward in a vicious blur and striking your shoulder with numbing force. A hot line of pain flares across your arm as you stumble hard against the jagged stone wall, dropping your tools into the dark water below. The drained basin fills again in an instant with a violent rush of freezing brine that chills you to the bone. You pick yourself up from the muck, nursing a bruised shoulder and gasping for air in the damp, oppressive gloom.

exits.label: Drag yourself back to the central locks

nodes.title: The Cleared Sluice
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted emergency valve against immense counter-pressure, straining your shoulders to drain a flooded room and claim a pristine diver's helmet.
nodes.page: Your muscles burn and your palms ache from the biting iron, but the stubborn valve finally gives way with a shriek of metal. The pent-up water drains away in a roaring cataract down the secondary spillway, leaving the chamber floor slick and passable. In the recess where the pressure had pinned it, you find an iron wedge stamped with the crest of the old Tidewardens. It is solid, cold, and notched with a hundred ancient uses.

exits.label: Return to the central pressure locks

nodes.title: The Leech-Filled Sump
nodes.brief: You wade through waist-deep, freezing water teeming with translucent leeches, enduring the horror to salvage a waterproof satchel containing preserved salted meats.
nodes.page: Waist-deep, freezing water laps against your thighs as you wade cautiously through a sunken corridor teeming with translucent leeches clinging to the masonry. The creatures writhe and stretch toward the warmth of your skin, demanding every ounce of your resolve just to keep moving without panic. Every step disturbs thick clouds of black silt that swirl like smoke around your shins. Pinned against a floating timber beam is a waterproof canvas satchel, secured with a salt-crusted toggle. You reach out, brushing the squirming parasites aside to pull it free.

exits.label: Carry the satchel back to the junction

nodes.title: Wading Through the Horror
nodes.brief: You wade through waist-deep, freezing water teeming with translucent leeches, enduring the horror to salvage a waterproof satchel containing preserved salted meats.
nodes.page: The water rises toward your chest as you step deeper into the writhing mass of pale leeches, their blind heads swaying toward the heat of your pulse. A cold dread coils in your stomach, whispering of infections that rot the flesh from the bone before a man can climb back to the cliffs. You fix your eyes on a dry ledge ahead, forcing your legs to move through the thick, crawling water while every instinct screams at you to turn back. At the darkest part of the channel, a sudden current threatens to sweep your footing away entirely.

nodes.title: The Sinking Terror
nodes.brief: You wade through waist-deep, freezing water teeming with translucent leeches, enduring the horror to salvage a waterproof satchel containing preserved salted meats.
nodes.page: Panic takes hold as a cluster of heavy leeches fastens onto your forearm beneath the water, sending a sudden, nauseating numbness spreading through your skin. You thrash backward in disgust, slipping on the slick stone floor and plunging waist-deep into the filthy brine. The waterproof satchel slips from your numb fingers, sinking into the black silt before you can snatch it back. You scramble upright, scraping your knuckles against the rough masonry and shivering as the cold water drains your remaining strength.

nodes.title: The Spoils of the Sump
nodes.brief: You wade through waist-deep, freezing water teeming with translucent leeches, enduring the horror to salvage a waterproof satchel containing preserved salted meats.
nodes.page: You grit your teeth and wade through the writhing horror, however narrowly avoiding the worst of the clinging swarms to reach the opposite ledge. Snatching the waterproof satchel from the timber beam, you pry open its stiff leather clasp with cold, clumsy fingers. Inside, protected from the brine by layers of waxed cloth, lies a package of preserved salted meats wrapped in old Gullmouth news-sheets. The food is dry, heavy, and rich with salt, offering a much-needed reprieve from the hollow hunger gnawing at your ribs.

exits.label: Return to the central pressure locks

nodes.title: Rusted Iron Alcove
nodes.brief: You pry open a deformed metal locker with sheer force, tearing the hinges apart to acquire a heavy iron prybar for future obstacles.
nodes.page: Thick crusts of grey salt flake off the corrugated bulkhead as you squeeze into a narrower service recess where the gloom smells of stagnant bilge and old oil. Heavy dripping echoes from somewhere out of sight, each drop sounding like a lead shot hitting tin in the damp quiet. You trace your fingers along the cold metal ribs, feeling for any sign of a latch or seam among the encrusted rivets. A stubborn steel locker blocks the rear of the maintenance tunnel, its hinges sealed tight by decades of briny corrosion and wet neglect.

nodes.title: Against the Jammed Seam
nodes.brief: You pry open a deformed metal locker with sheer force, tearing the hinges apart to acquire a heavy iron prybar for future obstacles.
nodes.page: Cold moisture beads heavily on your shoulders while you brace your boots against a rusted bulkhead rib and lean your full weight into the warped door. Iron screeches against iron with a high, teeth-setting groan that vibrates straight up your forearms and scatters flakes of red scale into the dark water. The handle refuses to yield an inch under ordinary pushing, demanding something much heavier than bare hands if you mean to get past this barrier. You wedge your fingers into the narrow gap where the warped latch has buckled outward from the frame.

nodes.title: Forcing the Vault
nodes.brief: You pry open a deformed metal locker with sheer force, tearing the hinges apart to acquire a heavy iron prybar for future obstacles.
nodes.page: Saltwater drips steadily into your eyes as you wedge the palms of your hands against the swollen frame and gather every ounce of muscle beneath your sodden clothes. The metal biting into your skin is freezing, slick with a greasy film that smells of old grease and dead kelp from the drying seabed miles above. Your breath comes in ragged, shallow hitches while your heels search for purchase on the slimy floor plates. Muscle and bone strain against the immovable mass of rusted iron as you throw your entire weight forward into the wedge.

nodes.title: Bruised and Battered
nodes.brief: You pry open a deformed metal locker with sheer force, tearing the hinges apart to acquire a heavy iron prybar for future obstacles.
nodes.page: Pain flares hot across your shoulder as the warped locker gives a sudden, treacherous shudder and slams back against your knuckles with a bruising crack. You stumble backward into the knee-deep sump, gasping for breath as a sharp edge slices a deep red line across your forearm. The heavy iron door remains stubbornly jammed in place, leaving you nursing a fresh, throbbing ache that makes every movement of your arm a trial. You shake the salt water from your smarting eyes and gather your wits against the damp chill settling deep into your bones.

exits.label: Pick yourself up and press onward

nodes.title: Heavy Iron Lever
nodes.brief: You pry open a deformed metal locker with sheer force, tearing the hinges apart to acquire a heavy iron prybar for future obstacles.
nodes.page: Metal yields with a sudden, shrieking pop that echoes down the flooded corridor, leaving your muscles trembling from the sudden release of tension. Inside the dark recess, half-submerged in greasy silt, lies a heavy ribbed prybar forged from blackened ship-iron that looks entirely immune to the rot of the Low. You lift it free from the muck, feeling its solid, reassuring weight settle into your palm as a welcome tool for whatever obstructions still lie ahead.

nodes.title: The Murky Tributary
nodes.brief: You analyze the flow of leaking water to determine the safe path through a compromised corridor, reasoning your way to a hidden tool cache.
nodes.page: Murky water swirls in sluggish eddies around your knees, carrying tiny fragments of yellow lichen and grey froth from some higher drainage pipe. You hold your small salvage torch higher, its yellow beam cutting dimly through the rising mist to illuminate salt-stained pipes running along the curved ceiling. A faint trickling sound guides your attention toward a narrow side passage where the current runs slightly clearer over a bed of smooth stone rubble.

nodes.title: The Hidden Alcove
nodes.brief: You analyze the flow of leaking water to determine the safe path through a compromised corridor, reasoning your way to a hidden tool cache.
nodes.page: Careful steps keep your boots from sinking into the treacherous silt patches hidden beneath the shallow surface of the stagnant pool. The damp walls here are lined with ancient terracotta tiles, most of them cracked and weeping thin lines of rusty moisture into the gloom. You pause to listen over the steady plop of dripping water, catching the faint, hollow echo of a distant draft that hints at an unsealed chamber nearby.

nodes.title: Reading the Current
nodes.brief: You analyze the flow of leaking water to determine the safe path through a compromised corridor, reasoning your way to a hidden tool cache.
nodes.page: Water laps softly at your thighs as you watch the pattern of ripples washing back from a half-submerged bulkhead ahead. A complicated network of drainage valves and overflow channels disappears into the dark masonry on your left, each pipe carrying its own thin whisper of brine. You trace the direction of the micro-currents with the tip of your finger, trying to calculate which conduit leads to the dry maintenance vault marked on your weathered scrap of chart. The slightest miscalculation could trap you in a dead-end sump filled with freezing black runoff.

nodes.title: Choked in the Silt
nodes.brief: You analyze the flow of leaking water to determine the safe path through a compromised corridor, reasoning your way to a hidden tool cache.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of cold water spills over the lip of a hidden drainage trench, sweeping your boots out from under you and plunging you shoulder-deep into thick, foul-smelling silt. You scramble frantically against the slippery brickwork, losing your grip on a leather pouch of dry tinder as the black current drags you down the corridor. Though you manage to haul yourself upright against a rusted handrail, you are left coughing up brackish water and soaked to the skin with greasy mud.

exits.label: Wading out of the choked trench

nodes.title: The Sealed Cache
nodes.brief: You analyze the flow of leaking water to determine the safe path through a compromised corridor, reasoning your way to a hidden tool cache.
nodes.page: Water swirls away from your boots as your careful deductions lead you straight to a small, dry maintenance locker raised safely above the baseline of the flood. Inside, resting on a bed of dry oily rags, sits a small brass oiler filled with amber grease that still moves freely despite the damp chill of the depths. You pocket the tidy instrument with a quiet nod of satisfaction, knowing its contents will keep hinges silent and mechanisms turning when you finally reach the great iron heart of the Sunken Stair.

nodes.title: The Sunken Bulkhead
nodes.brief: You heave a submerged fallen pillar aside to free a trapped airlock door, relying on raw power to secure a heavy brass dive weight.
nodes.page: Green brine drips from the ribbed iron ceiling above as you wedge your shoulder against the swollen gasket of the inner hatch. Rusted bolts groan under the steady pressure, resisting every inch of your forward push. A thin stream of brackish water sprays across your cheek, carrying the sharp tang of old grease and stagnant kelp. Beyond the barrier, the dark corridor slopes downward into absolute shadow. You must clear this obstacle to follow the faint scrape of metal echoing from the depths.

nodes.title: Weight of the Deep
nodes.brief: You heave a submerged fallen pillar aside to free a trapped airlock door, relying on raw power to secure a heavy brass dive weight.
nodes.page: As you haul the dive weight closer to the sunken hatch frame, bronze links rattle against your shins. The air grows noticeably colder here, smelling strongly of ancient rust and sulfurous mud leaking from the floor panels. Slipping your fingers through the ring of the dead weight, you brace your boots against a ribbed bulkhead plate to plant yourself for the work ahead. The silence of the seabed presses down from above like a physical weight.

nodes.title: Strain Against Iron
nodes.brief: You heave a submerged fallen pillar aside to free a trapped airlock door, relying on raw power to secure a heavy brass dive weight.
nodes.page: Muscles bunch in your shoulders and back as you set your palms flat against the freezing metal of the fallen pillar, leaning your entire body weight into the heave. The stone-encrusted column refuses to budge at first, biting into your calloused palms with sharp barnacle edges. Veins throb at your temples as you draw upon every ounce of raw strength you possess to wrench the obstacle away from the jammed seal.

nodes.title: Bruised and Bone-Sore
nodes.brief: You heave a submerged fallen pillar aside to free a trapped airlock door, relying on raw power to secure a heavy brass dive weight.
nodes.page: The pillar slips from your sweat-slicked grip, crashes back onto your boot with a jarring thud, and a white-hot flash of pain runs up your shin. You stumble backward into the cold brine, gasping for breath as your bruised muscles throb in protest. Though you manage to wrench the obstacle clear on a second desperate lunge, the struggle leaves you limping heavily and nursing a deep, angry purple bruise along your lower leg.

nodes.title: Clearance Gained
nodes.brief: You heave a submerged fallen pillar aside to free a trapped airlock door, relying on raw power to secure a heavy brass dive weight.
nodes.page: With a sudden, protesting screech of sheared iron, the pillar finally rolls sideways into the silt and clears the path to the inner chamber. You catch your breath, wiping salt-crusted sweat from your forehead with the back of a trembling wrist. The victory is hard-won and leaves your muscles aching, but the way forward stands wide open at last. Resting in the mud beside the cleared frame is a solid brass wedge dropped by an earlier scavenger.

nodes.title: Orsolya's Final Trail
nodes.brief: Beyond the locks, you find Orsolya Venn's torn coat snagged on a fractured pipe, alongside a frantic message scrawled in dried blood pointing downwards.
nodes.page: Behind the airlock, in a sheltered recess, a scrap of wool you know flutters in the draft. It is a torn piece of Orsolya Venn's dark weather-coat, snagged sharply on the jagged edge of a fractured steam pipe. Beside it, smeared across the rusted plating in dark, drying strokes, a hasty arrow points directly downward into the black throat of the stairwell. The handwriting is unmistakably hers, rushed and frantic, warning of something rising from the sump. No voice answers your low call, only the hollow dripping of water echoing from the vaults below. You gather the scrap of fabric and prepare yourself for the final descent.

nodes.title: The Ruined Camp
nodes.brief: The Ruined Camp: A makeshift camp established by Orsolya lies devastated, scattered with half-finished maps and broken instruments beside a gaping vertical shaft.
nodes.page: A cavernous chamber opens before you, littered with the wreckage of an abandoned expedition. Scattered maps drift in stagnant puddles beside shattered glass lenses and overturned oil lamps. This is Orsolya's ruined camp, left deserted in great haste. A gaping vertical shaft yawns in the center of the floor, exhaling a gust of freezing air that smells of old copper and ozone. Various paths branch outward into the gloom, offering different ways to scavenge the ruins or push deeper toward the heart of the machinery.

exits.label: Slide down to the Meridian Gear

nodes.title: Shadows of the Camp
nodes.brief: You sleep briefly in the unsettling silence of the abandoned camp, suppressing terrible nightmares to recover your stamina and find a hidden silver flask.
nodes.page: You pull a damp wool blanket over your shoulders and sit down on an overturned crate within the quiet shelter of the deserted campsite. Around you the silence feels wrong, broken only by faint ticking from machinery buried deep in the rock. Closing your eyes for a brief moment, you force your racing pulse to steady against the rising tide of exhaustion. A small metallic glint catches your eye from beneath a pile of discarded canvas sheets in the corner.

nodes.title: Facing the Dark
nodes.brief: You sleep briefly in the unsettling silence of the abandoned camp, suppressing terrible nightmares to recover your stamina and find a hidden silver flask.
nodes.page: Shadows seem to lengthen and writhe along the damp stone walls as the oppressive quiet of the ruined camp presses in upon your thoughts. Terrible visions of the dry seabed and drowning towns flicker uninvited behind your closed eyelids, threatening to break your fragile composure. You grip the edges of your wooden seat until your knuckles turn white, fighting off the phantom terrors that claw at the edges of your mind.

nodes.title: Shaken Resolve
nodes.brief: You sleep briefly in the unsettling silence of the abandoned camp, suppressing terrible nightmares to recover your stamina and find a hidden silver flask.
nodes.page: A sudden wave of intense vertigo sends you tumbling sideways off the crate, crashing hard against a stack of discarded brass tubing with a sharp clatter. You lie gasping on the cold stone as dark shapes dance at the edge of your vision, your nerves frayed to a breaking point by the relentless isolation. Although you eventually force yourself back to your feet, the terrifying episode leaves you trembling and drains your remaining strength.

nodes.title: The Silver Flask
nodes.brief: You sleep briefly in the unsettling silence of the abandoned camp, suppressing terrible nightmares to recover your stamina and find a hidden silver flask.
nodes.page:
Exhaustion pulls you down against the damp timbers of the neglected shelter, where you snatch a few hours of uneasy sleep beneath the weight of relentless, creeping dread. Waking with the taste of salt on your tongue, your fingers brush against a cold, dented object wedged into the corner of the berth: a heavy silver flask smelling faintly of stale port and old iron.

Pocketing the small prize, you feel a modest reserve of strength return to your limbs, hardening your resolve against the damp chill that seeps upward from the deep floors below.

exits.label: Climb down through the iron hatch

nodes.title: The Iron Pool
nodes.brief: You haul a heavy, submerged iron lockbox out of a dark pool within the camp, using immense strength to uncover Orsolya's encrypted journal.
nodes.page:
Black water laps against the rusted ribs of a collapsed shelter, smelling of stagnant kelp and copper. Deep within the silt of the basin, something heavy catches your boot edge with a dull, muffled thud. Kneeling in the wet grit, you brush aside layers of slimy silt until the rusted corners of an iron lockbox emerge from the murk. It is wedged tightly between two fallen foundation timbers, held fast by decades of accumulated grime and suction.

You brace your boots against the slimy stone and reach down into the freezing water to get a firm, two-handed grip on the rusted handles.

exits.label: Pry the heavy box from the silt

nodes.title: Unyielding Anchor
nodes.brief: You haul a heavy, submerged iron lockbox out of a dark pool within the camp, using immense strength to uncover Orsolya's encrypted journal.
nodes.page:
You strain against the suction of the water-filled cavity. Cold brine gets into the scrapes across your knuckles. The iron box will not move. Shifting rubble and mud have settled over it and locked it down. Your back tightens as you haul backward against the buried chest. Water ripples hard. Dark sediment lifts around your forearms and the pool goes murky.

You plant both feet on the slick moss, draw one slow breath, and set for a harder heave.

exits.label: Strain once more against the suction

nodes.title: Hauling the Relic
nodes.brief: You haul a heavy, submerged iron lockbox out of a dark pool within the camp, using immense strength to uncover Orsolya's encrypted journal.
nodes.page:
Water drips from your hair as you sink your fingers deep into the cold mire beneath the handles, ignoring the ache in your shoulders. You lock your elbows and drive your legs upward against the slimy stone floor, throwing every ounce of muscle and sinew into wrenching the iron box free from its watery grave. The metal groans in protest against the suction, shifting an inch before the stubborn silt threatens to pull you back down into the dark pool.

Your breath burns in your chest as you hold the straining tension at the breaking point.

check.label: Wrench the lockbox from the deep mire

nodes.title: Waterlogged Strain
nodes.brief: You haul a heavy, submerged iron lockbox out of a dark pool within the camp, using immense strength to uncover Orsolya's encrypted journal.
nodes.page: A sudden shift in the unstable gravel beneath your boots sends a sharp jolt shooting up your spine, throwing your balance off completely. The heavy iron box slips from your numbed fingers with a dull splash, plunging back into the black water and showering your shins with jagged shards of rusted shale. A sharp edge slices deep across your forearm, drawing a slow line of dark blood that mixes instantly with the briny pool. Gasping for air, you stumble backward against the damp stones, clutching your throbbing arm while the cold damp settles deep into your bruised joints.

exits.label: Pick yourself up from the wet stone

nodes.title: The Iron Lockbox
nodes.brief: You haul a heavy, submerged iron lockbox out of a dark pool within the camp, using immense strength to uncover Orsolya's encrypted journal.
nodes.page:
Mud suction clings to your boots as you wrench the waterlogged iron chest from the dark, oil-filmed basin, your muscles burning with every inch of lift. Inside the heavy casing, protected from the brine by thick wax seals, lies Orsolya's encrypted journal filled with marginal notes on the Meridian Gear.

You slide the leather-bound book into your dry-sack, feeling the solid weight of her guarded secrets against your ribs.

nodes.title: Scattered Charts
nodes.brief: You piece together the torn fragments of a tidal chart left near the bedroll, using keen observation to learn the exact timing of the currents.
nodes.page:
Torn fragments of parchment lie scattered across the camp bedroll like fallen autumn leaves, curling at the edges from the damp salt air. You kneel beside the makeshift table, carefully arranging the fragile strips of ink-stained paper into something resembling a coherent map. The diagrams show strange lunar alignments and tidal vectors foreign to the old almanacs of Gullmouth. By the dim light of your lantern, you trace the faint, hurried annotations penned in Orsolya's familiar, cramped hand.

The scattered lines begin to reveal a hidden pattern beneath the messy ink.

exits.label: Trace the alignment of the ink lines

nodes.title: The Missing Vector
nodes.brief: You piece together the torn fragments of a tidal chart left near the bedroll, using keen observation to learn the exact timing of the currents.
nodes.page:
Faded ink smudges beneath your fingertips as you try to align the jagged edges of a torn coastal chart. One corner is gone. A blank gap sits where the deepest channel of the Low should be marked with soundings. You squint against the flickering amber flame of your lamp and search the dust beneath the cot for the lost scrap of paper. Every shadow along the stone wall stretches and distorts in the draft, and the tiny symbols slide confusingly before your tired eyes.

You brace your hand and look closer at the overlapping ink strokes left behind on the remaining fragments.

exits.label: Study the faint marks in the dust

nodes.title: Decoding the Tides
nodes.brief: You piece together the torn fragments of a tidal chart left near the bedroll, using keen observation to learn the exact timing of the currents.
nodes.page:
Your eyes dart back and forth across the fractured margins of the parchment, tracking the subtle variations in the ink density where Orsolya corrected her calculations. You mentally reconstruct the missing quadrant, calculating the exact lag of the receding waters against the geometry of the Sunken Stair. A sudden realization forms in your mind, connecting the erratic lunar symbols to the jammed mechanism waiting far below in the dark. The margins conceal a hidden sequence, but one wrong deduction will leave you blind in the subterranean maze.

You hold your breath and fix your gaze on the converging lines.

nodes.title: False Horizons
nodes.brief: You piece together the torn fragments of a tidal chart left near the bedroll, using keen observation to learn the exact timing of the currents.
nodes.page:
A headache flares behind your temples as the complex arrangement of lines blurs into an unintelligible tangle of ink and salt stains. You spend precious hours chasing a faulty calculation, only to realize the torn edges belonged to an entirely different mapping expedition from years ago.
