Fatigue dulls your senses, robbing you of valuable time while the damp chill sinks deeper into your bones. Your supplies are lighter now, depleted by the hours spent staring fruitlessly at the ruined paper.

You rub your tired eyes and push the useless fragments aside on the makeshift table.

exits.label: Stand up from the makeshift table

nodes.title: Fragments of the Tide
nodes.brief: You piece together the torn fragments of a tidal chart left near the bedroll, using keen observation to learn the exact timing of the currents.
nodes.page:
Careful fingers sort through the damp, scattered paper scraps caught between rotting floorboards until the missing pieces of the tidal chart click into place before your eyes. The smeared ink reveals a hidden rhythm in the Gear's stoppage, showing precisely when the locked tumblers will ease their grip.

You pocket the reconstructed scrap of parchment, confident in the secret schedule now resting against your palm.

nodes.title: Copper And Cinder
nodes.brief: You salvage parts from a smashed water purifier to build a working filter, demonstrating mechanical ingenuity to gain a reliable source of clean drinking water.
nodes.page: Salt-crusted filters lie scattered across the flagstones like the ribs of salted cod, their diaphragms split by mineral rot and years of neglect. Your thumb traces the hairline fracture in a brass valve while the damp air smells of stagnant lime and old grease. With a blunt screwdriver salvaged from a rusted toolbox, you pry open the copper casing to reach the ceramic filter core inside.

nodes.title: Rebuilding The Core
nodes.brief: You salvage parts from a smashed water purifier to build a working filter, demonstrating mechanical ingenuity to gain a reliable source of clean drinking water.
nodes.page: Thin streams of brackish gray water drip from the overhead stone, splashing against your boots with a rhythmic, hollow ping. Working by the dim, flickering light of a tallow candle, you fit a fresh strip of oiled canvas around the intake ring and bind it tight with waxed twine. Every component feels brittle in the chill, demanding a delicate touch to avoid snapping the fragile copper pins.

nodes.title: Testing The Filter
nodes.brief: You salvage parts from a smashed water purifier to build a working filter, demonstrating mechanical ingenuity to gain a reliable source of clean drinking water.
nodes.page: Water from the stagnant cistern pools in the upper funnel, dark as bog-tea and flecked with gray silt that circles lazily toward the drain hole. Your fingers press down on the cracked lever, coaxing the valve open by a fraction of a hair's breadth to control the pressure before the brittle seals burst under the sudden weight of the liquid. The entire contraption shudders as the foul water meets the dry charcoal core, trembling on the verge of total collapse if the tension shifts even a fraction of an inch.

check.label: Twist the valve to steady pressure

nodes.title: A Bitter Draft
nodes.brief: You salvage parts from a smashed water purifier to build a working filter, demonstrating mechanical ingenuity to gain a reliable source of clean drinking water.
nodes.page: A sudden high-pitched squeal splits the quiet as the ceramic core fractures down the middle, unleashing a dirty torrent that floods across your knuckles and soaks your sleeves in foul gray muck. You pull your hand back with a sharp hiss of pain as a jagged brass burr slices a shallow red line across your palm. The precious water drains away into the porous stone below, leaving you empty-handed and wiping sticky mud from your stinging skin while the damp cold settles deep into the new scratch.

nodes.title: Sweet Clear Droplets
nodes.brief: You salvage parts from a smashed water purifier to build a working filter, demonstrating mechanical ingenuity to gain a reliable source of clean drinking water.
nodes.page: Clear liquid begins to bead at the brass nozzle, falling with a clean, steady plink into the tin cup below until the vessel holds a small, untainted measure of sweet water. You lift the tin to your lips, washing away the lingering taste of salt and dry stone with a cold, reviving swallow that steadies your tired limbs. Whatever hardships wait down in the dark, you carry a dependable means of survival against the encroaching thirst.

nodes.title: Shell And Sinew
nodes.brief: You brutally smash a creeping, armored rock-centipede that invaded the campsite, relying on sudden violence to extract its valuable phosphorescent venom sac.
nodes.page: Hard jointed armor scrapes against the dry masonry of the lower alcove, signaling the sudden, scuttling advance of a pale centipede with antennae twitching like frayed wire. You waste no time weighing risk: an iron belaying pin is in your hand and then hard across the creature's segmented back with a dull, echoing crunch. Yellowish fluid bubbles from the cracked shell, smelling sharply of vinegar and old copper.

nodes.title: Crushing The Carapace
nodes.brief: You brutally smash a creeping, armored rock-centipede that invaded the campsite, relying on sudden violence to extract its valuable phosphorescent venom sac.
nodes.page: The armored beast thrashes in the dust, its dozens of needle-tipped legs kicking wildly against your boots as it tries to wedge its heavy mandibles into the leather of your instep. You plant your heel squarely upon the center of its segmented thorax, throwing your entire weight downward while your muscles strain against the stubborn resilience of its calcified hide. The shell resists with a sickening, leathery groan, hovering on the absolute edge of snapping beneath your boot-sole.

nodes.title: A Costly Struggle
nodes.brief: You brutally smash a creeping, armored rock-centipede that invaded the campsite, relying on sudden violence to extract its valuable phosphorescent venom sac.
nodes.page: The creature wrenches sideways with unexpected fury, its barbed forelegs catching the back of your hand and tearing a ragged gash through your glove before you can grind it into the flagstones. You stumble back against the damp wall, cradling the bleeding hand against your chest while the venom-sac bursts uselessly against the stone, wasting its luminous prize in the dust. The dull throb in your knuckles reminds you of the careless speed of your strike.

nodes.title: The Luminous Vial
nodes.brief: You brutally smash a creeping, armored rock-centipede that invaded the campsite, relying on sudden violence to extract its valuable phosphorescent venom sac.
nodes.page: Your boot-heel crushes the final layer of armor. The segmented carcass twitches once in the gloom. You slice free the pulsing blue-tinged gland from beneath its throat. It sits in your palm like a cold pearl. Phosphorescent glow cuts the shadows without a flicker of smoke. Into a pocket it goes. Where ordinary torches fail, this light will still show the next step.

nodes.title: Into The Iron Throat
nodes.brief: You slide down a crumbling chute of debris and land on the colossal, silent teeth of the Meridian Gear itself, surrounded by impenetrable darkness.
nodes.page: Loose shale gives way beneath your boots with a sudden, sliding roar, pitching you headfirst down a steep chute of rusted iron plates and ancient sediment. You tumble through the suffocating dark, elbows scraping against cold rivets until you drop clear of the descent and land with a jarring thud upon a colossal ridge of jagged metal. Towering shapes loom around you in the pitch black, cold as frozen anchors and silent as graves - the enormous, unmoving teeth of the Meridian Gear itself, waiting for a hand to turn them.

exits.label: Stand upon the stalled gear teeth

nodes.title: The Stalled Gear Housing
nodes.brief: The Gear Housing: The magnificent, stalled heart of the ocean rests here, locked by massive salt crystals and guarded by the ghosts of drowned engineers.
nodes.page: Colossal brass rings and salt-frosted teeth dominate the vast chamber, locked in a silence that smells of stagnant bilge and oxidized copper. Pale phosphorescent lichens bleed a sickly green light across the ancient iron flooring, and the motionless bulk of the Meridian Gear takes that green without answering. The housing is still. In the shadows drowned engineers linger in frozen postures, and one whispers, "The spindle will not move," while sightless eyes stay fixed on the immovable central spindle. The dry ocean presses hard on the rock above the chamber. From the gloom an unexpected presence steps into view.

exits.label: Confront the figure stepping from shadows

nodes.title: The Spindle Alignment
nodes.brief: You study the alignment of the central spindle to find the primary jam, employing sharp intellect to discover a beautifully crafted golden astrolabe.
nodes.page:
Towering brass braces frame the central axis where the ocean presses against the ancient machinery of the Tidewardens. Fine white salt dust drifts through the damp air and settles on grease-stained indicator rings and notched dials that refuse to turn. Your fingers trace the cold grooves of the primary housing. Pressures grind below against the locked teeth.

Behind a shroud of crystalline buildup a delicate instrument catches the sparse green luminescence, and its brass rings shiver at the distant pull of water. You reach toward the glinting metal. Jagged mineral growths still lock the spindle in place.

nodes.title: Reaching For The Astrolabe
nodes.brief: You study the alignment of the central spindle to find the primary jam, employing sharp intellect to discover a beautifully crafted golden astrolabe.
nodes.page: Razor salt crystals sheath the brass housing. They can cut leather and flesh if you misread the angles. You breathe against the damp chill and peer through the gloom, mapping stress fractures webbed across the metal plate. A tremor rolls through the subterranean floor; the jagged mineral spikes above your knuckles shift a hair. Your hand hangs inches from the glinting instrument while you pick an angle that slips past the grinding pressure without snapping the fragile linkages.

check.label: Calculate the clearance and pry free the astrolabe

nodes.title: A Slip In The Salt
nodes.brief: You study the alignment of the central spindle to find the primary jam, employing sharp intellect to discover a beautifully crafted golden astrolabe.
nodes.page: Sudden vibration rattles the brass framework. Needle-sharp salt splinters rain down across your knuckles. You wrench your hand backward with a sharp hiss, but not before a jagged edge opens a long, weeping gash across your skin. Warm blood drips onto the ancient iron plates and smells faintly of salt and copper. The ache settles into your bones. The delicate instrument remains wedged tight within the mineral crust, and its brass rings protest with a shrill metallic scrape that fills the vast chamber. You bind the torn flesh with a strip of damp canvas and grit your teeth as you step back to survey the stubborn jam.

exits.label: Return to the central engine floor

nodes.title: The Golden Astrolabe
nodes.brief: You study the alignment of the central spindle to find the primary jam, employing sharp intellect to discover a beautifully crafted golden astrolabe.
nodes.page: Nimble fingers navigate the hazardous mineral growths, slipping past the jagged edges with careful precision until the metal loosens from its stony bed. The brass instrument lifts free into your palm, cold and oddly balanced, an internal gyroscope ticking faintly against your skin. The ancient device remains intact, its inscribed rings tracking invisible celestial tides that no longer exist above the dry seabed. You slip the cold metal into your pouch, feeling the quiet assurance of a relic that remembers how the waters moved before the world went still.

exits.label: Return to the central engine floor

nodes.title: The Encrusted Relay
nodes.brief: You chisel away the suffocating salt crust from a delicate relay switch, applying careful precision to free a specialized gear mechanism for your own use.
nodes.page: Thick layers of pale grey salt seal the junction box like hardened mortar, hiding the intricate mechanical switches that govern the lower sluices. You trace the hairline cracks in the mineral crust, listening to the hollow resonance beneath the metal as you search for a vulnerable seam. Condensation drips rhythmically from an overhead rivet, splashing into stagnant puddles that reflect the sickly green phosphorescence of the cavern walls. Small, jointed carapaces twitch briefly in the gloom nearby, drawn by the faint warmth of your skin before scuttling away into the rusted machinery frames. You select a narrow scraper from your belt, preparing to chip away the suffocating buildup without damaging the fragile brass contacts within.

nodes.title: Clearing The Contacts
nodes.brief: You chisel away the suffocating salt crust from a delicate relay switch, applying careful precision to free a specialized gear mechanism for your own use.
nodes.page: Tiny flakes of crystalline salt scatter across your boots with every measured tap of the hardened steel blade. Beneath the grey crust the copper housing gleams with a dull, greenish patina from centuries of damp subterranean air. The spring clicks. It releases a small cogwheel that mineral expansion had locked fast. You brush away the remaining debris with your sleeve and uncover a compact assembly of interlocking brass plates that still retain their original oil and balance. The mechanism looks entirely salvageable if you can extract it before the chamber settles further.

exits.label: Test the freedom of the gear mechanism

nodes.title: Freeing The Mechanism
nodes.brief: You chisel away the suffocating salt crust from a delicate relay switch, applying careful precision to free a specialized gear mechanism for your own use.
nodes.page: Minute tolerances govern how the brass relay seats. Around you the iron framework groans as if the dry abyss itself presses on it. You wedge the flat edge of your tool beneath the assembly and push, slow and measured, to coax the corroded pins from their sockets. Stressed metal screeches. The housing shifts half a hair's breadth. One wrong tremor shears the delicate teeth. Damp air cools the back of your neck while you hold the angle and wait for the last stubborn burr to snap free.

check.label: Pry the relay housing with delicate precision

nodes.title: A Broken Tooth
nodes.brief: You chisel away the suffocating salt crust from a delicate relay switch, applying careful precision to free a specialized gear mechanism for your own use.
nodes.page: A dry metallic snap shatters the silence as one of the tiny brass teeth shears away under your tool. A sharp jolt runs straight up your wrist. The relay housing jars sideways and wedges itself even tighter into the rusted mount while a shower of fine metal shavings dusts your knuckles. You let out a slow breath. You shake out your fingers and inspect the minor damage to the assembly. The salvaged piece bears a fresh scar, but the core mechanism remains intact enough to serve your purpose even if it will need careful adjustment later. You tuck the stubborn artifact into your pocket alongside your remaining tools.

exits.label: Return to the central engine floor

nodes.title: The Specialized Relay
nodes.brief: You chisel away the suffocating salt crust from a delicate relay switch, applying careful precision to free a specialized gear mechanism for your own use.
nodes.page: Subtle leverage and patient fingers do the work where brute force would have shattered the delicate brass components into useless scrap. The assembly slides free from its mount with a soft, satisfying click, releasing a whiff of stagnant oil that has lingered in the dark since the Tidewardens built the place. The specialized gear mechanism rests in your hand, its tiny teeth aligned and ready for repurposing. You wipe the residual grime onto your trousers, securing the prize as an invaluable asset for whatever lies ahead in the deep machinery.

exits.label: Return to the central engine floor

nodes.title: Etched Warnings In Iron
nodes.brief: You decipher the final warnings etched into the control console by the ancient builders, gaining critical knowledge that grants you a significant tactical advantage.
nodes.page:
Deep chisel marks scar the bronze plate beneath your fingers, recording the bitter lessons of the builders who watched the salt rise too high. Their warning speaks of misaligned relays and the catastrophic backlash that follows a hasty torque upon the main drum. You trace the jagged lettering through the grease, recognizing the exact geometry of a trap meant to keep the curious from breaking what remains of the sea's lung.

That hard-won clarity lets you spot the hair-thin fractures spider-webbing across the secondary manifold before your thumb brushes against them.

nodes.title: The Builder's Legacy
nodes.brief: You decipher the final warnings etched into the control console by the ancient builders, gaining critical knowledge that grants you a significant tactical advantage.
nodes.page: Faded verdigris cakes the ancient instructions until they read like a sailor's superstition carved into sheet metal, yet the core logic holds true for anyone with the salt-sense to decode it. The old Tidewardens designed their machinery to punish impatience, punishing any hand that attempts to force the gear without first bleeding the residual pressure from the brine lines. You adjust your stance against the vibrating deck-plates, letting the rhythmic groaning of the distant gears guide your eye to the hidden bypass valve.

nodes.title: Decoding The Iron Cipher
nodes.brief: You decipher the final warnings etched into the control console by the ancient builders, gaining critical knowledge that grants you a significant tactical advantage.
nodes.page: Sweat stings your eyes as you lean closer to the dim control console, squinting against the grime to decipher the worn glyphs that dictate the sequence of the main release. One misread symbol could lock the entire mechanism permanently or trigger a counter-weight drop that would shatter your fingers into pulp against the housing. You press your sleeve against the greasy metal, weighing the strange maritime notation against everything Orsolya taught you in the salt-damp stillness of the Gullmouth lighthouse.

nodes.title: A Costly Misreading
nodes.brief: You decipher the final warnings etched into the control console by the ancient builders, gaining critical knowledge that grants you a significant tactical advantage.
nodes.page: A sudden shift in the iron foundation betrays your concentration, and your sleeve catches on a jagged burr of steel as the ancient glyphs blur into meaningless scratches. The heavy steel casing judders violently against your knuckles, leaving a deep, weeping graze across your forearm that smells faintly of old brine and iron oxide. You pull your arm back with a sharp hiss of breath, nursing the bruised limb while the console clicks into a stubborn, locked stance that demands more time and patience to bypass.

nodes.title: The Hidden Glyph
nodes.brief: You decipher the final warnings etched into the control console by the ancient builders, gaining critical knowledge that grants you a significant tactical advantage.
nodes.page: You find the worn indentation of the final symbol and press it home. The locking tumbler drops with a hollow thud that runs through the floorboards. No further catch holds. Exact tolerances on the great gear lay out the ancient builder's intent in plain metal. Into a pocket goes the small grease-stained brass tally some forgotten artificer left behind. Scratched numerals catch the lamp light on your way out.

nodes.title: The Severed Conduit
nodes.brief: You reattach a severed hydraulic line using salvaged fittings, demonstrating expert technical skill to restore partial power and claim a glowing crystal battery.
nodes.page: High-pressure mist hisses from the ruptured hydraulic line, spraying lukewarm, oily brine across the rusted floor grates and filling the cramped recess with the metallic tang of stagnation. You reach into your satchel for a length of braided copper wire and a heavy rubber sleeve salvaged from a wrecked trawler's winch housing near the Low. Kneeling in the wet grit, you square your shoulders against the vibrating bulkhead and prepare to bind the weeping joint before the pressure drops entirely.

nodes.title: Rebuilding The Circuit
nodes.brief: You reattach a severed hydraulic line using salvaged fittings, demonstrating expert technical skill to restore partial power and claim a glowing crystal battery.
nodes.page: Working by the faint, pulsing glow of the exposed armature, you slip the salvaged fittings over the torn rubber and clamp them down with steady, practiced movements born of long years fixing nets in the Gullmouth wind. Every screw turns smoothly beneath your calloused fingers, bridging the gap between the dead auxiliary pump and the pulsing core of the machinery. A low, resonant hum begins to build beneath the floorboards as life slowly returns to the forgotten conduit.

nodes.title: Patching The Vein
nodes.brief: You reattach a severed hydraulic line using salvaged fittings, demonstrating expert technical skill to restore partial power and claim a glowing crystal battery.
nodes.page: The copper wire slips on the slick, grease-coated pipe, threatening to unseat the fragile rubber seal just as the internal pressure surges with a sudden, alarming shriek. If the makeshift patch gives way now, the boiling spray will scald your skin and leave the secondary pump starved of the fluid it needs to turn the main gear. You plant your boot firmly against the iron bulkhead, using both hands to apply agonizingly even pressure to the failing joint as the metal groans under the strain.

nodes.title: A Scorched Finger
nodes.brief: You reattach a severed hydraulic line using salvaged fittings, demonstrating expert technical skill to restore partial power and claim a glowing crystal battery.
nodes.page: A jet of superheated brine spits past the failing seal, catching the back of your hand and leaving a raw, blistering red welt that throbs in time with your racing pulse. You curse into the damp gloom, shaking the stinging hand before grabbing a dry rag to wrench the retaining collar home by sheer stubborn muscle. The leak finally slows to a greasy drip, but the hurried fix costs you precious ointment and leaves your knuckles stiff and throbbing.

exits.label: Accept the burn and press on

nodes.title: The Glowing Core
nodes.brief: You reattach a severed hydraulic line using salvaged fittings, demonstrating expert technical skill to restore partial power and claim a glowing crystal battery.
nodes.page: The repaired line holds firm against the surging pressure, sealing the circuit and bathing the dark recess in a steady, amber pulse of revived mechanical energy. You detach the humming crystal battery from the secondary housing, feeling its residual warmth hum pleasantly against your palm like a sleeping ember pulled from a hearth. Rare and perfectly preserved, this piece of old-world hardware will draw a fat pouch of coin or favors from the Low to Saltspire.

nodes.title: The Blind Mentor
nodes.brief: Orsolya Venn emerges from the shadows, her eyes completely white, demanding you help her turn the Gear to drown Saltspire and save Gullmouth.
nodes.page: Shadows detach themselves from the dripping brickwork of the grand chamber as a familiar silhouette steps into the amber wash of the revived core. Orsolya Venn stands before the iron framework, her lighthouse keeper's coat stiff with dried salt and old seaweed. When she turns her head toward the sound of your boots, the lamplight catches eyes stripped of pigment, rendered entirely milky-white by the deep pressures of the abyss. Her voice rasps like dry gravel scraped across slate as she demands your immediate assistance to throw the main gear. She insists that Saltspire must drown in the returning flood so that Gullmouth and its stranded people might finally breathe again.

exits.label: Step closer to the blinding light

nodes.title: The Final Choice
nodes.brief: The Final Choice: Your mentor stands at the primary release lever, presenting a terrible moral trial that will decide which faction receives the returning ocean.
nodes.page: Massive iron levers cast long, trembling shadows across the vaulted ceiling of the Sunken Stair as your mentor holds her hand over the primary release mechanism without a tremor. Every faction with a stake in the dry seabed has left its mark upon these stones, yet the ultimate decision of where the waters rush first rests entirely in your blistered hands. Brass teeth of the Meridian Gear grind against each other with a sound like cracking teeth, waiting for the choice that will remake the world.

exits.label: Reach for the heavy iron arm
Challenge her dark decree with law
Heave against the jammed secondary cog
Brace your back against the tremor
Wait for the great iron to groan

nodes.title: Wrestling The Iron
nodes.brief: You forcefully wrestle the primary lever away from Orsolya, using your superior strength to take control of the mechanism and secure your own authority.
nodes.page: Muscles strain against bone as you lunge forward to intercept her trembling fingers before they can trip the catastrophic release. Orsolya fights with an unnatural, salt-brined strength, her knuckles scraping against the freezing metal as you lock arms in a desperate struggle for supremacy over the mechanism. The heavy bronze lever vibrates with the immense torque of the entire trapped ocean waiting just beyond the stone walls.

exits.label: Force the lever to your side

nodes.title: Seizing The Lever
nodes.brief: You forcefully wrestle the primary lever away from Orsolya, using your superior strength to take control of the mechanism and secure your own authority.
nodes.page: Iron bites deep into your palm as you throw your entire body weight against the stubborn shaft of the primary control. The mentor gasps, her white eyes widening in shock as your superior leverage forces her hands back from the polished brass knob. Every bolt in the housing groans in protest under the sudden cross-pressure of your competing wills.

exits.label: Test your strength against the mechanism

nodes.title: Iron Against Bone
nodes.brief: You forcefully wrestle the primary lever away from Orsolya, using your superior strength to take control of the mechanism and secure your own authority.
nodes.page: Tremors shake the vaulted masonry as your fingers slip along the freezing iron of the primary lever. Orsolya throws her weight downward, her jaw set with the desperate finality of a lighthouse keeper watching her last flame die. Every muscle in your back fires as you plant your boots against the salt-crusted flagstones, striving to wrench the mechanism away from her grip before the counterweight drops into the locking groove.

check.label: Wrench the iron from her grasp

nodes.title: The Slip of Leverage
nodes.brief: You forcefully wrestle the primary lever away from Orsolya, using your superior strength to take control of the mechanism and secure your own authority.
nodes.page: Friction burns the skin of your palms as Orsolya's superior leverage forces your arms back in a brutal arc of iron and salt. You stagger away from the console with a bruised shoulder and a shallow gash across your knuckles where the rusted locking pin bit deep. Breath rasps hot in your throat while she braces the iron bar, eyes fixed and unyielding in the damp gloom.

exits.label: Step back and watch her move

nodes.title: Weight of the Lever
nodes.brief: You forcefully wrestle the primary lever away from Orsolya, using your superior strength to take control of the mechanism and secure your own authority.
nodes.page: Steel groans as your sheer muscle overrides her desperate resistance, and you pivot the bar upward. Orsolya stumbles back against the masonry, gasping for breath while her fingers curl into empty air where the control once was. A brass locking pin slides home into the bulkhead with a solid thud and secures your authority over the mechanism at last.

nodes.title: Words in the Deep
nodes.brief: You argue against her apocalyptic logic using fragments of old tidal law, winning a battle of words to earn her reluctant submission and a rare compass.
nodes.page: Silence settles over the damp chamber save for the low, rhythmic dripping of subterranean brine against the stone floor. You lean against the cold iron of the control console, marshaling forgotten clauses from the old Gullmouth harbor ordinances and the ancient salvage pacts of the Tidewardens. Orsolya listens, her gaze dropping slowly from the catastrophic release valve to the pitted brass floorboards as the harsh lines of her resolve soften into reluctant agreement.

exits.label: Press your advantage with ancient law

nodes.title: Parsing the Old Oaths
nodes.brief: You argue against her apocalyptic logic using fragments of old tidal law, winning a battle of words to earn her reluctant submission and a rare compass.
nodes.page: Words feel like dry sand in your mouth as you invoke the binding statutes of the first seal, searching for a flaw in her bleak calculation. Orsolya narrows her eyes, weighing your argument against the terrible silence of the dry seabed stretching miles above them. Your logic hangs suspended in the damp air, waiting to see whether she will accept your reasoning or dismiss it with a sweep of her hand.

nodes.title: Flawed Arguments
nodes.brief: You argue against her apocalyptic logic using fragments of old tidal law, winning a battle of words to earn her reluctant submission and a rare compass.
nodes.page: Your tongue stumbles over a misplaced clause from the forgotten charters, and Orsolya cuts through your reasoning with a single scathing reminder of the costs. A dull ache throbs behind your temples, leaving you drained of breath and carrying the bitter sting of a lost argument. She turns back toward the console, refusing to yield an inch of ground to your faulty logic.

nodes.title: The Reluctant concession
nodes.brief: You argue against her apocalyptic logic using fragments of old tidal law, winning a battle of words to earn her reluctant submission and a rare compass.
nodes.page: Every syllable of your carefully constructed defense strikes true, slipping past her defensive walls however narrowly until her shoulders slump in exhaustion. She reaches into her oilskin coat and withdraws a heavy brass instrument, pressing its cool casing into your palm without a word of ceremony. It is a tool for finding true north when the seas have vanished from the earth.

exits.label: Face the turning of the gear

nodes.title: Footsteps On The Iron
nodes.brief: You physically block a group of descending Drift Pilgrims aiming to sabotage the controls, using brute force to protect the console and earn Orsolya's grudging respect.
nodes.page:
Salt-crusted boots ring against the damp spiral treads of the stair above, and with them come the low murmuring prayers of the Drift Pilgrims who seek to unmake the work of generations. Their cowls are stiff with dried brine, and iron crowbars gleam dull in the lantern-light as they descend with fury toward the great console. Orsolya shouts, "Drift Pilgrims on the stair!" Her fingers stay locked on the trembling brass housing of the primary indicators, but the intruders press downward through the gloom. Dust shakes loose from the vaulted brickwork overhead with every stride they take on the rusted iron gratings.

Sweat runs into your eyes as you plant your boots against the condensation-slick plate and brace your shoulders across the narrow landing before the main gear-housing.

exits.label: Bar the path of the zealots

nodes.title: Shouting Through The Damp
nodes.brief: You physically block a group of descending Drift Pilgrims aiming to sabotage the controls, using brute force to protect the console and earn Orsolya's grudging respect.
nodes.page:
Cold air whistles through the vertical shaft, smelling sharply of ancient mud and stagnant sea-muck stirred up from the deep tunnels below. The lead Pilgrim snarls an oath against the false idols of the Tide-wardens, hefting a notched breaker's bar as his followers crowd close behind him on the narrow gallery. There is no room here for subtlety or polite bargaining; the vaulted stone walls press in tight, throwing back the hollow echoes of your ragged breathing. Orsolya glances back from her post with a sharp, assessing squint, her jaw set hard against the encroaching tide of zealotry.

You drop your centre of gravity, flexing your fingers into iron fists as the foremost intruder lunges forward into the dim circle of yellow lamplight.

exits.label: Meet the charge with hard bone

nodes.title: Holding The Lower Landing
nodes.brief: You physically block a group of descending Drift Pilgrims aiming to sabotage the controls, using brute force to protect the console and earn Orsolya's grudging respect.
nodes.page:
Bone grinds against gristly muscle as the lead pilgrim slams his full body into your chest, aiming to drive you back into the delicate brass linkages of the primary console. Your heels skid across the condensation-slick plating. Teeth bare against the shock. Iron bars clatter against stone walls in the narrow shaft, and the air fills with the acrid stench of old sweat and wet wool. You hook a boot behind the intruder's ankle and throw your strength into a counter-shove that could crack ribs on both sides.

His frame is dead weight against you. You push before their crowbars smash the control housing.

nodes.title: Bruised On The Sump-Plates
nodes.brief: You physically block a group of descending Drift Pilgrims aiming to sabotage the controls, using brute force to protect the console and earn Orsolya's grudging respect.
nodes.page:
An iron crowbar catches your shoulder. White-hot agony flares down your arm and drives the air from your lungs in a ragged gasp while you stumble backward over a protruding bolt-head, slam your hip hard against the sharp edge of the brass casing, and taste copper in the back of your throat. The pilgrim pushes forward through the gap, his boots splashing into oily puddle-water as he raises his weapon toward the trembling glass dials. Orsolya moves with sudden, savage grace to intercept him, and she buys you the precious heartbeat you need to haul your bruised frame back up from the deck.

Your shoulder aches deep as you drag yourself to your feet and rejoin the desperate struggle for the console.

nodes.title: The Unyielding Barricade
nodes.brief: You physically block a group of descending Drift Pilgrims aiming to sabotage the controls, using brute force to protect the console and earn Orsolya's grudging respect.
nodes.page:
Flesh and bone prove harder than iron fanaticism as you throw your entire weight into a crushing counter-leverage, sending the lead pilgrim tumbling backward over the slippery edge of the lower landing. The rest hesitate just long enough, dismayed by the brutal finality of your defence and the cold glare in your mentor's eyes. Orsolya lets out a sharp, grudging breath that sounds almost like respect, her calloused fingers tightening over the bronze valve-wheel as the immediate peril passes into the damp shadows. Shoulder-to-shoulder against the cold iron frame you stand, chest heaving in the brine-laden air, master and scavenger holding the heart of the world between them.

An iron pry-bar clatters to the deck at your feet, abandoned in the hasty retreat of the broken zealots.

nodes.title: Straining Against The Cogs
nodes.brief: You heave against a secondary jammed cog to assist her terrible plan, straining every muscle to align the teeth and claim a piece of the mechanism.
nodes.page:
Thick grease blackens your knuckles as you wedge your fingers into the freezing tooth-gap of the secondary transfer wheel, seeking leverage where the ancient iron has warped against its housing. The metal is freezing cold, drawing the heat straight out of your skin with every second you maintain your grip. Across the pit, Orsolya throws her weight against the opposite spoke, her face pale and strained beneath the flickering glare of the gimbal lamp. Deep underground, something massive and aquatic shifts within the sealed bedrock, sending a long, shuddering vibration straight up through the stone foundations.

You brace your boots against the slimy concrete lip of the pit, preparing for the final, bone-cracking heave.

nodes.title: Metal Screaming In The Dark
nodes.brief: You heave against a secondary jammed cog to assist her terrible plan, straining every muscle to align the teeth and claim a piece of the mechanism.
nodes.page:
Rusted scale flakes off the primary drive-train like dried fish skin, raining down into the oily bilge-water as the massive gears groan under the strain of your combined efforts. The smell of hot axle-tallow rises thick and suffocating in the enclosed vault, stinging your nostrils and making your eyes water in the gloom. Orsolya grunts through clenched teeth, her shoulder pressed hard against the iron spoke to prevent the mechanism from slipping back into its deadly lock. Every muscle in your back hums with dangerous tension, stretched to the very limit of endurance by the dead weight of the sea-machine.

Gathering your resolve for one final push, you signal your mentor to lock her fingers alongside yours.

nodes.title: The Teeth Of The World
nodes.brief: You heave against a secondary jammed cog to assist her terrible plan, straining every muscle to align the teeth and claim a piece of the mechanism.
nodes.page:
Sinners and salvagers alike have cursed this iron labyrinth for three long days, but the mechanism cares nothing for prayers or salt-tears. You throw your chest against the freezing spoke, feeling the solid oak lever bow and splinter slightly beneath your ribs as the seized teeth begin to inch forward with a sound like tearing tin. The dark water sloshes in the deep drain channels below, echoing the erratic rhythm of your own pounding pulse. A fraction of an inch more will seat the locking pin, but the rusty housing threatens to shatter into razor-sharp shards at any second.

Putting every ounce of muscle and desperate will into the gap, you force the frozen iron toward its home.

nodes.title: Splintered Ash And Blood
nodes.brief: You heave against a secondary jammed cog to assist her terrible plan, straining every muscle to align the teeth and claim a piece of the mechanism.
nodes.page:
The wooden lever snaps with a deafening crack that echoes like a musket shot through the vaulted stair, throwing you violently backward against the stone bulkhead. A jagged splinter rips a deep, ragged gash across your forearm, and dark blood wells up instantly to mix with the greasy grime coating your skin. Orsolya catches the spinning spoke just in time with her bare hands, her palms blistering raw as she prevents the whole mechanism from unwinding into chaos. You pick yourself up from the wet flagstones, clutching your bleeding arm while the bitter taste of failure coats your tongue.

Gritting your teeth against the fiery new wound, you reach out and brace the trembling iron rod alongside her.

nodes.title: The Iron Seated True
nodes.brief: You heave against a secondary jammed cog to assist her terrible plan, straining every muscle to align the teeth and claim a piece of the mechanism.
nodes.page:
With a sudden, shuddering lurch that rattles the loose teeth in your jaws, the massive gear slides home into its oil-blackened housing and locks with a satisfying, resonant thud. The vibration travels up through the stone soles of your boots from deep under the seabed. Orsolya exhales a long, trembling breath, wiping a smear of grease and sweat from her forehead with the back of her sleeve. Without a word she tosses a salt-pitted brass pin into your open palm, grim proof that you earned your keep in the dark.

In your palm rests a brass locking-pin, cold metal notched with the maker's ancient seal.

nodes.title: Weight Of The Deep
nodes.brief: You stand your ground as the immense pressure of the turning gear threatens to crush the chamber, maintaining iron resolve to grab a fallen royal seal.
nodes.page: Stone dust powders your shoulders as the brass collar grinds in its seating. Slip now and it flattens you into the masonry. You brace until your knuckles ache, muscles tight with strain, while rust flakes hang in the air. Through the particulate haze a glint of gold shows in the rubble, close to the crushing edge. You drop lower, reach across the trembling flagstones, and snatch the royal seal before the machinery moves again.

nodes.title: Hold The Line
nodes.brief: You stand your ground as the immense pressure of the turning gear threatens to crush the chamber, maintaining iron resolve to grab a fallen royal seal.
nodes.page: Tremors shake the bedrock as the iron chamber groans under unbearable tonnage, threatening to snap the pillars and crush everything in the stairwell. Without a thought for safety, you plant your boots against the shifting floor and throw your entire weight into the narrow gap beside the grinding housing. Dust fills your throat and the stone beneath your knees splinters into grey grit, but your gaze remains fixed on the fallen royal seal glinting just inches from the churning teeth.

nodes.title: Scraped From The Sockets
nodes.brief: You stand your ground as the immense pressure of the turning gear threatens to crush the chamber, maintaining iron resolve to grab a fallen royal seal.
nodes.page: A sudden lateral shudder of the ironwork hurls you violently against a jagged salt-pillar, tearing a deep, stinging gash across your forearm while the royal seal slips away into the dark machinery. Blood wets your wool sleeve as you pick yourself up from the grit, gasping for breath against the sulfurous air. Though your ribs ache with every intake and your arm throbs with a fresh, raw stripe of pain, the immediate peril passes as the mechanism settles into a stubborn, sullen stillness.

nodes.title: Gold From The Grinder
nodes.brief: You stand your ground as the immense pressure of the turning gear threatens to crush the chamber, maintaining iron resolve to grab a fallen royal seal.
nodes.page: Metal screeches against stone, then yields with a sudden, granting shudder that leaves your ears ringing in the heavy silence. Your fingers close around the cold metal of the royal seal just as the primary housing locks firmly into place, sparing your bones from the descending weight. You pull your arm back into the safety of the alcove and slide the prize into your canvas pouch alongside your salt-crusted compass.

nodes.title: The Long-Held Breath
nodes.brief: With a deafening groan that shakes the bedrock of the world, the Meridian Gear finally turns, and the distant roar of returning water begins.
nodes.page: Beneath the vaulted arches, the very earth shudders as the immense brass teeth of the Meridian Gear lock into their ancient track with a sound like a distant cathedral bell. For a long heartbeat, silence swallows the damp corridors, broken only by saltwater dripping from the ceiling. Then a low, rising moan travels up from the abyss, shaking the moss from the mortar and rattling the bone charms hanging from your belt. The seabed floor outside is cracking, and the salt-crust shatters as a dark wall of water surges back toward the cliffs of Gullmouth.

nodes.title: Fighting The Flood
nodes.brief: You crank a rusted emergency valve against immense counter-pressure, straining your shoulders to drain a flooded room and claim a pristine diver's helmet.
nodes.page: Cold brine sprays against your face as you heave against the spokes of the rusted emergency valve, your shoulders burning with every turn. The flooded chamber groans, slowly forcing gallons of stagnant seawater out through the drainage grates until the floor emerges from the grey muck. Resting your hands on your knees to catch your breath, you spot a pristine diver's helmet resting atop a drowned sea-chest, its glass faceplate gleaming with untouched clarity.

nodes.title: Steps Of The Ancients
nodes.brief: You study a mosaic of the old Tidewardens to deduce the correct pressure plate path, using your sharp mind to uncover a hidden cache of medicinal kelp.
nodes.page: Carved images of the old Tidewardens stare down from the damp stone walls, their blank stone eyes tracing the geometric patterns worn into the flagstones beneath your boots. Kneeling in the gloom, you trace the faded incisions with a salt-calloused finger, deciphering the sequence that avoided the hidden weight-traps. A discreet click echoes through the chamber as a concealed floor panel pops an inch upward, revealing a bundle of dried medicinal kelp wrapped in oiled canvas.

nodes.title: Bottom Of The World
nodes.brief: You finally reach the cavernous bottom of the Sunken Stair, standing before the vast, silent brass teeth of the Meridian Gear.
nodes.page: Deep beneath the cliffs, the winding stair terminates in a vast, cathedral-like vault echoing with the drips of ancient moisture. Towering before you stand the immense brass teeth of the Meridian Gear, silent and motionless like the jawbones of a buried titan. Thick crusts of salt and centuries of accumulated deep-sea debris choke the massive cogs, locking the great mechanism in a frozen slumber.

nodes.title: The Clogged Heart
nodes.brief: The Gear's Threshold: The immense mechanism is jammed tight with centuries of deep-sea debris and salt crust, requiring immediate physical clearing before any cogs can turn.
nodes.page: The colossal brass mechanism fills the damp cavern, its vast teeth locked tight by centuries of calcified salt and deep-sea wreckage. Every surface is coated in grey brine crust and the tangled remnants of drowned rigging, leaving the great wheel immobile and silent. You must clear the obstructions from the drive system before any lever can be pulled or any tide commanded.

nodes.title: Mast And Mire
nodes.brief: You heave a wrecked galleon's mast out of the primary cogs, risking severe exhaustion, to uncover a masterfully forged wrecker's hook trapped beneath.
nodes.page: Water drips from the vaulted ceiling onto your neck as you brace your shoulder against the splintered pine of a wrecked galleon mast wedged deep between the primary cogs. The timber groans under your weight, soaked through with brine and heavy as lead, yet it refuses to budge from its iron prison. You dig your boots into the greasy silt, gathering your strength for another heave against the massive obstruction.

nodes.title: Strain And Salt
nodes.brief: You heave a wrecked galleon's mast out of the primary cogs, risking severe exhaustion, to uncover a masterfully forged wrecker's hook trapped beneath.
nodes.page: Muscles strain to their breaking point as you throw your weight against the lodged mast once more, feeling the ancient wood shift a fraction of an inch in the dark. The surrounding machinery rattles in protest, shedding flakes of orange rust that sting your eyes. Ragged gasps fill your chest in the damp air of the vault as you ready one final push.

nodes.title: Shifting The Dead Wood
nodes.brief: You heave a wrecked galleon's mast out of the primary cogs, risking severe exhaustion, to uncover a masterfully forged wrecker's hook trapped beneath.
nodes.page: Bracing your back against the cold iron housing, you wedge your hands beneath the waterlogged pine mast and plant your boots firmly in the thick, greasy silt of the floor. Every muscle in your arms and thighs trembles under the immense dead weight of the timber wedged deep between the primary cogs. You grit your teeth against the strain, throwing your entire body into a desperate heave to dislodge the obstruction before your strength gives out entirely.

nodes.title: Broken Sinews
nodes.brief: You heave a wrecked galleon's mast out of the primary cogs, risking severe exhaustion, to uncover a masterfully forged wrecker's hook trapped beneath.
nodes.page: The timber slips with a sickening jar, throwing you hard against the jagged iron housing and leaving a dull, throbbing ache across your ribs. You slump into the wet silt, gasping for air while your strained muscles burn with exhaustion and a dark bruise blooms across your shoulder. Though the mast remains stubbornly wedged, you pick yourself up from the muck, determined to find another way to clear the cogs.

nodes.title: Cleared Mast And Iron
nodes.brief: You heave a wrecked galleon's mast out of the primary cogs, risking severe exhaustion, to uncover a masterfully forged wrecker's hook trapped beneath.
nodes.page: Splintering wood groans under your final frantic heave and releases its iron-toothed grip on the primary cogs with a sharp snap that runs through the soles of your boots. You stumble backward into the damp gloom. Chest heaving and palms raw, you clutch the prize you wrested from the wreck. Beneath the fallen timber lies a masterfully forged wrecker's hook, its curved steel edge gleaming with a faint oily sheen in the salt-fog. It is an instrument born of Gullmouth's trade, forged for tearing open stubborn hulls. You tuck it firmly against your belt.

exits.label: Return to the thrumming gear mechanism

nodes.title: Turning The Calcified Wheel
nodes.brief: You force a calcified alignment wheel to rotate by sheer strength, risking crushed hands, to gain vital access to the central pressure valve.
nodes.page: Thick crusts of grey salt and ancient scale flake away under the assault of your knuckles as you track the rusted line of the machinery toward the central pressure valve. Reaching the calcified alignment wheel, you set your boots against the slick iron plating and lock your fingers into the frozen spokes. The metal resists with stubborn malice, cold enough to bite through your thick leather gloves. Inch by straining inch, you lean your weight into the frozen circle, feeling the ancient grease within the housing give way with a wet, grinding hiss. The path forward opens at last, demanding your next move.

nodes.title: Forcing The Frozen Spokes
nodes.brief: You force a calcified alignment wheel to rotate by sheer strength, risking crushed hands, to gain vital access to the central pressure valve.
nodes.page: Your back and shoulders knot as you throw everything you have against the iron wheel. Boots slip a little in the greasy silt on the chamber floor. Calcified spokes groan under your palms; they could snap, or peel skin from your fingers, while the rusted gears inside screech against the sudden torque. Pressure climbs against your chest. Air in your lungs turns to fire as you shove the alignment wheel toward its salt-locked dead center.

nodes.title: Broken Grip And Salt
nodes.brief: You force a calcified alignment wheel to rotate by sheer strength, risking crushed hands, to gain vital access to the central pressure valve.
nodes.page: The frozen wheel bites back with brutal suddenness, slipping from your strained grip and spinning backward with a bone-jarring metallic shriek that echoes off the wet stone walls. You stumble hard against the jagged iron housing, a sharp, white-hot pain shooting across your knuckles and tearing the skin from your palms. Warm blood mingles instantly with the greasy brine coating your hands, leaving a stinging reminder of your failure against the ancient machinery. You drag yourself upright, breathing heavily through the salt-choked air, and press onward despite the fresh injury throbbing in your hands.

nodes.title: Turning The Iron Valve
nodes.brief: You force a calcified alignment wheel to rotate by sheer strength, risking crushed hands, to gain vital access to the central pressure valve.
nodes.page: Iron screams against iron as your renewed effort catches the internal teeth just right, bringing the calcified alignment wheel around in a full, satisfying rotation. A deep, subterranean shudder passes through the foundations of the stair, followed by the hissing release of pent-up steam and brine from the central pressure valve. Clutched in your palm or secured safely within your pack rests a tangible token of your struggle: a heavy bronze seal-ring bearing the crest of the ancient Tidewardens, cool to the touch and gleaming faintly through the grime. You pocket the relic, knowing the path back to the great mechanism lies open before you.

nodes.title: Clearing The Drive Shaft
nodes.brief: You smash apart a massive colony of iron-shelled barnacles blocking the drive shaft, risking deep cuts, to harvest a cluster of razor-sharp shell-blades.
nodes.page: Jagged shells splinter and fly into the dark water below as you hammer relentlessly at the massive colony of iron-shelled barnacles choking the primary drive shaft. Each blow sends a sharp vibration up your forearms, threatening to slice through your sleeves and skin if your aim falters for even a heartbeat. Yet you persist, clearing away the centuries-old crustacean growth until the gleaming steel beneath is exposed to the damp air. Among the shattered debris, a cluster of razor-sharp shell-blades remains intact, gleaming with a deadly, iridescent edge. You gather them carefully before moving onward.

nodes.title: Smashing The Shell Crust
nodes.brief: You smash apart a massive colony of iron-shelled barnacles blocking the drive shaft, risking deep cuts, to harvest a cluster of razor-sharp shell-blades.
nodes.page: Your muscles coil and snap forward as you bring your heavy tool down once more upon the dense crust of iron-shelled barnacles encrusting the drive shaft. The impact sends a violent shockwave through your wrists, and the razor-sharp edges of the living barrier fracture outward in a dangerous spray of jagged fragments. You tighten your grip on the handle, bracing yourself against the slick machinery as you prepare to smash through the final layer of calcified armour blocking the turning mechanism.

nodes.title: Lacerated Hands And Rusted Iron
nodes.brief: You smash apart a massive colony of iron-shelled barnacles blocking the drive shaft, risking deep cuts, to harvest a cluster of razor-sharp shell-blades.
nodes.page: A sudden slip sends your bare hand sliding directly across the razor-sharp edge of a shattered barnacle cluster, biting deep into your flesh with vicious speed. You pull back with a sharp intake of breath, clutching your bleeding palm as dark crimson droplets mix with the oily brine at your feet. The wound is raw and throbbing, a painful tax paid to the mechanical heart of the Low, but you bind it tightly with a strip of cloth and keep moving.

nodes.title: Harvesting The Shell Blades
nodes.brief: You smash apart a massive colony of iron-shelled barnacles blocking the drive shaft, risking deep cuts, to harvest a cluster of razor-sharp shell-blades.
nodes.page: Your perseverance pays off as the last stubborn crust of barnacles shatters completely, leaving the drive shaft turning smoothly in its oiled bed. Sorting through the wreckage of the colony, you unearth a cluster of razor-sharp shell-blades, perfectly preserved by the deep-sea minerals and notched like a wrecker's knife. You tuck the deadly curved fragments into your belt pouch, securing a versatile new tool born from the ruins of the deep. With the obstruction cleared, you turn your steps back toward the towering core of the mechanism.

nodes.title: Moving The Leviathan Bone
nodes.brief: You drag a petrified leviathan rib from the heavy counterweights, risking a crushing fall, to claim a rare marrow-stone amulet snagged on the bone.
nodes.page: Massive and yellowed with age, the petrified leviathan rib blocks the iron counterweights that regulate the gear's descent. You set your shoulder against the porous bone of a creature that swam the open seas before Gullmouth was even a cluster of salt-bleached shacks. Pushing with steady, measured force, you feel the leviathan remain grind against the stone flooring with a low, mournful groan that sounds almost like a sigh. The counterweights shift an inch, revealing a glint of metal wedged deep within the fossilised marrow.

nodes.title: Unlodging The Ancient Rib
nodes.brief: You drag a petrified leviathan rib from the heavy counterweights, risking a crushing fall, to claim a rare marrow-stone amulet snagged on the bone.
nodes.page: Sweat runs into your eyes as you heave the massive arch of bone clear of the moving parts until just enough gap opens to slide a hand into the dark crevice behind it. Old salt, dried ambergris, and the metallic tang of unceasing friction fill your nose. Something small and cold sits against the porous calcium. Bone holds it. You work it back and forth until it comes free, then step back with the prize in your palm.

nodes.title: Wrestling The Fossilized Bone
nodes.brief: You drag a petrified leviathan rib from the heavy counterweights, risking a crushing fall, to claim a rare marrow-stone amulet snagged on the bone.
nodes.page: Your boots slide across the grease-slick stone as you throw your whole body against the petrified leviathan rib, straining to shove the giant obstruction clear of the iron counterweights. The fossilized bone refuses to budge easily, its immense mass seeming to anchor itself deeper into the floor as the machinery above vibrates with a menacing, irregular rhythm. You plant your heels harder into the silt and drive your muscles to their absolute limit, trying to wrench the bone aside before the whole assembly shifts out of your control.

nodes.title: Crushed Counterweights And Bruised Ribs
nodes.brief: You drag a petrified leviathan rib from the heavy counterweights, risking a crushing fall, to claim a rare marrow-stone amulet snagged on the bone.
nodes.page: The heavy counterweight drops with a sudden, thunderous crash, clipping your shoulder and slamming you sideways against the cold stone bulkhead. Pain flares hot and sharp across your ribs. You gasp for breath in the salt-laden air while the massive bone settles back into its original, immovable position. You clutch your side, feeling the dull ache of a deep bruise forming beneath your jacket as you struggle back to your feet. Surviving the misstep is victory enough, though the cost is written clearly in your aching bones.

nodes.title: Marrow Stone Secret
nodes.brief: You drag a petrified leviathan rib from the heavy counterweights, risking a crushing fall, to claim a rare marrow-stone amulet snagged on the bone.
nodes.page: Fingers trace the cold, calcified ridge where the ancient rib wedged tight against the heavy iron counterweights, scraping away salt crust and encrusted barnacles until your nails find the purchase they need. As the grinding stone shifts and settles, a cold pulse yields to your tug. Deep in the porous grey marrow sits a smooth, pale pebble that glows with a faint briny light and smells of old rain and deep sea trenches. You pry the small relic free and slide it safely into your pocket as the machinery settles with a protesting sigh.

nodes.title: Copper Wire Salvage
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a broken bathysphere lodged between the great gears, risking sudden structural collapse, to salvage a precious spool of pristine copper wire.
nodes.page: Salt-crusted plates of the shattered bathysphere groan beneath your boots as you lean deep into the tangled maw of the great iron gearing. Every movement threatens to shift the rusted hull plates into a grinding collapse that would pin your arms forever in the dark. Steadying your weight against a frozen piston, you work a curved blade with painstaking care through layers of encrusted hemp and tarred canvas. Lengths of bright, untarnished copper wire slide free from the ruined conduit, coiling smoothly into your waiting palm like a sleeping serpent.

nodes.title: Untangling The Copper Coil
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a broken bathysphere lodged between the great gears, risking sudden structural collapse, to salvage a precious spool of pristine copper wire.
nodes.page: Your fingers move with deliberate precision among the jagged, razor-sharp edges of the shattered bathysphere hull, probing blindly into the greasy darkness where the thick bundle of copper wire is wedged. Every breath must be measured, because a single careless twitch of your blade against the tensioned steel bracing could bring tons of rusted iron crashing down upon your shoulders. Sweat drips from your chin, splashing silently against the damp machinery as you attempt to sever the stubborn housing without snagging the pristine strands within.

nodes.title: Snapped Wire And Splintered Hull
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a broken bathysphere lodged between the great gears, risking sudden structural collapse, to salvage a precious spool of pristine copper wire.
nodes.page: A sudden, sickening lurch of the rusted steel plates sends the entire jagged assembly sliding sideways with a screech of tortured metal. You jerk your hands back too late as a sharp edge of the bathysphere bites deep across your forearm, slicing through canvas and skin in a hot flash of pain. The tangled bundle of copper wire snaps violently under the sudden stress, whipping back into the gloom and leaving you empty-handed and bleeding against the cold bulkhead. You bandage the raw, weeping gash with a strip of salt-stiffened rag, your breath coming in ragged gasps in the damp dark.

exits.label: Retreat to the solid stone ledge

nodes.title: Spoils Of The Wreckage
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a broken bathysphere lodged between the great gears, risking sudden structural collapse, to salvage a precious spool of pristine copper wire.
nodes.page: Your hands ache from the struggle against the ruined hull. You pull the last pristine coil of copper wire free with a sharp tug. The twisted apparatus stays put overhead. The prize rests in your grip. The metal shines with an unblemished reddish glow, untouched by the corrosive brine that has eaten away everything else in this drowned vault for generations. Back in the cliff-town a coil like this buys a fat purse of coin or a dozen favors.

nodes.title: Oaths Of The Depths
nodes.brief: With the outer debris finally cleared, the Last Tidewarden emerges from the damp shadows, demanding your solemn oaths before permitting access to the inner workings.
nodes.page: Out of the dripping darkness where the massive iron gears meet the damp rock wall, a tall figure steps forward with a sound like grinding shingle. The Last Tidewarden stands shoulder-high, its brass plates pitted with green verdigris and its glass-bulb eyes glowing with the amber light of a dying hearth. It raises an elongated hand of riveted copper, barring your path to the central shaft with an authoritative weight that brooks no argument. Its voice rasps like dry parchment sliding over gravel, demanding to know what vows you bring to the great mechanism before a single further step is permitted into the heart of the tide.

nodes.title: The Warden's Archive
nodes.brief: The Warden's Archive: The ancient automaton-archivist fiercely guards the alignment levers, forcing you to prove your worth or cleverly trick it to manipulate the returning ocean's path.
nodes.page: Piled high with water-logged ledgers, brass astrolabes, and copper pipes weeping grey condensation, the vaulted archive smells of old salt and scorched oil. At the far side of the chamber, the towering automaton stands sentinel before the great alignment levers that control the returning ocean's path. Every surface gleams faintly with dampness, reflecting the amber glow of the archivist's unblinking optical lenses as it tracks your every movement. The narrow room offers several paths forward into the working machinery, each guarded by the relentless watchfulness of the mechanical keeper.

exits.label: Speak softly to the metal archivist
Slip past toward the ledger shelves

nodes.title: Debating The Ancient Decrees
nodes.brief: You debate obscure ancient maritime laws with the weary Tidewarden, risking its mechanical wrath, to earn a heavy brass access key to the lower shafts.
nodes.page: Words become your only shield as you stand before the towering automaton, reciting clause after obsolete clause from the maritime codes of the old Tidewardens. The machine pauses, its internal cogs clicking rhythmically as it cross-references your claims against centuries of forgotten sea-law carved into the stone floor. Every argument must be chosen with absolute precision, because a single flawed precedent will cause the mechanical keeper to lock the access shafts forever. Slowly the bronze latch on the side of its torso gives way with a pneumatic hiss, and a brass key slides out into the open air.

nodes.title: The Weight Of Old Law
nodes.brief: You debate obscure ancient maritime laws with the weary Tidewarden, risking its mechanical wrath, to earn a heavy brass access key to the lower shafts.
nodes.page: Echoes bounce off the damp stone walls as you press your case further into the archive's dim recesses, matching the automaton's literal interpretation with clever applications of historical exemption. The machine's amber eyes flare brighter, registering the complex web of maritime jurisdiction you have woven around its ancient programming logic. It cannot refute the precedents without violating its core oaths, yet granting passage runs counter to its primary directive of total exclusion. You stand your ground in the dripping chill, waiting for the final mechanical verdict to drop.

nodes.title: Parsing The Maritime Decrees
nodes.brief: You debate obscure ancient maritime laws with the weary Tidewarden, risking its mechanical wrath, to earn a heavy brass access key to the lower shafts.
nodes.page: Your mind races through forgotten volumes of Admiralty law, searching for the precise legal loophole that will compel the automaton to recognize your wrecker's license as a valid warrant of access. You lean close to the machine's whirring faceplate, speaking clearly and formally while its internal cogs grind in agitated deliberation. Every syllable must hit the mark without hesitation, because the slightest ambiguity in your phrasing will trigger its defensive protocols and seal the lower shafts for good.

nodes.title: A Flawed Citation And A Heavy Cost
nodes.brief: You debate obscure ancient maritime laws with the weary Tidewarden, risking its mechanical wrath, to earn a heavy brass access key to the lower shafts.
nodes.page: A sharp clunk echoes through the chamber as the automaton rejects your legal citation with a blast of pressurized steam that leaves your ears ringing and your throat raw. You stumble backward across the slippery stone, coughing violently as the hot vapor scalds your skin and leaves a persistent, aching tightness in your chest. The machine's amber eyes narrow down to cold, unmoving pinpricks of light, signaling that its patience has worn dangerously thin. You clutch your burning chest, bruised and chastised, realizing you must find another way past its relentless sentinel guard.

nodes.title: The Brass Key
nodes.brief: You debate obscure ancient maritime laws with the weary Tidewarden, risking its mechanical wrath, to earn a heavy brass access key to the lower shafts.
nodes.page:
You trade sharp-edged articles of ancient statute with the automaton-archivist until its copper jaw clicks shut upon a grudging concession. It pushes a brass access key across the oiled slate table, brass fingers whirring in reluctant respect for your stubborn scholarship.

This weighty relic bears the teeth of the lower shafts, cold to the touch and smelling faintly of stagnant deep-water.

exits.label: Seize the key and turn toward the lower shafts

nodes.title: Staring Down The Brass
nodes.brief: You stare down the towering automaton when it threatens to flood the chamber, risking sudden drowning, to assert your absolute authority and claim a tide-warding lantern.
nodes.page:
Cold brine pools around your boots as the archivist-automaton raises its copper hand. "I will sluice this chamber," it warns. You refuse to blink. You plant your feet on the slick masonry while the metal giant vents a hissing roar of steam that fogs the air. Your silence works harder than any shouted threat; the ancient sentinel still remembers the legal authority you wrestled from its gears only moments before. It lowers its arm with a dismal screech of protesting iron.

You seize the moment, reach past its plated shoulder, and take the brass-bound tide-warding lantern that sputters with cold blue fire.

nodes.title: Defying The Sluice Gates
nodes.brief: You stare down the towering automaton when it threatens to flood the chamber, risking sudden drowning, to assert your absolute authority and claim a tide-warding lantern.
nodes.page:
Steam billows around your shoulders, thick and scalding, yet you refuse to retreat an inch from the towering automaton's threatening posture. Every drop of water in the subterranean cistern laps higher against your shins, but your unyielding stare pins the mechanical archivist in place. Authority among wreckers is forged in the teeth of worse gales than this tin-plated relic can conjure. Slowly, the deafening pressure hiss subsides into a sullen hum of defeated gears.

You reach for the tide-warding lantern and claim it before the damp chill can settle back into your bones.

exits.label: Claim the heavy tide warding lantern

nodes.title: The Weight Of Staring Eyes
nodes.brief: You stare down the towering automaton when it threatens to flood the chamber, risking sudden drowning, to assert your absolute authority and claim a tide-warding lantern.
nodes.page: Black water creeps past your knees, carrying the bitter reek of old rust and forgotten weed, while the automaton's twin brass lenses glow with a sudden, murderous crimson glare. Valves shriek open along the ceiling, ready to drown the entire stairwell in a torrent of black brine if you show the slightest tremor of doubt. You lock your jaw against the rising panic, meeting the machine's gaze with the stubborn, immovable defiance of a Gullmouth cliff carved by centuries of salt. Your knuckles whiten around the edge of the stone console as you lean directly into the rising pressure, daring the mechanism to make its final move.

check.label: Hold your ground against the torrent

nodes.title: Drenched And Defiant
nodes.brief: You stare down the towering automaton when it threatens to flood the chamber, risking sudden drowning, to assert your absolute authority and claim a tide-warding lantern.
nodes.page: Water slams into your chest with the force of an open sea, knocking the wind from your lungs and sweeping you backward into the churning surge. You claw desperately at the slick masonry, swallowing a mouthful of bitter, stagnant brine that burns your throat like alkali before you finally manage to haul yourself back onto the ledge. The automaton's brass jaw clacks shut in mechanical satisfaction, leaving you bruised, shivering, and soaked to the skin with a fresh jagged scrape across your forearm. Yet the lantern remains within reach, waiting for those who refuse to stay down.

exits.label: Grab the lantern from the ledge

nodes.title: The Lantern Gleams
nodes.brief: You stare down the towering automaton when it threatens to flood the chamber, risking sudden drowning, to assert your absolute authority and claim a tide-warding lantern.
nodes.page: Iron valves shriek in submission as the machine's crimson lenses fade back to a dull, bruised amber. The water laps harmlessly around your boots once more, leaving you dripping with cold spray but entirely unbroken by the chamber's watery threat. You reach out and lift the brass vessel from its iron cradle; trapped sea-magic freezes through the handle and shakes your palm.

nodes.title: Weaving The Broken Filaments
nodes.brief: You diligently repair the automaton's damaged memory-coil, risking a painful electrical surge, to receive a flawlessly accurate map of the seabed's shifting salt-flats and sinkholes.
nodes.page:
Fine copper threads snap beneath your trembling fingers as you ease open the automaton's cranium casing, exposing a maze of grease-slicked cogs and twitching nerve-wires. A sudden blue spark dances across your knuckle, searing the skin with the sharp smell of ozone and hot tin, but you do not pull away. You delicately twist the fractured memory-coil back into alignment, coaxing the ancient machine's stuttering thoughts into a clean, rhythmic pulse. Under your palm the brass plating warms and gives a soft grateful shiver.

A folded parchment slides from a hidden slot in the chassis, and every sinkhole and treacherous salt-flat shows mapped on it in black ink.

exits.label: Pocket the map of the seabed

nodes.title: Mending The Copper Brain
nodes.brief: You diligently repair the automaton's damaged memory-coil, risking a painful electrical surge, to receive a flawlessly accurate map of the seabed's shifting salt-flats and sinkholes.
nodes.page:
Pliers in hand, you coax the charred filament back into its delicate slot among the whirring clockwork teeth of the automaton's cranial housing. The machine shudders violently, showering your sleeves with hot sparks that bite into the fabric like stinging salt-wasps. You ignore the pain, hold your wrist firm, and listen as the rhythmic clicking inside the brass skull smooths from a chaotic rattle into a clear, even cadence. The archivist tilts its head in a gesture of reluctant, mechanical respect.

A leather-backed scroll unfurls from its chestplate, offering a pristine charting of the treacherous seabed below.

exits.label: Take the parchment map of the flats

nodes.title: The Spark And The Coil
nodes.brief: You diligently repair the automaton's damaged memory-coil, risking a painful electrical surge, to receive a flawlessly accurate map of the seabed's shifting salt-flats and sinkholes.
nodes.page: Static electricity crawls up your forearms, making the hairs stand on end as you bridge the severed copper veins within the automaton's exposed skull. A single slip of your fingers against the live-wire manifold will unleash enough current to numb your hands for days, yet the memory-coil remains half-detached and blind to the world. You hold your breath, squinting through the acrid blue smoke of burning resin while you guide the final microscopic solder-point into place against the vibrating frame. The entire chassis shudders with a deep, low-frequency hum that threatens to blow the delicate connections apart.

nodes.title: Burned By The Spark
nodes.brief: You diligently repair the automaton's damaged memory-coil, risking a painful electrical surge, to receive a flawlessly accurate map of the seabed's shifting salt-flats and sinkholes.
nodes.page: A blinding white flash obliterates the dim chamber as the live-wire manifold arcs violently against your knuckles, throwing you backward onto the stone floor with a scorched, smoking palm. A high-pitched whine rings in your ears and singed skin turns your stomach, but you force yourself up through the raw burn. The automaton's head cycles through a frantic series of clicks before settling into a grudging, stuttering hum. You survived the backlash, though your right hand is wrapped in a tight strip of rag soaked in stinging liniment and the memory-coil is barely holding together.

exits.label: Gather the charts with trembling fingers

nodes.title: The Rebuilt Brain
nodes.brief: You diligently repair the automaton's damaged memory-coil, risking a painful electrical surge, to receive a flawlessly accurate map of the seabed's shifting salt-flats and sinkholes.
nodes.page: Copper threads cool beneath your fingertips, bitter ozone fading as the automaton's bronze jaw clicks shut as if centuries had waited for that sound. It exhales a long, dry hiss of compressed steam and raises a stiff, clockwork hand to trace the air above the slab, projecting a flickering chart of pale light upon the stones. This map reveals every crusted sinkhole, shifting salt-flats hazard, and concealed trench across the entire breadth of the Low with chilling precision. The archivist tilts its copper cranium in a silent nod of absolute recognition, granting you its hard-won cartographic secret before returning its cold gaze to the trembling alignment levers.

exits.label: Step past the seated archivist toward the alignment levers

nodes.title: Ink Upon Wet Stone
nodes.brief: You decipher the faded navigational charts scrawled on the wet walls, risking severe mental strain, to pinpoint the exact location of your missing mentor.
nodes.page:
Salt-crusted diagrams bleed across the damp masonry like bruised lichen, tracing the old underwater conduits that feed the grand machinery. Condensation drips from the vaulted ceiling, striking your sleeve with steady, freezing ticks that mimic a faulty pocket-watch. Orsolya Venn left her crude charcoal annotations in the margins, marking where the sluice-gates channelled the deep currents toward Gullmouth's harbour long before the seabed dried. By matching these erratic markings to the carved relief on the bulkhead, the missing keeper's path through the lower drainage tunnels sharpens out of the gloom.

You trace the damp chalk lines toward the lower gallery.

nodes.title: Charts In The Silt
nodes.brief: You decipher the faded navigational charts scrawled on the wet walls, risking severe mental strain, to pinpoint the exact location of your missing mentor.
nodes.page:
Smudged charcoal and salt-stiffened ink map out the sunken vaults beneath the tower, revealing where the tide currents used to split before the great lock jammed. Your thumb tracks a faint crosshatch pattern near the lowest drainage sump, where Orsolya Venn must have descended while the first dry gales scoured the seabed. Damp stone smells of stagnant bladderwrack and old iron, and each drawn breath makes the lungs ache. Her hasty cartography strokes all point toward the damp chambers where bronze locks guard the sluices.

The path leads deeper into the damp dark.

nodes.title: Reading The Pale Lines
nodes.brief: You decipher the faded navigational charts scrawled on the wet walls, risking severe mental strain, to pinpoint the exact location of your missing mentor.
nodes.page: Phosphorescent mold grows in jagged veins across the masonry, casting a sickly greenish glow over the faded ink of the navigational charts. Your temples throb with a sharp, blinding ache as you force your vision to untangle the smeared currents and subterranean soundings left behind by the missing keeper. Every line seems to shift and blur under the damp salt air, threatening to pull your thoughts into a dizzying spiral of exhaustion. Gritting your teeth against the mounting pressure behind your eyes, you narrow your focus onto the precise intersection where the flooded tunnels converge beneath the foundation stones.

nodes.title: The Price Of Sight
nodes.brief: You decipher the faded navigational charts scrawled on the wet walls, risking severe mental strain, to pinpoint the exact location of your missing mentor.
nodes.page: A sudden spike of white-hot agony splits your temples, sending you staggering sideways into the slick stone wall with a hollow thud. Vision swims through a haze of greasy black spots and phantom salt-stars as the overwhelming weight of the charts scrambles your thoughts. You catch your breath on the damp flags, spitting copper-tasting bile while your hands shake violently from the mental strain.
