The headache lingers like a leaden weight behind your eyes, a harsh reminder that the secrets of the deep do not yield without drawing blood from the unwary.

exits.label: Push onward through the throbbing pain

nodes.title: The Keeper's Trail
nodes.brief: You decipher the faded navigational charts scrawled on the wet walls, risking severe mental strain, to pinpoint the exact location of your missing mentor.
nodes.page: Through sheer willpower and a stubborn refusal to let the dizziness take you, the smeared lines snap into sudden, startling clarity. However narrowly, you isolate the exact subterranean alcove where Orsolya Venn sought shelter before the heavy brass doors jammed fast against the silt. Tucked beneath a protruding ledge of rusted ironwork, you find a small, water-stained navigational book filled with her hurried observations about the jammed mechanism. It is a vital map of the inner conduits that will guide your next steps through the labyrinthine foundations of the tide-gear.

nodes.title: Shadows In The Archive
nodes.brief: You quietly slip past the distracted archivist to steal a forbidden ledger, risking immediate lethal detection, to gain powerful blackmail material against the wealthy Brineholders.
nodes.page:
Bronze ledgers pack the high cedar shelves of the restricted gallery. The automaton-archivist ticks through its brass gears and turns its eyeless face toward the far corner. You slide between the towering oak reading desks, boots clear of paper scraps that would crunch. Dry parchment and ozone sit on your tongue; the Brineholders bought the water rights before the sea vanished, and their secrets live in these books. Your hand finds the leather spine of the forbidden register and draws it free without lifting a leaf of dust.

You tuck the stolen ledger beneath your oilskin coat.

exits.label: Slip away with the forbidden ledger

nodes.title: The Archivist's Turn
nodes.brief: You quietly slip past the distracted archivist to steal a forbidden ledger, risking immediate lethal detection, to gain powerful blackmail material against the wealthy Brineholders.
nodes.page: The mechanical archivist swivels its brass neck with a harsh, grinding screech of gears, its lens-eyes flaring with a sudden, amber search-light beam that sweeps across the flagstones. You freeze mid-stride in the narrow gap between the mahogany shelving units, barely daring to draw breath as the heavy brass plates whir and click only paces away. The slightest shift of your boots against the grit could trigger the weighted trip-wires strung across the threshold, bringing down the entire security lattice upon your head. Your heart hammers hard against your ribs in the suffocating silence as the glowing lens pauses, lingering directly over the shadow where you stand pressed against the cold timber.

nodes.title: Caught In The Lens
nodes.brief: You quietly slip past the distracted archivist to steal a forbidden ledger, risking immediate lethal detection, to gain powerful blackmail material against the wealthy Brineholders.
nodes.page: A bronze cog drops from the archivist's cranial housing with a sharp clatter, strikes your boot, and breaks the stillness. The mechanical watcher snaps its lens directly toward your chest, a piercing shriek of steam and alarms venting from its iron joints as it lunges forward. You twist away just in time, but the jagged edge of its brass gauntlet catches your forearm, tearing through oilskin and flesh in a hot, stinging line. You scramble backward through the narrow stacks, leave a dark smear of blood across the oak paneling, and hear the sentinel's footsteps thunder after you into the gloom.

nodes.title: Silence And Ledger
nodes.brief: You quietly slip past the distracted archivist to steal a forbidden ledger, risking immediate lethal detection, to gain powerful blackmail material against the wealthy Brineholders.
nodes.page: The brass guardian clicks, settles into its rusted pivot, and dims its burning lenses just enough for you to dart across the remaining flagstones. You slip past the blind spot in its sweeping patrol, clutching the sheepskin ledger tight against your ribs. The volume is thick with the names, bribes, and water-debts of every high-ranking Brineholder who engineered the great drought for profit. Dangerous cargo, but in the right hands it holds enough poison to shatter their entire mercantile monopoly.

exits.label: Carry the ledger into the depths

nodes.title: Voices From The Brine
nodes.brief: The Hollow Choir suddenly descends upon the echoing chamber, their drowned voices singing terrible promises as they attempt to drag you into the rising water.
nodes.page:
The damp air turns suddenly frigid, frosting the stone walls with a crust of grey salt as the Hollow Choir floods into the chamber from every dark archway. They drift above the flags with waterlogged limbs and hair streaming in an unseen current, their drowned faces contorted in silent, weeping pleas that echo straight inside your skull. A chorus of wet, rattling whispers promises endless peace beneath the waves if you would only let them pull you down into the rising tide. Their cold fingers brush against your wrists like drifting kelp, seeking to anchor you to the floor as the first grey tongues of the returning sea spill across the threshold.

You wrench your arms free from the clinging dead and scramble toward the iron service ladder.

exits.label: Climb away from the drowned choir

nodes.title: The Flooding Atrium
nodes.brief: The Flooding Atrium: The drowned spirits swarm the crumbling control room as the very first trickles of the returning sea begin to breach the rusted pressure seals.
nodes.page: Frigid salt-spray lashes the cracked flagstones as the first dark tongues of the returning ocean breach the rusted pressure seals. Shivering spectres of the Hollow Choir swarm the crumbling control room, their mournful weeping drowned out by the rising roar of pressurized brine. Every shadow flickers with drowned intent, clawing towards the high gears while the central tide clock ticks with frantic menace. You stand ankle-deep in the surging overflow, forced to choose your path before the chamber goes entirely under.

nodes.title: Among the Drowned
nodes.brief: You walk directly through the shivering ghostly congregation, risking the freezing chill of sudden death, to snatch a coral-encrusted breathing mask from a flooded alcove.
nodes.page: Icy wisps curl around your ankles as you push deeper into the swirling congregation of spectres, ignoring the bone-deep numbness creeping up your shins. The air smells intensely of stagnant weed and ancient copper, thick enough to choke an unseasoned wrecker. Ahead of you, a hollow alcove glows with faint luminescence beneath a cascade of dripping brine. You reach through the freezing mist towards the shape resting in the stone, your fingers brushing against slick stone and encrusted metal.

nodes.title: The Ghostly Gauntlet
nodes.brief: You walk directly through the shivering ghostly congregation, risking the freezing chill of sudden death, to snatch a coral-encrusted breathing mask from a flooded alcove.
nodes.page: Spectral hands reach from the freezing mist, their long fingers brushing your coat like trailing seaweed as you stride past the wailing congregation. Frost crusts instantly upon your eyelashes, and every breath burns your lungs as though you had swallowed dry salt. You lunge forward through the biting chill toward the recessed alcove where the coral-encrusted breathing mask waits in the gloom. You must steel your spirit against the paralyzing cold before the ghostly horde closes the gap around your shoulders.

nodes.title: Frostbitten Retreat
nodes.brief: You walk directly through the shivering ghostly congregation, risking the freezing chill of sudden death, to snatch a coral-encrusted breathing mask from a flooded alcove.
nodes.page: Numbness seizes your limbs, and a sudden, violent shudder rattles your teeth as the phantom chill pierces your coat. You stumble backward out of the freezing alcove, gasping for breath as a sharp pain spikes through your ribs like a rusted nail. The ghostly crowd presses in closer, forcing you to retreat empty-handed while the bitter brine claims the ledge. You stagger back into the central atrium, nursing a raw, aching burn across your chest that will leave a pale, scaly scar.

nodes.title: Salvaged Relic
nodes.brief: You walk directly through the shivering ghostly congregation, risking the freezing chill of sudden death, to snatch a coral-encrusted breathing mask from a flooded alcove.
nodes.page: Determination hardens your stride against the biting frost, and you wrench the encrusted relic free from the stony recess just as the ghostly fingers graze your collar. The freezing mist recoils from the artifact's pale, pulsing glow, leaving you gasping in the damp air with the prize clutched tightly in your fist. You turn back toward the swirling atrium, your lungs burning but your resolve unbroken by the spectral ordeal.

nodes.title: Valves Under Pressure
nodes.brief: You frantically jam the breaching pressure valves with heavy scrap metal, risking a lethal blowout, to buy precious time and secure a watertight leather satchel.
nodes.page: Hissing jets of salt-water shoot horizontally across the narrow chamber, cutting through the gloom like steel wire. You leap over a groaning conduit and skid across the slick iron plates toward the primary intake manifold, where the rusted pressure valves are screaming under the strain. Scrap metal litters the deck for anyone desperate enough to wedge it into the collapsing machinery before the bulkhead fails entirely.

nodes.title: Bracing the Rupture
nodes.brief: You frantically jam the breaching pressure valves with heavy scrap metal, risking a lethal blowout, to buy precious time and secure a watertight leather satchel.
nodes.page: Cold brine mixes with sweat on your forehead as you drive an iron gear wedge into the shrieking seam of the primary valve. The metal screeches in protest, bending inward under the colossal weight of the incoming sea while the surrounding rivets pop like dry bone. You lean your entire weight against the makeshift brace, hammering it deeper with a heavy wrench just as the casing begins to fracture.

nodes.title: Groaning Metal
nodes.brief: You frantically jam the breaching pressure valves with heavy scrap metal, risking a lethal blowout, to buy precious time and secure a watertight leather satchel.
nodes.page: A deafening shriek splits the air as the rusted iron wedge snaps in half, sending jagged shrapnel flying past your ear to gouge a deep red furrow into your forearm. Boiling brine sprays across your face, blinding you momentarily and filling your mouth with the taste of old blood and copper. You stumble back, clutching your bleeding arm as water floods around your boots, having bought only a few seconds of hollow safety at a painful cost.

nodes.title: Watertight Prize
nodes.brief: You frantically jam the breaching pressure valves with heavy scrap metal, risking a lethal blowout, to buy precious time and secure a watertight leather satchel.
nodes.page: Hammering the jagged scrap metal deep into the screaming seam with one decisive blow, you force the straining valve back into its iron housing. The violent hiss subsides into a sullen gurgle and seals off the worst of the spray. A leather satchel sits wedged safely within the dry recess behind the manifold. You snatch the pouch from its nook, checking its contents as water laps against your shins.

nodes.title: Voices in the Spray
nodes.brief: You listen closely to the Choir's maddening song for operational clues, risking your own sanity, to learn the ancient spoken command for the main lock.
nodes.page: Eerie melodies ripple through the rising water, carrying the cadence of a thousand drowned voices singing in hollow unison. You press your back against the dripping stone wall, closing your eyes to shut out the swirling phantoms while you strain to isolate the repeating cadence hidden beneath the wails. The song speaks of iron teeth and deep trenches, offering a dangerous glimpse into the ancient language that commands the locks.

nodes.title: The Drowned Cadence
nodes.brief: You listen closely to the Choir's maddening song for operational clues, risking your own sanity, to learn the ancient spoken command for the main lock.
nodes.page: Water laps higher against your knees, cold and relentless, but you remain motionless amidst the floating debris, letting the strange rhythm wash over your mind. The voices shift from weeping to a rhythmic, mechanical chant, repeating a sequence of harsh, guttural syllables that vibrates directly behind your temples. Every instinct warns you to block your ears, yet the secret architecture of the lock unfolds syllable by syllable within your memory.

nodes.title: Deciphering the Choir
nodes.brief: You listen closely to the Choir's maddening song for operational clues, risking your own sanity, to learn the ancient spoken command for the main lock.
nodes.page: The chaotic chorus rises to a deafening crescendo, threatening to splinter your thoughts into jagged shards of salt and memory. You bite your tongue until you taste copper, forcing your racing mind to track the hidden pattern within the endless dirge of the drowned. The correct phrase hovers just beyond your grasp in the freezing air, waiting to be snared before the madness takes root.

nodes.title: Shattered Focus
nodes.brief: You listen closely to the Choir's maddening song for operational clues, risking your own sanity, to learn the ancient spoken command for the main lock.
nodes.page: A piercing shriek echoes inside your skull, driving you to your knees in the swirling water as a wave of vertigo shatters your concentration. You gasp for air, clutching your temples as the haunting song dissolves into a chaotic jumble of meaningless noise, leaving you drained and disoriented. The opportunity slips away into the depths, and a throbbing ache settles behind your eyes that will linger for days.

nodes.title: The Drowned Secret
nodes.brief: You listen closely to the Choir's maddening song for operational clues, risking your own sanity, to learn the ancient spoken command for the main lock.
nodes.page:
Silence follows the shrieking tide-voices as you strain to catch the hidden cadences buried beneath the noise. Your ears bleed salt, but the ancient pattern settles into your memory like iron settling into a groove. The ghostly chorus shifts from malice to instruction, whispering the exact tonal command needed to release the main lock without shattering the gears.

You rise from the freezing water with the secret locked behind your teeth, knowing precisely how to turn the great machine when the moment arrives.

nodes.title: The Compass of Bones
nodes.brief: You threaten to completely shatter the central tide clock, risking the Choir's violent frenzy, to force the spirits into yielding a glowing spectral compass.
nodes.page:
Cold hands lock on the rim of the central tide clock. You press the edge of your scraper against brass that shivers under the blade. The chamber goes still. Spirits of the Hollow Choir rush forward in a wave of blinding phosphorescence, ready to tear your mind apart for the insult.

You do not blink. You hold. The spectral entities recoil from that stubborn threat. A small pulsing compass carved from whale-bone drifts into your open hand.

nodes.title: Testing the Spectral Anchor
nodes.brief: You threaten to completely shatter the central tide clock, risking the Choir's violent frenzy, to force the spirits into yielding a glowing spectral compass.
nodes.page: Every muscle in your body tightens as you raise your heavy iron blade toward the pulsing face of the central tide clock. The water whips around your calves, agitated by the howling fury of the drowned dead who swirl within the masonry like smoke trapped in a bottle. You plant your boots firmly against the slick stone, locking your gaze on the trembling pointer that dictates the return of the ocean. With a low growl, you lean your entire weight forward to force the spirit-bound mechanism into submission.

nodes.title: Punishment of the Deep
nodes.brief: You threaten to completely shatter the central tide clock, risking the Choir's violent frenzy, to force the spirits into yielding a glowing spectral compass.
nodes.page: The central mechanism bucks violently against your pressure, throwing you backward into the churning brine with a force that knocks the breath from your lungs. Your ribs crack against a protruding bolt of rusted iron, sending a white-hot spike of agony through your chest as you submerge in the freezing water. You scramble back to your surface gasping and coughing up brine, clutching your side where a deep, ugly bruise begins to bloom beneath your soaked woollen tunic.

nodes.title: Reluctant Yield
nodes.brief: You threaten to completely shatter the central tide clock, risking the Choir's violent frenzy, to force the spirits into yielding a glowing spectral compass.
nodes.page: Pain flares in your bruised limbs, yet you maintain your grip on the vibrating brass until the frantic howling of the Hollow Choir subsides into a sullen, wet rumble. The spirits recognize a will harder than their own, conceding defeat with a long, mournful sigh that ripples across the surface of the rising water. A small, cold object detaches itself from the clock-face and drifts against your chest, settling into the folds of your wet coat.

nodes.title: The Chamber of Rivals
nodes.brief: As the dark water rises, desperate representatives from the rival factions burst into the dripping chamber, turning the precarious control room into a deadly standoff.
nodes.page:
Iron doors groan open behind you as dark water spills across the threshold, and the hunters who tracked you through the sunken shafts step in. Wealthy Brineholders in oilskin coats push past the dripping archway with leveled pikes, faces tight with greed and desperation. Close behind them press the fanatic Drift Pilgrims. They chant wild prayers to the absent ocean while they clutch rusted harpoons and lengths of chain.

Before you can raise a hand, members of your own Gullmouth wreckers crew scramble from a side tunnel, knives drawn and eyes wild with the fever of the hunt. Every faction converges on the central mechanism. The dripping stone chamber is a narrow cage of hostility around that gear.

nodes.title: The Standoff at the Gear
nodes.brief: The Standoff at the Gear: The wealthy Brineholders, fanatic Drift Pilgrims, and your own Wreckers' Guild clash violently over the controls, demanding you choose a side before the sea crashes down.
nodes.page: The air grows thick with the smell of wet wool, fear, and old salt as the armed representatives of three desperate worlds fill the chamber. Across the grease-slicked floor, the Brineholders demand immediate control to secure the water supplies for their high-perched city, while the fanatic Pilgrims howl that the mechanism must remain untouched to appease the sulking sea-god. Your fellow wreckers eye the heavy brass levers with hungry calculations of profit and survival, waiting for your lead. Every weapon in the room is angled toward your chest, and the rising tide laps impatiently against your boots.

nodes.title: Whispering in the Deep
nodes.brief: You carefully negotiate a fragile temporary truce between the screaming factions, risking sudden betrayal, to secure a sworn pledge of support from the fanatic Drift Pilgrims.
nodes.page: Raising both hands palms outward, you pitch your voice to cut through the mutual snarling of the factions, appealing to their shared dread of the coming deluge. The Drift Pilgrims pause their chanting, their wild eyes darting toward you as you offer a share of the high ground in exchange for their temporary restraint. You weave promises and warnings with careful breath, playing upon their superstitions until the leader of the fanatics lowers his rusted harpoon an inch. It is a gossamer thread of an agreement, liable to snap at the slightest wrong movement, but it buys you a precious moment of quiet in the roaring chamber.

nodes.title: Binding the Pilgrims
nodes.brief: You carefully negotiate a fragile temporary truce between the screaming factions, risking sudden betrayal, to secure a sworn pledge of support from the fanatic Drift Pilgrims.
nodes.page: The fanatic leader presses a damp, salt-crusted palm against your own in a binding oath that tastes of copper and old sea-wrack. Around you, the other factions murmur with uneasy suspicion, watching as the Pilgrims step back from the control console to form a protective ring around your position. The temporary alliance holds, though you can feel the twitching tension in the muscles of the men guarding your flanks. You turn your attention back to the massive iron gear, knowing this fragile shield will crumble the second the water touches the ceiling.

nodes.title: Walking the Razor Edge
nodes.brief: You carefully negotiate a fragile temporary truce between the screaming factions, risking sudden betrayal, to secure a sworn pledge of support from the fanatic Drift Pilgrims.
nodes.page: Your tongue feels thick as wool while you pitch your voice across the echoing chamber, balancing the desperate demands of the Brineholders against the mad prophecies of the Pilgrims. Every eye is fixed on your face, and the smallest tremble in your tone will invite a dozen blades into your ribs. You lean forward into the damp gloom, measuring the exact distance to the nearest armed opponent while you spin a web of half-truths designed to keep all sides off balance. The air hangs motionless, charged with the threat of sudden violence.

nodes.title: Shattered Words
nodes.brief: You carefully negotiate a fragile temporary truce between the screaming factions, risking sudden betrayal, to secure a sworn pledge of support from the fanatic Drift Pilgrims.
nodes.page: A Brineholder officer spits a foul curse into the damp air, dismissing your careful diplomacy with a sudden, vicious thrust of his pike handle into your shoulder. The fragile peace shatters instantly as shouting erupts from all sides, and you are forced to scramble backward to avoid a flurry of jagged iron. You escape with your life, but the opportunity to reason with the factions is gone, leaving you bruised, winded, and surrounded by hostile enemies who now view you as a primary threat.

nodes.title: Words of Salt and Iron
nodes.brief: You carefully negotiate a fragile temporary truce between the screaming factions, risking sudden betrayal, to secure a sworn pledge of support from the fanatic Drift Pilgrims.
nodes.page: Your gamble pays off as the rival leaders reluctantly lower their weapons, caught off guard by the sheer audacity of your persuasion. The fanatic leader steps forward and presses a heavy iron medallion into your palm, sealing the verbal pact with a token of blood and rust. It is a dangerous alliance forged in the damp dark, but it grants you temporary immunity from the daggers of the faithful as you prepare for the final turn of the gear.

nodes.title: Iron in the Grip
nodes.brief: You brutally intimidate the Brineholder mercenaries into slowly backing down, risking a fatal stab in the dark, to confiscate their heavy iron lockboxes of coin.
nodes.page:
Stepping hard into the mercs' personal space, you keep your eyes locked on their leader while your fingers curl around the cold hilt of your scraper. Between them sit piles of iron lockboxes, brimming with silver coin that could buy a dozen boats back in Gullmouth. Every breath smells of damp wool and rising panic.

One lunge in the dark could open your ribs, yet you refuse to give an inch of wet stone. You press forward until their boots slide back on the brine-slick floor and the coin chests fall to you.

nodes.title: Weight of the Bribe
nodes.brief: You brutally intimidate the Brineholder mercenaries into slowly backing down, risking a fatal stab in the dark, to confiscate their heavy iron lockboxes of coin.
nodes.page:
Metal scrapes sharply against cold masonry as you crowd the mercenaries, forcing their pike points down with sheer salt-crusted bravado. They sneer through salt-stiffened beards, muttering oaths against the Gullmouth guild, but the raw threat in your narrowed eyes keeps their cold steel sheathed for now.

With a rough shove, you thrust your arms past their guard to snatch up the iron lockboxes, feeling the dead weight of stolen coin drag heavily against your aching muscles as you retreat into the gloom.

nodes.title: Staring Down the Blade
nodes.brief: You brutally intimidate the Brineholder mercenaries into slowly backing down, risking a fatal stab in the dark, to confiscate their heavy iron lockboxes of coin.
nodes.page:
Shadows writhe along the damp corridor while you lean your chest against the mercenaries' leveled pikes, daring them to strike through the gloom. A single misjudged twitch of a forearm means a six-inch spike driven straight through your lungs, but you refuse to blink or show a flicker of doubt.

Your fingers hover inches from the heavy iron lockboxes while you lock eyes with the lead mercenary, waiting to see if his nerve breaks first.

nodes.title: Paid in Red
nodes.brief: You brutally intimidate the Brineholder mercenaries into slowly backing down, risking a fatal stab in the dark, to confiscate their heavy iron lockboxes of coin.
nodes.page:
Cold steel bites deep into your shoulder before you can twist clear, leaving a jagged red slash that sears like boiling brine. The mercenaries snatch up their iron lockboxes and vanish into the shadows, leaving you gasping against the damp wall with a fresh wound weeping through your jacket.

Pain throbs in rhythm with your pounding heart, a sharp reminder that the Low extracts a toll from every scavenger who tries to play the big game.

nodes.title: Spoil of the Standoff
nodes.brief: You brutally intimidate the Brineholder mercenaries into slowly backing down, risking a fatal stab in the dark, to confiscate their heavy iron lockboxes of coin.
nodes.page:
The mercenaries' resolve crumbles and they drop their iron burden with a dull thud. You hoist the stout chest onto your shoulder, feeling the solid jingle of stolen silver coins against your ribs as your prize for standing firm in the dark.

A dented brass padlock hangs from the clasp, bearing the private stamp of the Brineholder treasury - a neat little token of leverage to carry back into the fray.

nodes.title: Barring the Vault
nodes.brief: You physically bar the rusted iron doors against incoming rival wrecker crews, risking badly battered limbs, to ensure you maintain total control over the main console.
nodes.page:
Rival boots thunder up the spiral stairs just as you slam your shoulder against the rusted iron doors, throwing your full weight into the rusted latch. Screaming metal protests under the sudden strain as outside hands heave against the barrier, trying to force an entry into the chamber of the Gear.

Sweat runs into your eyes while you wedge a jagged piece of ship timber through the handles, sealing the portals shut against the tide of desperate scavengers clawing to get inside.

nodes.title: Weight Against the Iron
nodes.brief: You physically bar the rusted iron doors against incoming rival wrecker crews, risking badly battered limbs, to ensure you maintain total control over the main console.
nodes.page:
Outside the chamber, a mob of rival wreckers throws their combined weight against the rusted iron plates, groaning as the hinges threaten to snap. You brace your boots against the slick stone floor, heaving your entire body against the barrier with every ounce of muscle you possess to keep the heavy doors shut.

Muscles strain to the point of tearing while the iron frame vibrates violently beneath your palms.

nodes.title: Broken Hinges
nodes.brief: You physically bar the rusted iron doors against incoming rival wrecker crews, risking badly battered limbs, to ensure you maintain total control over the main console.
nodes.page:
The heavy iron door suddenly gives a vicious shudder, buckling inward and catching your arm in a crushing pinch that leaves your shoulder bruised and useless. You tumble backward onto the cold flagstones as the rival wreckers pour past you into the chamber, shouting triumphantly over your groans.

A dull, throbbing ache settles deep into your bones, leaving your limb hanging limp and useless at your side while the crowd surges toward the console.

nodes.title: Master of the Threshold
nodes.brief: You physically bar the rusted iron doors against incoming rival wrecker crews, risking badly battered limbs, to ensure you maintain total control over the main console.
nodes.page:
By sheer stubborn muscle and a total disregard for torn ligaments, you manage to keep the heavy iron doors slammed shut until the sliding bolt drops firmly into place with a resounding echo. The furious hammering from the corridor slowly dies away into frustrated curses, leaving you in solitary command of the massive console.

A notched brass winding key, dropped by a fleeing rival during the frantic scramble, lies wedged neatly in the groove of the stone floor.

nodes.title: The Missing Keeper
nodes.brief: Orsolya Venn finally appears from the flooding shadows, badly wounded and clutching the master lever, revealing her radical plan to destroy the Meridian Gear entirely.
nodes.page:
Water drips from the vaulted ceiling as a familiar, salt-bleached figure steps out from behind the massive pillars of the Gear. Orsolya Venn leans on a driftwood cane, her skin pale as sea-foam and her coat soaked in dark, drying blood from a wound she refuses to cradle. Trembling fingers hold the master lever. Her eyes burn with a wild, cold clarity that brooks no argument. She speaks in a dry rasp that cuts through the machinery. "The Meridian Gear has rusted its last turn," she says. It must be shattered down to its bedrock roots before the tide returns to drown them all.

The immense bronze cogs groan behind her.

nodes.title: The Final Stand
nodes.brief: Orsolya's Final Stand: Your bleeding mentor stands ready to shatter the machine and let the ocean run wild, forcing you to urgently either help her or stop her.
nodes.page:
Orsolya leans against the grease-stained iron of the Meridian Gear, her knuckles smeared with old rust and her breath coming in shallow, rattling gasps. Blood from her shoulder seeps through her canvas tunic, matting the gray hairs at her nape, yet her one good hand still clutches a heavy iron pry-bar raised high above the primary cogs. She means to shatter the timing-teeth and let the ocean rush in unchecked, drowning Gullmouth and the Low in one chaotic, vengeful surge. You step onto the dripping platform with a bruised arm, caught between the duty you owe your mentor and the desperate need to keep your home from the brine.

Machinery groans beneath your boots as the salt-thick air turns colder, a coming deluge pressing at the chamber.

exits.label: Wait for the seabed to flood

nodes.title: Shadow of the Keep
nodes.brief: You bravely confront Orsolya about her sudden disappearance, risking her remarkably volatile temper, to learn the devastating truth concerning the ancient Tidewardens' original watery sin.
nodes.page: Salt crusts the corners of your eyes as you close the distance to the old lighthouse keeper, your boots slipping slightly on the oily grease coating the lower deck. Orsolya turns her head slowly, her expression hardened into something bitter and unforgiving that you have never seen directed at your trade before. You ask her flatly why she vanished into the dark stairwell, demanding an explanation for the sabotage and the secrecy that led you both to this rusted vault. She lets out a dry, rattling laugh that echoes off the iron pillars, her gaze drifting toward the immovable bronze bulk of the Gear. The truth she spits out tastes of ancient brine and old sin, revealing how the first Tidewardens bound the sea with stolen blood, condemning the coast to perpetual thirst so they could rule the dry dust above.

exits.label: Press her for the full history

nodes.title: Staring Down Wrath
nodes.brief: You bravely confront Orsolya about her sudden disappearance, risking her remarkably volatile temper, to learn the devastating truth concerning the ancient Tidewardens' original watery sin.
nodes.page: Orsolya's eyes narrow to venomous slits, and the iron crowbar in her hand trembles not with weakness, but with a sudden, gathering fury that could crack flint. You plant your boots firmly against the wet metal grating, refusing to flinch as her voice rises over the distant, subterranean rumble of the trapped tide. Staring directly into her wild, bloodshot gaze, you force your shoulders to drop and your breathing to steady, standing your ground against a lifetime of accumulated authority. Every muscle in your body tightens like a strained hawser as you lean into her space, daring her to strike or speak the truth.

check.label: Hold your ground against her fury

nodes.title: A Bitter Reprimand
nodes.brief: You bravely confront Orsolya about her sudden disappearance, risking her remarkably volatile temper, to learn the devastating truth concerning the ancient Tidewardens' original watery sin.
nodes.page: The old woman's patience snaps like a water-rotted hawser, and she swings the iron bar so fast you cannot brace your bruised shoulder. The thick metal catches you square across the ribs with a dull, sickening thud that knocks every ounce of air from your lungs and sends you sprawling onto the greasy grating. Pain flares white and hot through your torso, leaving a deep, purple bruise that will ache every time the weather turns wet. Orsolya towers over you, chest heaving and eyes blazing, while you wheeze for breath on the iron deck, having learned the hard way just how sharp her temper remains.

exits.label: Pick yourself up from the iron

nodes.title: The Keeper's Burden
nodes.brief: You bravely confront Orsolya about her sudden disappearance, risking her remarkably volatile temper, to learn the devastating truth concerning the ancient Tidewardens' original watery sin.
nodes.page: Salt-crusted brows furrow beneath the lamplight as you demand an accounting from your old mentor, pushing past her fierce glare to draw out the truth of the ancient Tidewardens' original watery sin. Her voice rasps like dry pebbles against the masonry, revealing how the sea was first bound by a cruel bargain struck in the deep trenches. She presses a brass key into your palm for your trouble, a token that once unlocked the inner vaults of the Saltspire.

exits.label: Demand she stand down and explain the full cost of her silence

nodes.title: The Primer Cords
nodes.brief: You carefully disarm the volatile explosive charges she planted on the primary drive, risking a premature detonation, to save the mechanism and pocket a rare blast-cap.
nodes.page: Coils of gray fuse-wire snake across the greasy housing of the primary drive, pinned by crude lead weights Orsolya hung there herself, each one set just so. You drop to one knee beside the main casing, your fingers slick with condensation and oil as you trace the path of the sputtering detonators. Each wire is knotted with old sailor's hitches that tighten under tension, requiring a delicate touch and absolute stillness to unravel without striking a spark against the ironwork. The metal beneath your palms vibrates with a deep, ominous thrum, warning you that the entire apparatus is teetering on a hair-trigger just waiting for a careless movement.

nodes.title: Gathering the Charges
nodes.brief: You carefully disarm the volatile explosive charges she planted on the primary drive, risking a premature detonation, to save the mechanism and pocket a rare blast-cap.
nodes.page: With infinite patience you slip the lead weights from their moorings one by one, letting the grey coils tumble harmlessly into the oily sludge at the base of the machine. The primary drive falls silent save for condensation dripping from the vaulted ceiling far above. You scoop up the exposed detonator caps, their brass casings cold and heavy against your palm, and tuck them securely into your canvas pouch. Orsolya watches from the shadows, her expression dark with betrayal, but the machinery remains intact for now.

exits.label: Step back from the disarmed drive

nodes.title: Fingers on the Wire
nodes.brief: You carefully disarm the volatile explosive charges she planted on the primary drive, risking a premature detonation, to save the mechanism and pocket a rare blast-cap.
nodes.page: The copper primer cap sits wedged deep within the iron housing of the primary drive, held fast by a rusted screw that refuses to turn for ordinary thumbs. You draw your salt-pitted knife from its sheath, using the narrow tip to lever against the delicate brass lip while avoiding the sensitive friction-powder packed inside. A single slip of the blade against the iron casing will send a hot spark straight into the volatile core, taking your fingers and half the bulkhead with it. You hold your breath in the damp, echoing vault, applying just enough pressure to coax the cylinder free without setting off the catastrophe.

nodes.title: A Spark in the Dark
nodes.brief: You carefully disarm the volatile explosive charges she planted on the primary drive, risking a premature detonation, to save the mechanism and pocket a rare blast-cap.
nodes.page: The blade slips with a sharp screech of steel against iron, and a tiny, vicious spark leaps from the housing to bite straight into the sensitive primer grain. The cramped recess fills with a muffled pop that scorches your knuckles black and showers your face with metallic grit and hot soot. With a curse you jerk your hand back, clutching a blackened thumb while burnt saltpetre fills the damp air with its pungent smell. You survive the minor blast with singed skin and a throbbing hand, but the explosive charge remains stubbornly wedged in the mechanism.

nodes.title: The Unexploded Spark
nodes.brief: You carefully disarm the volatile explosive charges she planted on the primary drive, risking a premature detonation, to save the mechanism and pocket a rare blast-cap.
nodes.page: Cool sweat prickles your neck as your fingers work with agonizing care to unseat the volatile charges wired into the primary drive, averting a premature blast that would have buried the mechanism forever. Your heart hammers against your ribs like a trapped gull against a pane, yet your hands do not shake until the final copper wire is slipped free. Safe in your coat pocket rests an unexploded brass blast-cap, salvaged from the very jaws of ruin.

exits.label: Confront your mentor before she can trigger another catastrophe

nodes.title: The Release Valves
nodes.brief: You help her quietly rig the final sabotage on the release valves, risking being crushed by falling masonry, to earn her deepest trust and a master-work wrench.
nodes.page:
Dust powders your eyelashes as granite splinters drop from the vaulted ceiling like dead teeth, ticking against your shoulders with every heave of the cavern walls. Kneeling beside the rusted release valves, you wedge iron wedges into the groaning slots while cold brine drips steadily down your neck from the fissures above. Your fingers move with rhythmic, practiced economy, aligning the locking pins precisely as she directs through clenched teeth. Trembling grease coats your palms, yet every turn of the bolt feels certain and anchors the brass mechanism against the impending pressure of the surge.

After the final satisfying click of the locking arm, she turns her soot-stained face toward yours and offers a notched iron wrench that smells faintly of old grease and sea-moss. Her hard gaze softens into an unspoken pact sealed in the damp gloom of the deep shaft.

nodes.title: Bracing the Masonry
nodes.brief: You help her quietly rig the final sabotage on the release valves, risking being crushed by falling masonry, to earn her deepest trust and a master-work wrench.
nodes.page: Overhead masonry shifts with an ominous groan, shedding a cascade of sharp flint chips that patter against your safety hood like hail while the entire structural ribbing bows inward under unimaginable strain. Throwing your weight against the vibrating intake pipe, you drive the master wedge deep into the shearing gap, trying to buy the necessary seconds to seat the final valve seal before the stone header collapses completely. Your muscles scream under the lateral load as the cast iron frame screeches, threatening to shear your fingers against the rough wall at any micro-second.

nodes.title: Crushed and Clamoring
nodes.brief: You help her quietly rig the final sabotage on the release valves, risking being crushed by falling masonry, to earn her deepest trust and a master-work wrench.
nodes.page: Stone smashes into your shoulder with brutal force, driving you hard into the iron flooring and tearing a ragged strip of skin from your forearm as the lintel drops two inches. Pain flares white and hot down your spine, and you gasp for salty air while warm blood trickles into your sleeve. Scrambling backward from the settling rubble, you clutch your bruised ribs and salvage the scattered tools from the grit, realizing how narrowly you escaped being pinned permanently beneath the foundation.

exits.label: Pull clear of the falling stone

nodes.title: The Iron Keepsake
nodes.brief: You help her quietly rig the final sabotage on the release valves, risking being crushed by falling masonry, to earn her deepest trust and a master-work wrench.
nodes.page: Stone splinters rain down around your boots, yet you hold your ground against the tremor until the final locking pin slides home with a heavy, satisfying thud into the bronze sleeve. You stagger back from the vibrating housing, catch your breath in the damp chill of the chamber, and take the oil-darkened wrench she presses into your palm without a word. The cold metal feels reassuringly solid against your bruised skin, carrying the undeniable weight of absolute trust forged in the dark shadow of the falling masonry.

nodes.title: Wrestling the Iron
nodes.brief: You desperately wrestle the master lever away from her trembling hands, risking a broken jaw in the struggle, to take absolute physical command of the returning tide.
nodes.page: Breath catches in your throat as leather gloves slip against the slick, grease-smeared brass of the control housing while the massive iron gear hums with a deep, bone-rattling vibration. Steel teeth grind together in the dark bowels of the staircase, echoing like distant thunder through the damp stone corridors as the immense pressure builds behind the sealed floodgates. Planting your boots firmly against the salt-encrusted grating, you reach out to catch her flailing wrist before she can yank the emergency release into the red zone.

nodes.title: The Shuddering Shaft
nodes.brief: You desperately wrestle the master lever away from her trembling hands, risking a broken jaw in the struggle, to take absolute physical command of the returning tide.
nodes.page: Condensation runs in thick rivulets down the moss-grown masonry walls, catching the weak, yellow glare of the storm lantern and casting dancing, monstrous shadows across the vaulted ceiling. Every bolt in the subterranean framework shrieks in protest as the immense weight of the returning ocean presses against the outer iron doors like a living beast eager to devour the coast. Your boots find precarious traction on the slick metal plating, keeping you balanced as the floor rolls beneath your feet like the deck of a dying schooner.

nodes.title: Tugging the Lever
nodes.brief: You desperately wrestle the master lever away from her trembling hands, risking a broken jaw in the struggle, to take absolute physical command of the returning tide.
nodes.page: Muscles bunch in your shoulders as you wrench hard against the stubborn iron arm, throwing your entire body weight backward while the stubborn locking pawl refuses to budge from its rusted groove. Veins bulge in your temples and your teeth grind together in a silent snarl as you pit your raw strength against the ancient, locked mechanism of the Tide-engine. The heavy steel bar shudders violently in your white-knuckled grip, hovering right on the razor edge between yielding to your leverage or snapping clean off in your fist.

nodes.title: A Heavy Toll
nodes.brief: You desperately wrestle the master lever away from her trembling hands, risking a broken jaw in the struggle, to take absolute physical command of the returning tide.
nodes.page: Iron snaps with a vicious crack, sending you sprawling backward onto the wet stone floor with your knuckles bleeding and a jagged bruise blooming across your jaw where the bucking handle caught you. Ringing bells echo in your ears as you spit copper-tasting blood into the dark grime, struggling back to your feet while your head spins from the sudden, jarring impact. The mechanism remains locked in its stubborn position, mocking your effort and leaving your body aching with a sharp, throbbing reminder of the shaft's raw power.

exits.label: Pick yourself up from the grates

nodes.title: Seizing Control
nodes.brief: You desperately wrestle the master lever away from her trembling hands, risking a broken jaw in the struggle, to take absolute physical command of the returning tide.
nodes.page: Steel teeth grind and give way beneath your desperate heave, sliding smoothly into the primary notch with a resounding metallic clang that reverberates through the entire foundation of the Sunken Stair. Gasping for breath, you lock your fingers around the grooved handle and force the massive brass arm down to the floor, feeling the immense hydraulic resistance break as the deep locks finally yield. The shuddering mechanism hums a different, deeper note beneath your palms, acknowledging your undisputed mastery over the rising tide.

nodes.title: The Roar Below
nodes.brief: A truly deafening roar echoes down the dark shaft as the open seabed finally floods, and the ancient Meridian Gear shudders violently to life beneath your hands.
nodes.page: Darkness ahead shimmers with a sudden, violent turbulence as a low, subterranean groan rises through the spiraling stone steps, rattling the iron rivets in their sockets with growing fury. Dust billows from the vaulted arches overhead like a dry grey fog, swallowing the pale yellow glow of the lanterns and leaving only the harsh, metallic smell of hot grease and ancient brine in the air. The very mountain seems to draw a long, shuddering breath around you, preparing for the inevitable cataclysm that waits at the bottom of the world. Tremors travel up through the soles of your boots, keeping time with the hidden heart of the machine.

nodes.title: The Missing Mentor
nodes.brief: You bravely confront Orsolya about her sudden disappearance, risking her remarkably volatile temper, to learn the devastating truth concerning the ancient Tidewardens' original watery sin.
nodes.page:
Damp air clings to your skin as you step into the lantern-lit alcove and find Orsolya leaning against the cold stone, her fingers stained with grease and salt-crust. You demand to know why she vanished from the lighthouse when the sea died, your voice cracking against the damp masonry. She turns on you with a familiar, terrifying glare, her knuckles white around her iron wrench. In a jagged whisper, she tells you of the first Tidewardens and the pact they forged with the deep, trading innocent blood for eternal calm long before Gullmouth was even timber and stone.

The confession hangs heavy between you, smelling of old bilge and bitter regret, leaving you to decide how to answer her treason.

exits.label: Demand answers about the ancient betrayal

nodes.title: Rigging the Valves
nodes.brief: You help her quietly rig the final sabotage on the release valves, risking being crushed by falling masonry, to earn her deepest trust and a master-work wrench.
nodes.page: Condensation drops patter on your shoulders as you crouch beside Orsolya in the shadowed recess of the lower bulkhead. Together you wedge the final explosive charge into the hairline fractures of the main release valve, working in short shared silence while the ceiling groans overhead. Loose mortar dust showers into your eyes as the foundation shudders; the masonry above could bury you both. She meets your gaze through the gloom and slides an oil-stained master wrench into your palm with a sharp nod of trust.

exits.label: Secure the master wrench and stand ready

nodes.title: The Tidewarden's Ledger
nodes.brief: You debate obscure ancient maritime laws with the weary Tidewarden, risking its mechanical wrath, to earn a heavy brass access key to the lower shafts.
nodes.page: Ancient brass gears grind within the colossal automaton's chest as you recite the forgotten clauses of the Third Maritime Charter to its vacant glass eyes. Sparks snap from its rusted collar, threatening to sear your eyebrows as it processes your legal defiance with mechanical fury. Slowly, the grinding halts, and a heavy iron compartment in its chest springs open with a resonant chime. It offers up a massive brass key, encrusted with salt and big enough to crack flagstones, a nod to your mastery over its archaic statutes.

exits.label: Take the heavy brass access key

nodes.title: Disarming the Charges
nodes.brief: You carefully disarm the volatile explosive charges she planted on the primary drive, risking a premature detonation, to save the mechanism and pocket a rare blast-cap.
nodes.page: Sweat stings your brow as you peer into the mechanical guts of the primary drive, where Orsolya has lashed a tangle of priming wires to a live detonator. One slip of your salt-numbed fingers will turn this damp vault into a jagged tomb of shrapnel and salt. You pinch the fragile copper filament with your pliers, breathing out a slow, trembling sigh as the firing pin clicks harmlessly home. Slipping the rare, serrated blast-cap into your pocket, you wipe your palms on your canvas trousers and step back from the smoking machinery.

exits.label: Pocket the blast-cap and look around

nodes.title: Staring Down the Iron
nodes.brief: You stare down the towering automaton when it threatens to flood the chamber, risking sudden drowning, to assert your absolute authority and claim a tide-warding lantern.
nodes.page: Water surges over the lower threshold, swirling around your boots as the towering brass automaton raises a massive, rivet-studded fist to flood the chamber entirely. You stand your ground, locking your gaze onto its unblinking optical lenses while the icy brine creeps steadily up your shins. The machine pauses, its internal pressures hissing in hesitation before its towering frame powers down into a sullen, obedient hum. You reach out, snatching the heavy tide-warding lantern from its magnetized bracket before the waters can rise any further.

exits.label: Claim the lantern and press onward

nodes.title: The Drowned Cartography
nodes.brief: You decipher the faded navigational charts scrawled on the wet walls, risking severe mental strain, to pinpoint the exact location of your missing mentor.
nodes.page: Faint phosphorescent lichen traces the jagged lines of ancient sea-lanes scrawled across the weeping stone walls of the shaft. You trace the glowing maps with a trembling finger, letting the complex geometry wash over your mind until your temples throb with a sharp, blinding ache. The fog clears from your thoughts just long enough to reveal the hidden cross-hatch marking Orsolya's bolt-hole beneath the salt-flats. You steady your breathing against the lingering vertigo, certain of where your mentor must be hiding in the dark.

exits.label: Memorize the path to her hiding place

nodes.title: Salvaging the Bathysphere
nodes.brief: You carefully dismantle a broken bathysphere lodged between the great gears, risking sudden structural collapse, to salvage a precious spool of pristine copper wire.
nodes.page: Iron plates groan and shift violently as you wedge your pry bar into the wreckage of the rusted bathysphere wedged fast between the main drive cogs. A sudden slip could send tons of jagged steel crashing down upon you, crushing bone and canvas alike in the spray of salt. You brace your boots against the slimy bulkhead, heaving with every ounce of muscle until the jammed frame finally yields with a shriek of tortured metal. Reaching into the dark interior, you pull free a pristine, gleaming spool of copper wire untouched by the corrosive brine.

nodes.title: A Fragile Truce
nodes.brief: You carefully negotiate a fragile temporary truce between the screaming factions, risking sudden betrayal, to secure a sworn pledge of support from the fanatic Drift Pilgrims.
nodes.page: Shouting echoes off the damp stone as fanatical Drift Pilgrims and hardened guild wreckers raise their rusted blades across the narrow corridor. You step straight into the knife-edge between them, talking fast and low of the rising water that will drown believer and scavenger alike. A sudden dagger flickers near your throat, held by a wild-eyed zealot whose faith has turned to madness, but you do not flinch from the cold steel. The fanatic lowers the blade with a grudging spit, swearing a bitter oath of allegiance to your cause before melting back into the shadows.

exits.label: Secure the pledge from the Pilgrims

nodes.title: The Pilgrims' Vow
nodes.brief: You carefully negotiate a fragile temporary truce between the screaming factions, risking sudden betrayal, to secure a sworn pledge of support from the fanatic Drift Pilgrims.
nodes.page: Gray hoods pulled low over hollow eyes, the leaders of the Drift Pilgrims crowd into the echoing alcove, their breath pluming in the chill air. You hold out an open palm, sealing the uneasy pact with a firm grasp on a calloused, salt-encrusted wrist while daggers remain half-drawn in the gloom. They whisper prayers to the sleeping sea, swearing their lives to your command on the condition that the first wave washes clean the sins of the Brineholders. You tuck the signed parchment into your coat, knowing full well the price of their fanatic devotion.

exits.label: Accept the oath and move forward

nodes.title: Breaking the Mercenaries
nodes.brief: You brutally intimidate the Brineholder mercenaries into slowly backing down, risking a fatal stab in the dark, to confiscate their heavy iron lockboxes of coin.
nodes.page: Brineholder mercenaries grip their short-swords in the dripping gloom, their eyes fixed on your chest with cold calculation as you step into their path. You do not reach for a weapon; instead, you let a cruel, humorless grin touch your mouth as you name the bounty on their captains back in Gullmouth. A nervous twitch runs through the lead enforcer's shoulder, his blade dipping an inch as doubt eats away at his greed. He drops two heavy iron lockboxes of coin onto the wet flagstones with a dull thud, backing away into the dark with his men close behind.

exits.label: Confiscate the heavy lockboxes of coin

nodes.title: Splintering the Dial
nodes.brief: You threaten to completely shatter the central tide clock, risking the Choir's violent frenzy, to force the spirits into yielding a glowing spectral compass.
nodes.page: Shadows writhe inside the glass face of the central tide clock. Cold mist laps at your boots. You lift a jagged iron crowbar and aim it at the ticking brass gears, and the heart of the mechanism could come apart in a thousand useless shards. The Hollow Choir shrieks in unison, a wall of drowning wails fit to burst your eardrums and crack the stone vault. Under that menace the spectral voices falter and fold back into the damp masonry. A pale compass drifts from the trembling dial, its ghost-blue light hard through the gloom.

nodes.title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Sin
nodes.brief: You bravely confront Orsolya about her sudden disappearance, risking her remarkably volatile temper, to learn the devastating truth concerning the ancient Tidewardens' original watery sin.
nodes.page: Confronting Orsolya amid the dripping masonry feels like striking flint against dry salt. Her eyes flash with a familiar, dangerous heat, the sort of stubborn temper that once kept the Gullmouth beacon lit through the worst winter gales. Instead of shrinking back, you press her on the sudden disappearance, demanding to know why she fled into the dark roots of the stairs. She turns away, jaw tight, before whispering the terrible truth of the ancient Tidewardens and their original watery sin - a debt paid in drowned lives that the ocean has finally come to collect.

nodes.title: Striking the Mercenaries' Hoard
nodes.brief: You brutally intimidate the Brineholder mercenaries into slowly backing down, risking a fatal stab in the dark, to confiscate their heavy iron lockboxes of coin.
nodes.page: Cold steel scrapes against wet stone as you crowd the Brineholder mercenaries into a dripping corner of the corridor. They eye your stance and weigh the dark drop behind them against the raw fury in your grip. You let out a low, gravelly growl and step closer, daring the blade to find your ribs until their nerve breaks with a collective sigh of surrender. The bluff holds. Iron lockboxes packed with stolen coin hit the wet flags at your feet, yours for the taking.

nodes.title: Mending the Memory Coil
nodes.brief: You diligently repair the automaton's damaged memory-coil, risking a painful electrical surge, to receive a flawlessly accurate map of the seabed's shifting salt-flats and sinkholes.
nodes.page: Sparks spit from the exposed wiring of the automaton, stinging your knuckles with sharp, needle-like bursts of current. You keep your teeth gritted, steadying the delicate copper filament with a pair of salt-crusted pliers until the sputtering spark settles into a steady, rhythmic hum. The machine's glass optics flare to life, whirring as long-buried memory-coils align with a soft click. Out spills a flawlessly detailed map of the seabed's shifting salt-flats and hidden sinkholes, etched in fine blue light upon the damp flags.

nodes.title: The Final Reckoning
nodes.brief: With the black sea violently crashing against the reinforced glass, you grab the vibrating controls to make the ultimate, irrevocable choice of where the water falls.
nodes.page:
Black sea-water batters the reinforced glass overhead with the force of a falling mountain, groaning and fracturing under the pressure of the waiting deep. Your fingers wrap around the icy brass spokes of the Meridian Gear, the great mechanism vibrating violently against your palms as the tide clock strikes twelve. This is the ultimate crucible where every broken wreck, every drowned prayer, and every hard bargain converges. The fate of the coast hangs on a single pull, and no one else is here to bear the weight.

Choose how the waters fall, for the tide is breaking now.

exits.label: Sell the sea to the highest bidder
Leave the seabed dry and bare
Claim the tide for the wreckers

nodes.title: The First Drop Falls
nodes.brief: Ending "Return the Sea Gently"
nodes.page: Trembling brass yields to your grip as the great axle turns inward, spinning with a sound like a cathedral bell tolling underwater. A soft, cool sigh breathes through the vaulted chamber, carrying the clean scent of open kelp and deep salt. Above the reinforced glass, the furious wall of black water pauses its violent assault. The jagged pressure fractures spider-web and fade into harmless mist as the ocean begins to lower its massive head, sighing back into its ancient bed with infinite, measured grace.

nodes.title: The Low Submerged
nodes.brief: Ending "Return the Sea Gently"
nodes.page: Across the wide expanse of the Low, the wrecks and whale bones drink the returning flood in a long, bubbling gasp. Drowned streets and sun-bleached alleys fill slowly, the salt-crust dissolving into a rich, green-grey brine that remembers every ship that ever broke upon Gullmouth. There is no roar of destruction, only the steady, rising hiss of a million tiny ripples meeting at last. The tide-pool shrines fill one by one, their stone basins overflowing with clear, living foam under the grey light of noon.

nodes.title: The First Long Swell
nodes.brief: Ending "Return the Sea Gently"
nodes.page: A low, trembling vibration passes through the soles of your boots as the great brass cogs of the Meridian Gear finally shift into alignment, releasing a pent-up sigh of ancient steam that tastes of old salt and deep, forgotten mud. Far out across the grey, desolate expanse of the Low, a distant grey line darkens the horizon before a single, magnificent wall of green water surges forward to reclaim the naked seabed. It does not crash with violent fury, but rises with a steady, solemn grace, lifting stranded hulks and filling dry harbours as the tide comes home to Gullmouth once and for all.

exits.label: Watch the grey water rise against the cliff face

nodes.title: The Tide Remembered
nodes.brief: Ending "Return the Sea Gently"
nodes.page: You leave the Meridian Gear to its eternal clockwork, its brass cogs spinning smoothly in the quiet dark beneath the stairs. The sea has returned to where it belongs, washing over the secrets of the seabed and hiding the drowned things from the cruel light of day once more. License and ledger, coin and salt-shrine - they all fade into the rhythmic wash of the waves against the stone. Only the long pull of the tide remains, and the wash of waves against the shore.

nodes.title: Saltspire Beneath the Surge
nodes.brief: Ending "Drown Saltspire"
nodes.page: Water does not ask when it takes Saltspire back. It simply rises, and the wooden stilts answer with a long wet groan of timber and iron. The wealthy Brineholders who traded in bottled rain and hoarded moisture find their high balconies suddenly level with a churning grey-green sea that cares nothing for ledgers or sealed wells. From your vantage on the shore you watch the proud stilt-city shudder as the first great wall of brine hits its lower ladders. Baskets of precious water tumble into the foam. No bell rings for them. No ferryman waits. The tide climbs higher, turns parlours into tide-pools, and drowns the ledgers where the price of thirst was calculated. The water tastes of ancient slate and silt. It fills every doorway until Saltspire is nothing more than a cluster of drowning chimneys poking through the froth.

nodes.title: The Drowning of the Spires
nodes.brief: Ending "Drown Saltspire"
nodes.page: Beneath the surface, the grand pavilions of the Brineholders dissolve into silent gardens of drifting silt and swaying kelp, where crabs scuttle across velvet carpets and furniture bobs against carved ceilings. Down in the drowned streets, the wealth of a hundred seasons drifts away on the current, turning into mere wreckage that any common wrecker might claim with a gaff-hook. You stand at the water's edge and feel the spray cool your face, tasting the salt that Orsolya Venn spent her life watching from her windy tower. There is no triumph in the flood, only a deep, settling quiet as the sea reclaims the world it lent for a little while, smoothing over the footprints of the greedy and the desperate alike. The great brass cogs beneath the earth have done their work, and the world is wet again, smelling of wet wool and rotting kelp.

exits.label: Turn away from the grey expanse

nodes.title: The Endless Wet Horizon
nodes.brief: Ending "Drown Saltspire"
nodes.page: Gullmouth remains perched upon its high white cliffs, safe and salt-cured above the vast, restored ocean that stretches away to the grey horizon without a single break. Down below, the harbour is full once more, its stranded hulls lifting on the swell and knocking their wooden ribs together like old friends gossiping after a long absence. Orsolya Venn is still gone, vanished into the damp silence of the coast, but her lighthouse lamp burns bright again each evening, sweeping a yellow beam across the dark water to guide the returning boats home. You sit on the edge of the stone slipway with a mug of chicory and a dry pair of boots, listening to the familiar slap of the waves against the pilings. Water is back in the world, the tide clock ticks in the dark, and on the grey brine the wrecks wait for tomorrow's low tide to show what else the deep has swallowed.

nodes.title: Gullmouth Under the Green Wall
nodes.brief: Ending "Drown Gullmouth"
nodes.page: The cliff-town of Gullmouth goes down beneath a towering wall of green-black water that smells of old weed and rusted anchors. The narrow stone alleys where net-menders gossiped only yesterday choke with foam, and the whitewashed cottages smash like eggshells against the limestone cliffs under the returning flood. You scramble up the steep sheep-tracks toward the top of the ridge. Your home vanishes beneath a churning froth that tears roofs from rafters and drags the tavern stools out to sea. Down on the slipway the old boats that rested in the mud are snatched up, battered against the stone quays, and splintered into matchwood by the ocean. There is no time. You save neither kettle nor coil of rope as bitter freezing brine fills every corner of the town.

exits.label: Climb higher above the roaring surf

nodes.title: The Drowned Cliffs
nodes.brief: Ending "Drown Gullmouth"
nodes.page: From the high ledge where you cling to a stunted thorn bush, Gullmouth lies under a grey churning lake dotted with floating barrels, stray thatch, and the bobbing wreckage of a hundred lives. The marketplace is gone. Sea covers the pawn-widow's shop and the fish-salting sheds, and nothing moves except the gulls that wheel overhead across a bay that has become a vast graveyard. Down in the depths the streets where you grew up choke with weed and drowned furniture, and curious cod and the silent shades of the Hollow Choir are the only visitors left. You wipe salt spray from your eyes. A cold wind comes off the water, and the lighthouse bell clangs once as it dips beneath the rising flood. The brine takes the last dry roof.

exits.label: Walk the lonely path away inland

nodes.title: The Salt-Cured Wanderer
nodes.brief: Ending "Drown Gullmouth"
nodes.page: Inland the hills rise high and dry, untouched by the great flood that has reclaimed the coast and turned the lowlands into a seamless, grey-green sea stretching to every horizon. You walk alone along the sheep-tracks with your empty canvas sack over your shoulder, your boots caked in dried salt that scratches every time you take a step. Behind you, the sea breathes deep and steady against the newly sunken cliffs, erasing the last traces of Gullmouth and leaving only the wheeling gulls and the empty sky behind. There are no more tides to watch and no more clocks to turn, for the water has finally come home and stayed there, locking the secrets of the deep away from the sun forever. You pull your woollen collar tight against the wind and keep walking toward the interior, a wrecker with no port left to call home, carrying nothing but the taste of old salt on your tongue.

nodes.title: The Iron Hand
nodes.brief: Ending "Keep the Gear"
nodes.page: Salt dries white in your eyebrows as your boot rests upon the central cog of the Meridian Gear, heavy and cold as an anchor-stock. Below in the spiral shaft, the Hollow Choir falls silent at last, their watery laments choking down into a dull, rhythmic grinding that shakes the very bedrock of the Sunken Stair. Orsolya Venn would have called this stubbornness; you call it ownership. The Brineholders may send their ledgers and their stilted messengers down from Saltspire, but no clerk's ink can wash away the grease upon your palms or rewrite the oaths written in rust. You hold the brake lever with both hands, locking the great iron teeth into a permanent, immovable clinch that defies the tide clock on the wall.

exits.label: Lock the heavy iron lever fast

nodes.title: Masters of the Dry
nodes.brief: Ending "Keep the Gear"
nodes.page: Out across the Low, where whale bones bleach in the unshaded sun and rusted hulls lie stranded like broken ribs, the world waits for a wet word that never comes. No distant line of white foam darkens the western horizon; the seabed remains yours to roam, a vast desert of ancient mud and drowned streets where a wrecker can walk dry-shod from cliff to cliff. The Drift Pilgrims wander the salt-flats in bewildered clusters, muttering prayers to a sky that offers only glare and silence, while the pawn-widow back in Gullmouth counts out copper for iron spikes you no longer need to pull from timbers. You have turned your back on the water, choosing instead the unyielding sovereignty of the dry.

exits.label: Watch the empty grey horizon burn

nodes.title: A Kingdom of Salt
nodes.brief: Ending "Keep the Gear"
nodes.page: Nights on the high ledges of Gullmouth are quiet now, save for the wind whistling through the empty chimneys and the steady crunch of salt crystals forming in the harbour basins where boats rot in the dust. Beside your boots on the flags rests the brass key to the Meridian Gear, cold as the hearth, a dead thing that once commanded the deep. Orsolya is gone, swallowed by the dark or the distance, but the light in the keeper's tower stays dark by your own decree, a warning to anyone who thinks the sea might someday remember its old masters and come rushing back to claim what it lost. Nothing moves upon the flats, nothing stirs in the weed-choked streets, and the vast grey basin holds a silence as complete as a closed tomb.

nodes.title: The Price of Water
nodes.brief: Ending "Sell the Sea"
nodes.page: Gold coins clink on the bronze casing of the Meridian Gear, dense as wet clay, stacked in neat greedy pillars by Brineholders' factors who crowded down the Sunken Stair with ledgers tucked in their oiled coats. They pay in bright, hard coin minted in Saltspire, buying every fathom of the seabed and every drop of water that might one day return to fill the empty harbours and drown the lowlands once more. You sweep the metal tokens into a leather sack until your shoulders ache under the dead weight of their wealth, trading the ancient power of the tides for a pouch that makes you richer than any wrecker who ever scavenged a rib-bone or stripped a drowned spar.

exits.label: Take the heavy bags of coin

nodes.title: Lords on Stilts
nodes.brief: Ending "Sell the Sea"
nodes.page: Saltspire celebrates beneath a canopy of flapping oilskin banners as the news travels up the long wooden ladders that the water is at last officially for sale to any town willing to pay the pipe-tax. From the high balconies of the stilted city, you watch the wealthy Brineholders uncork their private casks and toast the new monopoly, their laughter echoing across the vast, dry expanse of the Low where Gullmouth's empty boats lie baking in the mud. The Drift Pilgrims curse your name from the salt-flats, screaming up at the brass balconies where you stand draped in velvet bought with tide-gold, but their dry throats can raise no storm to wash away the ledgers that now bind the sea to a merchant's ledger-book.

exits.label: Look down upon the dusty flats

nodes.title: The Sold Horizon
nodes.brief: Ending "Sell the Sea"
nodes.page: Wealth buys a high seat and a quiet room above the reach of the old tide, but it cannot wash the smell of dried weed from your clothes or make the silence of the seabed feel any less like a judgment. The brass key hangs on a hook by the door, a polished bauble that turned the entire world into a marketplace where everything from a whale carcass to a breaking wave has its price tag pinned to its ribs. Down in Gullmouth, the net-menders have long since gone inland, leaving the grey cliffs to the gulls and the sun, while out on the polished flats the Brineholders drive their iron stakes to mark the boundaries of an ocean they now own by the yard. You sit by the window with a cup of stale water, rich beyond reckoning and poorer than a beggar standing on the naked floor of the world.

nodes.title: The Choir's Choir
nodes.brief: Ending "The Choir's Choir"
nodes.page: Voices rise from the salt-crusted masonry of the Sunken Stair, thin and clear as grease-light on iron, singing the water back to a bed that has forgotten its weight. You stand knee-deep in the rising brine while the Hollow Choir weave their harmonies from old ribs and drowned brass, each note drawing the grey ocean up through the spiral floor with the steady pull of an anchor-chain. Orsolya Venn would have called this foolishness, but Orsolya is gone into the spray, and only the tread of her boots stays in your memory. The tide comes not as a conqueror or a gift, but as a long-withheld confession spilling out between the stone teeth of the coast. The chill climbs your shins, tasting of old kelp and copper filings, enough water to drown a town or wash a debt clean off the slate.

exits.label: Listen to the drowned voices rise

nodes.title: Below the Salt
nodes.brief: Ending "The Choir's Choir"
nodes.page: Water laps against your chest now, grey and opaque with silt, turning the dark shafts into a submerged cathedral where only the dead have standing room. The Brineholders' ledgers drift past your shoulders like bloated white fish, their gold ink dissolving into the swell before the clerks can reckon the price of an inch of lift. There is no air left to breathe that does not taste of salt and iron, yet your lungs refuse to give up the ghost, held by some strange bargain struck in the dark with the things that stayed behind when the tide went out. Above, the sky is a narrow strip of pale slate, shrinking as the sea reclaims its chambers and locks the doors against the sun. You let your feet leave the bottom, trusting the lift of the brine to carry you where it will among the rafters of the sunken world.

nodes.title: The Endless Deep
nodes.brief: Ending "The Choir's Choir"
nodes.page: Gullmouth is only a cluster of wet chimneys against the horizon now, swallowed by the grey heave of a sea that has decided never to retreat again. The Meridian Gear spins on its own beneath the waves, locked in a rhythm too slow for mortal ears, turning the world back into a silent place of weed and bone. You float among the drowned streets where the fish swim through parlor windows and the net-menders' benches wear green kelp; cold and hunger do not reach you in the deep dark. There are no more bells to ring and no more ships to wreck upon the rocks, only the slow, rhythmic pulse of the water overhead and the company of those who never left. The salt-crust on your skin dissolves at last, leaving you as smooth and empty as a river-stone polished by a thousand years of tide.

nodes.title: The Long Dry
nodes.brief: Ending "The Long Dry"
nodes.page: Dust settles over Gullmouth like a grey fleece, thick enough to blunt the sound of footsteps on the cobbles and choke the remaining wells until they cough up only dry sand. The Low stretches out to the horizon like an unplowed field of white bones and rusted iron, baking under a sun that refuses to set or soften its glare. Down in the town square, the net-menders sit on overturned tubs with empty bowls between their knees, staring at the dry harbour where the gulls have died of thirst upon the mud-banks. No water comes through the pipes, and no ships come up the channel, for the Brineholders have locked their cisterns behind iron grates and left the poor to chew on leather straps and memories of foam. You wipe the alkali from your cracked lips and watch the horizon shimmer with heat-ghosts that look for all the world like white-capped waves.

exits.label: Walk out onto the dry seabed

nodes.title: Bone and Alkali
nodes.brief: Ending "The Long Dry"
nodes.page: Salt cakes the windows of the cliff-houses until they are as opaque as sheep-skull bone, shutting out the merciless glare of a sky that has forgotten how to cloud over. You walk the empty floor of the bay where the great leviathan carcass rots into the silt, its ribs standing against the pale air like the skeleton of an unfinished church. The ferryman sits by his dry dock with an oar across his knees, sharpening the blade with a dry stone that screeches through the stillness like a dying gull. Everyone stays indoors now, hoarding the last drops of brackish water in earthenware jars and listening to the wind whistle through the empty chimneys of a town that has nothing left to sell. The world has grown narrow and dry, reduced to the thickness of a dried skin stretched tight over a wooden frame, waiting for a rain that never gathers in the upper air.

exits.label: Cross the white flats to the silence

nodes.title: The Quiet Shore
nodes.brief: Ending "The Long Dry"
nodes.page: There is no salt left in the air, only the bitter taste of limestone dust and the dry smell of old wreckage baking in the sun until the timber cracks. You reach the outer edge of the Low where the sea used to begin, but there is nothing there now except more flat, white earth stretching away under a brassy heaven toward an invisible edge. Orsolya Venn's lighthouse stands upon its cliff like a blind man's eye, looking out over a world that has traded its tides for stone and silence. You drop your wrecker's hook into the dust; it hits the hard ground with a dull clack, raising no spray and making no ripple in the air. The tide clock on the shelf in the hall has stopped at low water, its copper hand pointing forever toward a dry horizon that swallows the sun without a hiss.

nodes.title: Orsolya's Final Measure
nodes.brief: Ending "Orsolya's Way"
nodes.page: Under the vast, empty sky, Orsolya's hand remains steady upon the Meridian Gear, guiding its brass teeth back into their ancient, deliberate alignment. The iron groans against centuries of silence, but as the final tooth slips into place the mechanism lets out a deep sigh that travels right through the soles of your boots. Bitter alkali dust in the air settles abruptly under a sudden dampness that smells intensely of cold weed and deep trenches. Far out on the bare seabed, the white salt crust shivers, fracturing along a thousand unseen lines as the earth itself seems to catch its breath. Orsolya does not look at you, her gaze fixed entirely on the bronze face of the tide clock as the pointer trembles and begins to swing backward with gathering speed.

exits.label: Watch the copper dial spin around

nodes.title: The Return of the Deep
nodes.brief: Ending "Orsolya's Way"
nodes.page: Water comes back not with a wall of white spray, but as a low, continuous rumble that shakes the foundations of Saltspire and rattles the dry timbers of Gullmouth's empty harbour. A dark, smooth line appears at the absolute edge of the western horizon, swallowing the bleached ribs of the sunken leviathan and racing across the flat expanses of the Low with terrifying grace. You stand beside the open shaft of the Sunken Stair, feeling the cold wind rise up from the depths as the sea reclaims its rightful floor. The Brineholders' high platforms on stilts tremble as the surge hits their pilings, sending a sudden mist of spray high into the sunlit air to catch the light in fleeting, brilliant arcs of green and grey.

exits.label: Step back from the rising edge

nodes.title: Salt on the Threshold
nodes.brief: Ending "Orsolya's Way"
